# Fase 3 — Penjadwalan (Jadwal Dokter): Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Fase ini membangun **penjadwalan dokter**:
- tiga lapis jadwal (templat mingguan, pengecualian cuti/libur, sesi per tanggal);
- `DoctorAvailabilityQuery` sebagai satu sumber jadwal;
- propagasi perubahan (`ScheduleChangeService`, 00 F.4);
- halaman admin #35 (Templat, Sesi, Pengecualian);
- halaman publik #6 Daftar Dokter, #7 Detail Dokter, #8 Jadwal Dokter;
- skema booking (`patient_profiles`, `appointments`, `appointment_status_histories`) beserta spike konkurensi.

Booking sungguhan (wizard, `BookingService`) baru dibangun di fase 6. Layar Sesi Terdampak (resolusi) dibangun di fase 7.

**Architecture:** Arsitektur fase 1–2 tetap berlaku: monolit Laravel 12, controller tipis, Form Request, Policy per model, aturan bisnis di `app/Services`, pelaku `Actor`.
- **Namespace `App\Services\Scheduling`** berisi:
  - `PracticeSessionGenerator`: pembangkitan idempoten `insertOrIgnore`;
  - `DoctorAvailabilityQuery`: baca saja, klasifikasi label 00 F.3;
  - `ScheduleChangeService`: satu-satunya jalur tulis templat/pengecualian/sesi setelah simpan, dengan audit eksplisit;
  - DTO `AvailabilityFilter`, `SessionAvailability`, `ScheduleChangeReport`.
- **`App\Services\Booking\BookingRules`** dibuat di fase ini sebagai snapshot pengaturan `booking.*` saja (tanpa `assertBookable`, yang menyusul di fase 6).
- **Model jadwal tidak diobservasi `AuditObserver`.** Audit ditulis service.
- **Tautan ke route fase berikutnya** (`patient.appointments.create`, `admin.sessions.review`) tetap disaring `Route::has()`.

**Tech Stack:** sama dengan fase 2. PHP 8.2.12 (XAMPP `C:\xampp3`), Laravel 12.69, MariaDB 10.4.32, spatie/laravel-permission 6.25, Bootstrap 5.3 + Sass + Vite 7, PHPUnit 11, Pint. **Tanpa paket baru.**

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-unpam-hospital-blueprint/`. Bagian utama yang dipakai:

## Global Constraints

- **XAMPP dan Prelude P.**
  - XAMPP ada di **`C:\xampp3`** (PHP 8.2.12). Apache dan MySQL harus di-**Start** sebelum tes.
  - Setiap perintah PowerShell diawali **Prelude P**:
    `$XAMPP = "C:\xampp3"; $PHP = "$XAMPP\php\php.exe"; $COMPOSER = "C:\composer\composer.phar"; $APP = "D:\Project Web RS"; $env:Path = "$XAMPP\php;$env:Path"; Set-Location $APP`
- **Perintah dan paket.** PHP dijalankan dengan `& $PHP …`. Tidak ada paket Composer/npm baru.
- **Kompatibilitas PHP 8.2–8.4.**
  - Dilarang memakai fitur khusus 8.3+: typed class constants, `#[\Override]`, `json_validate()`, property hooks, `new` tanpa kurung pada chaining.
  - Berkas baru di `app/Services`, `app/Support`, `app/Rules`, `app/Policies`, dan `app/View/Components` diawali `declare(strict_types=1);`.
- **Nama.**
  - Nama tabel, kolom, enum, route, URI, izin, Form Request, Policy, service, dan method harus **persis** seperti 00/09/10/11/12 dan kerangka ini.
  - Nama baru hanya yang tercantum di bagian D.
  - **Enum di `app/Enums` tidak boleh ditambah atau diubah**, karena `EnumCatalogTest` mengunci 15 berkas beserta label/warna/ikonnya.
  - **Izin tidak boleh ditambah.** Tetap 19 izin; `schedules.view`, `schedules.manage`, dan `sessions.review` sudah ada.
- **Bahasa.**
  - Identifier kode berbahasa Inggris.
  - Teks UI, pesan validasi, flash, dan deskripsi audit berbahasa Indonesia.
  - Flash berupa kalimat lengkap yang berakhir titik.
- **Waktu.**
  - Zona aplikasi `Asia/Jakarta`.
  - "Hari ini" dan "sekarang" selalu diambil dari `now()`/`today()` atau `CarbonImmutable::now()` aplikasi, **tidak pernah** dari `NOW()`/`CURDATE()` SQL.
  - Tes waktu memakai `$this->travelTo(...)` atau `Carbon::setTestNow(...)`, dan setiap tes yang bergantung waktu menetapkan waktunya sendiri.
- **Mode ketat.**
  - `Model::shouldBeStrict()` aktif di non-produksi. Semua relasi yang dipakai view, accessor, atau komponen wajib di-eager-load.
  - Tes daftar memakai beberapa baris sekaligus agar lazy loading terdeteksi.
  - Kolom sistem (`booked_count`, `last_queue_number`, `status` appointment, dan sejenisnya) diisi lewat `forceFill`.
  - `active_flag` tidak pernah ditulis.
- **Database tes.**
  - Tes memakai MariaDB `unpam_hospital_test` dengan `RefreshDatabase`. Peran dibuat lewat `InteractsWithStaff::seedRoles()`/`createStaff()`, dan data master lewat `InteractsWithMasterData`.
  - Tes yang memakai **koneksi PDO kedua** (spike konkurensi) tidak boleh berjalan di dalam transaksi `RefreshDatabase`. Lihat T3.
- **Migration.**
  - Migration yang sudah ada **tidak boleh** diubah.
  - Migration fase 3 memakai nama 09 §10 persis, dan CHECK ditambahkan lewat `DB::statement` dengan nama constraint 09 §11:
    - `2026_10_02_000100_create_patient_profiles_table`
    - `2026_10_02_000600_create_doctor_schedules_table`
    - `2026_10_02_000700_create_schedule_exceptions_table`
    - `2026_10_02_000800_create_practice_sessions_table`
    - `2026_10_02_000900_create_insurance_partners_table`
    - `2026_10_02_001000_create_appointments_table`
    - `2026_10_02_001100_create_appointment_status_histories_table`
- **Output HTML.**
  - `{!! !!}` tetap **hanya** untuk `clinics.description` (`RawOutputScanTest`). `doctors.bio` adalah teks biasa: tampilkan dengan `{{ }}` dan CSS `white-space: pre-line`.
  - Tidak boleh ada atribut event inline, tidak ada string `onerror`, dan tidak ada CDN.
  - CSP `img-src 'self' data:` tidak dilonggarkan.
  - Tidak ada entri Vite baru dan tidak ada listener `error` kedua (`FrontendManifestTest`).
- **Route.**
  - Route admin berada di dalam grup G-ADMIN `routes/admin.php`, masing-masing dengan `permission:*`.
  - Parameter bernama `{schedule}`, `{exception}`, dan `{session}`; batas numeriknya sudah ada di `bootstrap/app.php`.
  - Segmen statis didaftarkan **sebelum** segmen berparameter.
  - Route publik ditulis di `routes/web.php`.
  - Tidak boleh ada route `DELETE` di bawah `admin/dokter*` (`Phase2RoutePermissionTest`).
- **Super Admin.** `Gate::before` meloloskan Super Admin dari semua Policy. Aturan mutlak berikut ditegakkan di **service** atau Form Request, bukan Policy:
  - sesi lampau tidak diubah;
  - kuota tidak boleh di bawah `booked_count`;
  - dokter arsip tidak diberi jadwal;
  - hapus templat atau sesi yang dirujuk ditolak;
  - arsip dokter dengan appointment aktif mendatang ditolak.
- **Penulisan berkas.**
  - Pakai tool Write/Edit. Repo memakai akhiran baris **LF**, dan setiap `old` pada Edit harus cocok tepat satu kali.
  - Bila menulis lewat PowerShell, pakai `[IO.File]::WriteAllText(path, text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))`.
  - `.env*` tidak pernah di-commit.
- **Cabang dan commit.**
  - Cabang kerja `fase-3-jadwal-dokter` (sudah dibuat dari `master`).
  - Format pesan commit: `tipe(fase-3): ringkasan`, diakhiri `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
  - Di setiap commit `artisan test` hijau dan `vendor\bin\pint --test` bersih.
  - Bila menyentuh `resources/js` atau `resources/scss`, `npm run build` harus sukses.
- **Langkah MANUAL.** Langkah bertanda **MANUAL (koordinator)** dijalankan koordinator lewat Playwright di akhir fase. Implementer melewatinya.
- **Database pengembangan.** Implementer **tidak** menjalankan `migrate:fresh`, `db:seed`, atau `sessions:generate` pada database pengembangan `unpam_hospital`. Langkah itu dijalankan koordinator dengan izin eksplisit pemilik di gerbang Task 16.

## Review Focus

1. **Batas waktu dan jendela.** Kasus yang harus diuji:
   - sesi hari ini yang `end_time`-nya sudah lewat versus belum;
   - tepat pada `start − booking.online_cutoff_minutes`;
   - hari ke-30 versus ke-31 dari jendela;
   - pergantian hari 23:59 → 00:00;
   - `minggu` di luar jendela.

   Harapan: label `past`/`booking_closed`/`available` persis menurut 00 F.3, flag `is_bookable_online`/`is_bookable_counter` konsisten, dan tidak ada 500. → T5 (`DoctorAvailabilityQueryTest`) dan T14 (`PublicScheduleTest`).
2. **Templat bertetangga, beririsan, dan berbeda rentang berlaku.** Contoh: 08:00–12:00 dengan 12:00–15:00 (bersebelahan, diterima); 08:00–12:00 dengan 11:00–13:00 (beririsan, ditolak bila rentang berlaku beririsan dan keduanya aktif); templat nonaktif tidak dihitung bentrok; ubah templat tidak bentrok dengan dirinya sendiri. → T9 (`DoctorScheduleRequestTest`).
3. **Pemicu berurutan pada sesi ber-appointment aktif dan sesi lampau.** Contoh: ubah jam templat lalu tambah cuti, cuti lalu ubah jam, nonaktifkan dokter saat sesi `needs_review`, cabut cuti saat sesi `needs_review`, serta sesi yang sudah lewat. Harapan: prioritas `pending_change` 00 F.4 (jenis-batal mengalahkan jenis-jam), penggantian diaudit, sesi lampau dan sesi `is_manually_modified` tidak tersentuh propagasi templat, dan appointment lama tetap aktif. → T6, T7, T8.
4. **Parameter publik tidak valid dan dokter tidak tampil.** Contoh: `/dokter?tanggal=abc&spesialisasi=tidak-ada&poli[]=x`, `/jadwal-dokter?minggu=xx`, `/dokter/{slug}` untuk dokter nonaktif/arsip/poliklinik nonaktif (juga saat staf login), dan banyak dokter × banyak sesi di mode ketat. Harapan: 200 tanpa filter yang tidak valid; 404 untuk dokter tak tampil; tanpa `LazyLoadingViolationException`. → T13, T14.
5. **Aturan mutlak juga mengikat Super Admin.** Contoh: hapus templat yang punya sesi ber-appointment (termasuk yang hanya riwayat batal), hapus sesi hasil templat atau sesi manual ber-appointment, turunkan kuota di bawah `booked_count`, ubah atau batalkan sesi lampau, beri templat ke dokter arsip, dan arsipkan dokter yang punya appointment aktif mendatang. Harapan: ditolak dengan pesan Indonesia (flash `error` atau galat validasi), bukan 500 FK dan bukan lolos. → T6, T8, T9, T10, T12.

## Keterbatasan yang diketahui

Butir berikut disengaja dan tidak dikerjakan di fase 3:
- Sesi `needs_review` bersumber `template_time` yang jamnya kembali sama dengan templat (templat dikembalikan) tetap menunggu tinjauan petugas; tidak dibuka otomatis.
- Sesi `cancelled` "Jadwal berubah" tidak dibuka otomatis saat templat diaktifkan kembali. Sesi itu dibuka manual lewat `setSessionStatus(Open)`; UNIQUE (`doctor_schedule_id`, `session_date`) mencegah pembangkitan ulang pada tanggal itu.
- Templat milik dokter arsip tidak dapat diubah (V-23 menolak dokter arsip); templat itu sudah nonaktif dan hanya dapat dibaca atau dihapus. Setelah dokter dipulihkan (status `inactive`), templat dapat diubah lagi.
- Laporan `applyException` tidak menghitung sesi yang dibangkitkan `ensureRange`; laporannya hanya memuat sesi dibatalkan, perlu ditindaklanjuti, dan dibuka kembali.
- `PATCH admin.sessions.status` ke status yang sama tidak mengubah apa pun, tetapi flash tetap tampil. UI hanya menampilkan tombol yang mengubah status.

### Task 1: Skema jadwal dan booking (7 migration) dan tes skema

**Files:**
- Create: `database/migrations/2026_10_02_000100_create_patient_profiles_table.php`
- Create: `database/migrations/2026_10_02_000600_create_doctor_schedules_table.php`
- Create: `database/migrations/2026_10_02_000700_create_schedule_exceptions_table.php`
- Create: `database/migrations/2026_10_02_000800_create_practice_sessions_table.php`
- Create: `database/migrations/2026_10_02_000900_create_insurance_partners_table.php`
- Create: `database/migrations/2026_10_02_001000_create_appointments_table.php`
- Create: `database/migrations/2026_10_02_001100_create_appointment_status_histories_table.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Database/ScheduleSchemaTest.php` (folder `tests/Feature/Database` baru)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: tabel `users`, `doctors`, `clinics` (fase 1-2, tidak diubah); `Doctor::factory()`, `Clinic::factory()`, `User::factory()` untuk baris induk di tes; enum `AppointmentStatus::ACTIVE` (fase 1, tidak diubah). Model fase 3 **belum ada**, sehingga seluruh insert tes memakai `DB::table()`.
- Produces (persis kamus data):
  - Tujuh tabel dengan nama berkas migration 09 §10: `patient_profiles`, `doctor_schedules`, `schedule_exceptions`, `practice_sessions`, `insurance_partners`, `appointments`, `appointment_status_histories`.
  - Sebelas CHECK bernama (09 §11.3), semuanya lewat `DB::statement('ALTER TABLE … ADD CONSTRAINT …')` pada migration yang sama dengan tabelnya:
    - `doctor_schedules`: `chk_schedules_time`, `chk_schedules_day`, `chk_schedules_quota`, `chk_schedules_validity`;
    - `schedule_exceptions`: `chk_exceptions_dates`, `chk_schedule_exceptions_scope`;
    - `practice_sessions`: `chk_sessions_quota`, `chk_sessions_time`, `chk_sessions_quota_range`, `chk_sessions_queue`;
    - `appointments`: `chk_appointments_queue`.
  - Satu CHECK JSON otomatis `practice_sessions.pending_change` (`json_valid`), dari `$table->json()` (nama CHECK = nama kolom).
  - Kolom generated `appointments.active_flag` (`tinyInteger()->nullable()->storedAs(...)`), UNIQUE `appointments_patient_session_active_unique` (nama eksplisit), dan UNIQUE `practice_sessions_doctor_schedule_id_session_date_unique`.
  - `insurance_partners` **tanpa CHECK** (09 §6.7: "CHECK constraint: tidak ada").
  - `down()` setiap migration = `Schema::dropIfExists('<tabel>')` (CHECK ikut terhapus bersama tabel).

**Test IDs:** KON-01 (sisi skema: UNIQUE aktif dan CHECK kuota), JDW-13 (sisi DB: banyak `doctor_schedule_id` NULL), JDW-18 (sisi DB: `chk_schedule_exceptions_scope`), VAL-05 (bagian "CHECK DB" sebagai pagar terakhir; pagar Form Request di Task 9), invarian I-7, I-8, I-15 (`active_flag` selaras dengan enum), I-34.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Urutan penomoran (F3-R2).** Migration `000100` (`patient_profiles`) lebih awal daripada migration fase 2 (`000200`–`000500`) yang sudah jalan. Laravel menjalankannya sebagai migration tertunda, dan `migrate:fresh` (yang dipakai `RefreshDatabase`) mengikuti urutan nama berkas tanpa melanggar FK karena `patient_profiles` hanya merujuk `users`. `insurance_partners` (`000900`) harus mendahului `appointments` (`001000`). `RolePermissionSeederTest` hanya mengunci berkas `*_create_permission_tables.php`, sehingga tidak terpengaruh.
- **DB pengembangan.** Implementer **tidak** menjalankan `migrate` atau `migrate:fresh` pada `unpam_hospital`. Tes memigrasi `unpam_hospital_test` sendiri. Migrasi DB pengembangan (dan seed ulang) dilakukan koordinator dengan izin pemilik pada gerbang fase (Task 16).
- **Tipe dan default yang dilaporkan MariaDB 10.4** (dipakai tes seperti `MasterDataSchemaTest`): `bigint(20) unsigned`, `tinyint(3) unsigned` (`day_of_week`), `smallint(5) unsigned`, `tinyint(1)`, `char(4)`, `longtext` (kolom `json()`; `MariaDbGrammar` Laravel 12.69 tidak menimpa `typeJson`, jadi DDL-nya `json` dan MariaDB mengubahnya menjadi `longtext` + `CHECK (json_valid(...))`). Default NULL dilaporkan sebagai string `"NULL"` dan default string dengan kutip, sehingga tes menormalkannya.
- **Kolom generated.** `Schema::getColumns()` (Laravel 12.69) mengisi kunci `generation` (`type`, `expression`) bila `information_schema.columns.generation_expression` terisi. `MySqlGrammar::modifyNullable()` tidak menambahkan `null`/`not null` pada kolom generated kecuali `nullable(false)`, sehingga `->nullable()->storedAs(...)` menghasilkan DDL yang diterima MariaDB (diverifikasi 09 §14.1). Tes membuktikan sifat STORED lewat `SHOW CREATE TABLE`.
- **Menulis `active_flag` ditolak** dengan errno 1906 pada MariaDB 10.4 (09 §14.1, 11.4). Aplikasi tidak pernah menulisnya; Task 2 memastikan `active_flag` tidak ada di `$fillable`.
- **CHECK.** Pelanggaran memberi SQLSTATE `23000` dan errno `4025` (bukan 3819 seperti MySQL 8). Pesan memuat nama constraint diapit backtick, sehingga tes mencocokkan `` `chk_sessions_quota` `` (dengan backtick) agar tidak ikut cocok dengan `chk_sessions_quota_range`. Setiap kasus pelanggaran hanya melanggar satu constraint.
- **`chk_media_owner` (fase 2) tetap ada**, sehingga tes daftar CHECK dibatasi pada empat tabel fase 3 (`information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS` memuat semua tabel di database).
- **Index otomatis FK.** Pada kolom FK yang sudah tertutup index lain (mis. `doctor_schedules.doctor_id` oleh index `(doctor_id, day_of_week, is_active)`), MariaDB membuang index otomatis `*_foreign`. Karena itu tes **tidak** menegaskan keberadaan index `*_foreign` untuk kolom-kolom itu, hanya untuk FK yang tidak tertutup index lain (`clinic_id`, `created_by`, dst.) sesuai daftar 09. Nama FK tetap `{tabel}_{kolom}_foreign` dan semuanya ≤ 64 karakter (terpanjang: `appointment_status_histories_appointment_id_created_at_index`, 60 karakter).
- **`INSERT IGNORE`** (dipakai generator di Task 4) mengabaikan baris duplikat UNIQUE dan mengembalikan jumlah baris yang benar-benar tersisip (0 untuk duplikat); kegagalan CHECK tetap galat (09 §14). Tes `test_insert_ignore_is_idempotent_on_the_session_unique_key` mengunci perilaku ini.
- **Mode strict SQL.** Kolom `NOT NULL` tanpa default wajib diisi pada insert tes (mis. `appointments.queue_number`, `status`, `channel`, `payment_type`); pembantu insert tes memenuhinya.
- Jumlah tes: **227** (provider kolom 106, urutan kolom 7, index 42, FK 22, pelanggaran CHECK 19, dan 31 tes perilaku).
- Semua blok PHP lolos `php -l` 8.2 dan `pint --test`.

```php
    /**
     * Pelanggaran CHECK: nama constraint dan penyisipan yang melanggarnya. Setiap kasus hanya melanggar
     * satu constraint agar nama pada pesan galat tidak ambigu.
     *
     * @return array<string, array{0: string, 1: Closure}>
     */
    public static function checkViolations(): array
    {
        return [
            'chk_schedules_time: jam terbalik' => ['chk_schedules_time', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSchedule(['start_time' => '12:00:00', 'end_time' => '08:00:00'])],
            'chk_schedules_time: jam sama' => ['chk_schedules_time', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSchedule(['start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '08:00:00'])],
            'chk_schedules_day: hari 0' => ['chk_schedules_day', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSchedule(['day_of_week' => 0])],
            'chk_schedules_day: hari 8' => ['chk_schedules_day', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSchedule(['day_of_week' => 8])],
            'chk_schedules_quota: kuota 0' => ['chk_schedules_quota', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSchedule(['quota' => 0])],
            'chk_schedules_quota: kuota 201' => ['chk_schedules_quota', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSchedule(['quota' => 201])],
            'chk_schedules_validity: berlaku terbalik' => ['chk_schedules_validity', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSchedule(['valid_from' => '2026-10-10', 'valid_until' => '2026-10-09'])],
            'chk_exceptions_dates: rentang terbalik' => ['chk_exceptions_dates', fn (self $t) => $t->insertException(['start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-11'])],
            'chk_schedule_exceptions_scope: cuti dokter tanpa dokter' => ['chk_schedule_exceptions_scope', fn (self $t) => $t->insertException(['type' => 'doctor_leave', 'doctor_id' => null])],
            'chk_schedule_exceptions_scope: libur RS berdokter' => ['chk_schedule_exceptions_scope', fn (self $t) => $t->insertException(['type' => 'hospital_holiday', 'doctor_id' => $t->doctorId()])],
            'chk_schedule_exceptions_scope: libur nasional berdokter' => ['chk_schedule_exceptions_scope', fn (self $t) => $t->insertException(['type' => 'national_holiday', 'doctor_id' => $t->doctorId()])],
            'chk_sessions_quota: terisi melebihi kuota' => ['chk_sessions_quota', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSession(['quota' => 5, 'booked_count' => 6, 'last_queue_number' => 6])],
            'chk_sessions_quota_range: kuota 0' => ['chk_sessions_quota_range', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSession(['quota' => 0])],
            'chk_sessions_quota_range: kuota 201' => ['chk_sessions_quota_range', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSession(['quota' => 201])],
            'chk_sessions_time: jam terbalik' => ['chk_sessions_time', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSession(['start_time' => '12:00:00', 'end_time' => '08:00:00'])],
            'chk_sessions_time: jam sama' => ['chk_sessions_time', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSession(['start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '08:00:00'])],
            'chk_sessions_queue: pencacah di bawah terisi' => ['chk_sessions_queue', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSession(['quota' => 5, 'booked_count' => 2, 'last_queue_number' => 1])],
            'chk_appointments_queue: nomor antrean 0' => ['chk_appointments_queue', fn (self $t) => $t->insertAppointment(['queue_number' => 0])],
            'pending_change: bukan JSON' => ['pending_change', fn (self $t) => $t->insertSession(['pending_change' => 'bukan json'])],
        ];
    }

    // --- Pembantu skema ---

    /** @return array<string, array<string, mixed>> */
    private function columnsOf(string $table): array
    {
        $columns = [];

        foreach (Schema::getColumns($table) as $column) {
            $columns[$column['name']] = $column;
        }

        return $columns;
    }

    /** MariaDB 10.4 melaporkan default NULL sebagai string "NULL" dan default string dengan kutip. */
    private function normalizedDefault(?string $default): ?string
    {
        if ($default === null || strtoupper($default) === 'NULL') {
            return null;
        }

        return trim($default, "'");
    }

    /** @return array<string, array<string, mixed>> */
    private function indexesOf(string $table): array
    {
        $indexes = [];

        foreach (Schema::getIndexes($table) as $index) {
            $indexes[$index['name']] = $index;
        }

        return $indexes;
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    private function namedChecks(): array
    {
        $rows = DB::select(
            'SELECT TABLE_NAME AS table_name, CONSTRAINT_NAME AS constraint_name
             FROM information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS
             WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
               AND CONSTRAINT_NAME LIKE ?
               AND TABLE_NAME IN (?, ?, ?, ?)',
            ['chk\\_%', 'doctor_schedules', 'schedule_exceptions', 'practice_sessions', 'appointments'],
        );

        $names = array_map(fn ($row): string => $row->table_name.'.'.$row->constraint_name, $rows);
        sort($names);

        return $names;
    }

    // --- Pembantu insert ---

    private function doctorId(): int
    {
        if ($this->doctorId === null) {
            $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
            $this->doctorId = $doctor->id;
            $this->clinicId = $doctor->clinic_id;
        }

        return $this->doctorId;
    }

    private function clinicId(): int
    {
        $this->doctorId();

        return (int) $this->clinicId;
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function insertUserId(array $overrides = []): int
    {
        return User::factory()->create($overrides)->id;
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    public function insertSchedule(array $overrides = []): int
    {
        return DB::table('doctor_schedules')->insertGetId(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctorId(),
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinicId(),
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-05',
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    public function insertException(array $overrides = []): int
    {
        return DB::table('schedule_exceptions')->insertGetId(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => null,
            'type' => 'other',
            'start_date' => '2026-10-10',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'reason' => 'Contoh pengecualian',
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    public function insertSession(array $overrides = []): int
    {
        return DB::table('practice_sessions')->insertGetId(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctorId(),
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinicId(),
            'session_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    public function insertPatient(array $overrides = []): int
    {
        return DB::table('patient_profiles')->insertGetId(array_merge([
            'full_name' => 'Pasien Contoh',
            'birth_date' => '1990-01-01',
            'gender' => 'L',
            'phone' => '081234567890',
            'address' => 'Jl. Contoh No. 1',

        ], $overrides));

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    public function insertInsurancePartner(array $overrides = []): int
    {
        $this->counter++;

        return DB::table('insurance_partners')->insertGetId(array_merge([
            'name' => "Asuransi Contoh {$this->counter}",
            'slug' => "asuransi-contoh-{$this->counter}",
            'type' => 'asuransi',
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * Appointment pada sesi bersama (kuota 50). Pasien baru dibuat untuk setiap pemanggilan kecuali
     * `patient_profile_id` diberikan; nomor antrean dan kode booking dibuat unik otomatis.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    public function insertAppointment(array $overrides = []): int
    {
        $this->counter++;

        if ($this->sessionId === null) {
            $this->sessionId = $this->insertSession(['quota' => 50]);
        }

        return DB::table('appointments')->insertGetId(array_merge([
            'booking_code' => sprintf('UPH-%04d-TEST', $this->counter),
            'patient_profile_id' => $this->insertPatient(),
            'practice_session_id' => $this->sessionId,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctorId(),
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinicId(),
            'session_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'queue_number' => $this->counter,
            'status' => 'pending',
            'channel' => 'online',
            'payment_type' => 'umum',
        ], $overrides));
    }

        $this->assertArrayHasKey($name, $columns, "Kolom {$table}.{$name} belum ada.");

    }

    // --- Perilaku CHECK (errno 4025) ---

    #[DataProvider('checkViolations')]
    public function test_check_constraint_rejects_the_value_with_errno_4025(string $constraint, Closure $insert): void
    {
        try {
            $insert($this);
            $this->fail("Constraint {$constraint} seharusnya menolak penyisipan.");
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('23000', $e->errorInfo[0], 'SQLSTATE');
            $this->assertSame(4025, $e->errorInfo[1], 'errno');
            $this->assertStringContainsString("`{$constraint}`", $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public function test_boundary_values_are_accepted_by_the_check_constraints(): void
    {
        $this->insertSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1, 'quota' => 1]);
        $this->insertSchedule(['day_of_week' => 7, 'quota' => 200, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-10', 'valid_until' => '2026-10-10']);
        $this->insertSchedule(['valid_until' => null]);
        $this->insertException(['start_date' => '2026-10-10', 'end_date' => '2026-10-10']);
        $this->insertSession(['quota' => 1, 'booked_count' => 1, 'last_queue_number' => 1]);
        $this->insertSession(['quota' => 200, 'session_date' => '2026-10-13']);
        $this->insertSession(['quota' => 5, 'booked_count' => 2, 'last_queue_number' => 2, 'session_date' => '2026-10-14']);
        $this->insertAppointment(['queue_number' => 1]);

        $this->assertSame(3, DB::table('doctor_schedules')->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('schedule_exceptions')->count());
        $this->assertSame(4, DB::table('practice_sessions')->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->count());
    }

        $this->insertSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => null, 'session_date' => '2026-10-12', 'start_time' => '16:00:00', 'end_time' => '18:00:00']);

    public function test_session_unique_rejects_the_same_schedule_on_the_same_date_but_not_on_another_date(): void
    {
        $scheduleId = $this->insertSchedule();
        $this->insertSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => $scheduleId, 'session_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        $this->insertSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => $scheduleId, 'session_date' => '2026-10-19']);

        try {
            $this->insertSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => $scheduleId, 'session_date' => '2026-10-12']);
            $this->fail('UNIQUE (doctor_schedule_id, session_date) seharusnya menolak.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(1062, $e->errorInfo[1]);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('practice_sessions_doctor_schedule_id_session_date_unique', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame(2, DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('doctor_schedule_id', $scheduleId)->count());
    }

    public function test_insert_ignore_is_idempotent_on_the_session_unique_key(): void
    {
        $scheduleId = $this->insertSchedule();
        $row = [
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctorId(), 'clinic_id' => $this->clinicId(), 'doctor_schedule_id' => $scheduleId,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-12', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00', 'quota' => 20,
        ];

        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('practice_sessions')->insertOrIgnore($row));
        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('practice_sessions')->insertOrIgnore($row));
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('practice_sessions')->count());
    }

    public function test_patient_profile_user_id_and_patient_number_are_unique_but_allow_many_nulls(): void
    {

        $this->insertPatient(['user_id' => null, 'patient_number' => null]);
        $this->insertPatient(['user_id' => null, 'patient_number' => null]);
        $this->insertPatient(['user_id' => $userId, 'patient_number' => 'P000001']);

        try {
            $this->insertPatient(['user_id' => $userId]);
            $this->fail('user_id ganda seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('patient_profiles_user_id_unique', $e->getMessage());
        }

        try {
            $this->insertPatient(['patient_number' => 'P000001']);
            $this->fail('patient_number ganda seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('patient_profiles_patient_number_unique', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame(3, DB::table('patient_profiles')->count());
    }

    public function test_appointment_queue_number_is_unique_per_session(): void
    {
        $this->insertAppointment(['queue_number' => 1]);

        try {
            $this->insertAppointment(['queue_number' => 1]);
            $this->fail('Nomor antrean ganda pada satu sesi seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(1062, $e->errorInfo[1]);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('appointments_practice_session_id_queue_number_unique', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $otherSession = $this->insertSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-13']);
        $this->insertAppointment(['queue_number' => 1, 'practice_session_id' => $otherSession]);

        $this->assertSame(2, DB::table('appointments')->count());
    }

    // --- active_flag dan UNIQUE aktif (KON-01 sisi skema) ---

    public function test_active_flag_matches_the_active_statuses_for_every_enum_case(): void
    {
        $expected = array_map(fn (AppointmentStatus $status): string => $status->value, AppointmentStatus::ACTIVE);

        foreach (AppointmentStatus::cases() as $status) {
            $id = $this->insertAppointment(['status' => $status->value]);
            $flag = DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $id)->value('active_flag');

            if (in_array($status->value, $expected, true)) {
                $this->assertSame(1, (int) $flag, "active_flag untuk {$status->value}");
            } else {
                $this->assertNull($flag, "active_flag untuk {$status->value}");
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_the_database_rejects_a_value_written_to_active_flag(): void
    {
        try {
            $this->insertAppointment(['active_flag' => 1]);
            $this->fail('Menulis active_flag seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(1906, $e->errorInfo[1]);
        }
    }

    public function test_a_second_active_appointment_for_the_same_patient_and_session_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $patientId = $this->insertPatient();

        foreach (['pending', 'confirmed', 'checked_in'] as $status) {
            DB::table('appointments')->delete();
            $this->insertAppointment(['patient_profile_id' => $patientId, 'status' => $status, 'queue_number' => 1]);

            try {
                $this->insertAppointment(['patient_profile_id' => $patientId, 'status' => 'pending', 'queue_number' => 2]);
                $this->fail("Appointment aktif kedua seharusnya ditolak (pertama: {$status}).");
            } catch (QueryException $e) {
                $this->assertSame(1062, $e->errorInfo[1]);
                $this->assertStringContainsString('appointments_patient_session_active_unique', $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_cancelled_and_other_final_appointments_do_not_block_a_new_active_one(): void
    {
        $patientId = $this->insertPatient();

        $this->insertAppointment(['patient_profile_id' => $patientId, 'status' => 'cancelled', 'queue_number' => 1]);
        $this->insertAppointment(['patient_profile_id' => $patientId, 'status' => 'cancelled', 'queue_number' => 2]);
        $this->insertAppointment(['patient_profile_id' => $patientId, 'status' => 'no_show', 'queue_number' => 3]);
        $this->insertAppointment(['patient_profile_id' => $patientId, 'status' => 'pending', 'queue_number' => 4]);

        $this->assertSame(4, DB::table('appointments')->where('patient_profile_id', $patientId)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->where('patient_profile_id', $patientId)->whereNotNull('active_flag')->count());
    }

    public function test_cancelling_the_active_appointment_frees_the_patient_to_book_again(): void
    {
        $patientId = $this->insertPatient();
        $first = $this->insertAppointment(['patient_profile_id' => $patientId, 'status' => 'confirmed', 'queue_number' => 1]);

        DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $first)->update(['status' => 'cancelled']);
        $this->assertNull(DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $first)->value('active_flag'));

        $this->insertAppointment(['patient_profile_id' => $patientId, 'status' => 'pending', 'queue_number' => 2]);

        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->where('patient_profile_id', $patientId)->whereNotNull('active_flag')->count());
    }

    // --- Perilaku FK ---

    public function test_deleting_a_user_sets_patient_profile_and_schedule_links_to_null(): void
    {
        $userId = $this->insertUserId();
        $patientId = $this->insertPatient(['user_id' => $userId, 'created_by_user_id' => $userId]);
        $scheduleId = $this->insertSchedule(['created_by' => $userId, 'updated_by' => $userId]);
        $exceptionId = $this->insertException(['created_by' => $userId]);
        $sessionId = $this->insertSession(['reviewed_by' => $userId]);

        DB::table('users')->where('id', $userId)->delete();

        $profile = DB::table('patient_profiles')->find($patientId);
        $this->assertNull($profile->user_id);
        $this->assertNull($profile->created_by_user_id);

        $schedule = DB::table('doctor_schedules')->find($scheduleId);
        $this->assertNull($schedule->created_by);
        $this->assertNull($schedule->updated_by);
        $this->assertNull(DB::table('schedule_exceptions')->where('id', $exceptionId)->value('created_by'));
        $this->assertNull(DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $sessionId)->value('reviewed_by'));
    }

    public function test_deleting_a_user_sets_appointment_and_history_actor_links_to_null(): void
    {
        $userId = $this->insertUserId();
        $appointmentId = $this->insertAppointment(['created_by_user_id' => $userId, 'cancelled_by_user_id' => $userId]);
        $historyId = DB::table('appointment_status_histories')->insertGetId([
            'appointment_id' => $appointmentId, 'to_status' => 'pending', 'actor_type' => 'staff', 'actor_user_id' => $userId,
        ]);

        DB::table('users')->where('id', $userId)->delete();

        $appointment = DB::table('appointments')->find($appointmentId);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->created_by_user_id);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->cancelled_by_user_id);
        $this->assertNull(DB::table('appointment_status_histories')->where('id', $historyId)->value('actor_user_id'));
    }

    public function test_a_doctor_with_a_schedule_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $doctorId = Doctor::factory()->create()->id;
        $clinicId = Clinic::factory()->create()->id;
        $this->insertSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctorId, 'clinic_id' => $clinicId]);

        try {
            DB::table('doctors')->where('id', $doctorId)->delete();
            $this->fail('FK doctor_schedules.doctor_id RESTRICT seharusnya menolak.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('doctor_schedules_doctor_id_foreign', $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    }

    public function test_a_doctor_with_an_exception_cannot_be_deleted(): void

        }
    }

    public function test_deleting_a_schedule_or_exception_sets_the_session_links_to_null(): void
    {
        $scheduleId = $this->insertSchedule();
        $exceptionId = $this->insertException();
        $sessionId = $this->insertSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => $scheduleId, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exceptionId, 'status' => 'cancelled']);

        DB::table('schedule_exceptions')->where('id', $exceptionId)->delete();
        $this->assertNull(DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $sessionId)->value('schedule_exception_id'));
        $this->assertSame($scheduleId, (int) DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $sessionId)->value('doctor_schedule_id'));

        DB::table('doctor_schedules')->where('id', $scheduleId)->delete();
        $this->assertNull(DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $sessionId)->value('doctor_schedule_id'));
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $sessionId)->count());
    }

    public function test_a_session_with_an_appointment_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $this->insertAppointment();

        try {

        }
    }

    public function test_a_patient_profile_with_an_appointment_cannot_be_deleted(): void

    {
        $partnerId = $this->insertInsurancePartner();
        $this->insertAppointment(['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'insurance_partner_id' => $partnerId]);

        try {

    public function test_deleting_an_appointment_cascades_to_its_status_history(): void
    {
        $appointmentId = $this->insertAppointment();
        DB::table('appointment_status_histories')->insert([
            ['appointment_id' => $appointmentId, 'from_status' => null, 'to_status' => 'pending', 'actor_type' => 'patient'],
            ['appointment_id' => $appointmentId, 'from_status' => 'pending', 'to_status' => 'confirmed', 'actor_type' => 'staff'],
        ]);

        DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointmentId)->delete();

        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('appointment_status_histories')->count());
    }

    // --- Nilai bawaan ---

    public function test_column_defaults_are_applied_by_the_database(): void
    {
        $scheduleId = $this->insertSchedule();
        $sessionId = $this->insertSession();
        $patientId = $this->insertPatient();
        $partnerId = $this->insertInsurancePartner();
        $appointmentId = $this->insertAppointment();
        $historyId = DB::table('appointment_status_histories')->insertGetId([
            'appointment_id' => $appointmentId, 'to_status' => 'pending', 'actor_type' => 'system',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame(1, (int) DB::table('doctor_schedules')->find($scheduleId)->is_active);

        $session = DB::table('practice_sessions')->find($sessionId);
        $this->assertSame([0, 0, 'open', 0], [(int) $session->booked_count, (int) $session->last_queue_number, $session->status, (int) $session->is_manually_modified]);
        $this->assertNull($session->pending_change);
        $this->assertNull($session->doctor_schedule_id);

        $this->assertSame(1, (int) DB::table('patient_profiles')->find($patientId)->is_active);

        $partner = DB::table('insurance_partners')->find($partnerId);
        $this->assertSame([1, 0], [(int) $partner->is_active, (int) $partner->sort_order]);

        $this->assertNotNull(DB::table('appointment_status_histories')->find($historyId)->created_at);
    }
}
```

**Test IDs:** CRD-03 dan JDW-16 (bagian arsip dokter ditolak bila ada appointment aktif mendatang, termasuk Super Admin), CRD-02/CRD-13 (kode poliklinik terkunci dan hapus poliklinik yang dirujuk jadwal, sesi, atau appointment; rangkuman di Task 16), JDW-19 (sisi model: `deletionBlockedReason()` templat dan sesi), invarian I-1/I-2/I-15 pada pembantu tes, Review Focus 1 (batas `notEnded` pada jam yang sama) dan 2 (`overlapping`: bersebelahan, beririsan, nonaktif, `ignoreId`).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Mode ketat.** `new Model([... atribut non-fillable])` melempar `MassAssignmentException`; factory berjalan tanpa guard sehingga boleh mengisi `booked_count`, `status`, dan kolom sistem. Service fase berikutnya memakai `forceFill`. Pada model yang baru dibuat (`! exists`), membaca atribut yang belum ada (`$schedule->created_by`) mengembalikan `null` tanpa melempar.
- **Urutan atribut factory.** `Factory::expandAttributes()` mengevaluasi `Factory` menjadi id lebih dulu, lalu menjalankan closure berurutan dengan `$attributes` yang sudah berisi nilai sebelumnya. Karena itu `clinic_id` (closure) hanya boleh ditulis **setelah** `doctor_id` pada `definition()`, dan `doctor_schedule_id` setelah `session_date`/`start_time`/`end_time`/`quota`. State (`manual()`) dan override `create([...])` menggantikan closure tanpa mengevaluasinya.
- **`afterMaking`** dijalankan oleh `create()` sebelum insert, sehingga `PracticeSessionFactory::configure()` menjaga `chk_sessions_quota` dan `chk_sessions_queue` pada nilai yang ditimpa tes.
- **Satu definisi "aktif mendatang" (F3-R15).** `Appointment::scopeUpcomingActive()` = `active()` + `whereHas('practiceSession', notEnded)`, dan `PracticeSession::scopeNotEnded()` adalah satu-satunya tempat aturan "belum berakhir": `session_date > hari ini` atau (`session_date = hari ini` dan `end_time > jam sekarang`, tegas). Sesi yang berakhir tepat pada waktu sekarang sudah berakhir (konsisten dengan `isEnded()`: `ends_at <= now`). `$now` bertipe `CarbonInterface` dikonversi ke zona aplikasi (`Asia/Jakarta`) sebelum dibandingkan.
- **`travelTo`.** `Illuminate\Support\Carbon::setTestNow()` memanggil `Carbon` dan `CarbonImmutable`, sehingga `now()`, `today()`, dan `CarbonImmutable::today()` konsisten pada tes waktu. Setiap tes yang bergantung waktu memanggil `travelTo` sendiri di `setUp()`.
- **Accessor objek.** `starts_at`/`ends_at` memakai `Attribute::get(...)->withoutObjectCaching()` (seperti `Doctor::primary_specialty`), supaya mengikuti perubahan `start_time`/`end_time` pada instance yang sama.
- **Enkripsi.** Cast `encrypted` (`bpjs_number`, `payment_reference`) memerlukan `APP_KEY`, yang ada di `.env.testing`. Nilai mentah kolom diperiksa lewat `DB::table()`.
- **Titik sambung F2-R8.** `DoctorService` bersifat `final`, tetapi `futureActiveAppointmentsCount()` tetap `protected` dan dipanggil lewat `ReflectionMethod::invoke()` di tes (PHP 8.1+ tidak memerlukan `setAccessible`). `ArchiveDoctorRequest::blockedReason()` dan tes `AdminDoctorArchiveTest` tidak berubah. Kueri memakai kolom denormalisasi `appointments.doctor_id`.
- **`ClinicRequest::clinicHasAppointments()`.** `AdminClinicCrudTest::test_code_cannot_change_once_the_clinic_has_appointments` menimpa method ini lewat subkelas anonim dan tetap hijau.
- **Pesan hapus poliklinik.** Pesan fase 2 untuk dokter ("Poliklinik ini masih dirujuk oleh data dokter …") tetap dan didahulukan, karena dua tes fase 2 menegaskannya literal (`DoctorModelTest`, `AdminClinicCrudTest`). Pesan baru untuk jadwal, sesi, atau appointment: "Poliklinik ini masih dipakai oleh jadwal atau data pendaftaran sehingga tidak dapat dihapus. Nonaktifkan saja." (pola pesan fase 2; 12 BR-17).
- **Tes arsip dokter** memakai `ArchiveDoctorRequest` asli (tanpa subkelas): pesan penolakan persis `blockedMessage()` fase 2 (diuji literal oleh `DoctorServiceTest::test_archive_refusal_message_matches_the_specification`) dan berlaku untuk Super Admin karena dijaga di service dan Form Request, bukan Policy.
- **`bookAppointment()`** membuat pasien baru (kecuali `patient_profile_id` ditimpa), memakai `lockForUpdate` pada sesi di dalam transaksi, dan menaikkan `last_queue_number` serta (kecuali `cancelled`) `booked_count` lewat `forceFill`. Melebihi kuota memicu `chk_sessions_quota` (QueryException) dan membatalkan seluruh transaksi pembantu.
- Jumlah tes baru: **117** (siklus A: 99; siklus B: 18) ditambah satu tes fase 2 yang diganti (`DoctorServiceTest`, jumlah tetap).
- Semua blok PHP lolos `php -l` 8.2 dan `pint --test`; seluruh jangkar Edit dicocokkan dengan berkas nyata dan muncul tepat satu kali.

`tests/Feature/Models/DoctorScheduleModelTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Models;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\MassAssignmentException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 11 §5.3 dan F3-R15/V-23: templat jadwal mingguan.
 */
class DoctorScheduleModelTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 08:00:00');
    }

    public function test_casts_and_defaults(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 3, 'quota' => 15, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-05', 'valid_until' => '2026-12-31'])->fresh();

        $this->assertSame(3, $schedule->day_of_week);
        $this->assertSame(15, $schedule->quota);
        $this->assertTrue($schedule->is_active);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05', $schedule->valid_from->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('2026-12-31', $schedule->valid_until->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('08:00:00', $schedule->start_time);
        $this->assertSame('12:00:00', $schedule->end_time);
        $this->assertNull($schedule->notes);
    }

    public function test_the_audit_columns_are_not_mass_assignable(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(MassAssignmentException::class);

        new DoctorSchedule(['created_by' => 1]);
    }

    public function test_relations(): void
    {
        $staff = $this->createStaff('super-admin');
        $this->actingAs($staff);
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();
        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->create([
            'doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id, 'clinic_id' => $schedule->clinic_id, 'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
        ]);

        $schedule = DoctorSchedule::query()->with(['doctor', 'clinic', 'sessions', 'creator', 'updater'])->findOrFail($schedule->id);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Doctor::class, $schedule->doctor);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(Clinic::class, $schedule->clinic);
        $this->assertSame($schedule->doctor->clinic_id, $schedule->clinic_id);
        $this->assertSame([$session->id], $schedule->sessions->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $schedule->creator->id);
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $schedule->updater->id);
        $this->assertSame([$schedule->id], $schedule->doctor->schedules()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$schedule->id], $schedule->clinic->schedules()->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    public function test_created_by_and_updated_by_come_from_the_authenticated_user(): void
    {
        $first = $this->createStaff('super-admin');
        $second = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($first);
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();
        $this->assertSame($first->id, $schedule->fresh()->created_by);
        $this->assertSame($first->id, $schedule->fresh()->updated_by);

        $this->actingAs($second);
        $schedule->update(['quota' => 25]);

        $this->assertSame($first->id, $schedule->fresh()->created_by);
        $this->assertSame($second->id, $schedule->fresh()->updated_by);
    }

    public function test_audit_columns_stay_null_without_an_authenticated_user(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();
        $schedule->update(['quota' => 25]);

        $fresh = $schedule->fresh();
        $this->assertNull($fresh->created_by);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->updated_by);
    }

    public function test_active_scope(): void
    {
        $active = $this->createSchedule();
        $inactive = DoctorSchedule::factory()->inactive()->create();

        $this->assertSame([$active->id], DoctorSchedule::query()->active()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertFalse($inactive->is_active);
    }

    public function test_on_day_scope(): void
    {
        $monday = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $sunday = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 7]);

        $this->assertSame([$monday->id], DoctorSchedule::query()->onDay(1)->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$sunday->id], DoctorSchedule::query()->onDay(7)->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([], DoctorSchedule::query()->onDay(3)->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    public function test_effective_on_scope_includes_both_boundaries_and_open_ended_templates(): void
    {
        $bounded = $this->createSchedule(['valid_from' => '2026-10-10', 'valid_until' => '2026-10-20']);
        $openEnded = $this->createSchedule(['valid_from' => '2026-10-15', 'valid_until' => null]);

        $ids = fn (string $date): array => DoctorSchedule::query()->effectiveOn($date)->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([], $ids('2026-10-09'));
        $this->assertSame([$bounded->id], $ids('2026-10-10'));
        $this->assertSame([$bounded->id, $openEnded->id], $ids('2026-10-15'));
        $this->assertSame([$bounded->id, $openEnded->id], $ids('2026-10-20'));
        $this->assertSame([$openEnded->id], $ids('2026-10-21'));
        $this->assertSame([$openEnded->id], DoctorSchedule::query()->effectiveOn(CarbonImmutable::parse('2027-01-01'))->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    public function test_day_name_and_time_range_accessors(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1, 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:30:00']);
        $sunday = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 7, 'start_time' => '13:05:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);

        $this->assertSame('Senin', $schedule->day_name);
        $this->assertSame('08.00–12.30', $schedule->time_range);
        $this->assertSame('Minggu', $sunday->day_name);
        $this->assertSame('13.05–15.00', $sunday->time_range);
        $this->assertSame(['Senin', 'Selasa', 'Rabu', 'Kamis', 'Jumat', 'Sabtu', 'Minggu'], array_values(DoctorSchedule::DAY_NAMES));
    }

    // --- scopeOverlapping (V-23, Review Focus 2) ---

    private function existing(array $overrides = []): DoctorSchedule
    {
        return $this->createSchedule(array_merge([
            'day_of_week' => 1, 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-05', 'valid_until' => null,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function overlaps(DoctorSchedule $existing, string $start, string $end, string $from = '2026-10-05', ?string $until = null, ?int $ignoreId = null, ?int $day = null): bool
    {
        return DoctorSchedule::query()
            ->overlapping(
                $existing->doctor_id,
                $day ?? 1,
                $start,
                $end,
                CarbonImmutable::parse($from),
                $until === null ? null : CarbonImmutable::parse($until),
                $ignoreId,
            )
            ->exists();
    }

    public function test_overlapping_detects_intersecting_times_on_the_same_day(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->existing();

        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($existing, '11:00', '13:00'));
        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($existing, '07:00', '09:00'));
        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($existing, '09:00', '10:00'));
        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($existing, '08:00', '12:00'));
        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($existing, '07:00', '13:00'));
        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($existing, '11:59:59', '14:00:00'));
    }

    public function test_adjacent_times_do_not_overlap(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->existing();

        $this->assertFalse($this->overlaps($existing, '12:00', '15:00'));
        $this->assertFalse($this->overlaps($existing, '05:00', '08:00'));
    }

    public function test_a_template_of_another_day_or_doctor_does_not_overlap(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->existing();
        $otherDoctor = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1, 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);

        $this->assertFalse($this->overlaps($existing, '08:00', '12:00', day: 2));
        $this->assertSame(
            [$existing->id],
            DoctorSchedule::query()->overlapping($existing->doctor_id, 1, '08:00', '12:00', CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05'), null)->pluck('id')->all(),
        );
        $this->assertNotSame($existing->doctor_id, $otherDoctor->doctor_id);
    }

    public function test_an_inactive_template_is_not_counted_as_overlapping(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->existing();
        $existing->update(['is_active' => false]);

        $this->assertFalse($this->overlaps($existing, '08:00', '12:00'));
    }

    public function test_the_template_itself_is_excluded_with_ignore_id(): void
    {
        $existing = $this->existing();

        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($existing, '08:00', '12:00'));
        $this->assertFalse($this->overlaps($existing, '08:00', '12:00', ignoreId: $existing->id));
    }

    public function test_overlapping_considers_the_validity_ranges(): void
    {
        $bounded = $this->existing(['valid_from' => '2026-10-05', 'valid_until' => '2026-10-31']);

        // Rentang baru dimulai sehari setelah rentang lama berakhir: tidak beririsan.
        $this->assertFalse($this->overlaps($bounded, '08:00', '12:00', '2026-11-01', null));
        // Rentang baru berakhir sehari sebelum rentang lama mulai: tidak beririsan.
        $this->assertFalse($this->overlaps($bounded, '08:00', '12:00', '2026-09-01', '2026-10-04'));
        // Bersinggungan pada satu hari (31 Okt): beririsan.
        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($bounded, '08:00', '12:00', '2026-10-31', null));
        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($bounded, '08:00', '12:00', '2026-09-01', '2026-10-05'));
        // Rentang baru tanpa batas akhir yang mulai sebelum rentang lama berakhir: beririsan.
        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($bounded, '08:00', '12:00', '2026-10-01', null));
    }

    public function test_an_open_ended_existing_template_overlaps_any_later_range(): void
    {
        $openEnded = $this->existing(['valid_from' => '2026-10-05', 'valid_until' => null]);

        $this->assertTrue($this->overlaps($openEnded, '08:00', '12:00', '2027-06-01', '2027-06-30'));
        $this->assertFalse($this->overlaps($openEnded, '08:00', '12:00', '2026-09-01', '2026-10-04'));
    }

    // --- Hapus dan appointment mendatang ---

    public function test_deletion_is_allowed_without_sessions_or_with_sessions_that_never_had_appointments(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();
        $this->assertNull($schedule->deletionBlockedReason());

        $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id, 'clinic_id' => $schedule->clinic_id, 'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id]);

        $this->assertNull($schedule->deletionBlockedReason());
    }

    public function test_deletion_is_blocked_by_any_appointment_even_a_cancelled_one(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();
        $session = $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id, 'clinic_id' => $schedule->clinic_id, 'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id]);
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

        $this->assertSame(
            'Jadwal ini sudah memiliki sesi dengan pendaftaran dan hanya dapat dinonaktifkan.',
            $schedule->deletionBlockedReason(),
        );
    }

    public function test_has_upcoming_active_appointments(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();
        $make = fn (string $date, string $start = '08:00:00', string $end = '12:00:00'): PracticeSession => $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id, 'clinic_id' => $schedule->clinic_id,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id, 'session_date' => $date, 'start_time' => $start, 'end_time' => $end,
        ]);

        $this->assertFalse($schedule->hasUpcomingActiveAppointments());

        $this->bookAppointment($make('2026-10-12'), AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $this->bookAppointment($make('2026-10-13'), AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $this->assertFalse($schedule->hasUpcomingActiveAppointments());

        $this->bookAppointment($make('2026-10-05', '06:00:00', '07:00:00'), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->assertFalse($schedule->hasUpcomingActiveAppointments(), 'Sesi hari ini yang sudah berakhir tidak dihitung.');

        $this->bookAppointment($make('2026-10-20'), AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->assertTrue($schedule->hasUpcomingActiveAppointments());
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Models/ScheduleExceptionModelTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Models;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\MassAssignmentException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 11 §5.3, 12 BR-21 (pemilihan pengecualian), F3-R10.
 */
class ScheduleExceptionModelTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 08:00:00');
    }

    public function test_casts_and_relations(): void
    {
        $staff = $this->createStaff('super-admin');
        $this->actingAs($staff);
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $exception = $this->createException([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-14', 'reason' => 'Seminar',
        ]);
        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->cancelled()->create([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id,
        ]);

        $exception = ScheduleException::query()->with(['doctor', 'creator', 'sessions'])->findOrFail($exception->id);

        $this->assertSame(ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, $exception->type);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-12', $exception->start_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-14', $exception->end_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame($doctor->id, $exception->doctor->id);
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $exception->creator->id);
        $this->assertSame([$session->id], $exception->sessions->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$exception->id], $doctor->exceptions()->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    public function test_global_exception_has_no_doctor_relation(): void
    {
        $exception = ScheduleException::factory()->hospitalHoliday()->create();

        $this->assertNull($exception->fresh()->doctor_id);
        $this->assertNull(ScheduleException::query()->with('doctor')->findOrFail($exception->id)->doctor);
    }

    public function test_created_by_is_set_on_create_only_from_the_authenticated_user(): void
    {
        $first = $this->createStaff('super-admin');
        $second = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $anonymous = $this->createException();
        $this->assertNull($anonymous->fresh()->created_by);

        $this->actingAs($first);
        $exception = $this->createException();
        $this->assertSame($first->id, $exception->fresh()->created_by);

        $this->actingAs($second);
        $exception->update(['reason' => 'Diubah']);

        $this->assertSame($first->id, $exception->fresh()->created_by);
    }

    public function test_created_by_is_not_mass_assignable(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(MassAssignmentException::class);

        new ScheduleException(['created_by' => 1]);
    }

    public function test_covering_scope_includes_both_ends(): void
    {
        $exception = $this->createException(['start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-14']);

        $ids = fn (string $date): array => ScheduleException::query()->covering(CarbonImmutable::parse($date))->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([], $ids('2026-10-11'));
        $this->assertSame([$exception->id], $ids('2026-10-12'));
        $this->assertSame([$exception->id], $ids('2026-10-13'));
        $this->assertSame([$exception->id], $ids('2026-10-14'));
        $this->assertSame([], $ids('2026-10-15'));
    }

    public function test_for_doctor_scope_returns_global_and_that_doctors_exceptions_only(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $other = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $own = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id]);
        $global = ScheduleException::factory()->nationalHoliday()->create();
        $foreign = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $other->id]);

        $ids = ScheduleException::query()->forDoctor($doctor->id)->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([$own->id, $global->id], $ids);
        $this->assertNotContains($foreign->id, $ids);
    }

    public function test_upcoming_scope_keeps_exceptions_that_end_today_or_later(): void
    {
        $past = $this->createException(['start_date' => '2026-09-20', 'end_date' => '2026-10-04']);
        $endsToday = $this->createException(['start_date' => '2026-10-01', 'end_date' => '2026-10-05']);
        $future = $this->createException(['start_date' => '2026-10-20', 'end_date' => '2026-10-21']);

        $ids = ScheduleException::query()->upcoming()->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([$endsToday->id, $future->id], $ids);
        $this->assertNotContains($past->id, $ids);
    }

    // --- pickFor (BR-21, F3-R10) ---

    private function pick(int $doctorId, string $date): ?int
    {
        return ScheduleException::pickFor(ScheduleException::query()->get(), $doctorId, CarbonImmutable::parse($date))?->id;
    }

    public function test_pick_for_returns_null_when_nothing_covers_the_date_or_applies_to_the_doctor(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $other = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $other->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-14']);

        $this->assertNull($this->pick($doctor->id, '2026-10-13'), 'Cuti dokter lain tidak berlaku.');
        $this->assertNull($this->pick($other->id, '2026-10-15'), 'Di luar rentang.');
        $this->assertNull($this->pick($other->id, '2026-10-11'), 'Di luar rentang.');
    }

    public function test_pick_for_prefers_the_doctor_specific_exception_over_a_global_one_even_with_a_larger_id(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $global = ScheduleException::factory()->hospitalHoliday()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-14']);
        $leave = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-13', 'end_date' => '2026-10-13']);

        $this->assertGreaterThan($global->id, $leave->id);
        $this->assertSame($leave->id, $this->pick($doctor->id, '2026-10-13'));
        $this->assertSame($global->id, $this->pick($doctor->id, '2026-10-12'));
    }

    public function test_pick_for_takes_the_smallest_id_among_equals(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $firstGlobal = ScheduleException::factory()->hospitalHoliday()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        ScheduleException::factory()->nationalHoliday()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        $firstLeave = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);

        $this->assertSame($firstLeave->id, $this->pick($doctor->id, '2026-10-12'));

        ScheduleException::query()->where('doctor_id', $doctor->id)->delete();

        $this->assertSame($firstGlobal->id, $this->pick($doctor->id, '2026-10-12'));
    }

    public function test_pick_for_uses_the_given_collection_without_querying(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        $collection = ScheduleException::query()->get();
        $exception->delete();

        $picked = ScheduleException::pickFor($collection, $doctor->id, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12'));

        $this->assertSame($exception->id, $picked?->id);
    }

    // --- Accessor ---

    public function test_is_global_and_range_label(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $leave = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-14']);
        $holiday = ScheduleException::factory()->hospitalHoliday()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-17', 'end_date' => '2026-10-17']);

        $this->assertFalse($leave->is_global);
        $this->assertTrue($holiday->is_global);
        $this->assertSame('12 Oktober 2026 – 14 Oktober 2026', $leave->range_label);
        $this->assertSame('17 Oktober 2026', $holiday->range_label);
    }
}
```
