`tests/Feature/Models/PracticeSessionModelTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Models;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionResolution;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\MassAssignmentException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 11 §5.3, 00 F.4, F3-R14 (sumber pending_change), F3-R15, F3-R20, F3-R27.
 */
class PracticeSessionModelTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /** Senin 5 Oktober 2026, 10.00 WIB. */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 10:00:00');
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function manualSession(array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge(['doctor_schedule_id' => null], $overrides));
    }

    public function test_pending_change_source_constants(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('exception', PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->assertSame('template_time', PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TIME);
        $this->assertSame('template_removed', PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_REMOVED);
        $this->assertSame('manual_time', PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_TIME);
        $this->assertSame('manual_cancel', PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_CANCEL);
        $this->assertSame('doctor_inactive', PracticeSession::SOURCE_DOCTOR_INACTIVE);
        $this->assertSame(['exception', 'template_removed', 'manual_cancel', 'doctor_inactive'], PracticeSession::CANCEL_SOURCES);
        $this->assertSame(['template_time', 'manual_time'], PracticeSession::TIME_SOURCES);
        $this->assertSame([], array_intersect(PracticeSession::CANCEL_SOURCES, PracticeSession::TIME_SOURCES));
    }

    public function test_every_source_is_known_to_the_session_resolution_enum(): void
    {
        foreach ([...PracticeSession::CANCEL_SOURCES, ...PracticeSession::TIME_SOURCES] as $source) {
            $this->assertNotEmpty(SessionResolution::allowedFor($source), $source);
        }
    }

    public function test_casts_and_defaults(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 12, 'session_date' => '2026-10-12'])->fresh();

        $this->assertSame('2026-10-12', $session->session_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(12, $session->quota);
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->last_queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->status);
        $this->assertFalse($session->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertNull($session->pending_change);
        $this->assertNull($session->reviewed_at);
        $this->assertSame('08:00:00', $session->start_time);
    }

    public function test_counters_are_not_mass_assignable(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(MassAssignmentException::class);

        new PracticeSession(['booked_count' => 3]);
    }

    public function test_pending_change_round_trips_as_an_array(): void
    {
        $payload = ['source' => 'template_time', 'schedule_id' => 3, 'new_start_time' => '09:00', 'new_end_time' => '12:00'];
        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->needsReview($payload)->create()->fresh();

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $session->status);
        $this->assertSame($payload, $session->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame('template_time', $session->pendingSource());
    }

    public function test_pending_source_is_null_without_a_pending_change(): void
    {
        $this->assertNull($this->createSession()->pendingSource());
    }

    public function test_relations(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();
        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id]);
        $session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id, 'clinic_id' => $schedule->clinic_id, 'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id,
        ]);
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $reviewer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $session->forceFill(['reviewed_by' => $reviewer->id, 'reviewed_at' => now()])->save();

        $loaded = PracticeSession::query()->with(['doctor', 'clinic', 'schedule', 'exception', 'appointments', 'reviewer'])->findOrFail($session->id);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Doctor::class, $loaded->doctor);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(Clinic::class, $loaded->clinic);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(DoctorSchedule::class, $loaded->schedule);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ScheduleException::class, $loaded->exception);
        $this->assertSame([$appointment->id], $loaded->appointments->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame($reviewer->id, $loaded->reviewer->id);
        $this->assertSame([$session->id], $loaded->doctor->sessions()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$session->id], $loaded->clinic->sessions()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$appointment->id], $loaded->doctor->appointments()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$appointment->id], $loaded->clinic->appointments()->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    // --- Scope ---

    public function test_between_and_on_date_scopes_include_both_ends_and_accept_strings(): void
    {
        $day = fn (string $date): PracticeSession => $this->manualSession(['session_date' => $date]);
        $a = $day('2026-10-11');
        $b = $day('2026-10-12');
        $c = $day('2026-10-14');
        $d = $day('2026-10-15');

        $between = PracticeSession::query()->between(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12'), '2026-10-14')->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([$b->id, $c->id], $between);
        $this->assertSame([$d->id], PracticeSession::query()->onDate(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-15'))->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$a->id], PracticeSession::query()->onDate('2026-10-11')->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    public function test_upcoming_scope_keeps_today_and_later_dates(): void
    {
        $yesterday = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-04']);
        $today = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05']);
        $tomorrow = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06']);

        $ids = PracticeSession::query()->upcoming()->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([$today->id, $tomorrow->id], $ids);
        $this->assertNotContains($yesterday->id, $ids);
    }

    public function test_status_scopes(): void
    {
        $open = $this->manualSession();
        $review = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->needsReview(['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => 1])->create();
        $closed = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->closed()->create();
        $cancelled = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->cancelled()->create();

        $this->assertSame([$open->id], PracticeSession::query()->open()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$review->id], PracticeSession::query()->needsReview()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Closed, $closed->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $cancelled->status);
    }

    public function test_for_doctor_and_for_clinic_scopes(): void
    {
        $first = $this->manualSession();
        $second = $this->manualSession();

        $this->assertSame([$first->id], PracticeSession::query()->forDoctor($first->doctor_id)->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([$second->id], PracticeSession::query()->forClinic($second->clinic_id)->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    public function test_not_ended_scope_boundaries_on_the_same_day(): void
    {
        $yesterday = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-04', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '23:00:00']);
        $today = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
        $tomorrow = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '09:00:00']);

        $ids = fn (string $now): array => PracticeSession::query()->notEnded(CarbonImmutable::parse($now))->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([$today->id, $tomorrow->id], $ids('2026-10-05 11:59:59'), 'Satu detik sebelum selesai: belum berakhir.');
        $this->assertSame([$tomorrow->id], $ids('2026-10-05 12:00:00'), 'Tepat pada end_time: sudah berakhir.');
        $this->assertSame([$tomorrow->id], $ids('2026-10-05 12:00:01'));
        $this->assertSame([$today->id, $tomorrow->id], $ids('2026-10-05 00:00:00'), 'Pergantian hari 00:00: sesi hari itu belum berakhir.');
        $this->assertSame([$tomorrow->id], $ids('2026-10-05 23:59:59'));
        $this->assertSame([$tomorrow->id], $ids('2026-10-06 08:30:00'));
        $this->assertSame([], $ids('2026-10-06 09:00:00'));
        $this->assertNotContains($yesterday->id, $ids('2026-10-05 00:00:00'));
    }

    public function test_not_ended_scope_defaults_to_the_current_time(): void
    {
        $today = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:01']);
        $ended = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '07:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:00']);

        $ids = PracticeSession::query()->notEnded()->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([$today->id], $ids);
        $this->assertNotContains($ended->id, $ids);
    }

    public function test_not_ended_scope_converts_other_time_zones_to_the_application_zone(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);

        // 11:59 WIB = 04:59 UTC: belum berakhir; 12:00 WIB = 05:00 UTC: berakhir.
        $this->assertSame([$session->id], PracticeSession::query()->notEnded(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 04:59:00', 'UTC'))->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame([], PracticeSession::query()->notEnded(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 05:00:00', 'UTC'))->pluck('id')->all());
    }

    // --- Accessor dan method ---

    public function test_remaining_never_goes_negative(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession(['quota' => 5]);
        $this->assertSame(5, $session->remaining);

        $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $this->assertSame(3, $session->remaining);

        $session->forceFill(['quota' => 1]);
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->remaining);
    }

    public function test_starts_at_and_ends_at_are_immutable_carbon_in_the_application_zone(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-12', 'start_time' => '08:30:00', 'end_time' => '12:15:00']);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(CarbonImmutable::class, $session->starts_at);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-12 08:30:00', $session->starts_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-12 12:15:00', $session->ends_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
        $this->assertSame('Asia/Jakarta', $session->starts_at->timezoneName);

        $session->start_time = '09:00:00';
        $this->assertSame('09:00:00', $session->starts_at->format('H:i:s'), 'Tanpa cache objek: mengikuti perubahan jam.');
    }

    public function test_time_range_accessor(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('08.30–12.15', $this->manualSession(['start_time' => '08:30:00', 'end_time' => '12:15:00'])->time_range);
    }

    public function test_is_ended_uses_the_end_time_inclusively(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);

        $this->assertFalse($session->isEnded(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 11:59:59')));
        $this->assertTrue($session->isEnded(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 12:00:00')));
        $this->assertTrue($session->isEnded(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 12:00:01')));
        $this->assertFalse($session->isEnded(), 'Bawaan memakai waktu sekarang (10.00).');

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 12:00:00');
        $this->assertTrue($session->isEnded());
    }

    public function test_is_manual_follows_the_schedule_link(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue($this->manualSession()->isManual());
        $this->assertFalse($this->createSession()->isManual());
    }

    public function test_has_active_appointments(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession();
        $this->assertFalse($session->hasActiveAppointments());

        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $this->assertFalse($session->hasActiveAppointments());

        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $this->assertTrue($session->hasActiveAppointments());
    }

    // --- deletionBlockedReason (F3-R20) ---

    public function test_a_template_session_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(
            'Sesi dari templat tidak dapat dihapus. Tutup atau batalkan sesi ini.',
            $this->createSession()->deletionBlockedReason(),
        );
    }

    public function test_a_manual_session_with_any_appointment_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession();
        $this->assertNull($session->deletionBlockedReason());

        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

        $this->assertSame(
            'Sesi ini sudah memiliki pendaftaran. Tutup atau batalkan sesi ini.',
            $session->deletionBlockedReason(),
        );
    }

    public function test_a_manual_session_without_appointments_can_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $this->assertNull($this->manualSession()->deletionBlockedReason());
    }

    public function test_appointment_upcoming_active_scope_follows_the_session_end_time(): void
    {
        $ended = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '09:00:00']);
        $running = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
        $future = $this->manualSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06']);

        $this->bookAppointment($ended);
        $this->bookAppointment($running);
        $this->bookAppointment($future);

        $this->assertSame(
            [$running->id, $future->id],
            Appointment::query()->upcomingActive()->orderBy('practice_session_id')->pluck('practice_session_id')->all(),
        );
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Models;

use App\Enums\ActorType;

/**

 */
class BookingModelsTest extends TestCase
{

    // --- PatientProfile ---

    public function test_patient_profile_factory_and_casts(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['birth_date' => '1990-04-12', 'gender' => Gender::Female])->fresh();

        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^P\d{6}$/', $profile->patient_number);
        $this->assertSame('1990-04-12', $profile->birth_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(Gender::Female, $profile->gender);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $profile->registration_channel);
        $this->assertTrue($profile->is_active);
        $this->assertNull($profile->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05 10:00:00', $profile->consent_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
        $this->assertSame('1.0', $profile->consent_version);
    }

    public function test_patient_profile_bpjs_number_is_encrypted_and_hidden(): void
    {
        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create(['bpjs_number' => '0001234567890']);

        $raw = DB::table('patient_profiles')->where('id', $profile->id)->value('bpjs_number');

        $this->assertNotSame('0001234567890', $raw);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('0001234567890', (string) $raw);
        $this->assertSame('0001234567890', $profile->fresh()->bpjs_number);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('bpjs_number', $profile->fresh()->toArray());
    }

    public function test_patient_profile_system_columns_are_not_mass_assignable(): void
    {

    public function test_patient_profile_with_account_links_a_patient_user_and_copies_the_email(): void

        $this->assertNotNull($loaded->user);

        $this->assertSame($loaded->user->email, $loaded->email);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Online, $loaded->registration_channel);
    }

    {

        $profile = PatientProfile::factory()->create();
        $profile->forceFill(['created_by_user_id' => $staff->id])->save();
        $session = $this->createSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => null]);
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);

        $loaded = PatientProfile::query()->with(['user', 'creator', 'appointments'])->findOrFail($profile->id);

        $this->assertNull($loaded->user);
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $loaded->creator->id);

    // --- Appointment ---

    public function test_appointment_factory_derives_doctor_clinic_and_date_from_the_session(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-12']);

        $appointment = Appointment::factory()->create(['practice_session_id' => $session->id])->refresh();

        $this->assertSame($session->doctor_id, $appointment->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->clinic_id, $appointment->clinic_id);

    public function test_appointment_booking_codes_are_unique_across_a_batch(): void
    {

        foreach (range(1, 5) as $queue) {

    {

        $appointment = Appointment::factory()->create([

        ]);

            }
        }
    }

    public function test_appointment_relations(): void
    {
        $staff = User::factory()->staff()->create();
        $session = $this->createSession();
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $appointment->forceFill(['created_by_user_id' => $staff->id, 'cancelled_by_user_id' => $staff->id])->save();
        AppointmentStatusHistory::factory()->create(['appointment_id' => $appointment->id, 'to_status' => AppointmentStatus::Pending]);
        AppointmentStatusHistory::factory()->create([
            'appointment_id' => $appointment->id, 'from_status' => AppointmentStatus::Pending, 'to_status' => AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
        ]);

        $loaded = Appointment::query()
            ->with(['patientProfile', 'practiceSession', 'doctor', 'clinic', 'statusHistories', 'creator', 'canceller'])
            ->findOrFail($appointment->id);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(PatientProfile::class, $loaded->patientProfile);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(PracticeSession::class, $loaded->practiceSession);
        $this->assertSame($session->doctor_id, $loaded->doctor->id);
        $this->assertSame($session->clinic_id, $loaded->clinic->id);
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $loaded->creator->id);
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $loaded->canceller->id);
        $this->assertSame(
            [AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed],
            $loaded->statusHistories->map(fn (AppointmentStatusHistory $history): AppointmentStatus => $history->to_status)->all(),
        );
    }

    public function test_active_scope_matches_the_enum_and_the_generated_column_for_every_status(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 50]);

        foreach (AppointmentStatus::cases() as $status) {
            $this->bookAppointment($session, $status);
        }

        $activeValues = array_map(fn (AppointmentStatus $status): string => $status->value, AppointmentStatus::ACTIVE);
        $quotaValues = array_map(fn (AppointmentStatus $status): string => $status->value, AppointmentStatus::QUOTA_CONSUMING);

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing($activeValues, Appointment::query()->active()->get()->map(fn (Appointment $a): string => $a->status->value)->all());
        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing($activeValues, Appointment::query()->whereNotNull('active_flag')->get()->map(fn (Appointment $a): string => $a->status->value)->all(), 'I-15: active_flag harus selaras dengan enum.');
        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing($quotaValues, Appointment::query()->quotaConsuming()->get()->map(fn (Appointment $a): string => $a->status->value)->all());
        $this->assertSame(count($quotaValues), $session->fresh()->booked_count, 'I-1: booked_count = jumlah appointment non-batal.');
    }

    public function test_status_state_fills_the_matching_timestamps(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 50]);
        $make = fn (AppointmentStatus $status, int $queue): Appointment => Appointment::factory()->status($status)->create(['practice_session_id' => $session->id, 'queue_number' => $queue]);

        $pending = $make(AppointmentStatus::Pending, 1);
        $confirmed = $make(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, 2);
        $checkedIn = $make(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 3);
        $completed = $make(AppointmentStatus::Completed, 4);
        $cancelled = $make(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, 5);
        $noShow = $make(AppointmentStatus::NoShow, 6);

        $this->assertNull($pending->confirmed_at);
        $this->assertNotNull($confirmed->confirmed_at);
        $this->assertNull($confirmed->checked_in_at);
        $this->assertNotNull($checkedIn->checked_in_at);
        $this->assertNull($checkedIn->completed_at);
        $this->assertNotNull($completed->completed_at);
        $this->assertNotNull($cancelled->cancelled_at);
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::System, $cancelled->cancelled_by_type);
        $this->assertNull($cancelled->confirmed_at);
        $this->assertNotNull($noShow->no_show_at);
        $this->assertNull($noShow->completed_at);
    }

    // --- upcomingActive (F3-R15) ---

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: string, 1: AppointmentStatus, 2: string, 3: string, 4: bool}>
     */
    public static function upcomingCases(): array
    {
        return [
            'aktif, besok' => ['2026-10-06', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, '08:00:00', '12:00:00', true],
            'pending, besok' => ['2026-10-06', AppointmentStatus::Pending, '08:00:00', '12:00:00', true],
            'check-in, hari ini belum berakhir' => ['2026-10-05', AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, '09:00:00', '10:00:01', true],
            'aktif, hari ini tepat berakhir' => ['2026-10-05', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, '08:00:00', '10:00:00', false],
            'aktif, hari ini sudah berakhir' => ['2026-10-05', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, '06:00:00', '09:00:00', false],
            'aktif, kemarin' => ['2026-10-04', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, '08:00:00', '23:00:00', false],
            'dibatalkan, besok' => ['2026-10-06', AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, '08:00:00', '12:00:00', false],
            'selesai, besok' => ['2026-10-06', AppointmentStatus::Completed, '08:00:00', '12:00:00', false],
            'tidak hadir, besok' => ['2026-10-06', AppointmentStatus::NoShow, '08:00:00', '12:00:00', false],
        ];
    }

    /** Sekarang: Senin 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 10.00. */
    #[DataProvider('upcomingCases')]
    public function test_upcoming_active_scope(string $date, AppointmentStatus $status, string $start, string $end, bool $expected): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => null, 'session_date' => $date, 'start_time' => $start, 'end_time' => $end]);
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session, $status);

        $found = Appointment::query()->upcomingActive()->whereKey($appointment->id)->exists();

        $this->assertSame($expected, $found);
    }

    public function test_upcoming_active_scope_accepts_an_explicit_moment(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => null, 'session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session);

        $this->assertTrue(Appointment::query()->upcomingActive(now()->setTime(11, 59, 59))->whereKey($appointment->id)->exists());
        $this->assertFalse(Appointment::query()->upcomingActive(now()->setTime(12, 0, 0))->whereKey($appointment->id)->exists());
    }

    // --- AppointmentStatusHistory ---

    public function test_status_history_has_no_updated_at_and_casts_enums(): void
    {
        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::factory()->create()->fresh();

        $this->assertNull(AppointmentStatusHistory::UPDATED_AT);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('updated_at', $history->getAttributes());
        $this->assertNotNull($history->created_at);
        $this->assertNull($history->from_status);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $history->to_status);
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::System, $history->actor_type);
    }

    public function test_status_history_relations(): void
    {
        $staff = User::factory()->staff()->create();
        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::factory()->create(['actor_type' => ActorType::Staff, 'actor_user_id' => $staff->id]);

        $loaded = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->with(['appointment', 'actor'])->findOrFail($history->id);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Appointment::class, $loaded->appointment);
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $loaded->actor->id);
    }

    public function test_status_history_is_append_only(): void
    {
        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::factory()->create();

        try {
            $history->update(['reason' => 'Diubah']);
            $this->fail('Riwayat tidak boleh diubah.');
        } catch (LogicException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('Riwayat status appointment tidak dapat diubah atau dihapus.', $e->getMessage());
        }

        try {
            $history->delete();
            $this->fail('Riwayat tidak boleh dihapus.');
        } catch (LogicException) {
            $this->addToAssertionCount(1);
        }

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('appointment_status_histories', ['id' => $history->id, 'reason' => null]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Models;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Factory fase 3 (DoctorSchedule, ScheduleException, PracticeSession). Factory appointment, pasien, dan
 * riwayat diuji di BookingModelsTest.
 */
class ScheduleFactoriesTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 08:00:00');
    }

    public function test_schedule_factory_creates_an_active_template_in_the_doctors_clinic(): void
    {
        $schedule = DoctorSchedule::factory()->create();

        $this->assertTrue($schedule->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(1, $schedule->day_of_week);
        $this->assertSame(20, $schedule->quota);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05', $schedule->valid_from->toDateString());
        $this->assertNull($schedule->valid_until);
        $this->assertSame(Doctor::query()->findOrFail($schedule->doctor_id)->clinic_id, $schedule->clinic_id);
    }

    public function test_schedule_factory_keeps_an_explicit_clinic_and_has_an_inactive_state(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $other = Doctor::factory()->create();

        $schedule = DoctorSchedule::factory()->inactive()->create(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $other->clinic_id]);

        $this->assertFalse($schedule->is_active);
        $this->assertSame($doctor->id, $schedule->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($other->clinic_id, $schedule->clinic_id);
    }

    public function test_exception_factory_default_is_a_doctor_leave_that_satisfies_the_scope_check(): void
    {
        $exception = ScheduleException::factory()->create();

        $this->assertSame(ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, $exception->type);
        $this->assertNotNull($exception->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-12', $exception->start_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-14', $exception->end_date->toDateString());
    }

    public function test_exception_factory_states_produce_valid_type_and_doctor_combinations(): void
    {
        $leave = ScheduleException::factory()->leave()->create();
        $hospital = ScheduleException::factory()->hospitalHoliday()->create();
        $national = ScheduleException::factory()->nationalHoliday()->create();
        $global = ScheduleException::factory()->global()->create();

        $this->assertSame(ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, $leave->type);
        $this->assertNotNull($leave->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame(ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday, $hospital->type);
        $this->assertNull($hospital->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame(ExceptionType::NationalHoliday, $national->type);
        $this->assertNull($national->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame(ExceptionType::Other, $global->type);
        $this->assertNull($global->doctor_id);
        $this->assertTrue($global->is_global);
    }

    public function test_exception_leave_state_keeps_a_given_doctor(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();

        $exception = ScheduleException::factory()->leave()->create(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id]);

        $this->assertSame($doctor->id, $exception->doctor_id);
    }

    public function test_session_factory_creates_a_coherent_template_session(): void
    {
        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->create();
        $schedule = DoctorSchedule::query()->findOrFail($session->doctor_schedule_id);

        $this->assertSame('2026-10-06', $session->session_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->status);
        $this->assertSame($session->doctor_id, $schedule->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->clinic_id, $schedule->clinic_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->session_date->isoWeekday(), $schedule->day_of_week);
        $this->assertSame([$session->start_time, $session->end_time, $session->quota], [$schedule->start_time, $schedule->end_time, $schedule->quota]);
        $this->assertSame([0, 0], [$session->booked_count, $session->last_queue_number]);
    }

    public function test_session_factory_manual_state_has_no_template(): void
    {
        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create();

        $this->assertNull($session->doctor_schedule_id);
        $this->assertTrue($session->isManual());
        $this->assertSame(0, DoctorSchedule::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_session_factory_status_states(): void
    {
        $closed = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->closed()->create();
        $cancelled = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->cancelled()->create();
        $review = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->needsReview(['source' => 'manual_cancel', 'reason' => 'Dokter sakit'])->create();

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Closed, $closed->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $cancelled->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $review->status);
        $this->assertSame(['source' => 'manual_cancel', 'reason' => 'Dokter sakit'], $review->fresh()->pending_change);
    }

    public function test_session_factory_keeps_the_counters_within_the_check_constraints(): void
    {
        $capped = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(['quota' => 5, 'booked_count' => 9]);
        $queue = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(['quota' => 10, 'booked_count' => 4, 'last_queue_number' => 1]);

        $this->assertSame([5, 5], [$capped->fresh()->booked_count, $capped->fresh()->last_queue_number]);
        $this->assertSame([4, 4], [$queue->fresh()->booked_count, $queue->fresh()->last_queue_number]);
    }

    public function test_session_factory_batch_has_distinct_templates_and_no_unique_collisions(): void
    {
        $sessions = PracticeSession::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $this->assertCount(3, $sessions->pluck('doctor_schedule_id')->unique());
        $this->assertSame(3, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Models;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Pembantu tes `InteractsWithSchedules`: pencacah sesi harus selalu konsisten dengan CHECK dan invarian I-1/I-2.
 */
class InteractsWithSchedulesTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 08:00:00');
    }

    public function test_create_helpers_return_persisted_models_and_accept_overrides(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['quota' => 33]);
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 44, 'doctor_schedule_id' => null]);
        $exception = $this->createException(['reason' => 'Seminar']);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(DoctorSchedule::class, $schedule);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(PracticeSession::class, $session);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ScheduleException::class, $exception);
        $this->assertSame(33, $schedule->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertSame(44, $session->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertNull($session->fresh()->doctor_schedule_id);
        $this->assertSame('Seminar', $exception->fresh()->reason);
    }

    public function test_book_appointment_increments_the_counters_and_numbers_the_queue_sequentially(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 5]);

        $first = $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $second = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->assertSame([1, 2], [$first->queue_number, $second->queue_number]);
        $this->assertSame([2, 2], [$session->booked_count, $session->last_queue_number], 'Instance pemanggil ikut diperbarui.');
        $this->assertSame([2, 2], [$session->fresh()->booked_count, $session->fresh()->last_queue_number]);
    }

    public function test_book_appointment_copies_doctor_clinic_and_date_from_the_session(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-12']);

        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session);

        $this->assertSame($session->id, $appointment->practice_session_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->doctor_id, $appointment->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->clinic_id, $appointment->clinic_id);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-12', $appointment->session_date->toDateString());
    }

    public function test_a_cancelled_appointment_consumes_a_queue_number_but_not_quota(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 2]);

        $cancelled = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $active = $this->bookAppointment($session);

        $this->assertSame(1, $cancelled->queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(2, $active->queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(2, $session->last_queue_number);
        $this->assertNull($cancelled->active_flag);
        $this->assertSame(1, $active->active_flag, 'Hasil dikembalikan dalam keadaan ter-refresh sehingga active_flag terbaca.');
    }

    public function test_counters_satisfy_i1_and_i2_after_a_mixed_batch(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 10]);

        foreach (AppointmentStatus::cases() as $status) {
            $this->bookAppointment($session, $status);
        }

        $nonCancelled = Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->quotaConsuming()->count();
        $maxQueue = (int) Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->max('queue_number');

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame($nonCancelled, $fresh->booked_count, 'I-1');
        $this->assertSame($maxQueue, $fresh->last_queue_number, 'I-2');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual($fresh->booked_count, $fresh->last_queue_number, 'chk_sessions_queue');
    }

    public function test_booking_beyond_the_quota_is_rejected_by_the_check_constraint(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 1]);
        $this->bookAppointment($session);

        try {
            $this->bookAppointment($session);
            $this->fail('Kuota terlampaui seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(4025, $e->errorInfo[1]);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('`chk_sessions_quota`', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame(1, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_book_appointment_uses_a_new_patient_each_time_or_the_given_one(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 5]);
        $patient = PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        $first = $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $second = $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $same = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, ['patient_profile_id' => $patient->id]);

        $this->assertNotSame($first->patient_profile_id, $second->patient_profile_id);
        $this->assertSame($patient->id, $same->patient_profile_id);
        $this->assertSame(3, PatientProfile::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_book_appointment_applies_overrides(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(['quota' => 5]);

        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['complaint' => 'Demam tiga hari']);

        $this->assertSame('Demam tiga hari', $appointment->complaint);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $appointment->status);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Database\Factories\DoctorScheduleFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

/**
 * Templat jadwal mingguan (lapis 1, 00 F.1). Sesi per tanggal dibangkitkan dari templat ini oleh
 * PracticeSessionGenerator; perubahan setelah ada booking melalui ScheduleChangeService (00 F.4).
 * Model ini tidak diobservasi AuditObserver: audit ditulis service.
 */
class DoctorSchedule extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<DoctorScheduleFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    /** Nama hari menurut ISO-8601 (1 = Senin ... 7 = Minggu). */
    public const DAY_NAMES = [
        1 => 'Senin',
        2 => 'Selasa',
        3 => 'Rabu',
        4 => 'Kamis',
        5 => 'Jumat',
        6 => 'Sabtu',
        7 => 'Minggu',
    ];

    /**
     * `created_by` dan `updated_by` sengaja tidak termasuk: diisi event `saving` dari Auth::id().
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'doctor_id',
        'clinic_id',
        'day_of_week',
        'start_time',
        'end_time',
        'quota',
        'valid_from',
        'valid_until',
        'is_active',
        'notes',
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'day_of_week' => 'integer',
            'quota' => 'integer',
            'valid_from' => 'date',
            'valid_until' => 'date',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::saving(function (self $schedule): void {
            $userId = Auth::id();

            if ($userId === null) {
                return;
            }

            if (! $schedule->exists && $schedule->created_by === null) {
                $schedule->created_by = $userId;
            }

            $schedule->updated_by = $userId;
        });
    }

    public function doctor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Doctor::class);
    }

    public function clinic(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Clinic::class);
    }

    public function sessions(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(PracticeSession::class, 'doctor_schedule_id');
    }

    public function creator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'created_by');
    }

    public function updater(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'updated_by');
    }

    public function scopeActive(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('doctor_schedules.is_active', true);
    }

    /** Berlaku pada tanggal tertentu: `valid_from <= tanggal` dan (`valid_until` NULL atau `>= tanggal`). */
    public function scopeEffectiveOn(Builder $query, CarbonInterface|string $date): Builder
    {
        $day = Carbon::parse($date)->toDateString();

        return $query
            ->where('doctor_schedules.valid_from', '<=', $day)
            ->where(function (Builder $range) use ($day): void {
                $range->whereNull('doctor_schedules.valid_until')->orWhere('doctor_schedules.valid_until', '>=', $day);
            });
    }

    /** Hari ISO-8601 (1 = Senin ... 7 = Minggu). */
    public function scopeOnDay(Builder $query, int $isoDay): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('doctor_schedules.day_of_week', $isoDay);
    }

    /**
     * Templat AKTIF dokter yang sama pada hari yang sama dengan jam beririsan dan rentang berlaku beririsan
     * (V-23). Jam bersebelahan (selesai 12:00, mulai 12:00) tidak beririsan. Templat nonaktif tidak dihitung.
     * `$ignoreId` mengecualikan templat itu sendiri saat ubah.
     */
    public function scopeOverlapping(
        Builder $query,
        int $doctorId,
        int $dayOfWeek,
        string $start,
        string $end,
        CarbonInterface $validFrom,
        ?CarbonInterface $validUntil,
        ?int $ignoreId = null,
    ): Builder {
        return $query
            ->where('doctor_schedules.doctor_id', $doctorId)
            ->where('doctor_schedules.is_active', true)
            ->where('doctor_schedules.day_of_week', $dayOfWeek)
            ->where('doctor_schedules.start_time', '<', self::normalizeTime($end))
            ->where('doctor_schedules.end_time', '>', self::normalizeTime($start))
            ->where(function (Builder $range) use ($validFrom): void {
                $range->whereNull('doctor_schedules.valid_until')
                    ->orWhere('doctor_schedules.valid_until', '>=', $validFrom->toDateString());
            })
            ->when(
                $validUntil !== null,
                fn (Builder $inner): Builder => $inner->where('doctor_schedules.valid_from', '<=', $validUntil?->toDateString()),
            )
            ->when(
                $ignoreId !== null,
                fn (Builder $inner): Builder => $inner->where('doctor_schedules.id', '!=', $ignoreId),
            );
    }

    /** Nama hari: "Senin" ... "Minggu". */
    protected function dayName(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): string => self::DAY_NAMES[(int) $this->day_of_week] ?? '');
    }

    /** Rentang jam tampilan, mis. "08.00–12.00". */
    protected function timeRange(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): string => self::displayTime((string) $this->start_time).'–'.self::displayTime((string) $this->end_time));
    }

    /**
     * Ada sesi milik templat ini pada waktu mendatang yang punya appointment aktif (F.4: dasar penolakan
     * ganti poliklinik dan arsip dokter). Memakai Appointment::upcomingActive().
     */
    public function hasUpcomingActiveAppointments(?CarbonInterface $now = null): bool
    {
        return $this->sessions()
            ->whereHas('appointments', fn (Builder $appointments): Builder => $appointments->upcomingActive($now))
            ->exists();
    }

    /**
     * Alasan hapus ditolak (BR-12), atau null bila boleh dihapus: ditolak bila ada sesi milik templat ini
     * yang pernah memiliki appointment (termasuk yang hanya riwayat batal).
     */
    public function deletionBlockedReason(): ?string
    {
        if ($this->sessions()->whereHas('appointments')->exists()) {
            return 'Jadwal ini sudah memiliki sesi dengan pendaftaran dan hanya dapat dinonaktifkan.';
        }

        return null;
    }

    /** "08:00" atau "08:00:00" menjadi "08:00:00" agar dibandingkan sebagai TIME. */
    private static function normalizeTime(string $time): string
    {
        return strlen($time) === 5 ? $time.':00' : $time;
    }

    /** "08:00:00" menjadi "08.00". */
    private static function displayTime(string $time): string
    {
        return str_replace(':', '.', substr($time, 0, 5));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Database\Factories\ScheduleExceptionFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

/**
 * Pengecualian jadwal (lapis 2, 00 F.1): cuti dokter, libur rumah sakit, libur nasional, atau lainnya,
 * selalu satu hari penuh. `doctor_id` NULL berarti berlaku untuk seluruh dokter. Tidak ada penghapusan
 * langsung: "hapus" = ScheduleChangeService::removeException() lalu delete().
 */
class ScheduleException extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<ScheduleExceptionFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'doctor_id',
        'type',
        'start_date',
        'end_date',
        'reason',
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string|class-string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => ExceptionType::class,
            'start_date' => 'date',
            'end_date' => 'date',
        ];
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::creating(function (self $exception): void {
            $userId = Auth::id();

            if ($userId !== null && $exception->created_by === null) {
                $exception->created_by = $userId;
            }
        });
    }

    /** Dokter yang bercuti; NULL untuk pengecualian yang berlaku bagi seluruh dokter. */
    public function doctor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Doctor::class);
    }

    public function creator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'created_by');
    }

    public function sessions(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(PracticeSession::class, 'schedule_exception_id');
    }

    /** Mencakup tanggal tertentu (kedua ujung termasuk). */
    public function scopeCovering(Builder $query, CarbonInterface $date): Builder
    {
        $day = $date->toDateString();

        return $query
            ->where('schedule_exceptions.start_date', '<=', $day)
            ->where('schedule_exceptions.end_date', '>=', $day);
    }

    /** Berlaku bagi dokter itu: `doctor_id` NULL (semua dokter) atau sama dengan dokter. */
    public function scopeForDoctor(Builder $query, int $doctorId): Builder
    {
        return $query->where(function (Builder $scope) use ($doctorId): void {
            $scope->whereNull('schedule_exceptions.doctor_id')->orWhere('schedule_exceptions.doctor_id', $doctorId);
        });
    }

    /** Belum berakhir: `end_date >= hari ini`. */
    public function scopeUpcoming(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('schedule_exceptions.end_date', '>=', today()->toDateString());
    }

    /**
     * Memilih satu pengecualian untuk dokter pada tanggal tertentu dari kumpulan yang sudah dimuat (BR-21,
     * F3-R10): hanya yang mencakup tanggal dan berlaku bagi dokter; yang khusus dokter didahulukan, lalu
     * `id` terkecil. NULL bila tidak ada.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, self>  $exceptions
     */
    public static function pickFor(Collection $exceptions, int $doctorId, CarbonInterface $date): ?self
    {
        $day = $date->toDateString();

        return $exceptions
            ->filter(fn (self $exception): bool => $exception->start_date->toDateString() <= $day
                && $exception->end_date->toDateString() >= $day
                && ($exception->doctor_id === null || (int) $exception->doctor_id === $doctorId))
            ->sort(function (self $a, self $b): int {
                $rankA = $a->doctor_id === null ? 1 : 0;
                $rankB = $b->doctor_id === null ? 1 : 0;

                return [$rankA, (int) $a->id] <=> [$rankB, (int) $b->id];
            })
            ->first();
    }

    /** Berlaku untuk seluruh dokter. */
    protected function isGlobal(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): bool => $this->doctor_id === null);
    }

    /** "12 Oktober 2026" untuk satu hari, atau "12 Oktober 2026 – 14 Oktober 2026" untuk rentang. */
    protected function rangeLabel(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(function (): string {
            $first = $this->start_date->translatedFormat('j F Y');

            return $this->start_date->isSameDay($this->end_date)
                ? $first
                : $first.' – '.$this->end_date->translatedFormat('j F Y');
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Database\Factories\PracticeSessionFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

/**
 * Sesi praktik konkret per tanggal (lapis 3, 00 F.1): hasil pembangkitan dari templat atau sesi tambahan
 * manual (`doctor_schedule_id` NULL). Baris ini dikunci (lockForUpdate) saat booking. `booked_count` dan
 * `last_queue_number` bukan fillable: hanya service di bawah kunci yang mengubahnya (forceFill).
 */
class PracticeSession extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<PracticeSessionFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    /** Sumber `pending_change` (F3-R14, 00 F.4). Nilai disimpan di JSON `pending_change.source`. */
    public const SOURCE_EXCEPTION = 'exception';

    public const SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TIME = 'template_time';

    public const SOURCE_TEMPLATE_REMOVED = 'template_removed';

    public const SOURCE_MANUAL_TIME = 'manual_time';

    public const SOURCE_MANUAL_CANCEL = 'manual_cancel';

    public const SOURCE_DOCTOR_INACTIVE = 'doctor_inactive';

    /** Sumber jenis-batal: mengalahkan jenis-jam pada prioritas `pending_change`. */
    public const CANCEL_SOURCES = [
        self::SOURCE_EXCEPTION,
        self::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_REMOVED,
        self::SOURCE_MANUAL_CANCEL,
        self::SOURCE_DOCTOR_INACTIVE,
    ];

    /** Sumber jenis-jam: tidak pernah menimpa jenis-batal. */
    public const TIME_SOURCES = [
        self::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TIME,
        self::SOURCE_MANUAL_TIME,
    ];

    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'doctor_id',
        'clinic_id',
        'doctor_schedule_id',
        'session_date',
        'start_time',
        'end_time',
        'quota',
        'status',
        'status_reason',
        'schedule_exception_id',
        'pending_change',
        'is_manually_modified',
        'reviewed_by',
        'reviewed_at',
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string|class-string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'session_date' => 'date',
            'quota' => 'integer',
            'booked_count' => 'integer',
            'last_queue_number' => 'integer',
            'status' => SessionStatus::class,
            'pending_change' => 'array',
            'is_manually_modified' => 'boolean',
            'reviewed_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    public function doctor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Doctor::class);
    }

    public function clinic(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Clinic::class);
    }

    /** Templat asal; NULL untuk sesi tambahan manual. */
    public function schedule(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(DoctorSchedule::class, 'doctor_schedule_id');
    }

    /** Pengecualian penyebab `cancelled`/`needs_review`. */
    public function exception(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(ScheduleException::class, 'schedule_exception_id');
    }

    public function appointments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Appointment::class);
    }

    public function reviewer(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'reviewed_by');
    }

    /** Tanggal sesi di antara dua tanggal (kedua ujung termasuk); menerima Carbon atau "Y-m-d". */
    public function scopeBetween(Builder $query, CarbonInterface|string $from, CarbonInterface|string $to): Builder
    {
        return $query->whereBetween('practice_sessions.session_date', [
            Carbon::parse($from)->toDateString(),
            Carbon::parse($to)->toDateString(),
        ]);
    }

    /** Tanggal sesi persis; menerima Carbon atau "Y-m-d". */
    public function scopeOnDate(Builder $query, CarbonInterface|string $date): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('practice_sessions.session_date', Carbon::parse($date)->toDateString());
    }

    /** Tanggal sesi hari ini atau sesudahnya (tidak memeriksa jam). */
    public function scopeUpcoming(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('practice_sessions.session_date', '>=', today()->toDateString());
    }

    public function scopeOpen(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('practice_sessions.status', SessionStatus::Open->value);
    }

    public function scopeNeedsReview(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('practice_sessions.status', SessionStatus::NeedsReview->value);
    }

    public function scopeForDoctor(Builder $query, int $doctorId): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('practice_sessions.doctor_id', $doctorId);
    }

    public function scopeForClinic(Builder $query, int $clinicId): Builder
    {
        return $query->where('practice_sessions.clinic_id', $clinicId);
    }

    /**
     * Belum berakhir pada `$now` (bawaan sekarang): tanggal sesudah hari ini, atau hari ini dengan
     * `end_time > jam sekarang`. Sesi yang berakhir tepat pada `$now` dianggap sudah berakhir.
     */
    public function scopeNotEnded(Builder $query, ?CarbonInterface $now = null): Builder
    {
        $moment = self::momentOf($now);

        return $query->where(function (Builder $ended) use ($moment): void {
            $ended->where('practice_sessions.session_date', '>', $moment->toDateString())
                ->orWhere(function (Builder $today) use ($moment): void {
                    $today->where('practice_sessions.session_date', $moment->toDateString())
                        ->where('practice_sessions.end_time', '>', $moment->format('H:i:s'));
                });
        });
    }

    /** `quota - booked_count`, tidak pernah negatif. */
    protected function remaining(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): int => max(0, (int) $this->quota - (int) $this->booked_count));
    }

    /**
     * Waktu mulai (`CarbonImmutable`, zona aplikasi). Tanpa cache objek: mengikuti perubahan `start_time`.
     *
     * @return Attribute<CarbonImmutable, never>
     */
    protected function startsAt(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): CarbonImmutable => $this->combine((string) $this->start_time))->withoutObjectCaching();
    }

    /**
     * Waktu selesai (`CarbonImmutable`, zona aplikasi). Tanpa cache objek.
     *
     * @return Attribute<CarbonImmutable, never>
     */
    protected function endsAt(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): CarbonImmutable => $this->combine((string) $this->end_time))->withoutObjectCaching();
    }

    /** Rentang jam tampilan, mis. "08.00–12.00". */
    protected function timeRange(): Attribute
    {
        return Attribute::get(fn (): string => str_replace(':', '.', substr((string) $this->start_time, 0, 5))
            .'–'
            .str_replace(':', '.', substr((string) $this->end_time, 0, 5)));
    }

    /** Sesi sudah berakhir: `ends_at <= $now` (bawaan sekarang). */
    public function isEnded(?CarbonInterface $now = null): bool
    {
        return $this->ends_at->lessThanOrEqualTo(self::momentOf($now));
    }

    /** Sesi tambahan manual (bukan hasil templat). */
    public function isManual(): bool
    {
        return $this->doctor_schedule_id === null;
    }

    public function hasActiveAppointments(): bool
    {
        return $this->appointments()->active()->exists();
    }

    /** Nilai `pending_change.source`, atau NULL bila tidak ada `pending_change`. */
    public function pendingSource(): ?string
    {
        $source = is_array($this->pending_change) ? ($this->pending_change['source'] ?? null) : null;

        return is_string($source) ? $source : null;
    }

    /**
     * Alasan hapus ditolak (00 C, F3-R20), atau null bila boleh dihapus: hanya sesi tambahan manual yang
     * tidak pernah memiliki appointment.
     */
    public function deletionBlockedReason(): ?string
    {
        if (! $this->isManual()) {
            return 'Sesi dari templat tidak dapat dihapus. Tutup atau batalkan sesi ini.';
        }

        if ($this->appointments()->exists()) {
            return 'Sesi ini sudah memiliki pendaftaran. Tutup atau batalkan sesi ini.';
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function combine(string $time): CarbonImmutable
    {
        return CarbonImmutable::parse($this->session_date->toDateString().' '.$time, (string) config('app.timezone'));
    }

    private static function momentOf(?CarbonInterface $now): CarbonImmutable
    {
        return CarbonImmutable::instance($now ?? now())->setTimezone((string) config('app.timezone'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Database\Factories\AppointmentFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

/**
 * Satu pendaftaran kunjungan (09 §4.1). Fase 3 hanya menyediakan skema, model, factory, dan pembantu tes;
 * `BookingService` dan `AppointmentStatusService` (fase 6) adalah satu-satunya jalur tulis. Relasi
 * `insurancePartner()` ditambahkan fase 4/6, ketika model InsurancePartner ada (F3-R3).
 * `booking_code`, `queue_number`, `status`, kolom waktu status, dan `active_flag` (generated) bukan fillable.
 */
class Appointment extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<AppointmentFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'patient_profile_id',
        'practice_session_id',
        'doctor_id',
        'clinic_id',
        'session_date',
        'channel',
        'payment_type',
        'insurance_partner_id',
        'payment_reference',
        'complaint',
        'created_by_user_id',
    ];

    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $hidden = [
        'payment_reference',
    ];

    /**
     * @return array<string, string|class-string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'session_date' => 'date',
            'queue_number' => 'integer',
            'status' => AppointmentStatus::class,
            'channel' => BookingChannel::class,
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::class,
            'payment_reference' => 'encrypted',
            'confirmed_at' => 'datetime',
            'checked_in_at' => 'datetime',
            'completed_at' => 'datetime',
            'cancelled_at' => 'datetime',
            'no_show_at' => 'datetime',
            'cancelled_by_type' => ActorType::class,
            'schedule_changed_at' => 'datetime',
            'active_flag' => 'integer',
        ];
    }

    public function patientProfile(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(PatientProfile::class);
    }

    public function practiceSession(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(PracticeSession::class);
    }

    public function doctor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Doctor::class);
    }

    public function clinic(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Clinic::class);
    }

    /** Riwayat status, urut kronologis. */
    public function statusHistories(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(AppointmentStatusHistory::class)->orderBy('created_at')->orderBy('id');
    }

    /** Petugas pembuat (kanal loket); NULL untuk online. */
    public function creator(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'created_by_user_id');
    }

    public function canceller(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'cancelled_by_user_id');
    }

    /** Status aktif: pending, confirmed, checked_in (AppointmentStatus::ACTIVE; selaras dengan `active_flag`). */
    public function scopeActive(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->whereIn('appointments.status', self::values(AppointmentStatus::ACTIVE));
    }

    /** Status yang memakai kuota sesi: semua kecuali cancelled (AppointmentStatus::QUOTA_CONSUMING). */
    public function scopeQuotaConsuming(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        return $query->whereIn('appointments.status', self::values(AppointmentStatus::QUOTA_CONSUMING));
    }

    /**
     * Appointment aktif pada sesi yang belum berakhir pada `$now` (F3-R15): `session_date > hari ini`, atau
     * hari ini dengan `end_time > jam sekarang`. Satu-satunya implementasi definisi "aktif mendatang".
     */
    public function scopeUpcomingActive(Builder $query, ?CarbonInterface $now = null): Builder
    {
        return $query
            ->active()
            ->whereHas('practiceSession', fn (Builder $session): Builder => $session->notEnded($now));
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<AppointmentStatus>  $statuses
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private static function values(array $statuses): array
    {
        return array_map(fn (AppointmentStatus $status): string => $status->value, $statuses);
    }
}
```

```php
use LogicException;

/**
 * Jejak perubahan status appointment (09 §4.2). Append-only: tidak ada `updated_at`, tidak dapat diubah
 * atau dihapus lewat model (hapus appointment oleh DB tetap meng-cascade).
 */
class AppointmentStatusHistory extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<AppointmentStatusHistoryFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    /** Tabel append-only: tidak ada updated_at. */
    public const UPDATED_AT = null;

    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'appointment_id',
        'from_status',
        'to_status',
        'actor_type',
        'actor_user_id',

    /**

    {
        return [
            'from_status' => AppointmentStatus::class,
            'to_status' => AppointmentStatus::class,
            'actor_type' => ActorType::class,
            'created_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::updating(function (): void {
            throw new LogicException('Riwayat status appointment tidak dapat diubah atau dihapus.');
        });

        static::deleting(function (): void {
            throw new LogicException('Riwayat status appointment tidak dapat diubah atau dihapus.');
        });
    }

    public function appointment(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Appointment::class);
    }

    public function actor(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'actor_user_id');
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;

/**
 * @extends Factory<PracticeSession>
 */
class PracticeSessionFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * Sesi hasil templat besok pukul 08.00-12.00, kuota 20, status open, belum ada booking. Templat dibuat
     * serasi (dokter, poliklinik, hari ISO, jam, kuota sama); gunakan manual() untuk sesi tambahan tanpa
     * templat. `booked_count` dan `last_queue_number` tidak pernah melanggar CHECK (lihat configure()).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'doctor_id' => Doctor::factory(),
            'clinic_id' => fn (array $attributes): int => Doctor::query()->findOrFail($attributes['doctor_id'])->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => today()->addDay()->toDateString(),
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => fn (array $attributes): int => DoctorSchedule::factory()->create([
                'doctor_id' => $attributes['doctor_id'],
                'clinic_id' => $attributes['clinic_id'],
                'day_of_week' => CarbonImmutable::parse($attributes['session_date'])->isoWeekday(),
                'start_time' => $attributes['start_time'],
                'end_time' => $attributes['end_time'],
                'quota' => $attributes['quota'],
            ])->id,
            'booked_count' => 0,
            'last_queue_number' => 0,
            'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
            'status_reason' => null,
            'schedule_exception_id' => null,
            'pending_change' => null,
            'is_manually_modified' => false,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Menjaga CHECK `chk_sessions_quota` dan `chk_sessions_queue` pada nilai yang ditimpa tes:
     * `booked_count` dipangkas ke `quota`, dan `last_queue_number` tidak pernah di bawah `booked_count`.
     */
    public function configure(): static
    {
        return $this->afterMaking(function (PracticeSession $session): void {
            if ((int) $session->booked_count > (int) $session->quota) {
                $session->booked_count = (int) $session->quota;
            }

            if ((int) $session->last_queue_number < (int) $session->booked_count) {
                $session->last_queue_number = (int) $session->booked_count;
            }
        });
    }

    /** Sesi tambahan manual: tanpa templat (`doctor_schedule_id` NULL). */
    public function manual(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);
    }

    /** Ditutup petugas (status `closed`). */
    public function closed(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'status' => SessionStatus::Closed,
            'status_reason' => 'Ditutup sementara',
        ]);
    }

    /** Dibatalkan (status `cancelled`); isi `schedule_exception_id` untuk sesi yang dibatalkan pengecualian. */
    public function cancelled(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
            'status_reason' => 'Dibatalkan',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Menunggu tindak lanjut petugas pendaftaran, dengan `pending_change` menurut 00 F.4, mis.
     * `['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => 12]`.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $pendingChange
     */
    public function needsReview(array $pendingChange): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes): array => [
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'pending_change' => $pendingChange,
        ]);
    }
}
```

`database/factories/AppointmentFactory.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<Appointment>
 */
class AppointmentFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * Appointment `confirmed` kanal online, pembayaran umum, nomor antrean 1. Dokter, poliklinik, dan tanggal
     * diturunkan dari sesi. Factory TIDAK mengubah `booked_count`/`last_queue_number` sesi: untuk appointment
     * yang menjaga invarian kuota gunakan `InteractsWithSchedules::bookAppointment()`. Beberapa appointment
     * pada sesi yang sama wajib diberi `queue_number` berbeda.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'booking_code' => 'UPH-'.Str::upper(fake()->unique()->bothify('????-????')),
            'patient_profile_id' => PatientProfile::factory(),
            'practice_session_id' => PracticeSession::factory(),
            'doctor_id' => fn (array $attributes): int => PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($attributes['practice_session_id'])->doctor_id,
            'clinic_id' => fn (array $attributes): int => PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($attributes['practice_session_id'])->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => fn (array $attributes): string => PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($attributes['practice_session_id'])->session_date->toDateString(),
            'queue_number' => 1,
            'status' => AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
            'channel' => BookingChannel::Online,
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Umum,
            'insurance_partner_id' => null,
            'payment_reference' => null,
            'complaint' => null,
            'confirmed_at' => now(),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Menetapkan status beserta kolom waktu yang sesuai (09 §4.1, invarian I-14): `confirmed` mengisi
     * `confirmed_at`; `checked_in` menambah `checked_in_at`; `completed` menambah `completed_at`; `cancelled`
     * mengisi `cancelled_at` dan `cancelled_by_type`; `no_show` mengisi `no_show_at`.
     */
    public function status(AppointmentStatus $status): static
    {
        return $this->state(function (array $attributes) use ($status): array {
            $now = now();

            $timestamps = [
                'confirmed_at' => null,
                'checked_in_at' => null,
                'completed_at' => null,
                'cancelled_at' => null,
                'no_show_at' => null,
                'cancelled_by_type' => null,
                'cancel_reason' => null,
            ];

            switch ($status) {
                case AppointmentStatus::Pending:
                    break;
                case AppointmentStatus::Confirmed:
                    $timestamps['confirmed_at'] = $now;
                    break;
                case AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn:
                    $timestamps['confirmed_at'] = $now;
                    $timestamps['checked_in_at'] = $now;
                    break;
                case AppointmentStatus::Completed:
                    $timestamps['confirmed_at'] = $now;
                    $timestamps['checked_in_at'] = $now;
                    $timestamps['completed_at'] = $now;
                    break;
                case AppointmentStatus::Cancelled:
                    $timestamps['cancelled_at'] = $now;
                    $timestamps['cancelled_by_type'] = ActorType::System;
                    $timestamps['cancel_reason'] = 'Dibatalkan';
                    break;
                case AppointmentStatus::NoShow:
                    $timestamps['no_show_at'] = $now;
                    break;
            }

            return ['status' => $status] + $timestamps;
        });
    }
}
```

`tests/Support/InteractsWithSchedules.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Support;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Pembantu tes untuk jadwal, sesi, pengecualian, dan appointment. Dipakai bersama RefreshDatabase.
 * Appointment dibuat lewat factory; pencacah sesi (`booked_count`, `last_queue_number`) dijaga konsisten
 * dengan CHECK `chk_sessions_quota` dan `chk_sessions_queue` serta invarian I-1/I-2.
 */
trait InteractsWithSchedules
{
    /**
     * Templat jadwal aktif (Senin 08.00-12.00, kuota 20) untuk dokter baru, kecuali ditimpa.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    protected function createSchedule(array $overrides = []): DoctorSchedule
    {
        return DoctorSchedule::factory()->create($overrides);
    }

    /**
     * Sesi hasil templat (besok 08.00-12.00, kuota 20, open) dengan templat serasi; isi
     * `doctor_schedule_id => null` untuk sesi tambahan manual.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    protected function createSession(array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return PracticeSession::factory()->create($overrides);
    }

    /**
     * Pengecualian jadwal (cuti dokter tiga hari mulai 7 hari lagi), kecuali ditimpa. Jenis libur memakai
     * `type` dan `doctor_id => null`.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    protected function createException(array $overrides = []): ScheduleException
    {
        return ScheduleException::factory()->create($overrides);
    }

    /**
     * Membuat appointment pada sesi dan memperbarui pencacah sesi di bawah kunci tulis: nomor antrean =
     * `last_queue_number + 1` (kecuali `queue_number` ditimpa), `last_queue_number` naik, dan `booked_count`
     * naik kecuali status `cancelled` (yang tidak memakai kuota). Pasien baru dibuat kecuali
     * `patient_profile_id` ditimpa. Melebihi kuota memicu CHECK `chk_sessions_quota` (QueryException).
     * Instance `$session` pemanggil diperbarui dan appointment dikembalikan dalam keadaan ter-refresh
     * (termasuk `active_flag`).
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    protected function bookAppointment(
        PracticeSession $session,
        AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
        array $overrides = [],
    ): Appointment {
        $appointment = DB::transaction(function () use ($session, $status, $overrides): Appointment {
            $locked = PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($session->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

            $queue = (int) ($overrides['queue_number'] ?? $locked->last_queue_number + 1);
            $patientId = $overrides['patient_profile_id'] ?? PatientProfile::factory()->create()->id;

            $appointment = Appointment::factory()->status($status)->create(array_merge([
                'patient_profile_id' => $patientId,
                'practice_session_id' => $locked->id,
                'doctor_id' => $locked->doctor_id,
                'clinic_id' => $locked->clinic_id,
                'session_date' => $locked->session_date->toDateString(),
                'queue_number' => $queue,
            ], $overrides));

            $locked->forceFill([
                'last_queue_number' => max((int) $locked->last_queue_number, $queue),
                'booked_count' => (int) $locked->booked_count + ($status === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled ? 0 : 1),
            ])->save();

            return $appointment;
        });

        $session->refresh();

        return $appointment->refresh();
    }
}
```
