```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Doctors;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Doctors\DoctorService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Titik sambung F2-R8 yang diisi fase 3 (F3-R15, F3-R29): arsip dokter ditolak bila masih ada appointment
 * aktif pada sesi yang belum berakhir. Berlaku juga untuk Super Admin (CRD-03 dan JDW-16 bagian arsip).
 */
class DoctorArchiveAppointmentsTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const REFUSAL_ONE = 'Dokter masih memiliki 1 pendaftaran aktif pada sesi mendatang. Selesaikan sesi terdampak terlebih dahulu, lalu arsipkan dokter.';

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 10:00:00');
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $session
     */
    private function bookFor(Doctor $doctor, AppointmentStatus $status, array $session = []): Appointment
    {
        $practiceSession = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
        ], $session));

        return $this->bookAppointment($practiceSession, $status);
    }

    private function actor(): Actor
    {
        return Actor::staff($this->createStaff('super-admin'));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function managers(): array
    {
        return ['admin konten' => ['content-admin'], 'super admin' => ['super-admin']];
    }

    public function test_archiving_a_doctor_without_appointments_is_allowed_by_the_service(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();

        $archived = app(DoctorService::class)->archive($doctor, 'Pindah tugas', $this->actor());

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Archived, $archived->status);
        $this->assertNull(app(DoctorService::class)->archiveBlockedReason($doctor));
    }

    public function test_an_active_appointment_on_a_future_session_blocks_the_archive_with_the_specified_message(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->assertSame(self::REFUSAL_ONE, app(DoctorService::class)->archiveBlockedReason($doctor));

        try {
            app(DoctorService::class)->archive($doctor, null, $this->actor());
            $this->fail('Arsip seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(self::REFUSAL_ONE, $e->errors()['status'][0]);
        }

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, $doctor->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertNull($doctor->fresh()->archived_at);
    }

    public function test_each_active_status_blocks_and_the_message_counts_them(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, ['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);

        $this->assertStringStartsWith('Dokter masih memiliki 3 pendaftaran aktif', (string) app(DoctorService::class)->archiveBlockedReason($doctor));
    }

    public function test_finished_cancelled_and_past_appointments_do_not_block_the_archive(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::NoShow);
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['session_date' => '2026-10-04', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:00']);

        $this->assertNull(app(DoctorService::class)->archiveBlockedReason($doctor), 'Sesi hari ini yang tepat berakhir pukul 10.00 sudah berakhir.');
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Archived, app(DoctorService::class)->archive($doctor, null, $this->actor())->status);
    }

    public function test_appointments_of_another_doctor_do_not_block(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $other = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->bookFor($other, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->assertNull(app(DoctorService::class)->archiveBlockedReason($doctor));
        $this->assertSame(self::REFUSAL_ONE, app(DoctorService::class)->archiveBlockedReason($other));
    }

    public function test_the_block_is_lifted_when_the_appointment_is_cancelled(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $appointment = $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->assertNotNull(app(DoctorService::class)->archiveBlockedReason($doctor));

        $appointment->forceFill(['status' => AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, 'cancelled_at' => now(), 'cancelled_by_type' => ActorType::Staff])->save();

        $this->assertNull(app(DoctorService::class)->archiveBlockedReason($doctor));
    }

    #[DataProvider('managers')]
    public function test_the_archive_route_refuses_even_for_super_admin_and_keeps_the_doctor_active(string $role): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))
            ->from(route('admin.doctors.show', $doctor))
            ->patch(route('admin.doctors.archive', $doctor), ['reason' => 'Pindah tugas'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.doctors.show', $doctor))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', self::REFUSAL_ONE);

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, $doctor->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('audit_logs', ['action' => 'doctor.archived']);
    }

    #[DataProvider('managers')]
    public function test_the_archive_route_succeeds_once_no_active_future_appointment_remains(string $role): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        // Sesi lampau (4 Okt): tidak disentuh applyDoctorInactive (T8), sehingga flash tetap tanpa ringkasan laporan.
        $this->bookFor($doctor, AppointmentStatus::Completed, ['session_date' => '2026-10-04']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))
            ->patch(route('admin.doctors.archive', $doctor))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Dokter diarsipkan.');

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Archived, $doctor->fresh()->status);
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Admin/ClinicSchedulingCarryTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\ClinicRequest;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use ReflectionMethod;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Titik sambung fase 2 yang diisi fase 3 (F3-R29): penghapusan poliklinik yang dirujuk jadwal, sesi, atau
 * appointment (BR-17, F2-R18) dan penguncian `code` poliklinik setelah ada appointment (BR-13, I-31).
 */
class ClinicSchedulingCarryTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const SCHEDULE_REASON = 'Poliklinik ini masih dipakai oleh jadwal atau data pendaftaran sehingga tidak dapat dihapus. Nonaktifkan saja.';

    private const DOCTOR_REASON = 'Poliklinik ini masih dirujuk oleh data dokter sehingga tidak dapat dihapus. Nonaktifkan saja.';

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 10:00:00');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function deleters(): array
    {
        return ['admin konten' => ['content-admin'], 'super admin' => ['super-admin']];
    }

    /**
     * Poliklinik tanpa dokter yang menjadi tempat praktik dokter dari poliklinik lain, sehingga hanya
     * jadwal/sesi/appointment yang merujuknya.
     */
    private function clinicUsedOnlyBySchedules(): Clinic
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic();
        $schedule = DoctorSchedule::factory()->create(['clinic_id' => $clinic->id]);

        $this->assertSame(0, $clinic->doctors()->count());
        $this->assertSame($clinic->id, $schedule->clinic_id);

        return $clinic;
    }

    public function test_a_clinic_with_only_a_schedule_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->clinicUsedOnlyBySchedules();

        $this->assertSame(self::SCHEDULE_REASON, $clinic->deletionBlockedReason());
    }

    public function test_a_clinic_with_only_a_session_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic();
        PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(['clinic_id' => $clinic->id]);

        $this->assertSame(self::SCHEDULE_REASON, $clinic->deletionBlockedReason());
    }

    public function test_a_clinic_with_only_an_appointment_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic();
        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(['clinic_id' => $clinic->id]);
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

        $this->assertSame(self::SCHEDULE_REASON, $clinic->deletionBlockedReason());
        $this->assertSame(1, $clinic->appointments()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_doctor_message_takes_precedence_and_an_unused_clinic_stays_deletable(): void
    {
        $withDoctor = $this->createDoctor()->clinic()->first();
        $unused = $this->createClinic();

        $this->assertSame(self::DOCTOR_REASON, $withDoctor->deletionBlockedReason());
        $this->assertNull($unused->deletionBlockedReason());
    }

    #[DataProvider('deleters')]
    public function test_the_delete_route_refuses_a_clinic_used_by_a_schedule_even_for_super_admin(string $role): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->clinicUsedOnlyBySchedules();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))
            ->delete(route('admin.clinics.destroy', $clinic))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.clinics.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', self::SCHEDULE_REASON);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('clinics', ['id' => $clinic->id]);
    }

    public function test_clinic_has_appointments_reads_the_appointments_table(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic();
        $method = new ReflectionMethod(ClinicRequest::class, 'clinicHasAppointments');

        $this->assertTrue($method->isProtected());
        $this->assertFalse($method->invoke(new ClinicRequest, $clinic));

        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(['clinic_id' => $clinic->id]);
        $this->assertFalse($method->invoke(new ClinicRequest, $clinic), 'Sesi tanpa appointment belum mengunci kode.');

        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

        $this->assertTrue($method->invoke(new ClinicRequest, $clinic));
        $this->assertFalse($method->invoke(new ClinicRequest, $this->createClinic()));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(Clinic $clinic, string $code): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => $clinic->name,
            'code' => $code,
            'type' => 'poliklinik',
            'is_bookable' => '1',
            'short_description' => 'Layanan contoh untuk pengujian.',
            'location' => 'Gedung A Lt. 1',
            'is_active' => '1',
            'sort_order' => '0',
        ];
    }

    public function test_the_clinic_code_is_locked_once_an_appointment_exists_but_stays_editable_before(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic(['code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'));

        $this->put(route('admin.clinics.update', $clinic), $this->payload($clinic, 'ANL'))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->assertSame('ANL', $clinic->fresh()->code);

        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(['clinic_id' => $clinic->id]);
        $this->bookAppointment($session);

        $this->put(route('admin.clinics.update', $clinic), $this->payload($clinic, 'ZZZ'))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['code' => 'Kode poliklinik tidak dapat diubah karena sudah dipakai pada nomor antrean.']);
        $this->assertSame('ANL', $clinic->fresh()->code);

        $this->put(route('admin.clinics.update', $clinic), $this->payload($clinic, 'ANL'))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
    }
}
```

```php
    public function test_future_appointment_seam_is_protected_and_always_zero_in_phase_two(): void
```

### Task 3: Spike konkurensi KON-01 (dua koneksi PDO)

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/Support/RawPdoConnection.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Database/ConcurrencySpikeTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: skema Task 1; `PracticeSession::factory()->manual()`, `PatientProfile::factory()` (Task 2); `Tests\Support\DatabaseGuard`; `config('database.connections.mariadb')`.
- Produces:
  - `Tests\Support\RawPdoConnection::open(int $lockWaitTimeoutSeconds = 1): PDO` (final class; koneksi MariaDB baru ke `unpam_hospital_test`, mode galat `ERRMODE_EXCEPTION`, `SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout`). Nama baru (opsional di kerangka), dipakai ulang oleh tes konkurensi fase 6.
  - Pola tes konkurensi tanpa transaksi pembungkus: `use RefreshDatabase; protected $connectionsToTransact = [];` dengan pembersihan di `tearDown()`.

**Test IDs:** KON-01 versi spike (F3-R6): (a) tunggu kunci baris sampai galat 1205 (≈ KON-01c), (b) urutan kunci baku tanpa deadlock dan kunci pasien (KON-01d), (c) UNIQUE aktif (I-8), (d) CHECK `chk_sessions_quota` (KON-01a sisi DB).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Mekanisme yang dipilih: `RefreshDatabase` dengan `$connectionsToTransact = []`.**
  - `RefreshDatabase::connectionsToTransact()` membaca properti `$connectionsToTransact`. Dengan `[]`, trait tetap menjalankan `migrate:fresh` satu kali per proses (skema dijamin ada, juga saat tes dijalankan sendirian dengan `--filter`), tetapi **tidak membuka transaksi pembungkus**.
  - Akibatnya baris yang dibuat factory lewat koneksi aplikasi berjalan autocommit dan langsung **ter-commit**. Koneksi PDO A dan B adalah sesi MariaDB lain yang memulai transaksinya sesudah itu, sehingga baris terlihat oleh keduanya. Tes pertama membuktikannya (`DB::transactionLevel() === 0`, `COUNT(*)` dari A dan B, dan `CONNECTION_ID()` ketiganya berbeda).
  - Dua alternatif ditolak: `DatabaseMigrations` menjalankan `migrate:fresh` sebelum dan `migrate:rollback` sesudah **setiap** tes (puluhan detik pada suite yang sudah ±160 s), sedangkan `DatabaseTruncation` memerlukan daftar tabel dan memotong semua tabel termasuk data lain. Pendekatan ini hanya menghapus baris yang dibuat tes sendiri.
- **Mengapa satu proses PHP cukup.** Koneksi A memegang kunci lalu *diam*; koneksi B memanggil `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` yang memblokir sampai `innodb_lock_wait_timeout = 1` detik lalu gagal dengan SQLSTATE `HY000` dan errno `1205` (PDOException; `errorInfo[1]`). Karena A tidak sedang menunggu apa pun, tidak ada siklus tunggu dan PHP tidak perlu thread atau proses anak. Timeout 1 detik diset per sesi pada kedua koneksi supaya kekeliruan tidak membuat tes menggantung 50 detik. MariaDB memeriksa timeout dengan granularitas satu detik, sehingga menunggu bernilai 1–2 detik (asersi: ≥ 0,9 dan < 5 detik).
- **Tidak ada deadlock sungguhan yang direproduksi.** Siklus tunggu (A menunggu B dan B menunggu A) memerlukan dua pemanggilan yang memblokir serentak, di luar jangkauan satu proses sinkron. Tes (b) membuktikan jaminan yang relevan: dengan urutan baku `patient_profiles → practice_sessions`, transaksi kedua yang menunggu **tidak** menghalangi transaksi pertama (A selesai < 0,5 detik) dan galat yang muncul selalu 1205, bukan 1213. Pembuktian beban paralel penuh ada di KON-02 (fase 6).
- **Pengulangan transaksi.** Seperti `DB::transaction(..., attempts: 3)`, tes mengulang *seluruh* transaksi B (`rollBack` lalu mulai lagi) setelah 1205, sehingga pembacaan berikutnya memakai snapshot baru. Pembacaan `FOR UPDATE` selalu memberi nilai terbaru yang ter-commit.
- **Pembersihan.** `tearDown()` me-rollback transaksi PDO yang masih terbuka (supaya kunci tidak menahan penghapusan), menutup kedua koneksi, lalu menghapus baris yang dilacak sesuai urutan FK: `appointments`, `practice_sessions`, `patient_profiles`, `doctors`, `clinics`. Sesi dibuat dengan `manual()` agar tidak ada templat yang perlu dibersihkan. Tes terakhir menegaskan tabel `appointments`, `practice_sessions`, dan `patient_profiles` kosong di awal tes, sehingga kebocoran data terdeteksi.
- **`RawPdoConnection`** menolak database yang namanya tidak berakhiran `_test` (`DatabaseGuard`), mengatur `time_zone` dari konfigurasi koneksi, dan memverifikasi bahwa `innodb_lock_wait_timeout` sesi benar-benar terpasang. Kredensial berasal dari `config('database.connections.mariadb')` (nilai `.env.testing` dan `phpunit.xml`), sama dengan koneksi aplikasi.
- **Pelanggaran UNIQUE yang menunggu (c3).** Sisipan duplikat `(patient_profile_id, practice_session_id, active_flag = 1)` saat sisipan pertama belum di-commit menunggu kunci indeks UNIQUE (1205 setelah 1 detik). Setelah A commit, pengulangan berakhir 1062 dengan nama `appointments_patient_session_active_unique`. Ini perilaku yang diterjemahkan `BookingService` (11.4, fase 6).
- Waktu tambahan pada suite: ±8 detik. Jumlah tes: **11**.
- Semua blok PHP lolos `php -l` 8.2 dan `pint --test`.

- [ ] **Step 2: Tulis tes yang gagal (tool Write) `tests/Feature/Database/ConcurrencySpikeTest.php`**

`tests/Feature/Database/ConcurrencySpikeTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Database;

use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use PDO;
use PDOException;
use Tests\Support\RawPdoConnection;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * KON-01 versi spike fase 3 (F3-R6): dua koneksi PDO mentah ke database uji membuktikan perilaku penguncian
 * baris dan constraint yang menjadi dasar `BookingService` (fase 6). Versi penuh dengan `BookingService`,
 * proses anak, dan beban N paralel ada di fase 6.
 *
 * Mekanisme (mengapa baris terlihat lintas koneksi):
 *  - Kelas ini memakai RefreshDatabase hanya untuk memastikan skema termigrasi, tetapi
 *    `$connectionsToTransact = []` mematikan transaksi pembungkus. Baris yang dibuat factory lewat koneksi
 *    aplikasi berjalan dalam autocommit, sehingga langsung TER-COMMIT dan terlihat oleh koneksi PDO lain.
 *  - Koneksi A dan B adalah sesi MariaDB terpisah (transaksi dan kunci sendiri). `innodb_lock_wait_timeout`
 *    diatur 1 detik pada keduanya. Kunci baris yang dipegang A membuat B menunggu sampai galat 1205, dan
 *    karena A tidak sedang menunggu apa pun, satu proses PHP cukup (tanpa proses anak atau thread).
 *  - Karena data ter-commit, `tearDown()` membersihkannya sesuai urutan FK (appointments, sesi, pasien,
 *    dokter, poliklinik) agar tes lain tidak terpengaruh. Transaksi PDO yang masih terbuka di-rollback lebih
 *    dulu supaya kunci tidak menahan penghapusan.
 */
class ConcurrencySpikeTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /** Tanpa transaksi pembungkus: data harus ter-commit agar terlihat oleh koneksi PDO lain. */
    protected $connectionsToTransact = [];

    private ?PDO $a = null;

    private ?PDO $b = null;

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $sessionIds = [];

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $patientIds = [];

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $doctorIds = [];

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $clinicIds = [];

    private int $codeSequence = 0;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->assertSame(0, DB::transactionLevel(), 'Tes konkurensi tidak boleh berjalan di dalam transaksi.');

        $this->a = RawPdoConnection::open(1);
        $this->b = RawPdoConnection::open(1);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        try {
            foreach ([$this->a, $this->b] as $pdo) {
                if ($pdo !== null && $pdo->inTransaction()) {
                    $pdo->rollBack();
                }
            }

            $this->a = null;
            $this->b = null;

            if ($this->sessionIds !== []) {
                DB::table('appointments')->whereIn('practice_session_id', $this->sessionIds)->delete();
                DB::table('practice_sessions')->whereIn('id', $this->sessionIds)->delete();
            }

            if ($this->patientIds !== []) {
                DB::table('patient_profiles')->whereIn('id', $this->patientIds)->delete();
            }

            if ($this->doctorIds !== []) {
                DB::table('doctors')->whereIn('id', $this->doctorIds)->delete();
            }

            if ($this->clinicIds !== []) {
                DB::table('clinics')->whereIn('id', $this->clinicIds)->delete();
            }
        } finally {
            parent::tearDown();
        }
    }

    // --- Pembantu data (koneksi aplikasi, autocommit) ---

    private function makeSession(int $quota = 5): PracticeSession
    {
        $session = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create([
            'quota' => $quota,
            'session_date' => today()->addDay()->toDateString(),
        ]);

        $this->sessionIds[] = $session->id;
        $this->doctorIds[] = $session->doctor_id;
        $this->clinicIds[] = $session->clinic_id;

        return $session;
    }

    private function makePatient(): PatientProfile
    {
        $patient = PatientProfile::factory()->create();
        $this->patientIds[] = $patient->id;

        return $patient;
    }

    // --- Pembantu SQL mentah ---

    /**
     * SELECT ... FOR UPDATE: pembacaan berkunci selalu membaca nilai terbaru yang ter-commit.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function lockRow(PDO $pdo, string $table, int $id): array
    {
        $statement = $pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM {$table} WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE");
        $statement->execute([$id]);

        return (array) $statement->fetch();
    }

    /**
     * Awal transaksi booking dengan urutan kunci baku F.6: patient_profiles lalu practice_sessions.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed> baris sesi yang terkunci
     */
    private function beginAndLock(PDO $pdo, int $patientId, int $sessionId): array
    {
        $pdo->beginTransaction();
        $this->lockRow($pdo, 'patient_profiles', $patientId);

        return $this->lockRow($pdo, 'practice_sessions', $sessionId);
    }

    /**
     * Sisipkan appointment lalu naikkan pencacah sesi (tanpa commit). Mengembalikan nomor antrean.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $session  baris sesi yang terkunci (hasil beginAndLock)
     */
    private function insertBooking(PDO $pdo, int $patientId, array $session, string $status = 'pending'): int
    {
        $queue = (int) $session['last_queue_number'] + 1;

        $this->insertAppointment($pdo, $patientId, $session, $queue, $status);

        $update = $pdo->prepare('UPDATE practice_sessions SET booked_count = booked_count + 1, last_queue_number = ? WHERE id = ?');
        $update->execute([$queue, $session['id']]);

        return $queue;
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $session */
    private function insertAppointment(PDO $pdo, int $patientId, array $session, int $queue, string $status): void
    {
        $this->codeSequence++;

        $insert = $pdo->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO appointments (booking_code, patient_profile_id, practice_session_id, doctor_id, clinic_id, session_date, queue_number, status, channel, payment_type, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        );
        $now = now()->toDateTimeString();
        $insert->execute([
            sprintf('UPH-%04d-%04d', $this->codeSequence, random_int(0, 9999)),
            $patientId,
            $session['id'],
            $session['doctor_id'],
            $session['clinic_id'],
            $session['session_date'],
            $queue,
            $status,
            'online',
            'umum',
            $now,
            $now,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan $callback dan mengukur waktunya.
     *
     * @return array{0: ?PDOException, 1: float} galat (bila ada) dan lama dalam detik
     */
    private function attempt(callable $callback): array
    {
        $start = hrtime(true);
        $error = null;

        try {
            $callback();
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            $error = $e;
        }

        return [$error, (hrtime(true) - $start) / 1_000_000_000];
    }

    private function commitIfOpen(PDO $pdo): void
    {
        if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
            $pdo->commit();
        }
    }

    private function rollBackIfOpen(PDO $pdo): void
    {
        if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
            $pdo->rollBack();
        }
    }

    // --- Mekanisme ---

    public function test_rows_created_by_the_application_connection_are_committed_and_visible_to_other_connections(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $patient = $this->makePatient();

        $this->assertSame(0, DB::transactionLevel());

        foreach ([$this->a, $this->b] as $pdo) {
            $this->assertSame(1, (int) $pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_sessions WHERE id = {$session->id}")->fetchColumn());
            $this->assertSame(1, (int) $pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_profiles WHERE id = {$patient->id}")->fetchColumn());
        }
    }

    public function test_the_two_raw_connections_are_distinct_server_sessions_with_a_one_second_lock_wait(): void
    {
        $idA = (int) $this->a->query('SELECT CONNECTION_ID()')->fetchColumn();
        $idB = (int) $this->b->query('SELECT CONNECTION_ID()')->fetchColumn();
        $idApp = (int) DB::selectOne('SELECT CONNECTION_ID() AS id')->id;

        $this->assertCount(3, array_unique([$idA, $idB, $idApp]));
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) $this->a->query('SELECT @@SESSION.innodb_lock_wait_timeout')->fetchColumn());
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) $this->b->query('SELECT @@SESSION.innodb_lock_wait_timeout')->fetchColumn());
    }

    // --- (a) SELECT ... FOR UPDATE pada sesi yang sama ---

    public function test_for_update_on_the_same_session_waits_until_the_lock_wait_timeout_then_succeeds_after_commit(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();

        $this->a->beginTransaction();
        $this->assertSame($session->id, (int) $this->lockRow($this->a, 'practice_sessions', $session->id)['id']);

        $this->b->beginTransaction();
        [$error, $seconds] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->lockRow($this->b, 'practice_sessions', $session->id));

        $this->assertInstanceOf(PDOException::class, $error, 'Koneksi B seharusnya menunggu lalu gagal.');
        $this->assertSame('HY000', $error->errorInfo[0]);
        $this->assertSame(1205, $error->errorInfo[1], 'Lock wait timeout, bukan deadlock (1213).');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(0.9, $seconds, 'B harus benar-benar menunggu sekitar satu detik.');
        $this->assertLessThan(5.0, $seconds);

        $this->commitIfOpen($this->a);

        [$retryError, $retrySeconds] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->lockRow($this->b, 'practice_sessions', $session->id));

        $this->assertNull($retryError, 'Setelah A commit, B memperoleh kunci.');
        $this->assertLessThan(0.5, $retrySeconds);

        $this->commitIfOpen($this->b);
    }

    public function test_a_rollback_releases_the_lock_for_the_waiting_connection(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();

        $this->a->beginTransaction();
        $this->lockRow($this->a, 'practice_sessions', $session->id);
        $this->b->beginTransaction();
        [$error] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->lockRow($this->b, 'practice_sessions', $session->id));
        $this->assertSame(1205, $error?->errorInfo[1]);

        $this->a->rollBack();
        [$retryError] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->lockRow($this->b, 'practice_sessions', $session->id));

        $this->assertNull($retryError);
        $this->commitIfOpen($this->b);
    }

    // --- (b) Urutan kunci baku patient_profiles -> practice_sessions -> appointments ---

    public function test_the_patient_lock_serialises_bookings_of_the_same_patient_on_different_sessions_kon01d(): void
    {
        $patient = $this->makePatient();
        $first = $this->makeSession();
        $second = $this->makeSession();

        $firstRow = $this->beginAndLock($this->a, $patient->id, $first->id);

        $this->b->beginTransaction();
        [$error, $seconds] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->lockRow($this->b, 'patient_profiles', $patient->id));

        $this->assertSame(1205, $error?->errorInfo[1], 'Kunci pertama (pasien) menahan B; bukan deadlock.');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(0.9, $seconds);

        // A tidak terhalang oleh B: B belum memegang kunci apa pun yang dibutuhkan A.
        [$aError, $aSeconds] = $this->attempt(function () use ($patient, $firstRow): void {
            $this->insertBooking($this->a, $patient->id, $firstRow);
            $this->a->commit();
        });
        $this->assertNull($aError);
        $this->assertLessThan(0.5, $aSeconds);

        // B mengulang seluruh transaksi (seperti DB::transaction attempts) dan berhasil.
        $this->rollBackIfOpen($this->b);
        $secondRow = $this->beginAndLock($this->b, $patient->id, $second->id);
        $queue = $this->insertBooking($this->b, $patient->id, $secondRow);
        $this->b->commit();

        $this->assertSame(1, $queue);
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->where('practice_session_id', $first->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->where('practice_session_id', $second->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $first->id)->value('booked_count'));
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $second->id)->value('booked_count'));
    }

    public function test_the_standard_lock_order_serialises_two_patients_on_one_session_without_a_deadlock(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(5);
        $first = $this->makePatient();
        $second = $this->makePatient();

        // A memegang pasien 1 dan sesi.
        $locked = $this->beginAndLock($this->a, $first->id, $session->id);

        // B memperoleh pasien 2 (bebas), lalu menunggu sesi sambil MEMEGANG kunci pasien 2.
        $this->b->beginTransaction();
        [$ownLockError, $ownLockSeconds] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->lockRow($this->b, 'patient_profiles', $second->id));
        $this->assertNull($ownLockError);
        $this->assertLessThan(0.5, $ownLockSeconds);

        [$error, $seconds] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->lockRow($this->b, 'practice_sessions', $session->id));
        $this->assertSame(1205, $error?->errorInfo[1], 'B menunggu kunci sesi: lock wait timeout, bukan deadlock (1213).');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(0.9, $seconds);

        // A tidak pernah meminta kunci pasien 2, sehingga tidak ada siklus tunggu: A selesai tanpa menunggu.
        [$aError, $aSeconds] = $this->attempt(function () use ($first, $locked): void {
            $this->insertBooking($this->a, $first->id, $locked);
            $this->a->commit();
        });
        $this->assertNull($aError);
        $this->assertLessThan(0.5, $aSeconds);

        // B mengulang transaksi dan memperoleh nomor antrean berikutnya.
        $this->rollBackIfOpen($this->b);
        $lockedAgain = $this->beginAndLock($this->b, $second->id, $session->id);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) $lockedAgain['booked_count'], 'B membaca nilai terbaru setelah A commit.');
        $queue = $this->insertBooking($this->b, $second->id, $lockedAgain);
        $this->b->commit();

        $this->assertSame(2, $queue);
        $this->assertSame([1, 2], DB::table('appointments')->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->orderBy('queue_number')->pluck('queue_number')->map(fn ($n): int => (int) $n)->all());

        $fresh = DB::table('practice_sessions')->find($session->id);
        $this->assertSame([2, 2], [(int) $fresh->booked_count, (int) $fresh->last_queue_number]);
    }

    // --- (c) UNIQUE (patient_profile_id, practice_session_id, active_flag) ---

    public function test_a_second_active_appointment_for_the_same_patient_and_session_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $patient = $this->makePatient();
        $row = $this->committedSessionRow($session->id);

        $this->a->beginTransaction();
        $this->insertAppointment($this->a, $patient->id, $row, 1, 'pending');
        $this->a->commit();

        $this->b->beginTransaction();

        try {
            $this->insertAppointment($this->b, $patient->id, $row, 2, 'confirmed');
            $this->fail('Appointment aktif kedua seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('23000', $e->errorInfo[0]);
            $this->assertSame(1062, $e->errorInfo[1]);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('appointments_patient_session_active_unique', $e->getMessage());
        } finally {
            $this->rollBackIfOpen($this->b);
        }

        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_cancelled_appointments_for_the_same_patient_and_session_are_accepted(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $patient = $this->makePatient();
        $row = $this->committedSessionRow($session->id);

        $this->a->beginTransaction();
        $this->insertAppointment($this->a, $patient->id, $row, 1, 'pending');
        $this->a->commit();

        $this->b->beginTransaction();
        $this->insertAppointment($this->b, $patient->id, $row, 2, 'cancelled');
        $this->insertAppointment($this->b, $patient->id, $row, 3, 'cancelled');
        $this->b->commit();

        $this->assertSame(3, DB::table('appointments')->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->whereNotNull('active_flag')->count());
    }

    public function test_a_duplicate_active_insert_waits_for_the_uncommitted_first_one_and_then_fails_with_1062(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $patient = $this->makePatient();
        $row = $this->committedSessionRow($session->id);

        $this->a->beginTransaction();
        $this->insertAppointment($this->a, $patient->id, $row, 1, 'pending');

        $this->b->beginTransaction();
        [$error, $seconds] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->insertAppointment($this->b, $patient->id, $row, 2, 'pending'));

        $this->assertSame(1205, $error?->errorInfo[1], 'Kunci UNIQUE milik sisipan A yang belum commit menahan B.');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(0.9, $seconds);

        $this->a->commit();

        [$retryError] = $this->attempt(fn () => $this->insertAppointment($this->b, $patient->id, $row, 2, 'pending'));

        $this->assertSame(1062, $retryError?->errorInfo[1], 'Setelah A commit, B mendapat duplikat.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('appointments_patient_session_active_unique', (string) $retryError?->getMessage());

        $this->rollBackIfOpen($this->b);
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->count());
    }

    // --- (d) CHECK chk_sessions_quota ---

    public function test_the_check_constraint_rejects_an_increment_beyond_the_quota_even_if_the_application_forgets_to_check(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(1);
        $first = $this->makePatient();
        $second = $this->makePatient();

        $locked = $this->beginAndLock($this->a, $first->id, $session->id);
        $this->insertBooking($this->a, $first->id, $locked);
        $this->a->commit();

        $lockedAgain = $this->beginAndLock($this->b, $second->id, $session->id);
        $this->assertSame([1, 1], [(int) $lockedAgain['booked_count'], (int) $lockedAgain['quota']], 'Sesi penuh: kursi terakhir sudah diambil A.');

        try {
            // Naif: tanpa memeriksa booked_count < quota.
            $this->b->prepare('UPDATE practice_sessions SET booked_count = booked_count + 1, last_queue_number = last_queue_number + 1 WHERE id = ?')
                ->execute([$session->id]);
            $this->fail('CHECK chk_sessions_quota seharusnya menolak.');
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('23000', $e->errorInfo[0]);
            $this->assertSame(4025, $e->errorInfo[1]);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('`chk_sessions_quota`', $e->getMessage());
        } finally {
            $this->rollBackIfOpen($this->b);
        }

        $fresh = DB::table('practice_sessions')->find($session->id);
        $this->assertSame([1, 1], [(int) $fresh->booked_count, (int) $fresh->last_queue_number]);
        $this->assertSame(1, DB::table('appointments')->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->count());
    }

    // --- Kebersihan ---

    public function test_the_database_is_clean_at_the_start_of_each_test(): void
    {
        foreach (['appointments', 'practice_sessions', 'patient_profiles'] as $table) {
            $this->assertSame(0, DB::table($table)->count(), "Tabel {$table} harus kosong: tes sebelumnya wajib membersihkan di tearDown().");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Membaca baris sesi tanpa transaksi (nilai ter-commit) untuk melengkapi kolom appointment.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function committedSessionRow(int $id): array
    {
        $row = DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $id)->first();

        return [
            'id' => $row->id,
            'doctor_id' => $row->doctor_id,
            'clinic_id' => $row->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $row->session_date,
            'last_queue_number' => $row->last_queue_number,
        ];
    }
}
```

`tests/Support/RawPdoConnection.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Support;

use PDO;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Koneksi PDO mentah ke database uji, terpisah dari koneksi aplikasi, untuk tes konkurensi (KON-01).
 * Setiap pemanggilan open() menghasilkan koneksi MariaDB baru (sesi server baru, transaksi sendiri).
 * Parameter diambil dari `config('database.connections.mariadb')`, yaitu nilai yang sama dengan koneksi
 * aplikasi di tes (phpunit.xml memaksa database `unpam_hospital_test`).
 */
final class RawPdoConnection
{
    /**
     * @param  int  $lockWaitTimeoutSeconds  `innodb_lock_wait_timeout` untuk sesi ini; kecil agar tes tidak
     *                                       menunggu 50 detik bila terjadi kekeliruan.
     */
    public static function open(int $lockWaitTimeoutSeconds = 1): PDO
    {
        /** @var array<string, mixed> $config */
        $config = config('database.connections.mariadb');

        $database = (string) $config['database'];
        DatabaseGuard::assertIsTestDatabase($database);

        $dsn = sprintf(
            'mysql:host=%s;port=%s;dbname=%s;charset=utf8mb4',
            $config['host'],
            $config['port'],
            $database,
        );

        $pdo = new PDO($dsn, (string) $config['username'], (string) $config['password'], [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
            PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES => false,
        ]);

        $pdo->exec("SET time_zone = '".(string) ($config['timezone'] ?? '+07:00')."'");
        $pdo->exec('SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout = '.max(1, $lockWaitTimeoutSeconds));

        $actual = (int) $pdo->query('SELECT @@SESSION.innodb_lock_wait_timeout')->fetchColumn();

        if ($actual !== max(1, $lockWaitTimeoutSeconds)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("innodb_lock_wait_timeout sesi tidak dapat diatur (nilai: {$actual}).");
        }

        return $pdo;
    }
}
```

### Task 4: `PracticeSessionGenerator`, perintah `sessions:generate`, dan scheduler

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Services/Scheduling/PracticeSessionGenerator.php` (folder `app/Services/Scheduling` baru)
- Create: `app/Console/Commands/GenerateSessions.php`
- Modify: `routes/console.php` (scheduler harian)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Scheduling/PracticeSessionGeneratorTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Scheduling/GenerateSessionsCommandTest.php` (folder `tests/Feature/Scheduling` baru)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `DoctorSchedule::active()` dan `ScheduleException::pickFor()` (Task 2); `SettingsService::int(string $key, int $default = 0): int` (fase 1); `Cache::lock()`; `Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules` (Task 2); `SettingsSeeder` (fase 1; kunci `booking.window_days`).
- Produces (persis kontrak kerangka):
  - `App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator` (`final class`)
    - `__construct(SettingsService $settings)`
    - `public const LOCK_KEY = 'sessions:generate'`
    - `public static function markerKey(CarbonInterface $date): string` (`'sessions:generated:'.Y-m-d`)
    - `public function ensureRange(CarbonInterface $from, CarbonInterface $to, ?DoctorSchedule $only = null): int` (jumlah sesi **baru**)
    - `public function ensureDailyHorizon(): int`
  - `App\Console\Commands\GenerateSessions`: `sessions:generate {--days= : Jumlah hari ke depan (1–120; bawaan booking.window_days)}`.
  - Scheduler: `Schedule::command('sessions:generate')->dailyAt('00:05')->withoutOverlapping();`.

**Test IDs:** JDW-01, JDW-02, JDW-13 (regenerasi tidak menyentuh sesi manual dan tidak mengubah sesi yang ada), JDW-03/04 sisi generator (sesi baru yang tercakup cuti/libur langsung `cancelled` dengan `schedule_exception_id`; label `leave`/`holiday` diverifikasi lewat `DoctorAvailabilityQuery` di Task 5 dan 7), BR-20 (tiga pemicu), BR-21/F3-R10 (pemilihan pengecualian), Review Focus 1 (pergantian hari untuk penanda harian).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Keputusan koordinator yang mengikat.** F3-R7: `ensureRange` diklem ke hari ini dan tidak pernah membuat sesi lampau (sesi lampau demo dibuat seeder fase 6/7). F3-R8: `ensureDailyHorizon()` memakai `Cache::lock(LOCK_KEY, 30)->get(callback)` **tanpa menunggu** dan mengembalikan 0 bila kunci dipegang proses lain; `ensureRange()` tidak mengunci (idempoten lewat `insertOrIgnore` dan UNIQUE); perintah memakai `block(10)`. F3-R10: pengecualian khusus dokter didahulukan, lalu `id` terkecil (`ScheduleException::pickFor`).
- **`Lock::get($callback)`** mengembalikan hasil callback bila kunci diperoleh (dan melepasnya), serta `false` bila tidak. `Lock::block($seconds, $callback)` melempar `Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\LockTimeoutException` setelah menunggu; polanya `Sleep::usleep(250 ms)` dan membaca `now()`, sehingga tes mempercepatnya dengan `Sleep::fake(syncWithCarbon: true)` (sleep palsu menggeser jam tes). `Sleep::fake(false)` dipanggil di `tearDown()` karena `Sleep` bersifat statis dan tidak direset framework.
- **Cache tes = `array`** (`phpunit.xml`; mendukung lock). Dua instance lock dengan kunci sama berbagi penyimpanan yang sama dalam satu aplikasi tes, sehingga tes dapat "memegang kunci sebagai proses lain". TTL penanda memakai `CarbonImmutable::endOfDay()`; `ArrayStore` memeriksa kedaluwarsa dengan jam yang digeser `travelTo`.
- **Jendela inklusif.** Jendela 30 hari = `today` s.d. `today + 30` (kedua ujung termasuk), sama dengan 11 §6.4 dan syarat `session_date <= today + window_days` pada 00 F.3. Pada `travelTo('2026-10-05 08:00:00')` (Senin): Senin 5, 12, 19, 26 Okt dan 2 Nov; Rabu 7, 14, 21, 28 Okt dan 4 Nov.
- **Iterasi tanggal.** Generator tidak memakai `CarbonPeriod`: ia melompat ke hari templat pertama pada atau setelah tanggal awal (`(day_of_week - isoWeekday + 7) % 7`), lalu maju per minggu, sehingga 110 templat × 30 hari tetap murah. Rentang diklem terhadap `valid_from`/`valid_until` templat.
- **`insertOrIgnore`** melewati Eloquent, jadi `created_at`/`updated_at` diisi manual (`now()`), `is_manually_modified` ditulis `0`, dan `pending_change` ditulis `null` eksplisit karena semua baris dalam satu potongan harus memiliki kolom yang sama. `INSERT IGNORE` menurunkan galat FK, data terpotong, dan NOT NULL menjadi peringatan (09 §14), sehingga data divalidasi lewat kueri templat (dokter aktif, poliklinik aktif) sebelum insert; kegagalan CHECK tetap galat.
- **Kueri.** Templat dimuat satu kali (`whereHas('doctor')`, `whereHas('clinic')`), pengecualian satu kali untuk seluruh rentang, lalu `pickFor` bekerja pada koleksi di memori (tanpa kueri per tanggal).
- **Perintah.** `--days` divalidasi dengan `filter_var(..., FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, min 1, max 120)`; `abc`, `3.5`, `7a`, kosong, 0, negatif, dan 121 ditolak dengan "Opsi --days harus bilangan bulat 1–120." dan kode keluar 1. Tanpa opsi, jumlah hari = `booking.window_days` (bawaan 30). Perintah **tidak** memakai `Actor` karena tidak menulis audit (12 §8: tanpa audit per sesi); `AuditLogger` pun akan memakai `Actor::system()` di konsol bila suatu saat dibutuhkan.
- **Scheduler.** `routes/console.php` dimuat oleh kernel konsol pada bootstrap tes, sehingga `app(Schedule::class)->events()` memuat acara `sessions:generate` dengan `expression` `5 0 * * *` dan `withoutOverlapping = true`. Windows Task Scheduler (16 §11.1) tetap opsional.
- **Dua perilaku yang sengaja tidak ada.** Generator tidak memperbarui sesi yang sudah ada (itu tugas `ScheduleChangeService`, Task 6) dan tidak membuat sesi untuk templat dokter `inactive`/`archived` atau poliklinik nonaktif.
- Jumlah tes: **38** (generator 24, perintah 14).
- Semua blok PHP lolos `php -l` 8.2 dan `pint --test`.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 00 F.2, 11 §6.4, F3-R7, F3-R8, F3-R10. JDW-01, JDW-02, JDW-13 (sisi generator), JDW-03/04 (sesi baru yang
 * tercakup cuti/libur langsung `cancelled`).
 *
 * Waktu tes: Senin 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 08.00. Jendela 30 hari = 5 Oktober s.d. 4 November (inklusif):
 * Senin 5, 12, 19, 26 Okt dan 2 Nov; Rabu 7, 14, 21, 28 Okt dan 4 Nov.
 */
class PracticeSessionGeneratorTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const MONDAYS = ['2026-10-05', '2026-10-12', '2026-10-19', '2026-10-26', '2026-11-02'];

    private const WEDNESDAYS = ['2026-10-07', '2026-10-14', '2026-10-21', '2026-10-28', '2026-11-04'];

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 08:00:00');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
    }

    private function generator(): PracticeSessionGenerator
    {
        return app(PracticeSessionGenerator::class);
    }

    private function window(): int
    {
        return app(SettingsService::class)->int('booking.window_days');
    }

    private function generate(?DoctorSchedule $only = null): int
    {
        return $this->generator()->ensureRange(CarbonImmutable::today(), CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays($this->window()), $only);
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    private function datesOf(DoctorSchedule $schedule): array
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)
            ->orderBy('session_date')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (PracticeSession $session): string => $session->session_date->toDateString())
            ->all();
    }

    // --- JDW-01 ---

    public function test_jdw01_generates_one_session_per_matching_weekday_with_the_template_values(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $monday = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'day_of_week' => 1, 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00', 'quota' => 20]);
        $wednesday = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'day_of_week' => 3, 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:30:00', 'quota' => 10]);

        $created = $this->generate();

        $this->assertSame(10, $created);
        $this->assertSame(self::MONDAYS, $this->datesOf($monday));
        $this->assertSame(self::WEDNESDAYS, $this->datesOf($wednesday));

        $session = PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $wednesday->id)->orderBy('session_date')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame($doctor->id, $session->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($wednesday->clinic_id, $session->clinic_id);
        $this->assertSame('13:00:00', $session->start_time);
        $this->assertSame('16:30:00', $session->end_time);
        $this->assertSame(10, $session->quota);
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->last_queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->status);
        $this->assertNull($session->status_reason);
        $this->assertNull($session->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertNull($session->pending_change);
        $this->assertFalse($session->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertNotNull($session->created_at);
        $this->assertNotNull($session->updated_at);
    }

    public function test_jdw01_templates_that_are_not_eligible_produce_no_sessions(): void
    {
        $eligible = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        DoctorSchedule::factory()->inactive()->create(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1, 'valid_from' => '2026-09-01', 'valid_until' => '2026-10-04']);
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1, 'valid_from' => '2026-12-01']);
        DoctorSchedule::factory()->create(['day_of_week' => 1, 'doctor_id' => Doctor::factory()->inactive()->create()->id]);
        DoctorSchedule::factory()->create(['day_of_week' => 1, 'doctor_id' => Doctor::factory()->archived()->create()->id]);
        DoctorSchedule::factory()->create(['day_of_week' => 1, 'clinic_id' => Clinic::factory()->inactive()->create()->id]);

        $created = $this->generate();

        $this->assertSame(5, $created);
        $this->assertSame([$eligible->id], PracticeSession::query()->pluck('doctor_schedule_id')->unique()->values()->all());
    }

    public function test_the_range_is_clamped_to_today_and_never_creates_past_sessions(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $created = $this->generator()->ensureRange(CarbonImmutable::today()->subDays(10), CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays(2));

        $this->assertSame(1, $created);
        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-05'], $this->datesOf($schedule));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generator()->ensureRange(CarbonImmutable::today()->subDays(10), CarbonImmutable::today()->subDay()));
        $this->assertSame(1, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_end_of_the_range_is_inclusive_and_the_window_limits_it(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 3]);

        $this->generator()->ensureRange(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05'), CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-13'));
        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-07'], $this->datesOf($schedule));

        $this->generator()->ensureRange(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05'), CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-14'));
        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-07', '2026-10-14'], $this->datesOf($schedule));
    }

    public function test_the_validity_range_of_the_template_limits_the_sessions_on_both_ends(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-12', 'valid_until' => '2026-10-26']);

        $this->generate();

        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-12', '2026-10-19', '2026-10-26'], $this->datesOf($schedule));
    }

    public function test_only_limits_generation_to_one_template(): void
    {
        $first = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $second = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $created = $this->generate($first);

        $this->assertSame(5, $created);
        $this->assertSame(5, $this->generator()->ensureRange(CarbonImmutable::today(), CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays(30), $second));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generate($first));
        $this->assertSame(10, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_an_ineligible_only_template_creates_nothing(): void
    {
        $inactive = DoctorSchedule::factory()->inactive()->create(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generate($inactive));
        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    // --- JDW-02 dan JDW-13 ---

    public function test_jdw02_running_twice_creates_no_duplicates_and_returns_zero(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $this->assertSame(5, $this->generate());
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generate());
        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_jdw02_manually_modified_and_booked_sessions_are_not_overwritten_by_regeneration(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1, 'quota' => 20]);
        $this->generate();

        $manual = PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->where('session_date', '2026-10-12')->firstOrFail();
        $manual->forceFill(['quota' => 3, 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:00', 'status' => SessionStatus::Closed, 'is_manually_modified' => true])->save();

        $booked = PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->where('session_date', '2026-10-19')->firstOrFail();
        $this->bookAppointment($booked);

        $schedule->update(['quota' => 99, 'start_time' => '07:00:00']);

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generate());

        $manual->refresh();
        $this->assertSame([3, '09:00:00', SessionStatus::Closed, true], [$manual->quota, $manual->start_time, $manual->status, $manual->is_manually_modified]);

        $booked->refresh();
        $this->assertSame([20, '08:00:00', 1], [$booked->quota, $booked->start_time, $booked->booked_count]);
    }

    public function test_jdw13_manual_sessions_without_a_template_are_never_created_or_touched(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'day_of_week' => 1]);
        $first = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-12', 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00', 'quota' => 7]);
        $second = PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-12', 'start_time' => '16:00:00', 'end_time' => '18:00:00', 'quota' => 8]);

        $this->generate();
        $this->generate();

        $this->assertSame(2, PracticeSession::query()->whereNull('doctor_schedule_id')->count());
        $this->assertSame(7, $first->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertSame(8, $second->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->count());
    }

    // --- JDW-03 dan JDW-04 (sisi generator) ---

    public function test_jdw03_new_sessions_inside_a_doctor_leave_are_created_cancelled_with_the_exception(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $monday = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'day_of_week' => 1]);
        $wednesday = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'day_of_week' => 3]);
        $leave = ScheduleException::factory()->leave()->create([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-14', 'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ]);

        $this->generate();

        $cancelled = PracticeSession::query()->where('status', SessionStatus::Cancelled->value)->orderBy('session_date')->get();

        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-12', '2026-10-14'], $cancelled->map(fn (PracticeSession $s): string => $s->session_date->toDateString())->all());
        $this->assertSame([$leave->id], $cancelled->pluck('schedule_exception_id')->unique()->values()->all());
        $this->assertSame(['Cuti tahunan'], $cancelled->pluck('status_reason')->unique()->values()->all());
        $this->assertSame([$monday->id, $wednesday->id], $cancelled->pluck('doctor_schedule_id')->all());
        $this->assertSame(8, PracticeSession::query()->where('status', SessionStatus::Open->value)->count());
        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $monday->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $wednesday->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_jdw04_a_hospital_holiday_cancels_the_sessions_of_every_doctor_on_that_date(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $other = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 3]);
        $holiday = ScheduleException::factory()->hospitalHoliday()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-19', 'end_date' => '2026-10-19']);

        $this->generate();

        $onHoliday = PracticeSession::query()->onDate(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-19'))->get();

        $this->assertCount(2, $onHoliday);
        $this->assertSame(['cancelled'], $onHoliday->map(fn (PracticeSession $session): string => $session->status->value)->unique()->values()->all());
        $this->assertSame([$holiday->id], $onHoliday->pluck('schedule_exception_id')->unique()->values()->all());
        $this->assertSame(['Libur rumah sakit'], $onHoliday->pluck('status_reason')->unique()->values()->all());
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $other->id)->firstOrFail()->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, PracticeSession::query()->where('status', SessionStatus::Cancelled->value)->distinct()->count('session_date'));
    }

    public function test_an_exception_for_another_doctor_does_not_cancel_the_session(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        ScheduleException::factory()->leave()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);

        $this->generate();

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->where('status', SessionStatus::Cancelled->value)->count());
    }

    public function test_an_other_exception_applies_to_one_doctor_or_to_everyone_depending_on_doctor_id(): void
    {
        $first = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $second = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        ScheduleException::factory()->create([
            'doctor_id' => $first->doctor_id, 'type' => 'other', 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12', 'reason' => 'Kegiatan khusus',
        ]);
        ScheduleException::factory()->global()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-19', 'end_date' => '2026-10-19']);

        $this->generate();

        $status = fn (DoctorSchedule $schedule, string $date): SessionStatus => PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->where('session_date', $date)->firstOrFail()->status;

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $status($first, '2026-10-12'));
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $status($second, '2026-10-12'));
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $status($first, '2026-10-19'));
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $status($second, '2026-10-19'));
    }

    public function test_f3_r10_a_doctor_specific_exception_wins_over_a_global_one_and_the_smallest_id_wins_among_equals(): void
    {
        $first = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $second = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $globalA = ScheduleException::factory()->hospitalHoliday()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        ScheduleException::factory()->nationalHoliday()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        $leave = ScheduleException::factory()->leave()->create(['doctor_id' => $first->doctor_id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);

        $this->generate();

        $exceptionOf = fn (DoctorSchedule $schedule): ?int => PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->where('session_date', '2026-10-12')->firstOrFail()->schedule_exception_id;

        $this->assertGreaterThan($globalA->id, $leave->id);
        $this->assertSame($leave->id, $exceptionOf($first), 'Cuti khusus dokter didahulukan walau id lebih besar.');
        $this->assertSame($globalA->id, $exceptionOf($second), 'Antar pengecualian setara: id terkecil.');
    }

    public function test_an_exception_outside_the_range_is_ignored(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        ScheduleException::factory()->hospitalHoliday()->create(['start_date' => '2026-10-13', 'end_date' => '2026-10-18']);

        $this->generate();

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->where('status', SessionStatus::Cancelled->value)->count());
    }

    // --- Potongan 500 baris ---

    public function test_rows_are_inserted_in_chunks_of_five_hundred(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        DoctorSchedule::factory()->count(110)->create(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 1]);

        DB::enableQueryLog();
        $created = $this->generate();
        $inserts = collect(DB::getQueryLog())->filter(fn (array $query): bool => str_starts_with(strtolower($query['query']), 'insert ignore'))->count();
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        $this->assertSame(550, $created);
        $this->assertSame(2, $inserts);
        $this->assertSame(550, PracticeSession::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generate());
    }

    // --- ensureDailyHorizon (F3-R8) ---

    public function test_marker_key_format(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('sessions:generated:2026-10-05', PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 15:30:00')));
        $this->assertSame('sessions:generate', PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY);
    }

    public function test_the_daily_horizon_runs_once_per_day_and_sets_the_marker(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $this->assertFalse(Cache::has('sessions:generated:2026-10-05'));
        $this->assertSame(5, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon());
        $this->assertTrue(Cache::has('sessions:generated:2026-10-05'));

        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 2]);

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon(), 'Penanda hari ini mencegah pembangkitan kedua.');
        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_saving_a_template_triggers_ensure_range_directly_regardless_of_the_marker(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon();
        $late = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 2]);

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon());
        $this->assertSame(5, $this->generate($late), 'Pemicu simpan templat memanggil ensureRange langsung.');
    }

    public function test_the_marker_expires_at_the_end_of_the_day_and_the_next_day_generates_again(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $this->assertSame(5, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon());
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 2]);

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 23:59:00');
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon());

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 00:00:01');
        $this->assertFalse(Cache::has('sessions:generated:2026-10-05'), 'Penanda kemarin sudah kedaluwarsa.');
        $this->assertFalse(Cache::has('sessions:generated:2026-10-06'));
        $this->assertSame(5, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon(), 'Hari baru: selasa 6 Okt s.d. 3 Nov (5 sesi baru).');
        $this->assertTrue(Cache::has('sessions:generated:2026-10-06'));
    }

    public function test_the_daily_horizon_uses_the_booking_window_setting(): void
    {
        app(SettingsService::class)->set('booking.window_days', 7);
        app(SettingsService::class)->forget();
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $this->assertSame(2, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon());
        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-05', '2026-10-12'], $this->datesOf($schedule));
    }

    public function test_the_daily_horizon_returns_zero_without_waiting_when_another_process_holds_the_lock(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $other = Cache::lock(PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY, 30);
        $this->assertTrue($other->get());

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon());
        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());
        $this->assertFalse(Cache::has('sessions:generated:2026-10-05'), 'Penanda tidak diset bila kunci tidak diperoleh.');

        $other->release();

        $this->assertSame(5, $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon());
    }

    public function test_the_lock_is_released_after_the_daily_horizon_runs(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $this->generator()->ensureDailyHorizon();

        $lock = Cache::lock(PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY, 30);

        $this->assertTrue($lock->get());
        $lock->release();
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Scheduling/GenerateSessionsCommandTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Scheduling;

use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Event;
use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Sleep;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Perintah `sessions:generate {--days=}` dan penjadwalnya (00 F.2 pemicu c, F3-R8).
 * Waktu tes: Senin 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 08.00.
 */
class GenerateSessionsCommandTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 08:00:00');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        Sleep::fake(false);

        parent::tearDown();
    }

    public function test_it_generates_for_the_default_window_and_reports_the_count_and_range(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $this->artisan('sessions:generate')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('5 sesi baru dibangkitkan untuk 05/10/2026 s.d. 04/11/2026.')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_days_option_overrides_the_window(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $this->artisan('sessions:generate', ['--days' => 7])
            ->expectsOutputToContain('2 sesi baru dibangkitkan untuk 05/10/2026 s.d. 12/10/2026.')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->artisan('sessions:generate', ['--days' => 120])
            ->expectsOutputToContain('s.d. 02/02/2027.')
            ->assertExitCode(0);
    }

    public function test_a_second_run_is_idempotent(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $this->artisan('sessions:generate')->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->artisan('sessions:generate')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('0 sesi baru dibangkitkan untuk 05/10/2026 s.d. 04/11/2026.')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_boundaries_one_and_one_hundred_twenty_are_accepted(): void
    {
        $this->artisan('sessions:generate', ['--days' => 1])->expectsOutputToContain('s.d. 06/10/2026.')->assertExitCode(0);
        $this->artisan('sessions:generate', ['--days' => '120'])->assertExitCode(0);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string|int}>
     */
    public static function invalidDays(): array
    {
        return [
            'nol' => ['0'],
            'negatif' => ['-5'],
            '121' => ['121'],
            'huruf' => ['abc'],
            'desimal' => ['3.5'],
            'kosong' => [''],
            'campuran' => ['7a'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('invalidDays')]
    public function test_an_invalid_days_option_is_rejected_with_exit_code_one_and_generates_nothing(string $value): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);

        $this->artisan('sessions:generate', ['--days' => $value])
            ->expectsOutputToContain('Opsi --days harus bilangan bulat 1–120.')
            ->assertExitCode(1);

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_it_waits_for_the_lock_and_exits_with_code_one_when_another_process_keeps_it(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $other = Cache::lock(PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY, 30);
        $this->assertTrue($other->get());

        // Tidur dipalsukan dan menggeser jam tes, sehingga menunggu 10 detik tidak memakan waktu nyata.
        Sleep::fake(syncWithCarbon: true);

        $this->artisan('sessions:generate')
            ->expectsOutputToContain('Pembangkitan sesi sedang berjalan di proses lain. Coba lagi beberapa saat lagi.')
            ->assertExitCode(1);

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());
        $this->assertTrue(now()->greaterThanOrEqualTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:09')), 'Perintah menunggu hampir 10 detik (waktu virtual).');
    }

    public function test_it_succeeds_once_the_lock_is_free_and_releases_it_afterwards(): void
    {
        $this->createSchedule(['day_of_week' => 1]);
        $other = Cache::lock(PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY, 30);
        $other->get();
        $other->release();

        $this->artisan('sessions:generate')->assertExitCode(0);

        $lock = Cache::lock(PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY, 30);
        $this->assertTrue($lock->get());
        $lock->release();
    }

    public function test_the_scheduler_runs_the_command_daily_at_five_past_midnight_without_overlapping(): void
    {
        $events = collect(app(Schedule::class)->events())
            ->filter(fn (Event $event): bool => str_contains((string) $event->command, 'sessions:generate'));

        $this->assertCount(1, $events);

        $event = $events->first();
        $this->assertSame('5 0 * * *', $event->expression);
        $this->assertTrue($event->withoutOverlapping);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Pembangkit sesi praktik dari templat mingguan (00 F.2, 11 §6.4). Idempoten: `insertOrIgnore` terhadap
 * UNIQUE (`doctor_schedule_id`, `session_date`) tidak menyentuh sesi yang sudah ada, termasuk sesi yang
 * diubah manual, dan sesi tambahan manual (tanpa templat) tidak pernah dibuat atau diubah di sini.
 * Tidak membuat sesi lampau (BR-22, F3-R7). Audit tidak ditulis per sesi (12 §8).
 */
final class PracticeSessionGenerator
{
    /** Kunci `Cache::lock` pembangkitan harian dan perintah `sessions:generate` (F3-R8). */
    public const LOCK_KEY = 'sessions:generate';

    /** Jumlah baris per `insertOrIgnore`. */
    private const CHUNK_SIZE = 500;

    public function __construct(private readonly SettingsService $settings) {}

    /** Penanda "sudah dibangkitkan hari ini": `sessions:generated:Y-m-d`. */
    public static function markerKey(CarbonInterface $date): string
    {
        return 'sessions:generated:'.$date->format('Y-m-d');
    }

    /**
     * Membangkitkan sesi untuk `$from` s.d. `$to` (kedua ujung termasuk), diklem ke hari ini. `$only`
     * membatasi pada satu templat. Mengembalikan jumlah sesi BARU yang tersisip.
     *
     * Hanya templat aktif yang berlaku pada rentang itu, dengan dokter `active` dan poliklinik aktif,
     * yang dibangkitkan. Tanggal yang tercakup pengecualian menjadi sesi `cancelled` dengan
     * `schedule_exception_id` dan `status_reason` = alasan pengecualian; bila beberapa pengecualian
     * mencakup, yang khusus dokter didahulukan, lalu `id` terkecil (F3-R10).
     */
    public function ensureRange(CarbonInterface $from, CarbonInterface $to, ?DoctorSchedule $only = null): int
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $start = $this->day($from);
        $end = $this->day($to);

        if ($start->lessThan($today)) {
            $start = $today;
        }

        if ($end->lessThan($start)) {
            return 0;
        }

        $schedules = DoctorSchedule::query()
            ->active()
            ->when($only !== null, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->whereKey($only?->getKey()))
            ->whereHas('doctor', fn (Builder $doctor): Builder => $doctor->where('status', DoctorStatus::Active->value))
            ->whereHas('clinic', fn (Builder $clinic): Builder => $clinic->where('is_active', true))
            ->where('valid_from', '<=', $end->toDateString())
            ->where(function (Builder $range) use ($start): void {
                $range->whereNull('valid_until')->orWhere('valid_until', '>=', $start->toDateString());
            })
            ->get();

        if ($schedules->isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        $exceptions = ScheduleException::query()
            ->where('end_date', '>=', $start->toDateString())
            ->where('start_date', '<=', $end->toDateString())
            ->get();

        $timestamp = now()->toDateTimeString();
        $rows = [];

        foreach ($schedules as $schedule) {
            $validFrom = CarbonImmutable::parse($schedule->valid_from->toDateString());
            $validUntil = $schedule->valid_until === null ? $end : CarbonImmutable::parse($schedule->valid_until->toDateString());

            $first = $start->greaterThan($validFrom) ? $start : $validFrom;
            $last = $end->lessThan($validUntil) ? $end : $validUntil;

            if ($first->greaterThan($last)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Loncat ke hari templat pertama pada atau setelah $first, lalu maju per minggu.
            $offset = ($schedule->day_of_week - $first->isoWeekday() + 7) % 7;

            for ($date = $first->addDays($offset); $date->lessThanOrEqualTo($last); $date = $date->addWeek()) {
                $exception = ScheduleException::pickFor($exceptions, (int) $schedule->doctor_id, $date);

                $rows[] = [
                    'doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id,
                    'clinic_id' => $schedule->clinic_id,
                    'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
                    'session_date' => $date->toDateString(),
                    'start_time' => $schedule->start_time,
                    'end_time' => $schedule->end_time,
                    'quota' => $schedule->quota,
                    'booked_count' => 0,
                    'last_queue_number' => 0,
                    'status' => $exception === null ? SessionStatus::Open->value : SessionStatus::Cancelled->value,
                    'status_reason' => $exception?->reason,
                    'schedule_exception_id' => $exception?->id,
                    'pending_change' => null,
                    'is_manually_modified' => 0,
                    'created_at' => $timestamp,
                    'updated_at' => $timestamp,
                ];
            }
        }

        $created = 0;

        foreach (array_chunk($rows, self::CHUNK_SIZE) as $chunk) {
            $created += DB::table('practice_sessions')->insertOrIgnore($chunk);
        }

        return $created;
    }

    /**
     * Membangkitkan hari ini s.d. hari ini + `booking.window_days`, paling banyak sekali per hari
     * (pemicu b, 00 F.2): penanda `markerKey(today)` berlaku sampai akhir hari. Kunci tidak menunggu
     * (F3-R8): bila proses lain sedang membangkitkan, mengembalikan 0 dan halaman tetap tampil dengan
     * sesi yang ada.
     */
    public function ensureDailyHorizon(): int
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $marker = self::markerKey($today);

        if (Cache::has($marker)) {
            return 0;
        }

        $created = Cache::lock(self::LOCK_KEY, 30)->get(function () use ($today, $marker): int {
            if (Cache::has($marker)) {
                return 0;
            }

            $created = $this->ensureRange($today, $today->addDays($this->windowDays()));

            Cache::put($marker, true, $today->endOfDay());

            return $created;
        });

        return $created === false ? 0 : (int) $created;
    }

    /** Jendela pembangkitan dalam hari: `booking.window_days` (bawaan 30, minimal 1). */
    private function windowDays(): int
    {
        return max(1, $this->settings->int('booking.window_days', 30));
    }

    /** Awal hari pada zona aplikasi. */
    private function day(CarbonInterface $date): CarbonImmutable
    {
        return CarbonImmutable::instance($date)->setTimezone((string) config('app.timezone'))->startOfDay();
    }
}
```
