```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\LockTimeoutException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

/**
 * Pemicu (c) pembangkitan sesi (00 F.2, 11): `php artisan sessions:generate {--days=}`. Idempoten. Memakai
 * kunci yang sama dengan pembangkitan harian halaman publik, tetapi menunggu hingga 10 detik (F3-R8).
 * Tidak menulis audit per sesi (12 §8), sehingga tidak memerlukan pelaku (Actor).
 */
class GenerateSessions extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'sessions:generate {--days= : Jumlah hari ke depan (1–120; bawaan booking.window_days)}';

    protected $description = 'Bangkitkan sesi praktik dari templat jadwal untuk hari ini sampai beberapa hari ke depan';

    public function handle(PracticeSessionGenerator $generator, SettingsService $settings): int
    {
        $days = $this->resolveDays($settings);

        if ($days === null) {
            $this->error('Opsi --days harus bilangan bulat 1–120.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $from = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $to = $from->addDays($days);

        try {
            $created = Cache::lock(PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY, 30)
                ->block(10, fn (): int => $generator->ensureRange($from, $to));
        } catch (LockTimeoutException) {
            $this->error('Pembangkitan sesi sedang berjalan di proses lain. Coba lagi beberapa saat lagi.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $this->info("{$created} sesi baru dibangkitkan untuk {$from->format('d/m/Y')} s.d. {$to->format('d/m/Y')}.");

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    /** Jumlah hari dari opsi, atau `booking.window_days` bila opsi tidak diberikan; NULL bila tidak valid. */
    private function resolveDays(SettingsService $settings): ?int
    {
        $option = $this->option('days');

        if ($option === null) {
            return max(1, $settings->int('booking.window_days', 30));
        }

        $days = filter_var($option, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1, 'max_range' => 120]]);

        return $days === false ? null : $days;
    }
}

Tanpa `assertBookable` (menyusul fase 6).

    - `sessions(AvailabilityFilter $f, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): Collection` (`Collection<int, SessionAvailability>`);

    - `doctors(AvailabilityFilter $f, int $perPage = 12): LengthAwarePaginator` (tiap `Doctor` pada halaman diberi relasi `availabilities`);

**Test IDs:** JDW-03/JDW-04/JDW-05 (sisi query: `leave`, `holiday`, `past`, `booking_closed`, hari ke-30 versus ke-31), JDW-12 (kontrak kelas: `forSession()` sama dengan elemen `sessions()`), JDW-13 (`is_bookable_online` sesi manual), BR-16, BR-36, Review Focus 1 (batas waktu dan jendela) dan bagian Review Focus 4 (tanpa N+1 di mode ketat). Bagian `book()`/wizard ditunda ke fase 6 (F3-R5).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Urutan klasifikasi** persis F3-R12: (1) `past` bila `now ≥ endsAt`, (2) `cancelled` → `Availability::forException(exception?->type)`, (3) `needs_review` → `under_review`, (4) `closed` ∨ dokter ≠ `active` ∨ poliklinik tidak aktif → `closed`, (5) `quota - booked_count ≤ 0` → `full`, (6) `booking_closed` bila `session_date > today + window_days` ∨ poliklinik `is_bookable = false`, dan khusus online juga `now ≥ startsAt − online_cutoff_minutes`, (7) `available`. Batas "tepat pada `start − cutoff`" jatuh ke `booking_closed` (kondisi `≥`); hari ke-30 masih dalam jendela, hari ke-31 tidak. `isBookableOnline`/`isBookableCounter` = `classify(...) === Available` untuk masing-masing mode, dihitung selalu untuk kedua mode; `availability` mengikuti `forLoket` pada filter.
- **Mode ketat.** `classify()` sengaja tidak memuat relasi: `doctor`, `clinic`, dan `exception` wajib sudah dimuat (lazy loading melempar `LazyLoadingViolationException`). `sessions()` memuat `doctor.specialties`, `doctor.media`, `clinic`, `exception`; `forSession()` memakai `loadMissing`; `doctors()` memasang `doctor` pada sesi dari koleksi dokter halaman itu (`setRelation`) dan hanya memuat `clinic` dan `exception` tambahan. Tes N+1 membandingkan **jumlah kueri** untuk data kecil dan data besar (harus sama), bukan angka tetap.
- **`Doctor::scopePubliclyVisible()` tidak memeriksa `clinics.is_bookable`** (diverifikasi di `app/Models/Doctor.php`); kekurangan itu ditutup oleh aturan 6. `sessions()` hanya menyaring dokter (`publiclyVisible`, F3-R17), **tidak** poliklinik sesi, sehingga sesi di poliklinik nonaktif tetap muncul berlabel `closed` (aturan 4). `doctors()` mengambil sesi semua poliklinik milik dokter pada halaman itu; filter `clinicId` hanya menyaring dokter (`inClinic`).
- **Rentang bawaan.** Tanpa `date`/`from`/`to`, kueri memakai hari ini … hari ini + `booking.window_days`. `doctors()` dengan `date` mempertahankan dokter yang punya sesi pada tanggal itu **termasuk** sesi Cuti/Libur dan menampilkan semua sesi tanggal itu (juga yang `past`); tanpa `date` sesi `past` dibuang kecuali `includePast`.
- **Pengaturan di tes.** `RefreshDatabase` tidak men-seed `website_settings`; `BookingRules::fromSettings()` memakai nilai cadangan yang sama dengan default seeder (30/60/120/60/3/false) sehingga tabel kosong tidak menghasilkan jendela 0 hari. Tes menjalankan `SettingsSeeder` bila nilai pengaturan penting. Mengubah nilai lewat `WebsiteSetting::update()` wajib disusul `SettingsService::forget()` (cache `settings:all` dan memo `scoped`).

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Settings;

use App\Models\WebsiteSetting;

use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use ReflectionClass;
use Tests\TestCase;

class SettingsBookingRulesTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_booking_rules_is_a_final_readonly_snapshot_without_assert_bookable_in_phase_three(): void
    {
        $class = new ReflectionClass(BookingRules::class);

        $this->assertTrue($class->isFinal());
        $this->assertTrue($class->isReadOnly());
        $this->assertFalse($class->hasMethod('assertBookable'));
        $this->assertSame(
            ['windowDays', 'onlineCutoffMinutes', 'cancelCutoffMinutes', 'checkinOpenMinutes', 'maxActivePerPatient', 'autoConfirm'],
            array_map(fn ($parameter) => $parameter->getName(), $class->getConstructor()->getParameters()),
        );
    }

    public function test_booking_rules_reads_the_seeded_defaults(): void
    {
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $rules = $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules();

        $this->assertInstanceOf(BookingRules::class, $rules);
        $this->assertSame(30, $rules->windowDays);
        $this->assertSame(60, $rules->onlineCutoffMinutes);
        $this->assertSame(120, $rules->cancelCutoffMinutes);
        $this->assertSame(60, $rules->checkinOpenMinutes);
        $this->assertSame(3, $rules->maxActivePerPatient);
        $this->assertFalse($rules->autoConfirm);
    }

    public function test_booking_rules_falls_back_to_the_documented_defaults_when_the_table_is_empty(): void
    {
        $rules = $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules();

        $this->assertEquals(new BookingRules(30, 60, 120, 60, 3, false), $rules);
    }

    public function test_booking_rules_follows_changed_settings_after_the_cache_is_cleared(): void
    {
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $settings = $this->app->make(SettingsService::class);

        $this->assertSame(30, $settings->bookingRules()->windowDays);

        WebsiteSetting::query()->where('key', 'booking.window_days')->update(['value' => '14']);
        WebsiteSetting::query()->where('key', 'booking.online_cutoff_minutes')->update(['value' => '90']);
        WebsiteSetting::query()->where('key', 'booking.auto_confirm')->update(['value' => '1']);
        $settings->forget();

        $rules = $settings->bookingRules();

        $this->assertSame(14, $rules->windowDays);
        $this->assertSame(90, $rules->onlineCutoffMinutes);
        $this->assertTrue($rules->autoConfirm);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Booking;

use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;

/**
 * Snapshot pengaturan `booking.*` (11 §6.1), dibaca sekali per operasi. Fase 3 hanya menyediakan nilai;
 * `assertBookable()` (aturan F.5) ditambahkan fase 6 bersama BookingService.
 */
final readonly class BookingRules
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $windowDays,
        public int $onlineCutoffMinutes,
        public int $cancelCutoffMinutes,
        public int $checkinOpenMinutes,
        public int $maxActivePerPatient,
        public bool $autoConfirm,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Nilai cadangan sama dengan default seeder (00 E.7) sehingga tabel pengaturan yang kosong tidak
     * menghasilkan jendela 0 hari.
     */
    public static function fromSettings(SettingsService $settings): self
    {
        return new self(
            windowDays: $settings->int('booking.window_days', 30),
            onlineCutoffMinutes: $settings->int('booking.online_cutoff_minutes', 60),
            cancelCutoffMinutes: $settings->int('booking.cancel_cutoff_minutes', 120),
            checkinOpenMinutes: $settings->int('booking.checkin_open_minutes', 60),
            maxActivePerPatient: $settings->int('booking.max_active_per_patient', 3),
            autoConfirm: $settings->bool('booking.auto_confirm', false),
        );
    }
}

Satu data provider (`classificationRows`, 25 baris) menguji tabel prioritas F3-R12 untuk **online dan loket** sekaligus, termasuk batas waktu Review Focus 1.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\Availability;
use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use App\Services\Scheduling\AvailabilityFilter;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use App\Services\Scheduling\SessionAvailability;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * T5: satu sumber jadwal. "Sekarang" tetap Senin 2026-10-05 08:00 (Asia/Jakarta); jendela default 30 hari
 * (hari ke-30 = 2026-11-04, hari ke-31 = 2026-11-05) dan batas pendaftaran online 60 menit.
 */
class DoctorAvailabilityQueryTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private DoctorAvailabilityQuery $query;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->query = $this->app->make(DoctorAvailabilityQuery::class);
        $this->clinic = Clinic::factory()->create();
        $this->doctor = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function makeSession(array $overrides = [], ?Doctor $doctor = null, ?Clinic $clinic = null): PracticeSession
    {
        $doctor ??= $this->doctor;
        $clinic ??= $this->clinic;

        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $clinic->id,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-05',
            'start_time' => '14:00:00',
            'end_time' => '16:00:00',
            'quota' => 10,
            'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * Sesi dengan satu pendaftaran aktif pada kuota 1 sehingga `remaining` = 0.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function makeFullSession(array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(array_merge(['quota' => 1], $overrides));
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        return $session->fresh();
    }

    private function makeException(ExceptionType $type): ScheduleException
    {
        return $this->createException([
            'type' => $type,
            'doctor_id' => $type === ExceptionType::DoctorLeave || $type === ExceptionType::Other ? $this->doctor->id : null,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-05',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-05',
            'reason' => 'Alasan uji',
        ]);
    }

    private function buildSession(string $mutation): PracticeSession
    {
        return match ($mutation) {
            'past' => $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '07:00:00']),
            'ends_now' => $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '07:00:00', 'end_time' => '08:00:00']),
            'past_cancelled' => $this->makeSession([
                'start_time' => '06:00:00',
                'end_time' => '07:00:00',
                'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
                'schedule_exception_id' => $this->makeException(ExceptionType::DoctorLeave)->id,
            ]),
            'leave' => $this->makeSession(['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $this->makeException(ExceptionType::DoctorLeave)->id]),
            'holiday_hospital' => $this->makeSession(['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $this->makeException(ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday)->id]),
            'holiday_national' => $this->makeSession(['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $this->makeException(ExceptionType::NationalHoliday)->id]),
            'cancelled_other' => $this->makeSession(['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $this->makeException(ExceptionType::Other)->id]),
            'cancelled_plain' => $this->makeSession(['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled]),
            'needs_review' => $this->makeSession([
                'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
                'pending_change' => ['source' => 'doctor_inactive', 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id],
            ]),
            'needs_review_full' => $this->makeFullSession([
                'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
                'pending_change' => ['source' => 'doctor_inactive', 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id],
            ]),
            'closed' => $this->makeSession(['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]),
            'closed_full' => $this->makeFullSession(['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]),
            'doctor_inactive' => $this->deactivateDoctor($this->makeSession()),
            'clinic_inactive' => $this->deactivateClinic($this->makeSession()),
            'full' => $this->makeFullSession(),
            'full_inside_cutoff' => $this->makeFullSession(['start_time' => '08:30:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00']),
            'inside_cutoff' => $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '08:30:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00']),
            'exact_cutoff' => $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']),
            'in_progress' => $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '07:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:00']),
            'clinic_not_bookable' => $this->makeSessionInUnbookableClinic(),
            'day_30' => $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-04']),
            'day_31' => $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-05']),
            'available' => $this->makeSession(),
        };
    }

    private function deactivateDoctor(PracticeSession $session): PracticeSession
    {
        $this->doctor->forceFill(['status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive])->save();

        return $session;
    }

    private function deactivateClinic(PracticeSession $session): PracticeSession
    {
        $this->clinic->forceFill(['is_active' => false])->save();

        return $session;
    }

    private function makeSessionInUnbookableClinic(): PracticeSession
    {
        $this->clinic->forceFill(['is_bookable' => false])->save();

        return $this->makeSession();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string, string, Availability, Availability}>
     */
    public static function classificationRows(): array
    {
        $now = '2026-10-05 08:00:00';

        return [
            '1 sudah lewat' => ['past', $now, Availability::Past, Availability::Past],
            '1 berakhir tepat sekarang' => ['ends_now', $now, Availability::Past, Availability::Past],
            '1 lewat mengalahkan batal' => ['past_cancelled', $now, Availability::Past, Availability::Past],
            '2 cuti dokter' => ['leave', $now, Availability::Leave, Availability::Leave],
            '2 libur rumah sakit' => ['holiday_hospital', $now, Availability::Holiday, Availability::Holiday],
            '2 libur nasional' => ['holiday_national', $now, Availability::Holiday, Availability::Holiday],
            '2 batal jenis lain' => ['cancelled_other', $now, Availability::Cancelled, Availability::Cancelled],
            '2 batal tanpa pengecualian' => ['cancelled_plain', $now, Availability::Cancelled, Availability::Cancelled],
            '3 perlu tindak lanjut' => ['needs_review', $now, Availability::UnderReview, Availability::UnderReview],
            '3 perlu tindak lanjut mengalahkan penuh' => ['needs_review_full', $now, Availability::UnderReview, Availability::UnderReview],
            '4 ditutup' => ['closed', $now, Availability::Closed, Availability::Closed],
            '4 ditutup mengalahkan penuh' => ['closed_full', $now, Availability::Closed, Availability::Closed],
            '4 dokter nonaktif' => ['doctor_inactive', $now, Availability::Closed, Availability::Closed],
            '4 poliklinik nonaktif' => ['clinic_inactive', $now, Availability::Closed, Availability::Closed],
            '5 penuh' => ['full', $now, Availability::Full, Availability::Full],
            '5 penuh mengalahkan batas online' => ['full_inside_cutoff', $now, Availability::Full, Availability::Full],
            '6 dalam batas online' => ['inside_cutoff', $now, Availability::BookingClosed, Availability::Available],
            '6 tepat pada mulai dikurangi batas' => ['exact_cutoff', $now, Availability::BookingClosed, Availability::Available],
            '6 satu detik sebelum batas' => ['exact_cutoff', '2026-10-05 07:59:59', Availability::Available, Availability::Available],
            '6 sesi sedang berjalan' => ['in_progress', $now, Availability::BookingClosed, Availability::Available],
            '6 satu detik sebelum selesai' => ['in_progress', '2026-10-05 09:59:59', Availability::BookingClosed, Availability::Available],
            '6 poliklinik tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran' => ['clinic_not_bookable', $now, Availability::BookingClosed, Availability::BookingClosed],
            '6 hari ke-30 masih dalam jendela' => ['day_30', $now, Availability::Available, Availability::Available],
            '6 hari ke-31 di luar jendela' => ['day_31', $now, Availability::BookingClosed, Availability::BookingClosed],
            '7 tersedia' => ['available', $now, Availability::Available, Availability::Available],
        ];
    }

    private function countQueries(callable $callback): int
    {
        DB::flushQueryLog();
        DB::enableQueryLog();
        $callback();
        $count = count(DB::getQueryLog());
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        return $count;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ classify (F3-R12)

    #[DataProvider('classificationRows')]
    public function test_classify_follows_the_priority_table_for_online_and_counter(string $mutation, string $now, Availability $online, Availability $counter): void
    {
        $session = $this->buildSession($mutation)->load(['doctor', 'clinic', 'exception']);
        $rules = $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules();
        $at = CarbonImmutable::parse($now);

        $this->assertSame($online, $this->query->classify($session, $rules, $at, false));
        $this->assertSame($counter, $this->query->classify($session, $rules, $at, true));

        $item = $this->query->forSession($session, false, $at);

        $this->assertSame($online, $item->availability);
        $this->assertSame($online === Availability::Available, $item->isBookableOnline);
        $this->assertSame($counter === Availability::Available, $item->isBookableCounter);
        $this->assertSame($counter, $this->query->forSession($session, true, $at)->availability);
    }

    public function test_remaining_is_quota_minus_booked_count_and_never_negative(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(['quota' => 3]);
        $this->bookAppointment($session->fresh(), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->bookAppointment($session->fresh(), AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

        $item = $this->query->forSession($session->fresh());

        $this->assertSame(2, $item->remaining);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->query->forSession($this->makeFullSession())->remaining);
    }

    public function test_window_boundary_moves_at_midnight(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-05'])->load(['doctor', 'clinic', 'exception']);
        $rules = $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules();

        $this->assertSame(
            Availability::BookingClosed,
            $this->query->classify($session, $rules, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 23:59:00'), false),
        );
        $this->assertSame(
            Availability::Available,
            $this->query->classify($session, $rules, CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06 00:00:00'), false),
        );
    }

    public function test_cutoff_follows_the_booking_setting(): void
    {
        $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->setMany(['booking.online_cutoff_minutes' => 120]);
        $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->forget();
        $session = $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '09:30:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);

        $item = $this->query->forSession($session);

        $this->assertSame(Availability::BookingClosed, $item->availability);
        $this->assertFalse($item->isBookableOnline);
        $this->assertTrue($item->isBookableCounter);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sessions()

    public function test_sessions_lists_visible_doctors_in_date_then_time_order_and_hides_past_sessions(): void
    {
        $later = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00']);
        $afternoon = $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '14:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);
        $morning = $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00']);
        $ended = $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '07:00:00']);
        $beyondWindow = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-05']);
        $lastDay = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-04']);

        $result = $this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter);

        $this->assertSame(
            [$morning->id, $afternoon->id, $later->id, $lastDay->id],
            $result->map(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => $item->session->id)->all(),
        );
        $this->assertNotContains($ended->id, $result->map(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => $item->session->id)->all());
        $this->assertNotContains($beyondWindow->id, $result->map(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => $item->session->id)->all());
    }

    public function test_include_past_keeps_ended_sessions_labelled_past(): void
    {
        $ended = $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '07:00:00']);
        $upcoming = $this->makeSession();

        $result = $this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(includePast: true));

        $this->assertSame([$ended->id, $upcoming->id], $result->map(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => $item->session->id)->all());
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Past, $result->first()->availability);
        $this->assertFalse($result->first()->isBookableOnline);
    }

    public function test_sessions_of_doctors_that_are_not_publicly_visible_are_never_returned(): void
    {
        $inactive = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->inactive()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $archived = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->archived()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $dormantClinic = Clinic::factory()->inactive()->create();

        $visible = $this->makeSession();

        foreach ([$inactive, $archived, $inDormantClinic] as $hidden) {

    public function test_sessions_filters_by_date_range_doctor_clinic_specialty_and_name(): void
    {
        $otherClinic = Clinic::factory()->create();
        $other = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $otherClinic->id, 'name' => 'Zulkifli Hakim']);
        $mine = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-07']);
        $theirs = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-08'], $other, $otherClinic);

        $ids = fn (AvailabilityFilter $filter): array => $this->query->sessions($filter)
            ->map(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => $item->session->id)->all();

        $this->assertSame([$mine->id], $ids(new AvailabilityFilter(date: CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-07'))));
        $this->assertSame([$theirs->id], $ids(new AvailabilityFilter(from: CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-08'), to: CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-09'))));
        $this->assertSame([$mine->id], $ids(new AvailabilityFilter(doctorId: $this->doctor->id)));
        $this->assertSame([$theirs->id], $ids(new AvailabilityFilter(clinicId: $otherClinic->id)));
        $this->assertSame([$theirs->id], $ids(new AvailabilityFilter(q: 'Zulkifli')));

        $specialtyId = (int) $other->specialties()->first()->id;
        $this->assertSame([$theirs->id], $ids(new AvailabilityFilter(specialtyId: $specialtyId)));
    }

    public function test_for_loket_changes_the_displayed_label_but_not_the_two_flags(): void
    {
        $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '08:30:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00']);

        $online = $this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter)->sole();
        $counter = $this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(forLoket: true))->sole();

        $this->assertSame(Availability::BookingClosed, $online->availability);

    public function test_for_session_returns_the_same_result_as_sessions_for_the_same_session_jdw12(): void
    {
        $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '08:30:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00']);
        $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $this->makeFullSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-07']);
        $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-08', 'status' => SessionStatus::Closed]);
        $this->makeSession([
            'session_date' => '2026-10-09',
            'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
            'schedule_exception_id' => $this->createException([
                'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
                'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
                'start_date' => '2026-10-09',
                'end_date' => '2026-10-09',
                'reason' => 'Cuti',
            ])->id,
        ]);

        foreach ([false, true] as $forLoket) {
            $listed = $this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(forLoket: $forLoket));

            $this->assertCount(5, $listed);

            foreach ($listed as $item) {
                $single = $this->query->forSession(PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($item->session->id), $forLoket);

                $this->assertSame($item->remaining, $single->remaining);
                $this->assertSame($item->availability, $single->availability);
                $this->assertSame($item->isBookableOnline, $single->isBookableOnline);
                $this->assertSame($item->isBookableCounter, $single->isBookableCounter);
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_manual_extra_session_is_bookable_online_jdw13(): void
    {
        $manual = $this->makeSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => null, 'session_date' => '2026-10-06']);

        $item = $this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter)->sole();

        $this->assertSame($manual->id, $item->session->id);
        $this->assertNull($item->session->doctor_schedule_id);
        $this->assertTrue($item->isBookableOnline);
        $this->assertTrue($item->isBookableCounter);
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Available, $item->availability);

    public function test_sessions_do_not_trigger_n_plus_one_queries_in_strict_mode(): void
    {
        $this->makeSession();
        $this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter);

        $small = $this->countQueries(fn () => $this->touchEverything($this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter)));

        foreach (range(1, 5) as $index) {
            $doctor = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties(2)->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);

            foreach (range(1, 3) as $day) {
                $this->makeSession(['session_date' => CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05')->addDays($day + $index)->toDateString()], $doctor);
            }
        }

        $large = $this->countQueries(fn () => $this->touchEverything($this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter)));

        $this->assertCount(16, $this->query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter));
        $this->assertSame($small, $large);
    }

    /**
     * @param  iterable<SessionAvailability>  $items
     */
    private function touchEverything(iterable $items): void
    {
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $session = $item->session;

            $session->doctor->specialties->count();
            $session->doctor->firstMedia('photo');
            $session->doctor->display_name;
            $session->clinic->name;
            $session->exception?->reason;
        }
    }

    public function test_doctors_lists_only_publicly_visible_doctors_with_their_availabilities(): void
    {
        Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->inactive()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->archived()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $dormant = Clinic::factory()->inactive()->create();
        Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $dormant->id]);
        $empty = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);

        $tomorrow = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $today = $this->makeSession();
        $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '07:00:00']);
        $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-05']);

        $page = $this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter);

        $this->assertSame(2, $page->total());
        $byId = $page->getCollection()->keyBy('id');

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing([$this->doctor->id, $empty->id], $byId->keys()->all());
        $this->assertSame(
            [$today->id, $tomorrow->id],
            $byId[$this->doctor->id]->availabilities->map(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => $item->session->id)->all(),
        );
        $this->assertCount(0, $byId[$empty->id]->availabilities);
    }

    public function test_doctors_with_a_date_include_leave_sessions_and_exclude_doctors_without_sessions_that_day(): void
    {
        $onLeave = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $without = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $leave = $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $onLeave->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ]);
        $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-07', 'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $leave->id], $onLeave);
        $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-07']);
        $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-08'], $without);

        $page = $this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter(date: CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-07')));
        $byId = $page->getCollection()->keyBy('id');

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing([$this->doctor->id, $onLeave->id], $byId->keys()->all());
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Leave, $byId[$onLeave->id]->availabilities->sole()->availability);
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Available, $byId[$this->doctor->id]->availabilities->sole()->availability);
    }

    public function test_doctors_filters_by_name_specialty_and_clinic_and_paginates(): void
    {
        $otherClinic = Clinic::factory()->create();
        $other = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $otherClinic->id, 'name' => 'Zulkifli Hakim']);
        $this->makeSession();

        $this->assertSame([$other->id], $this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter(q: 'Zulkifli'))->getCollection()->modelKeys());
        $this->assertSame([$other->id], $this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter(clinicId: $otherClinic->id))->getCollection()->modelKeys());
        $this->assertSame(
            [$other->id],
            $this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter(specialtyId: (int) $other->specialties()->first()->id))->getCollection()->modelKeys(),
        );

        $page = $this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter, 1);

        $this->assertSame(2, $page->total());
        $this->assertCount(1, $page->getCollection());
        $this->assertSame(2, $page->lastPage());
    }

    public function test_doctors_load_sessions_once_per_page_without_n_plus_one(): void
    {
        $this->makeSession();
        $this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter);

        $small = $this->countQueries(fn () => $this->touchDoctors($this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter)));

        foreach (range(1, 6) as $index) {
            $doctor = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties(2)->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);

            foreach (range(1, 3) as $day) {
                $this->makeSession(['session_date' => CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05')->addDays($day)->toDateString()], $doctor);
            }
        }

        $large = $this->countQueries(fn () => $this->touchDoctors($this->query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter)));

        $this->assertSame($small, $large);
    }

    /**
     * @param  iterable<Doctor>  $doctors
     */
    private function touchDoctors(iterable $doctors): void
    {
        foreach ($doctors as $doctor) {
            $doctor->clinic->name;
            $doctor->primary_specialty;
            $doctor->firstMedia('photo');

            foreach ($doctor->availabilities as $item) {
                $item->session->clinic->name;
                $item->session->exception?->reason;
                $item->session->doctor->display_name;
            }
        }
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

/**

`app/Services/Scheduling/DoctorAvailabilityQuery.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\Availability;
use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingRules;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Satu-satunya sumber jadwal untuk halaman publik, wizard pasien, dan form walk-in (00 F.3, BR-16).
 * Hanya membaca; klasifikasi `Availability` mengikuti urutan 11 §6.5 (F3-R12).
 */
final class DoctorAvailabilityQuery
{
    public function __construct(private readonly SettingsService $settings) {}

    /**
     * Sesi dokter yang tampil di publik (F3-R17) beserta labelnya, urut tanggal lalu jam mulai.
     * Sesi `past` dibuang kecuali `includePast`.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, SessionAvailability>
     */
    public function sessions(AvailabilityFilter $filter, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): Collection
    {
        $now ??= CarbonImmutable::now();
        $rules = $this->settings->bookingRules();

        $items = $this->describeAll($this->sessionQuery($filter, $rules, $now)->get(), $rules, $now, $filter->forLoket);

        if (! $filter->includePast) {
            $items = $this->withoutPast($items);
        }

        return $items->values();
    }

    /**
     * Label satu sesi lewat kode yang sama dengan sessions() (kontrak JDW-12). Relasi yang dibutuhkan
     * klasifikasi dimuat bila belum.
     */
    public function forSession(PracticeSession $session, bool $forLoket = false, ?CarbonImmutable $now = null): SessionAvailability
    {
        $session->loadMissing(['doctor', 'clinic', 'exception']);

        return $this->describe($session, $this->settings->bookingRules(), $now ?? CarbonImmutable::now(), $forLoket);
    }

    /**
     * Direktori dokter (halaman #6). Setiap dokter pada halaman diberi relasi `availabilities`
     * (Collection<SessionAvailability>) lewat satu kueri sesi per halaman: sesi pada `date` bila diisi
     * (termasuk sesi Cuti/Libur), selain itu sesi hari ini … + jendela yang belum lewat.
     */
    public function doctors(AvailabilityFilter $filter, int $perPage = 12): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $page = Doctor::query()
            ->publiclyVisible()
            ->when($filter->q !== null && trim($filter->q) !== '', fn (Builder $query) => $query->search($filter->q))
            ->when($filter->specialtyId !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->inSpecialty((int) $filter->specialtyId))
            ->when($filter->clinicId !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->inClinic((int) $filter->clinicId))
            ->when($filter->date !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->whereHas(
                'sessions',
                fn (Builder $sessions) => $sessions->where('session_date', $filter->date->toDateString()),
            ))
            ->with(['clinic', 'specialties', 'media'])
            ->ordered()
            ->paginate($perPage);

        $doctors = $page->getCollection();

        if ($doctors->isEmpty()) {
            return $page;
        }

        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();
        $rules = $this->settings->bookingRules();
        [$from, $to] = $this->range($filter, $rules, $now);

        $sessions = PracticeSession::query()
            ->with(['clinic', 'exception'])
            ->whereIn('doctor_id', $doctors->modelKeys())
            ->whereBetween('session_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()])
            ->orderBy('session_date')
            ->orderBy('start_time')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get();

        $byId = $doctors->keyBy('id');
        $sessions->each(fn (PracticeSession $session) => $session->setRelation('doctor', $byId->get($session->doctor_id)));

        $items = $this->describeAll($sessions, $rules, $now, $filter->forLoket);

        if ($filter->date === null && ! $filter->includePast) {
            $items = $this->withoutPast($items);
        }

        $grouped = $items->groupBy(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => (int) $item->session->doctor_id);

        foreach ($doctors as $doctor) {
            $doctor->setRelation('availabilities', ($grouped->get($doctor->getKey()) ?? new Collection)->values());
        }

        return $page;
    }

    /**
     * Klasifikasi murni (tanpa kueri) menurut F3-R12; yang pertama cocok dipakai. Relasi `doctor`, `clinic`,
     * dan `exception` pada sesi wajib sudah dimuat (mode ketat).
     */
    public function classify(PracticeSession $session, BookingRules $rules, CarbonImmutable $now, bool $forLoket): Availability
    {
        $startsAt = CarbonImmutable::instance($session->starts_at);
        $endsAt = CarbonImmutable::instance($session->ends_at);

        if ($now->greaterThanOrEqualTo($endsAt)) {
            return Availability::Past;
        }

        if ($session->status === SessionStatus::Cancelled) {
            return Availability::forException($session->exception?->type);
        }

        if ($session->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview) {
            return Availability::UnderReview;
        }

        if (
            $session->status === SessionStatus::Closed
            || $session->doctor->status !== DoctorStatus::Active
            || ! $session->clinic->is_active
        ) {
            return Availability::Closed;
        }

        if ($session->quota - $session->booked_count <= 0) {
            return Availability::Full;
        }

        $beyondWindow = $session->session_date->toDateString() > $now->startOfDay()->addDays($rules->windowDays)->toDateString();
        $clinicNotBookable = ! $session->clinic->is_bookable;

        if ($beyondWindow || $clinicNotBookable) {
            return Availability::BookingClosed;
        }

        if (! $forLoket && $now->greaterThanOrEqualTo($startsAt->subMinutes($rules->onlineCutoffMinutes))) {
            return Availability::BookingClosed;
        }

        return Availability::Available;
    }

    private function describe(PracticeSession $session, BookingRules $rules, CarbonImmutable $now, bool $forLoket): SessionAvailability
    {
        return new SessionAvailability(
            session: $session,
            remaining: max(0, $session->quota - $session->booked_count),
            availability: $this->classify($session, $rules, $now, $forLoket),
            isBookableOnline: $this->classify($session, $rules, $now, false) === Availability::Available,
            isBookableCounter: $this->classify($session, $rules, $now, true) === Availability::Available,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, PracticeSession>  $sessions
     * @return Collection<int, SessionAvailability>
     */
    private function describeAll(Collection $sessions, BookingRules $rules, CarbonImmutable $now, bool $forLoket): Collection
    {
        return $sessions
            ->map(fn (PracticeSession $session): SessionAvailability => $this->describe($session, $rules, $now, $forLoket))
            ->values();
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, SessionAvailability>  $items
     * @return Collection<int, SessionAvailability>
     */
    private function withoutPast(Collection $items): Collection
    {
        return $items->reject(fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => $item->availability === Availability::Past);
    }

    /**
     * @return Builder<PracticeSession>
     */
    private function sessionQuery(AvailabilityFilter $filter, BookingRules $rules, CarbonImmutable $now): Builder
    {
        [$from, $to] = $this->range($filter, $rules, $now);

        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->with(['doctor.specialties', 'doctor.media', 'clinic', 'exception'])
            ->whereHas('doctor', fn (Builder $doctor) => $doctor->publiclyVisible())
            ->whereBetween('session_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()])
            ->when($filter->clinicId !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->where('clinic_id', $filter->clinicId))
            ->when($filter->doctorId !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->where('doctor_id', $filter->doctorId))
            ->when($filter->specialtyId !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->whereHas(
                'doctor.specialties',
                fn (Builder $specialties) => $specialties->where('specialties.id', $filter->specialtyId),
            ))
            ->when($filter->q !== null && trim($filter->q) !== '', fn (Builder $query) => $query->whereHas(
                'doctor',
                fn (Builder $doctor) => $doctor->search($filter->q),
            ))
            ->orderBy('session_date')
            ->orderBy('start_time')
            ->orderBy('id');
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: CarbonImmutable, 1: CarbonImmutable}
     */
    private function range(AvailabilityFilter $filter, BookingRules $rules, CarbonImmutable $now): array
    {
        if ($filter->date !== null) {
            return [$filter->date, $filter->date];
        }

        return [
            $filter->from ?? $now->startOfDay(),
            $filter->to ?? $now->startOfDay()->addDays($rules->windowDays),
        ];
    }
}
```

- Test: `tests/Unit/Scheduling/ScheduleChangeReportTest.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Scheduling/ScheduleChangeTemplateTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 4: `PracticeSessionGenerator::ensureRange(CarbonInterface $from, CarbonInterface $to, ?DoctorSchedule $only = null): int` (idempoten, diklem ke hari ini, melewati templat nonaktif/dokter non-`active`/poliklinik nonaktif).
  - Task 5: `SettingsService::bookingRules()->windowDays`.
  - Task 2: `DoctorSchedule` (`hasUpcomingActiveAppointments(?CarbonInterface $now = null): bool`, `deletionBlockedReason()` dengan pesan BR-12, accessor `day_name` dan `time_range`), `PracticeSession` (`appointments()`, `scopeNotEnded()`, `isEnded()`, konstanta `SOURCE_*`, `CANCEL_SOURCES`, `TIME_SOURCES`, kolom `pending_change` bercast array), `Appointment::scopeActive()`, `Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules`.
  - Fase 1–2: `AuditLogger::log(string $action, Model $model, ?array $old, ?array $new, string $description, ?Actor $actor = null)`, `Actor`, `Doctor::displayName`, enum `SessionStatus`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeReport` (`final readonly`): `(int $regenerated = 0, int $updated = 0, int $quotaAdjusted = 0, int $needsReview = 0, int $cancelled = 0, int $reopened = 0)` dan `message(): string` (F3-R23).
  - `App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService` (`final`), konstruktor `(PracticeSessionGenerator $generator, SettingsService $settings, AuditLogger $audit)`:
    - `assertClinicChangeAllowed(DoctorSchedule $schedule, int $newClinicId): void`: `ValidationException` kunci `clinic_id`;
    - `applyTemplateCreated(DoctorSchedule $schedule, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport`: audit `schedule.created`;
    - `applyTemplateChange(DoctorSchedule $schedule, array $before, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport`: audit `schedule.updated` (+ `impact`);
    - `deleteTemplate(DoctorSchedule $schedule, Actor $actor): void`: `ValidationException` kunci `schedule`, audit `schedule.deleted`;
    - `private setPendingChange(PracticeSession $session, array $change, Actor $actor): void`: audit `session.pending_replaced`.
  - Konstanta publik `MESSAGE_CLINIC_CHANGE_BLOCKED` dan `REASON_TEMPLATE_CHANGED` ("Jadwal berubah").
  - Pemanggil (Task 10) membungkus `$schedule->update(...)` dan `applyTemplateChange()` dalam satu `DB::transaction`; service sendiri membungkus semua pekerjaannya dalam transaksi luar (atomik) dan memproses tiap sesi dalam transaksi bersarang dengan `lockForUpdate()`.

| Kunci galat | Pesan | Sumber |
|---|---|---|
| `clinic_id` | "Poliklinik tidak dapat diganti karena masih ada sesi mendatang dengan pendaftaran aktif. Buat jadwal baru, lalu nonaktifkan jadwal lama." | 12 BR-10 / V-23 (`CLINIC_CHANGE_BLOCKED`) |
| `schedule` | "Jadwal ini sudah memiliki sesi dengan pendaftaran dan hanya dapat dinonaktifkan." (dari `DoctorSchedule::deletionBlockedReason()`) | 12 BR-12 |

**Aksi audit (12 §8.2, nama persis; tanpa data pasien):**

| Aksi | `old_values` → `new_values` |
|---|---|
| `schedule.created` | `null` → `{doctor_id, clinic_id, day_of_week, start_time "HH:MM", end_time, quota, valid_from, valid_until, is_active, notes, impact{regenerated, updated, quota_adjusted, needs_review, cancelled, reopened}}` |
| `schedule.updated` | hanya kolom yang berubah (lama) → kolom yang berubah (baru) + `impact` |
| `schedule.deleted` | seluruh nilai templat → `{impact: {deleted_sessions: n}}` |
| `session.pending_replaced` | `{pending_change: lama}` → `{pending_change: baru}` (auditable = sesi) |

**Test IDs:** tabel keputusan F.4 bagian templat (satu kasus per baris, 15 baris), JDW-08 (a)–(d), JDW-07 bagian templat (kuota `max`), JDW-17 (b) dan (c), JDW-19 (a)(b), CRD-13 baris `doctor_schedules`, Review Focus 3 (sesi lampau dan sesi manual tidak tersentuh) dan Review Focus 5 (aturan mutlak di service).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **`assertClinicChangeAllowed()`** memakai `DoctorSchedule::hasUpcomingActiveAppointments()` (Task 2; `Appointment::upcomingActive()`, definisi tunggal F3-R15), sehingga appointment aktif pada sesi yang sudah berakhir tidak menghalangi ganti poliklinik. Poliklinik lama dibaca dari `getOriginal('clinic_id')`, jadi aman dipanggil sebelum maupun sesudah model diisi.
- **Tabel keputusan F.4.** `test_f4_decision_table_row` adalah satu data provider dengan **15 baris** = 3 jenis sesi × 5 jenis perubahan: sesi tanpa appointment sama sekali / hanya riwayat batal / dengan appointment aktif × perubahan kuota saja / jam / hari / nonaktif / rentang menyempit. Templat dasar: Senin 08.00–12.00, kuota 20, berlaku 2026-10-12 s.d. 2026-10-18 (satu sesi, Senin 2026-10-12), sehingga setiap baris menentukan akibat pada sesi, jumlah sesi templat sesudahnya, dan laporan.
- **Penilaian per sesi** dibandingkan langsung dengan templat saat ini (bukan dengan selisih `$before`): sesi "sah" bila templat aktif, dokter dan poliklinik sama, hari sama, dan tanggal dalam rentang. `$before` hanya dipakai untuk audit (nilai lama). Karena itu operasi idempoten, dan sesi tanpa appointment yang sudah persis sama tidak dihapus-bangkitkan ulang (hasil akhirnya sama; ID tidak berganti).
- **Cabang C (appointment aktif).** Sah + hanya kuota: `max(kuota templat, booked_count)` (`quotaAdjusted`). Sah + jam berubah: `needs_review` sumber `template_time`. Tidak sah (hari/nonaktif/rentang/dokter/poliklinik): `template_removed`. **Keputusan penulis:** bila jam **dan** kuota berubah bersamaan, kuota langsung disesuaikan dan hanya jam yang menunggu tinjauan (kuota tidak pernah berisiko bagi pasien yang sudah terdaftar).
- **Cabang B (hanya riwayat batal).** Sah: `start_time`/`end_time`/`quota` diperbarui di tempat (`quota = max(kuota templat, booked_count)`, karena appointment `completed`/`no_show` tetap mengonsumsi kuota). Tidak sah: `cancelled` dengan `status_reason` "Jadwal berubah". **Keputusan penulis:** bila penyebabnya dokter atau poliklinik templat berubah, sesi itu juga **dilepas dari templat** (`doctor_schedule_id = NULL`); tanpa itu UNIQUE (`doctor_schedule_id`, `session_date`) menghalangi pembangkitan sesi baru pada tanggal yang sama. `doctor_id`, `clinic_id`, dan `session_date` sesi tidak pernah diubah (I-32).
- **Hanya sesi yang belum berakhir**, `is_manually_modified = false`, dan milik templat itu (F3-R27, BR-83): `scopeNotEnded()` dan pemeriksaan ulang setelah kunci. Tes batas memakai `11:59:59` (diproses), `12:00:00` (tepat berakhir, tidak diproses), dan hari berikutnya.
- **`setPendingChange()`** (prioritas F.4): sumber jenis-batal (`CANCEL_SOURCES`) mengalahkan jenis-jam (`TIME_SOURCES`) dan tidak pernah ditimpa olehnya (tanpa audit); setingkat, yang terbaru menggantikan (audit `session.pending_replaced`); payload identik tidak menulis apa pun. Payload dinormalkan (urutan kunci tetap, jam "HH:MM") sebelum dibandingkan. Sumber `exception` juga mengisi `schedule_exception_id`. Satu sesi tidak pernah punya lebih dari satu `pending_change`. **Pemetaan JDW-17 di T6:** (b) `exception` lalu ubah jam templat → tetap `exception`; (c) tingkat jenis-jam diuji dengan dua perubahan jam templat berturut-turut (`template_time` lama diganti yang baru) ditambah `template_time` → `template_removed`. Bentuk (c) literal `template_time` lalu `manual_time` bergantung pada `updateSession()` dan diuji di Task 8, bersama (d).
- **Laporan** (`message()`): urutan dan redaksi F3-R23. Sesi yang tetap `needs_review` karena prioritas (jam tidak menimpa batal) tetap dihitung `needsReview` karena masih perlu tindak lanjut petugas.
- **`deleteTemplate()`** (BR-12): mengunci baris templat dan sesinya, memeriksa `deletionBlockedReason()` (sesi mana pun yang pernah ber-appointment, termasuk riwayat batal atau yang sudah lampau), lalu menghapus **seluruh** sesi milik templat (semuanya tanpa appointment) sebelum templat, sehingga tidak ada sesi yatim (JDW-19 a). Ini sengaja berbeda dari F3-R27 (sesi lampau tidak dihapus lewat UI): penghapusan internal sesi tanpa appointment mengikuti 09 §3.5. Aturan ini berlaku bagi Super Admin juga karena ada di service; tes service tidak bergantung pada `Auth`.
- **Audit** ditulis lewat `AuditLogger::log()` di dalam transaksi yang sama (galat audit membatalkan seluruh perubahan; diuji dengan `AuditLog::creating(fn () => throw …)`). Nilai templat dinormalkan (jam "HH:MM", tanggal `Y-m-d`) agar `getOriginal()` bertipe cast dan model dapat dibandingkan. Kunci `description` tidak dipakai di payload (akan menjadi `[konten diubah]`).
- Tes memakai `Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create())` tanpa peran, karena service tidak memeriksa peran; `Gate::before` tidak relevan di lapisan ini. `SettingsSeeder` dijalankan di `setUp` agar jendela 30 hari eksplisit.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Scheduling;

/**
 * Ringkasan dampak sebuah perubahan jadwal (11 §6.1), dipakai untuk flash dan audit. Tidak memuat data pasien.
 */
final readonly class ScheduleChangeReport
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $regenerated = 0,
        public int $updated = 0,
        public int $quotaAdjusted = 0,
        public int $needsReview = 0,
        public int $cancelled = 0,
        public int $reopened = 0,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Kalimat ringkasan (F3-R23): bagian bernilai > 0 secara berurutan, dipisah ", " dan diakhiri ".";
     * semua nol menghasilkan string kosong.
     */
    public function message(): string
    {
        $parts = [];

        foreach ([
            [$this->regenerated, 'dibangkitkan'],
            [$this->updated, 'diperbarui'],
            [$this->quotaAdjusted, 'disesuaikan kuotanya'],
            [$this->cancelled, 'dibatalkan'],
            [$this->reopened, 'dibuka kembali'],
            [$this->needsReview, 'perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran'],
        ] as [$count, $label]) {
            if ($count > 0) {
                $parts[] = "{$count} sesi {$label}";
            }
        }

        return $parts === [] ? '' : implode(', ', $parts).'.';
    }
}

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeReport;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * T6: propagasi perubahan templat (00 F.4). "Sekarang" = Senin 2026-10-05 08:00. Templat dasar: Senin 08.00–12.00,
 * kuota 20, berlaku 2026-10-12 s.d. 2026-10-18, sehingga hanya satu sesi (Senin 2026-10-12) yang mungkin ada.
 */
class ScheduleChangeTemplateTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private ScheduleChangeService $service;

    private Actor $actor;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->service = $this->app->make(ScheduleChangeService::class);
        $this->actor = Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create());
        $this->clinic = Clinic::factory()->create();
        $this->doctor = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function template(array $overrides = []): DoctorSchedule
    {
        return $this->createSchedule(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-12',
            'valid_until' => '2026-10-18',
            'is_active' => true,
        ], $overrides))->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function templateSession(DoctorSchedule $schedule, string $date = '2026-10-12', array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id,
            'clinic_id' => $schedule->clinic_id,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
            'is_manually_modified' => false,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * @param  'none'|'cancelled'|'active'  $kind
     */
    private function prepareSession(DoctorSchedule $schedule, string $kind, string $date = '2026-10-12'): PracticeSession
    {
        $session = $this->templateSession($schedule, $date);

        if ($kind === 'cancelled') {
            $this->bookAppointment($session->fresh(), AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        }

        if ($kind === 'active') {
            foreach (range(1, 3) as $ignored) {
                $this->bookAppointment($session->fresh(), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
            }
        }

        return $session->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function changeAttributes(string $change): array
    {
        return match ($change) {
            'quota' => ['quota' => 30],
            'time' => ['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '13:00:00'],
            'day' => ['day_of_week' => 2],
            'deactivate' => ['is_active' => false],
            'range' => ['valid_from' => '2026-10-13'],
        };
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    private function change(DoctorSchedule $schedule, array $attributes): ScheduleChangeReport
    {
        $before = $schedule->getOriginal();
        $schedule->update($attributes);

        return $this->service->applyTemplateChange($schedule, $before, $this->actor);
    }

    private function assertRejected(callable $callback, string $key, string $message): void
    {
        try {
            $callback();
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame([$message], $e->errors()[$key] ?? null);

            return;
        }

        $this->fail('ValidationException tidak dilempar.');
    }

    private function auditRows(string $action): Collection
    {
        return AuditLog::query()->where('action', $action)->orderBy('id')->get();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ tabel keputusan F.4 (satu kasus per baris)

    /**
     * Kolom: jenis sesi (none = tanpa appointment sama sekali, cancelled = hanya riwayat batal, active = 3 appointment
     * aktif), jenis perubahan, akibat pada sesi, jumlah sesi templat sesudahnya, dan laporan
     * [regenerated, updated, quotaAdjusted, needsReview, cancelled, reopened].
     *
     * @return array<string, array{string, string, string, int, array<int, int>}>
     */
    public static function decisionTable(): array
    {
        return [
            'tanpa appointment × kuota' => ['none', 'quota', 'recreated', 1, [1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]],
            'tanpa appointment × jam' => ['none', 'time', 'recreated', 1, [1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]],
            'tanpa appointment × hari' => ['none', 'day', 'moved', 1, [1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]],
            'tanpa appointment × nonaktif' => ['none', 'deactivate', 'removed', 0, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]],
            'tanpa appointment × rentang menyempit' => ['none', 'range', 'removed', 0, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]],
            'hanya batal × kuota' => ['cancelled', 'quota', 'updated', 1, [0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0]],
            'hanya batal × jam' => ['cancelled', 'time', 'updated', 1, [0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0]],
            'hanya batal × hari' => ['cancelled', 'day', 'cancelled', 2, [1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0]],
            'hanya batal × nonaktif' => ['cancelled', 'deactivate', 'cancelled', 1, [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0]],
            'hanya batal × rentang menyempit' => ['cancelled', 'range', 'cancelled', 1, [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0]],
            'appointment aktif × kuota' => ['active', 'quota', 'quota', 1, [0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0]],
            'appointment aktif × jam' => ['active', 'time', 'pending_time', 1, [0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]],
            'appointment aktif × hari' => ['active', 'day', 'pending_removed', 2, [1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]],
            'appointment aktif × nonaktif' => ['active', 'deactivate', 'pending_removed', 1, [0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]],
            'appointment aktif × rentang menyempit' => ['active', 'range', 'pending_removed', 1, [0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, int>  $expectedReport
     */
    #[DataProvider('decisionTable')]
    public function test_f4_decision_table_row(string $kind, string $change, string $effect, int $sessionCount, array $expectedReport): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $original = $this->prepareSession($schedule, $kind);

        $report = $this->change($schedule, $this->changeAttributes($change));

        $this->assertSame(
            $expectedReport,
            [$report->regenerated, $report->updated, $report->quotaAdjusted, $report->needsReview, $report->cancelled, $report->reopened],
        );
        $this->assertSame($sessionCount, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->count());

        $current = PracticeSession::query()->find($original->id);

        match ($effect) {
            'recreated' => $this->assertRecreated($original, $schedule, $change),
            'moved' => $this->assertMoved($original, $schedule),
            'removed' => $this->assertNull($current),
            'updated' => $this->assertUpdatedInPlace($current, $change),
            'cancelled' => $this->assertCancelledForTemplate($current),
            'quota' => $this->assertQuotaAdjusted($current, 30),
            'pending_time' => $this->assertPending($current, [
                'source' => 'template_time',
                'schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
                'new_start_time' => '09:00',
                'new_end_time' => '13:00',
            ]),
            'pending_removed' => $this->assertPending($current, ['source' => 'template_removed', 'schedule_id' => $schedule->id]),
        };

        if ($kind === 'active') {
            $this->assertSame(3, $original->appointments()->active()->count());
            $this->assertSame(3, $current->booked_count);
        }
    }

    private function assertRecreated(PracticeSession $original, DoctorSchedule $schedule, string $change): void
    {
        $this->assertModelMissing($original);

        $new = PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->sole();

        $this->assertNotSame($original->id, $new->id);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-12', $new->session_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame($change === 'quota' ? 30 : 20, $new->quota);
        $this->assertSame($change === 'time' ? '09:00:00' : '08:00:00', $new->start_time);
        $this->assertSame($change === 'time' ? '13:00:00' : '12:00:00', $new->end_time);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $new->status);
    }

    private function assertMoved(PracticeSession $original, DoctorSchedule $schedule): void
    {
        $this->assertModelMissing($original);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-13', PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->sole()->session_date->toDateString());
    }

    private function assertUpdatedInPlace(?PracticeSession $session, string $change): void
    {
        $this->assertNotNull($session);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->status);
        $this->assertSame($change === 'quota' ? 30 : 20, $session->quota);
        $this->assertSame($change === 'time' ? '09:00:00' : '08:00:00', $session->start_time);
        $this->assertSame($change === 'time' ? '13:00:00' : '12:00:00', $session->end_time);
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->appointments()->count());
    }

    private function assertCancelledForTemplate(?PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        $this->assertNotNull($session);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $session->status);
        $this->assertSame('Jadwal berubah', $session->status_reason);
        $this->assertNull($session->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->appointments()->count());
    }

    private function assertQuotaAdjusted(?PracticeSession $session, int $quota): void
    {
        $this->assertNotNull($session);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->status);
        $this->assertNull($session->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame($quota, $session->quota);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    private function assertPending(?PracticeSession $session, array $payload): void
    {
        $this->assertNotNull($session);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $session->status);
        $this->assertSame($payload, $session->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame('08:00:00', $session->start_time);
        $this->assertSame('12:00:00', $session->end_time);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ kuota (JDW-07 bagian templat)

    public function test_quota_never_drops_below_booked_count_when_the_template_quota_is_lowered(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->prepareSession($schedule, 'active');

        $report = $this->change($schedule, ['quota' => 2]);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(3, $fresh->quota);
        $this->assertSame(3, $fresh->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $report->quotaAdjusted);
        $this->assertSame('1 sesi disesuaikan kuotanya.', $report->message());
    }

    public function test_time_and_quota_changed_together_adjust_the_quota_now_and_hold_the_time_for_review(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->prepareSession($schedule, 'active');

        $report = $this->change($schedule, ['quota' => 30, 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '13:00:00']);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(30, $fresh->quota);
        $this->assertSame('08:00:00', $fresh->start_time);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame('template_time', $fresh->pending_change['source']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $report->quotaAdjusted);
        $this->assertSame(1, $report->needsReview);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sesi lampau dan sesi manual tidak tersentuh

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string, bool}>
     */
    public static function endBoundary(): array
    {
        return [
            'satu detik sebelum selesai' => ['2026-10-12 11:59:59', true],
            'tepat saat selesai' => ['2026-10-12 12:00:00', false],
            'hari berikutnya' => ['2026-10-13 00:00:00', false],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('endBoundary')]
    public function test_only_sessions_that_have_not_ended_are_processed(string $now, bool $processed): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->prepareSession($schedule, 'none');
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse($now));

        $report = $this->change($schedule, ['quota' => 30]);

        if ($processed) {
            $this->assertModelMissing($session);
            $this->assertSame(30, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->sole()->quota);
            $this->assertSame(1, $report->regenerated);

            return;
        }

        $this->assertModelExists($session);
        $this->assertSame(20, $session->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertSame(1, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame('', $report->message());
    }

    public function test_past_sessions_with_active_appointments_are_never_flagged_for_review(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->prepareSession($schedule, 'active');
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12 13:00:00'));

        $report = $this->change($schedule, ['is_active' => false]);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame('', $report->message());
    }

    public function test_manual_sessions_modified_sessions_and_other_templates_are_untouched(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template(['valid_until' => '2026-10-25']);
        $modified = $this->templateSession($schedule, '2026-10-12', ['is_manually_modified' => true, 'quota' => 15]);
        $modifiedActive = $this->templateSession($schedule, '2026-10-19', ['is_manually_modified' => true]);
        $this->bookAppointment($modifiedActive->fresh(), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $manual = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'start_time' => '13:00:00',
            'end_time' => '15:00:00',
            'quota' => 8,
            'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
        ]);
        $other = $this->template(['day_of_week' => 2, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-13', 'valid_until' => '2026-10-13']);
        $otherSession = $this->templateSession($other, '2026-10-13');

        $report = $this->change($schedule, ['is_active' => false]);

        $this->assertSame(15, $modified->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $modified->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $modifiedActive->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertNull($modifiedActive->fresh()->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame(8, $manual->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $manual->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertModelExists($otherSession);
        $this->assertSame('', $report->message());
    }

    public function test_nothing_is_churned_when_no_relevant_field_changed(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->prepareSession($schedule, 'none');

        $report = $this->change($schedule, ['notes' => 'Catatan baru']);

        $this->assertModelExists($session);
        $this->assertSame($session->id, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->sole()->id);
        $this->assertSame('', $report->message());
    }

    public function test_extending_the_validity_generates_the_new_days(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();

        $report = $this->change($schedule, ['valid_until' => '2026-10-25']);

        $this->assertSame(1, $report->regenerated);
        $this->assertSame(2, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->count());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ ganti poliklinik (JDW-08 d)

    public function test_clinic_change_is_rejected_when_an_upcoming_session_has_active_appointments(): void
    {

        );

    public function test_clinic_change_is_allowed_for_history_only_ended_or_absent_sessions(): void
    {

    public function test_allowed_clinic_change_regenerates_empty_sessions_and_detaches_history_only_ones(): void
    {

        $this->assertSame('Jadwal berubah', $oldHistory->status_reason);
        $this->assertNull($oldHistory->doctor_schedule_id);

        $this->assertModelMissing($empty);
        $fresh = PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->orderBy('session_date')->get();
        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-12', '2026-10-19'], $fresh->map(fn (PracticeSession $s): string => $s->session_date->toDateString())->all());
        $this->assertSame([$other->id, $other->id], $fresh->map(fn (PracticeSession $s): int => (int) $s->clinic_id)->all());
        $this->assertSame(2, $report->regenerated);
        $this->assertSame(1, $report->cancelled);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ templat baru

    public function test_created_template_generates_the_window_and_writes_the_audit_row(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template(['valid_from' => '2026-10-05', 'valid_until' => null]);

        $report = $this->service->applyTemplateCreated($schedule, $this->actor);

            ->map(fn (PracticeSession $s): string => $s->session_date->toDateString())->all();

        $this->assertSame(5, $report->regenerated);

        $log = $this->auditRows('schedule.created')->sole();
        $this->assertSame($schedule->id, (int) $log->auditable_id);
        $this->assertSame($this->actor->userId, (int) $log->user_id);
        $this->assertNull($log->old_values);
        $this->assertSame(5, $log->new_values['impact']['regenerated']);
        $this->assertSame($this->doctor->id, $log->new_values['doctor_id']);

    public function test_created_template_of_an_inactive_doctor_generates_nothing(): void
    {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ audit dan atomisitas

    public function test_template_update_is_audited_with_the_changed_fields_and_the_impact(): void
    {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ prioritas pending_change (JDW-17 b, c)

    private function sessionPendingException(DoctorSchedule $schedule): PracticeSession
    {
        $exception = $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ]);
        $session = $this->templateSession($schedule, '2026-10-12', [
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id,
            'pending_change' => ['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => $exception->id],
        ]);

        foreach (range(1, 2) as $ignored) {
            $this->bookAppointment($session->fresh(), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        }

        return $session->fresh();
    }

    public function test_a_time_change_does_not_overwrite_a_pending_exception_jdw17b(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->sessionPendingException($schedule);
        $pending = $session->pending_change;

        $report = $this->change($schedule, ['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '13:00:00']);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame($pending, $fresh->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame('exception', $fresh->pending_change['source']);
        $this->assertSame((int) $session->schedule_exception_id, (int) $fresh->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced')->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, $report->needsReview);
    }

    public function test_a_newer_template_time_replaces_the_older_one_and_is_audited_jdw17c(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->prepareSession($schedule, 'active');

        $this->change($schedule, ['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '13:00:00']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced')->count());

        $this->change($schedule, ['start_time' => '10:00:00', 'end_time' => '14:00:00']);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame(
            ['source' => 'template_time', 'schedule_id' => $schedule->id, 'new_start_time' => '10:00', 'new_end_time' => '14:00'],
            $fresh->pending_change,
        );

        $log = $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced')->sole();
        $this->assertSame($session->id, (int) $log->auditable_id);
        $this->assertEquals(
            ['pending_change' => ['source' => 'template_time', 'schedule_id' => $schedule->id, 'new_start_time' => '09:00', 'new_end_time' => '13:00']],
            $log->old_values,
        );
        $this->assertEquals(
            ['pending_change' => ['source' => 'template_time', 'schedule_id' => $schedule->id, 'new_start_time' => '10:00', 'new_end_time' => '14:00']],
            $log->new_values,
        );
    }

    public function test_a_cancel_kind_source_replaces_a_time_kind_source_with_an_audit_row(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();

        $this->change($schedule, ['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '13:00:00']);

    {

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $session->fresh()->status);

    public function test_repeating_the_same_pending_change_writes_no_replacement_audit(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ hapus templat (JDW-19 a, b; CRD-13)

    public function test_deleting_a_template_removes_its_sessions_without_appointments_and_leaves_no_orphans(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template(['valid_until' => '2026-10-25']);

        $otherSession = $this->templateSession($other, '2026-10-13');

        $log = $this->auditRows('schedule.deleted')->sole();

    public function test_deleting_a_template_is_refused_when_a_session_ever_had_an_appointment(): void
    {

        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->deleteTemplate($withPast, $this->actor), 'schedule', $message);
        $this->assertModelExists($withPast);
