Berkas ini diperluas Task 7 dan Task 8 lewat tool Edit dengan anchor `    // ---- pembantu privat ----` (satu-satunya kemunculan).

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Audit\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use DateTimeInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Satu-satunya jalur tulis templat, pengecualian, dan sesi setelah disimpan (00 F.4, 11 §6.6). Setiap sesi
 * diproses dalam transaksinya sendiri dengan lockForUpdate(); audit eksplisit (model jadwal tidak diobservasi
 * AuditObserver) dan tanpa data pasien. Aturan mutlak (sesi lampau, kuota, hapus templat) berlaku untuk semua peran
 * karena dijaga di sini, bukan di Policy.
 */
final class ScheduleChangeService
{
    public const MESSAGE_CLINIC_CHANGE_BLOCKED = 'Poliklinik tidak dapat diganti karena masih ada sesi mendatang dengan pendaftaran aktif. Buat jadwal baru, lalu nonaktifkan jadwal lama.';

    /** Alasan sesi yang dibatalkan karena templat berubah (status_reason). */
    public const REASON_TEMPLATE_CHANGED = 'Jadwal berubah';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly PracticeSessionGenerator $generator,
        private readonly SettingsService $settings,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Mengganti poliklinik templat ditolak bila ada sesi yang belum berakhir dengan pendaftaran aktif (BR-10,
     * CLINIC_CHANGE_BLOCKED; definisi tunggal di Appointment::scopeUpcomingActive). Dipanggil DoctorScheduleRequest
     * sebelum templat disimpan.
     */
    public function assertClinicChangeAllowed(DoctorSchedule $schedule, int $newClinicId): void
    {
        if ($newClinicId === (int) $schedule->getOriginal('clinic_id')) {
            return;
        }

        if ($schedule->hasUpcomingActiveAppointments()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['clinic_id' => self::MESSAGE_CLINIC_CHANGE_BLOCKED]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Templat baru sudah tersimpan: bangkitkan sesi untuk jendela pendaftaran dan catat audit `schedule.created`.
     */
    public function applyTemplateCreated(DoctorSchedule $schedule, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($schedule, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $report = new ScheduleChangeReport(regenerated: $this->generate($schedule));

            $this->audit->log(
                'schedule.created',
                $schedule,
                null,
                $this->scheduleValues($schedule) + ['impact' => $this->impact($report)],
                $this->describeSchedule($schedule, 'ditambahkan'),
                $actor,
            );

            return $report;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Templat sudah diperbarui; `$before` = getOriginal() sebelum update. Hanya sesi yang belum berakhir, berasal
     * dari templat ini, dan `is_manually_modified = false` yang disentuh (F3-R27, BR-83). Keputusan per sesi
     * mengikuti tabel F.4: tanpa appointment sama sekali dihapus lalu dibangkitkan ulang; hanya riwayat batal
     * diperbarui di tempat atau dibatalkan; dengan appointment aktif: kuota disesuaikan (`max(kuota, booked_count)`)
     * atau menjadi needs_review (`template_time` / `template_removed`) lewat setPendingChange().
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $before
     */
    public function applyTemplateChange(DoctorSchedule $schedule, array $before, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($schedule, $before, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $counts = $this->counters();

            $ids = PracticeSession::query()
                ->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->getKey())
                ->where('is_manually_modified', false)
                ->notEnded()
                ->orderBy('id')
                ->pluck('id');

            foreach ($ids as $id) {
                DB::transaction(function () use ($id, $schedule, $actor, &$counts): void {
                    $session = $this->lockById((int) $id);

                    if ($session === null || $session->is_manually_modified || $session->isEnded()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    $this->propagateTemplate($session, $schedule, $actor, $counts);
                });
            }

            $counts['regenerated'] += $this->generate($schedule);
            $report = $this->toReport($counts);

            $old = $this->scheduleValues($before);
            $new = $this->scheduleValues($schedule);
            $changed = array_keys(array_filter($new, fn (mixed $value, string $key): bool => $value !== $old[$key], ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH));

            $this->audit->log(
                'schedule.updated',
                $schedule,
                array_intersect_key($old, array_flip($changed)),
                array_intersect_key($new, array_flip($changed)) + ['impact' => $this->impact($report)],
                $this->describeSchedule($schedule, 'diubah'),
                $actor,
            );

            return $report;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Hapus templat (BR-12): ditolak bila ada sesi miliknya yang pernah ber-appointment (termasuk riwayat batal).
     * Bila boleh, seluruh sesinya (semuanya tanpa appointment, termasuk yang lampau) dihapus lebih dulu agar tidak
     * ada sesi yatim, lalu templat dihapus. Berlaku untuk Super Admin juga.
     */
    public function deleteTemplate(DoctorSchedule $schedule, Actor $actor): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($schedule, $actor): void {
            DoctorSchedule::query()->whereKey($schedule->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->pluck('id');

            $reason = $schedule->deletionBlockedReason();

            if ($reason !== null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['schedule' => $reason]);
            }

            $values = $this->scheduleValues($schedule);
            $description = $this->describeSchedule($schedule, 'dihapus');
            $removed = PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->getKey())->delete();

            $schedule->delete();

            $this->audit->log('schedule.deleted', $schedule, $values, ['impact' => ['deleted_sessions' => $removed]], $description, $actor);
        });
    }

    // ---- pembantu privat ----

    /**
     * Terapkan keputusan F.4 pada satu sesi yang sudah dikunci (tanpa menyentuh sesi manual atau lampau).
     *
     * @param  array<string, int>  $counts
     */
    private function propagateTemplate(PracticeSession $session, DoctorSchedule $schedule, Actor $actor, array &$counts): void
    {
        $active = $session->appointments()->active()->count();
        $any = $active > 0 ? $active : $session->appointments()->count();
        $matches = $this->matchesTemplate($session, $schedule);

        if ($any === 0) {
            // Tanpa appointment sama sekali: dihapus lalu dibangkitkan ulang, kecuali sudah persis sama.
            if (! ($matches && $this->sameTimes($session, $schedule) && (int) $session->quota === (int) $schedule->quota)) {
                $session->delete();
            }

            return;
        }

        if ($active === 0) {
            $this->updateHistoryOnlySession($session, $schedule, $matches, $counts);

            return;
        }

        if (! $matches) {
            $this->setPendingChange($session, [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_REMOVED,
                'schedule_id' => (int) $schedule->getKey(),
            ], $actor);
            $counts['needsReview']++;

            return;
        }

        $quota = max((int) $schedule->quota, (int) $session->booked_count);

        if ($quota !== (int) $session->quota) {
            $session->forceFill(['quota' => $quota])->save();
            $counts['quotaAdjusted']++;
        }

        if (! $this->sameTimes($session, $schedule)) {
            $this->setPendingChange($session, [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TIME,
                'schedule_id' => (int) $schedule->getKey(),
                'new_start_time' => $this->hhmm($schedule->start_time),
                'new_end_time' => $this->hhmm($schedule->end_time),
            ], $actor);
            $counts['needsReview']++;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sesi yang hanya punya riwayat appointment non-aktif: diperbarui di tempat bila masih sah menurut templat,
     * selain itu dibatalkan. Bila dokter atau poliklinik templat berubah, sesi dilepas dari templat agar tanggal
     * itu dapat dibangkitkan ulang (UNIQUE doctor_schedule_id + session_date).
     *
     * @param  array<string, int>  $counts
     */
    private function updateHistoryOnlySession(PracticeSession $session, DoctorSchedule $schedule, bool $matches, array &$counts): void
    {
        if ($matches) {
            $quota = max((int) $schedule->quota, (int) $session->booked_count);

            if (! $this->sameTimes($session, $schedule) || $quota !== (int) $session->quota) {
                $session->forceFill([
                    'start_time' => $this->hhmm($schedule->start_time).':00',
                    'end_time' => $this->hhmm($schedule->end_time).':00',
                    'quota' => $quota,
                ])->save();
                $counts['updated']++;
            }

            return;
        }

        $changes = [];

        if ($session->status !== SessionStatus::Cancelled) {
            $changes = [
                'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
                'status_reason' => self::REASON_TEMPLATE_CHANGED,
                'schedule_exception_id' => null,
                'pending_change' => null,
            ];
            $counts['cancelled']++;
        }

        if ((int) $session->doctor_id !== (int) $schedule->doctor_id || (int) $session->clinic_id !== (int) $schedule->clinic_id) {
            $changes['doctor_schedule_id'] = null;
        }

        if ($changes !== []) {
            $session->forceFill($changes)->save();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Satu sesi hanya menyimpan satu `pending_change` (00 F.4). Sumber jenis-batal mengalahkan jenis-jam; setingkat,
     * yang terbaru menggantikan. Setiap penggantian dicatat `session.pending_replaced`. Dipanggil di dalam transaksi
     * sesi yang sudah dikunci.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $change
     */
    private function setPendingChange(PracticeSession $session, array $change, Actor $actor): void
    {
        $change = $this->normalizePending($change);
        $current = $session->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview && is_array($session->pending_change) && isset($session->pending_change['source'])
            ? $this->normalizePending($session->pending_change)
            : null;

        if ($current !== null) {
            if (in_array($change['source'], PracticeSession::TIME_SOURCES, true) && in_array($current['source'], PracticeSession::CANCEL_SOURCES, true)) {
                return;
            }

            if ($current === $change) {
                return;
            }
        }

        $attributes = ['status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview, 'pending_change' => $change];

        if ($change['source'] === PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION) {
            $attributes['schedule_exception_id'] = $change['exception_id'];
        }

        $session->forceFill($attributes)->save();

        if ($current !== null) {
            $this->audit->log(
                'session.pending_replaced',
                $session,
                ['pending_change' => $current],
                ['pending_change' => $change],
                "Perubahan tertunda sesi {$this->describeSession($session)} diganti.",
                $actor,
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Bentuk baku `pending_change` (00 F.4): urutan kunci dan tipe tetap, jam "HH:MM".
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $change
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function normalizePending(array $change): array
    {
        return match ($change['source'] ?? null) {
            PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION => [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION,
                'exception_id' => (int) $change['exception_id'],
            ],
            PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TIME => [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TIME,
                'schedule_id' => (int) $change['schedule_id'],
                'new_start_time' => $this->hhmm($change['new_start_time']),
                'new_end_time' => $this->hhmm($change['new_end_time']),
            ],
            PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_REMOVED => [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_REMOVED,
                'schedule_id' => (int) $change['schedule_id'],
            ],
            PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_TIME => [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_TIME,
                'new_start_time' => $this->hhmm($change['new_start_time']),
                'new_end_time' => $this->hhmm($change['new_end_time']),
            ],
            PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_CANCEL => [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_CANCEL,
                'reason' => (string) $change['reason'],
            ],
            PracticeSession::SOURCE_DOCTOR_INACTIVE => [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_DOCTOR_INACTIVE,
                'doctor_id' => (int) $change['doctor_id'],
            ],
            default => throw new InvalidArgumentException('Sumber perubahan sesi tidak dikenal.'),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Sesi masih sah menurut templat: templat aktif, dokter dan poliklinik sama, hari sama, dan tanggal dalam
     * rentang berlaku.
     */
    private function matchesTemplate(PracticeSession $session, DoctorSchedule $schedule): bool
    {
        if (
            ! $schedule->is_active
            || (int) $session->doctor_id !== (int) $schedule->doctor_id
            || (int) $session->clinic_id !== (int) $schedule->clinic_id
            || (int) $session->session_date->isoWeekday() !== (int) $schedule->day_of_week
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        $day = $session->session_date->format('Y-m-d');
        $until = $this->dateString($schedule->valid_until);

        return $day >= (string) $this->dateString($schedule->valid_from) && ($until === null || $day <= $until);
    }

    private function sameTimes(PracticeSession $session, DoctorSchedule $schedule): bool
    {
        return $this->hhmm($session->start_time) === $this->hhmm($schedule->start_time)
            && $this->hhmm($session->end_time) === $this->hhmm($schedule->end_time);
    }

    private function lockById(int $id): ?PracticeSession
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
    }

    /**
     * Bangkitkan sesi templat untuk hari ini … hari ini + booking.window_days (idempoten).
     */
    private function generate(DoctorSchedule $schedule): int
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();

        return $this->generator->ensureRange($today, $today->addDays($this->settings->bookingRules()->windowDays), $schedule);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, int>
     */
    private function counters(): array
    {
        return ['regenerated' => 0, 'updated' => 0, 'quotaAdjusted' => 0, 'needsReview' => 0, 'cancelled' => 0, 'reopened' => 0];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, int>  $counts
     */
    private function toReport(array $counts): ScheduleChangeReport
    {
        return new ScheduleChangeReport(
            regenerated: $counts['regenerated'],
            updated: $counts['updated'],
            quotaAdjusted: $counts['quotaAdjusted'],
            needsReview: $counts['needsReview'],
            cancelled: $counts['cancelled'],
            reopened: $counts['reopened'],
        );
    }

    /**
     * Dampak untuk audit (hanya angka, tanpa data pasien).
     *
     * @return array<string, int>
     */
    private function impact(ScheduleChangeReport $report): array
    {
        return [
            'regenerated' => $report->regenerated,
            'updated' => $report->updated,
            'quota_adjusted' => $report->quotaAdjusted,
            'needs_review' => $report->needsReview,
            'cancelled' => $report->cancelled,
            'reopened' => $report->reopened,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Nilai templat yang dicatat di audit, dinormalkan agar `getOriginal()` (bertipe cast) dan model dapat dibandingkan.
     *
     * @param  DoctorSchedule|array<string, mixed>  $source
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function scheduleValues(DoctorSchedule|array $source): array
    {
        $get = fn (string $key): mixed => $source instanceof DoctorSchedule ? $source->getAttribute($key) : ($source[$key] ?? null);

        return [
            'doctor_id' => (int) $get('doctor_id'),
            'clinic_id' => (int) $get('clinic_id'),
            'day_of_week' => (int) $get('day_of_week'),
            'start_time' => $this->hhmm($get('start_time')),
            'end_time' => $this->hhmm($get('end_time')),
            'quota' => (int) $get('quota'),
            'valid_from' => $this->dateString($get('valid_from')),
            'valid_until' => $this->dateString($get('valid_until')),
            'is_active' => (bool) $get('is_active'),
            'notes' => $get('notes') === null ? null : (string) $get('notes'),
        ];
    }

    private function describeSchedule(DoctorSchedule $schedule, string $verb): string
    {
        $name = Doctor::query()->find($schedule->doctor_id)?->displayName ?? '-';

        return "Templat jadwal {$name} hari {$schedule->day_name} {$schedule->time_range} {$verb}.";
    }

    private function describeSession(PracticeSession $session): string
    {
        return $session->session_date->format('d/m/Y').' '.$session->time_range;
    }

    /** "08:00:00" atau "08:00" menjadi "08:00". */
    private function hhmm(mixed $time): string
    {
        return substr((string) $time, 0, 5);
    }

    private function dateString(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        if ($value === null || $value === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return $value instanceof DateTimeInterface ? $value->format('Y-m-d') : substr((string) $value, 0, 10);
    }
}
```

### Task 7: `ScheduleChangeService` (2): pengecualian

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/Services/Scheduling/ScheduleChangeService.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Scheduling/ScheduleChangeExceptionTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:

  - Task 2: `ScheduleException` (`scopeCovering(Builder, CarbonInterface)`, `scopeForDoctor(Builder, int)` dengan NULL = semua dokter, `static pickFor(Collection $exceptions, int $doctorId, CarbonInterface $date): ?self`), `PracticeSession::scopeNotEnded()`/`isEnded()`, `InteractsWithSchedules::createException()`.
  - Task 5: `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::forSession()` (dipakai tes untuk label `leave`/`holiday`/`under_review`).
  - Task 4: `PracticeSessionGenerator::ensureRange()` (membuat sesi baru yang tercakup pengecualian langsung `cancelled`, lewat `pickFor`).

- Produces (tambahan pada `ScheduleChangeService`):

| `doctor_id` | "Pilih dokter untuk cuti dokter." | 12 BR-25 / V-25 |

**Aksi audit:**

| Aksi | `old_values` → `new_values` |
|---|---|
| `exception.created` | `null` → `{type, doctor_id, start_date, end_date, reason, impact{…}}` |
| `exception.updated` | `{start_date, end_date, doctor_id}` (nilai `$previous`) → `{type, doctor_id, start_date, end_date, reason, impact{…}}` |
| `exception.deleted` | `{type, doctor_id, start_date, end_date, reason}` → `{impact{…}}` |

**Test IDs:** JDW-03, JDW-04 (status sesi + `schedule_exception_id` + label lewat `DoctorAvailabilityQuery`), JDW-09, JDW-10 (cabut dan persempit), JDW-17 (a) dan (e), JDW-18 (sisi service), F3-R10 (pindah ke pengecualian lain), F3-R11 (`needs_review` diproses), F3-R21 (`start_date` lampau), BR-27 (berlaku juga untuk sesi `is_manually_modified`), Review Focus 3 (cabut cuti saat sesi `needs_review`, sesi lampau).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Sesi sasaran `applyException`** (F3-R11, BR-27): sesi yang belum berakhir, berstatus `open`/`closed`/`needs_review`, dalam `[start_date, end_date]`, dan milik dokter pengecualian (`doctor_id` NULL = semua), **tanpa melihat `is_manually_modified`**. Sesi `cancelled` tidak disentuh. Tanpa appointment aktif → `cancelled` (`schedule_exception_id`, `status_reason = reason`, `pending_change` dikosongkan, juga bila sebelumnya `needs_review`); dengan appointment aktif → `setPendingChange({source: exception, exception_id})`, sehingga `template_time`, `manual_time`, dan sumber jenis-batal lain digantikan (dengan audit `session.pending_replaced`), dan sesi yang sudah menunggu pengecualian yang sama tidak dihitung lagi.
- **Sesi yang terlepas** (penyempitan, perpindahan rentang, atau pergantian dokter): ditemukan lewat taut `schedule_exception_id` yang kini di luar rentang atau lingkup; `$previous` hanya dipakai untuk aturan F3-R21 dan audit lama. Setelah itu `ensureRange(today, today + window)` tanpa `$only` membuat sesi yang belum ada dan tercakup pengecualian langsung `cancelled`. Sesi baru itu tidak dihitung pada laporan.
- **Melepas sesi (`removeException` dan penyempitan)**: sesi yang belum berakhir dan bertaut ke pengecualian itu. Bila tanggalnya masih tercakup pengecualian **lain**, sesi dipindahkan ke pengecualian itu tanpa dibuka: pilihan memakai `ScheduleException::pickFor()` (F3-R10: khusus dokter lebih dulu, lalu `id` terkecil); sesi `needs_review` dipindahkan lewat `setPendingChange()` (jadi tercatat sebagai penggantian). Bila tidak ada yang lain: `cancelled` → `open` (`status_reason`/`schedule_exception_id` dikosongkan); `needs_review` sumber `exception` → `open` (`pending_change` dikosongkan, appointment tetap) dan `reopened++`. Sesi `needs_review` bersumber lain hanya dilepas tautannya.
- **Evaluasi ulang saat dibuka (BR-28, ASUMSI 12)** agar invarian I-35 tidak dilanggar: bila dokter tidak lagi `active`, sesi tetap `cancelled` ("Dokter tidak aktif"), atau `needs_review` `doctor_inactive` bila ada appointment aktif; bila templat sudah tidak sah, tetap `cancelled` ("Jadwal berubah") atau `needs_review` `template_removed`; bila jam templat berubah selama pengecualian berlaku dan ada appointment aktif, sesi menjadi `needs_review` `template_time` alih-alih `open`. Hanya sesi yang benar-benar dibuka yang dihitung `reopened`.
- **Pagar service** (E.2, BR-23/24/25): kombinasi jenis vs dokter, urutan tanggal, dan `start_date` lampau divalidasi sebelum DB disentuh, untuk pemanggil non-HTTP. Form Request (Task 9) tetap menjadi lapisan utama; CHECK DB `chk_schedule_exceptions_scope` adalah lapisan terakhir (JDW-18).
- Audit tidak memuat data pasien: hanya angka dampak dan kolom pengecualian. `reason` pengecualian bebas-teks admin (≤ 255 karakter) dicatat apa adanya.
- Sesi `needs_review` yang sudah menunggu sumber jenis-batal lain (mis. `doctor_inactive`) digantikan oleh `exception` (setingkat, terbaru menang). Konsekuensi: setelah pengecualian dicabut, sumber asli dihitung ulang lewat evaluasi di atas.

```php
<?php

     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function makeSession(string $date, array $overrides = [], ?Doctor $doctor = null): PracticeSession
    {
        $doctor ??= $this->doctor;

        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'session_date' => $date,

        return $session->fresh();
    }

    private function leave(string $start, string $end, ?Doctor $doctor = null, string $reason = 'Cuti tahunan'): ScheduleException
    {
        return $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => ($doctor ?? $this->doctor)->id,
            'start_date' => $start,
            'end_date' => $end,
            'reason' => $reason,

    {
        return $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday,
            'doctor_id' => null,
            'start_date' => $start,
            'end_date' => $end,
            'reason' => $reason,
        ]);

    private function previousOf(ScheduleException $exception): array

            'end_date' => $exception->end_date->toDateString(),
            'doctor_id' => $exception->doctor_id,
        ];

    private function assertRejected(callable $callback, string $key, string $message): void
    {

            $callback();

            $this->assertSame([$message], $e->errors()[$key] ?? null);

        $this->fail('ValidationException tidak dilempar.');

    private function auditRows(string $action): Collection

    public function test_doctor_leave_cancels_the_sessions_in_range_and_labels_them_leave_jdw03(): void
    {
        $other = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $inside = [$this->makeSession('2026-10-12'), $this->makeSession('2026-10-13'), $this->makeSession('2026-10-14')];
        $after = $this->makeSession('2026-10-15');
        $otherDoctor = $this->makeSession('2026-10-13', [], $other);
        $leave = $this->leave('2026-10-12', '2026-10-14');

        $report = $this->service->applyException($leave, null, $this->actor);

        foreach ($inside as $session) {
            $fresh = $session->fresh();

            $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $fresh->status);
            $this->assertSame($leave->id, (int) $fresh->schedule_exception_id);
            $this->assertSame('Cuti tahunan', $fresh->status_reason);

            $item = $this->query->forSession($fresh);
            $this->assertSame(Availability::Leave, $item->availability);
            $this->assertFalse($item->isBookableOnline);
            $this->assertFalse($item->isBookableCounter);

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $after->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $otherDoctor->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(3, $report->cancelled);
        $this->assertSame('3 sesi dibatalkan.', $report->message());

    public function test_hospital_holiday_cancels_every_doctor_on_that_day_jdw04(): void
    {
        $doctors = [$this->doctor, Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]), Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id])];
        $sessions = array_map(fn (Doctor $doctor) => $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', [], $doctor), $doctors);
        $nextDay = $this->makeSession('2026-10-13');
        $holiday = $this->holiday('2026-10-12', '2026-10-12');

        $report = $this->service->applyException($holiday, null, $this->actor);

        foreach ($sessions as $session) {
            $fresh = $session->fresh();

            $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $fresh->status);
            $this->assertSame($holiday->id, (int) $fresh->schedule_exception_id);
            $this->assertSame(Availability::Holiday, $this->query->forSession($fresh)->availability);
        }

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $nextDay->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(3, $report->cancelled);
    }

    public function test_sessions_with_active_appointments_need_review_and_keep_their_bookings_jdw09(): void
    {
        $empty = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12');
        $booked = $this->withActiveAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-13'), 2);
        $history = $this->makeSession('2026-10-14');
        $this->bookAppointment($history->fresh(), AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $leave = $this->leave('2026-10-12', '2026-10-14');

        $report = $this->service->applyException($leave, null, $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $empty->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $history->fresh()->status);

        $review = $booked->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $review->status);
        $this->assertSame(['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => $leave->id], $review->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame($leave->id, (int) $review->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertSame(2, $review->appointments()->active()->count());
        $this->assertSame(2, $review->booked_count);

        $item = $this->query->forSession($review);
        $this->assertSame(Availability::UnderReview, $item->availability);
        $this->assertFalse($item->isBookableOnline);

        $this->assertSame(2, $report->cancelled);
        $this->assertSame(1, $report->needsReview);
        $this->assertSame('2 sesi dibatalkan, 1 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran.', $report->message());
    }

    public function test_needs_review_closed_and_manually_modified_sessions_are_processed_f3_r11_br27(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-12',
            'valid_until' => '2026-10-26',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);
        $pendingTime = ['source' => 'template_time', 'schedule_id' => $schedule->id, 'new_start_time' => '09:00', 'new_end_time' => '13:00'];

        $timeReview = $this->withActiveAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-12', [
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'pending_change' => $pendingTime,
        ]));
        $inactiveReview = $this->withActiveAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-19', [
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'pending_change' => ['source' => 'doctor_inactive', 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id],
        ]));
        $reviewWithoutBookings = $this->makeSession('2026-10-26', [
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'pending_change' => $pendingTime,
        ]);
        $closed = $this->withActiveAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-20', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]), 1);
        $modified = $this->makeSession('2026-10-21', ['is_manually_modified' => true]);
        $leave = $this->leave('2026-10-12', '2026-10-26');

        $report = $this->service->applyException($leave, null, $this->actor);

        $expected = ['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => $leave->id];

        foreach ([$timeReview, $inactiveReview, $closed] as $session) {
            $fresh = $session->fresh();

            $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $fresh->status);
            $this->assertSame($expected, $fresh->pending_change);
            $this->assertSame($leave->id, (int) $fresh->schedule_exception_id);
        }

        $cleared = $reviewWithoutBookings->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $cleared->status);
        $this->assertNull($cleared->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $modified->fresh()->status);

        $this->assertSame(2, $report->cancelled);
        $this->assertSame(3, $report->needsReview);

        $replaced = $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced');
        $this->assertSame(2, $replaced->count());
        $this->assertEquals(['pending_change' => $pendingTime], $replaced->firstWhere('auditable_id', $timeReview->id)->old_values);
        $this->assertEquals(['pending_change' => $expected], $replaced->firstWhere('auditable_id', $timeReview->id)->new_values);
        $this->assertSame('doctor_inactive', $replaced->firstWhere('auditable_id', $inactiveReview->id)->old_values['pending_change']['source']);
    }

    public function test_start_date_must_not_be_in_the_past_unless_an_existing_exception_keeps_it_f3_r21(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12');
        $past = $this->leave('2026-10-04', '2026-10-14');

        $this->assertRejected(
            fn () => $this->service->applyException($past, null, $this->actor),
            'start_date',
            'Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu.',
        );
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->fresh()->status);

        $existing = $this->leave('2026-10-01', '2026-10-14');
        $previous = $this->previousOf($existing);
        $existing->update(['end_date' => '2026-10-20']);

        $report = $this->service->applyException($existing, $previous, $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $session->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $report->cancelled);

        $moved = $this->previousOf($existing);
        $existing->update(['start_date' => '2026-10-02']);

        $this->assertRejected(
            fn () => $this->service->applyException($existing, $moved, $this->actor),
            'start_date',
            'Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu.',
        );
    }

    public function test_type_and_doctor_combination_is_guarded_by_the_service_jdw18(): void
    {
        $leaveMessage = 'Pilih dokter untuk cuti dokter.';
        $holidayMessage = 'Libur rumah sakit atau libur nasional berlaku untuk semua dokter. Kosongkan pilihan dokter.';
        $make = fn (ExceptionType $type, ?int $doctorId): ScheduleException => new ScheduleException([
            'doctor_id' => $doctorId,
            'type' => $type,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'reason' => 'Uji kombinasi',
        ]);

        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->applyException($make(ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, null), null, $this->actor), 'doctor_id', $leaveMessage);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->applyException($make(ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday, $this->doctor->id), null, $this->actor), 'doctor_id', $holidayMessage);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->applyException($make(ExceptionType::NationalHoliday, $this->doctor->id), null, $this->actor), 'doctor_id', $holidayMessage);

        $withDoctor = $this->createException(['type' => ExceptionType::Other, 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12', 'reason' => 'Lainnya']);
        $withoutDoctor = $this->createException(['type' => ExceptionType::Other, 'doctor_id' => null, 'start_date' => '2026-10-13', 'end_date' => '2026-10-13', 'reason' => 'Lainnya semua']);

        $this->service->applyException($withDoctor, null, $this->actor);
        $this->service->applyException($withoutDoctor, null, $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(2, $this->auditRows('exception.created')->count());
    }

    public function test_removing_an_exception_reopens_its_cancelled_sessions_and_leaves_ended_ones_jdw10(): void
    {
        $leave = $this->leave('2026-10-05', '2026-10-13');
        $ended = $this->makeSession('2026-10-05', [

            'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,

        ]);
        $future = [];

        foreach (['2026-10-12', '2026-10-13'] as $date) {
            $future[] = $this->makeSession($date, [
                'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
                'schedule_exception_id' => $leave->id,
                'status_reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
            ]);
        }

        $report = $this->service->removeException($leave, $this->actor);
        $leave->delete();

        foreach ($future as $session) {

            $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $fresh->status);

            $this->assertNull($fresh->schedule_exception_id);

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $ended->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(2, $report->reopened);

    }

        $leave = $this->leave('2026-10-12', '2026-10-13');

        foreach (['2026-10-13', '2026-10-14', '2026-10-15'] as $date) {

    public function test_another_covering_exception_takes_over_before_a_session_is_reopened_f3_r10(): void
    {
        $holiday = $this->holiday('2026-10-12', '2026-10-12', 'Libur RS');
        $first = $this->leave('2026-10-12', '2026-10-12', null, 'Cuti A');
        $second = $this->leave('2026-10-12', '2026-10-12', null, 'Cuti B');
        $session = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', [
            'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
            'schedule_exception_id' => $first->id,
            'status_reason' => 'Cuti A',
        ]);

        $report = $this->service->removeException($first, $this->actor);
        $first->delete();

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame($second->id, (int) $fresh->schedule_exception_id, 'khusus dokter lebih dulu');
        $this->assertSame('Cuti B', $fresh->status_reason);
        $this->assertSame(0, $report->reopened);

        $this->service->removeException($second, $this->actor);
        $second->delete();

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame($holiday->id, (int) $fresh->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertSame('Libur RS', $fresh->status_reason);

        $final = $this->service->removeException($holiday, $this->actor);
        $holiday->delete();

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $final->reopened);
    }

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertNull($session->fresh()->schedule_exception_id);
    }
```

`new_string`:

```php
    /**
     * Pengecualian sudah tersimpan (baru, atau diubah dengan `$previous` = ['start_date', 'end_date', 'doctor_id']
     * sebelum diubah). Sesi yang belum berakhir dalam rentang dan lingkup dokter diproses tanpa melihat
     * `is_manually_modified` (BR-27): tanpa appointment aktif menjadi `cancelled`, dengan appointment aktif menjadi
     * `needs_review` sumber `exception` lewat setPendingChange() (juga untuk sesi yang sudah `needs_review`, F3-R11).
     * Sesi yang terlepas dari rentang atau lingkup baru dibuka kembali (penyempitan/perpindahan). Sesi yang belum
     * ada dibangkitkan langsung `cancelled` oleh generator.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>|null  $previous
     */
    public function applyException(ScheduleException $exception, ?array $previous, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport
    {
        $this->assertExceptionAllowed($exception, $previous);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($exception, $previous, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $counts = $this->counters();

            if ($previous !== null) {
                foreach ($this->detachedSessionIds($exception) as $id) {
                    DB::transaction(function () use ($id, $exception, $actor, &$counts): void {
                        $session = $this->lockById((int) $id);

                        if (
                            $session === null
                            || $session->isEnded()
                            || (int) $session->schedule_exception_id !== (int) $exception->getKey()
                            || $this->isCoveredBy($session, $exception)
                        ) {
                            return;
                        }

                        $this->releaseFromException($session, $exception, $actor, $counts);
                    });
                }
            }

            foreach ($this->coveredSessionIds($exception) as $id) {
                DB::transaction(function () use ($id, $exception, $actor, &$counts): void {
                    $session = $this->lockById((int) $id);

                    if ($session === null || ! $this->isTarget($session, $exception)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    $this->blockForException($session, $exception, $actor, $counts);
                });
            }

            $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
            $this->generator->ensureRange($today, $today->addDays($this->settings->bookingRules()->windowDays));

            $report = $this->toReport($counts);
            $new = $this->exceptionValues($exception) + ['impact' => $this->impact($report)];

            if ($previous === null) {
                $this->audit->log('exception.created', $exception, null, $new, $this->describeException($exception, 'ditambahkan'), $actor);

                return $report;
            }

            $old = [
                'start_date' => $this->dateString($previous['start_date'] ?? null),
                'end_date' => $this->dateString($previous['end_date'] ?? null),
                'doctor_id' => ($previous['doctor_id'] ?? null) === null ? null : (int) $previous['doctor_id'],
            ];

            $this->audit->log('exception.updated', $exception, $old, $new, $this->describeException($exception, 'diubah'), $actor);

            return $report;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Cabut pengecualian; dipanggil SEBELUM barisnya dihapus (pemanggil menghapus sesudahnya dalam transaksi yang
     * sama). Hanya sesi bertaut yang belum berakhir: `cancelled` dibuka kembali, `needs_review` sumber `exception`
     * kembali `open` (appointment tetap), dan bila tanggalnya masih tercakup pengecualian lain, sesi dipindahkan ke
     * pengecualian itu (F3-R10: khusus dokter lebih dulu, lalu id terkecil).
     */
    public function removeException(ScheduleException $exception, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($exception, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $counts = $this->counters();

            $ids = PracticeSession::query()
                ->where('schedule_exception_id', $exception->getKey())
                ->notEnded()
                ->orderBy('id')
                ->pluck('id');

            foreach ($ids as $id) {
                DB::transaction(function () use ($id, $exception, $actor, &$counts): void {
                    $session = $this->lockById((int) $id);

                    if ($session === null || $session->isEnded() || (int) $session->schedule_exception_id !== (int) $exception->getKey()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    $this->releaseFromException($session, $exception, $actor, $counts);
                });
            }

            $report = $this->toReport($counts);

            $this->audit->log(
                'exception.deleted',
                $exception,
                $this->exceptionValues($exception),
                ['impact' => $this->impact($report)],
                $this->describeException($exception, 'dihapus'),
                $actor,
            );

            return $report;
        });
    }

    // ---- pembantu privat ----

    /**
     * Pagar bagi pemanggil non-HTTP (kombinasi jenis vs dokter E.2, urutan tanggal, dan F3-R21: `start_date` lampau
     * hanya boleh bila pengecualian lama dan tanggalnya tidak berubah).
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>|null  $previous
     */
    private function assertExceptionAllowed(ScheduleException $exception, ?array $previous): void
    {
        $errors = [];

        if ($exception->type->requiresDoctor() && $exception->doctor_id === null) {
            $errors['doctor_id'] = 'Pilih dokter untuk cuti dokter.';
        }

        if ($exception->type->forbidsDoctor() && $exception->doctor_id !== null) {
            $errors['doctor_id'] = 'Libur rumah sakit atau libur nasional berlaku untuk semua dokter. Kosongkan pilihan dokter.';
        }

        $start = (string) $this->dateString($exception->start_date);
        $end = (string) $this->dateString($exception->end_date);

        if ($end < $start) {
            $errors['end_date'] = 'Tanggal selesai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai.';
        }

        $startChanged = $previous === null || $this->dateString($previous['start_date'] ?? null) !== $start;

        if ($startChanged && $start < CarbonImmutable::today()->format('Y-m-d')) {
            $errors['start_date'] = 'Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu.';
        }

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sesi yang belum berakhir, berstatus open/closed/needs_review, dalam rentang dan lingkup dokter pengecualian.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, int>
     */
    private function coveredSessionIds(ScheduleException $exception): Collection
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->whereBetween('session_date', [$this->dateString($exception->start_date), $this->dateString($exception->end_date)])
            ->whereIn('status', [SessionStatus::Open->value, SessionStatus::Closed->value, SessionStatus::NeedsReview->value])
            ->when($exception->doctor_id !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->where('doctor_id', $exception->doctor_id))
            ->notEnded()
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->pluck('id');
    }

    /**
     * Sesi bertaut ke pengecualian ini yang kini berada di luar rentang atau lingkup dokternya.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, int>
     */
    private function detachedSessionIds(ScheduleException $exception): Collection
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('schedule_exception_id', $exception->getKey())
            ->notEnded()
            ->where(function (Builder $outside) use ($exception): void {
                $outside->where('session_date', '<', $this->dateString($exception->start_date))
                    ->orWhere('session_date', '>', $this->dateString($exception->end_date));

                if ($exception->doctor_id !== null) {
                    $outside->orWhere('doctor_id', '!=', $exception->doctor_id);
                }
            })
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->pluck('id');
    }

    private function isCoveredBy(PracticeSession $session, ScheduleException $exception): bool
    {
        $day = $session->session_date->format('Y-m-d');

        return $day >= (string) $this->dateString($exception->start_date)
            && $day <= (string) $this->dateString($exception->end_date)
            && ($exception->doctor_id === null || (int) $session->doctor_id === (int) $exception->doctor_id);
    }

    private function isTarget(PracticeSession $session, ScheduleException $exception): bool
    {
        return $this->isCoveredBy($session, $exception)
            && ! $session->isEnded()
            && in_array($session->status, [SessionStatus::Open, SessionStatus::Closed, SessionStatus::NeedsReview], true);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, int>  $counts
     */
    private function blockForException(PracticeSession $session, ScheduleException $exception, Actor $actor, array &$counts): void
    {
        if ($session->appointments()->active()->count() === 0) {
            $session->forceFill([
                'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
                'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->getKey(),
                'status_reason' => $exception->reason,
                'pending_change' => null,
            ])->save();
            $counts['cancelled']++;

            return;
        }

        $pending = $session->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview ? $session->pending_change : null;

        if (
            is_array($pending)
            && ($pending['source'] ?? null) === PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION
            && (int) ($pending['exception_id'] ?? 0) === (int) $exception->getKey()
        ) {
            return;
        }

        $this->setPendingChange($session, [
            'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION,
            'exception_id' => (int) $exception->getKey(),
        ], $actor);
        $counts['needsReview']++;
    }

    /**
     * Lepaskan sesi dari pengecualian: pindah ke pengecualian lain yang masih mencakup tanggalnya (F3-R10), atau
     * buka kembali. Sesi `needs_review` bersumber lain hanya dilepas tautannya.
     *
     * @param  array<string, int>  $counts
     */
    private function releaseFromException(PracticeSession $session, ScheduleException $exception, Actor $actor, array &$counts): void
    {
        $date = $session->session_date;
        $others = ScheduleException::query()
            ->whereKeyNot($exception->getKey())
            ->covering($date)
            ->forDoctor((int) $session->doctor_id)
            ->get();
        $other = ScheduleException::pickFor($others, (int) $session->doctor_id, $date);

        if ($session->status === SessionStatus::Cancelled) {
            if ($other !== null) {
                $session->forceFill(['schedule_exception_id' => $other->getKey(), 'status_reason' => $other->reason])->save();

                return;
            }

            $this->reopenSession($session, $actor, $counts);

            return;
        }

        if ($session->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview && ($session->pending_change['source'] ?? null) === PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION) {
            if ($other !== null) {
                $this->setPendingChange($session, [
                    'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_EXCEPTION,
                    'exception_id' => (int) $other->getKey(),
                ], $actor);

                return;
            }

            $this->reopenSession($session, $actor, $counts);

            return;
        }

        $session->forceFill(['schedule_exception_id' => null])->save();
    }

    /**
     * Evaluasi ulang sesi yang lepas dari pengecualian (BR-28): dokter non-aktif atau templat yang sudah tidak
     * berlaku menahan sesi (batal, atau needs_review bila ada appointment aktif); jam templat yang berubah selama
     * pengecualian berlaku ditunda ke tinjauan; selain itu sesi dibuka kembali.
     *
     * @param  array<string, int>  $counts
     */
    private function reopenSession(PracticeSession $session, Actor $actor, array &$counts): void
    {
        $active = $session->appointments()->active()->count();
        $doctor = Doctor::query()->whereKey($session->doctor_id)->first(['id', 'status']);
        $schedule = $session->doctor_schedule_id === null ? null : DoctorSchedule::query()->find($session->doctor_schedule_id);

        if ($doctor === null || $doctor->status !== DoctorStatus::Active) {
            $this->holdAfterRelease($session, $active, [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_DOCTOR_INACTIVE,
                'doctor_id' => (int) $session->doctor_id,
            ], self::REASON_DOCTOR_INACTIVE, $actor, $counts);

            return;
        }

        if ($schedule !== null && ! $this->matchesTemplate($session, $schedule)) {
            $this->holdAfterRelease($session, $active, [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_REMOVED,
                'schedule_id' => (int) $schedule->getKey(),
            ], self::REASON_TEMPLATE_CHANGED, $actor, $counts);

            return;
        }

        $session->forceFill([
            'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
            'status_reason' => null,
            'schedule_exception_id' => null,
            'pending_change' => null,
        ])->save();

        if ($schedule !== null && $active > 0 && ! $this->sameTimes($session, $schedule)) {
            $this->setPendingChange($session, [
                'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_TEMPLATE_TIME,
                'schedule_id' => (int) $schedule->getKey(),
                'new_start_time' => $this->hhmm($schedule->start_time),
                'new_end_time' => $this->hhmm($schedule->end_time),
            ], $actor);
            $counts['needsReview']++;

            return;
        }

        $counts['reopened']++;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $pending
     * @param  array<string, int>  $counts
     */
    private function holdAfterRelease(PracticeSession $session, int $active, array $pending, string $reason, Actor $actor, array &$counts): void
    {
        $session->forceFill(['schedule_exception_id' => null])->save();

        if ($active > 0) {
            $this->setPendingChange($session, $pending, $actor);
            $counts['needsReview']++;

            return;
        }

        $session->forceFill(['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'status_reason' => $reason, 'pending_change' => null])->save();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function exceptionValues(ScheduleException $exception): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => $exception->type->value,
            'doctor_id' => $exception->doctor_id === null ? null : (int) $exception->doctor_id,
            'start_date' => $this->dateString($exception->start_date),
            'end_date' => $this->dateString($exception->end_date),
            'reason' => (string) $exception->reason,
        ];
    }

    private function describeException(ScheduleException $exception, string $verb): string
    {
        $range = CarbonImmutable::parse((string) $this->dateString($exception->start_date))->format('d/m/Y')
            .'–'.CarbonImmutable::parse((string) $this->dateString($exception->end_date))->format('d/m/Y');

        return "Pengecualian jadwal \"{$exception->reason}\" ({$range}) {$verb}.";
    }
```

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Keputusan tipe kembalian `changeStatus()` (kerangka T8).** Kode nyata: `changeStatus(...): Doctor` dan `archive(...): Doctor`. Pemanggil: `DoctorController@status` dan `@archive` (mengabaikan nilai kembalian) serta `DoctorServiceTest` (±16 pemanggilan; empat tes membaca `Doctor` kembalian: `$inactive->status`, `$result->status`, `$restored->status`/`archived_at`, `$archived->status`) dan `AdminDoctor*Test` lewat HTTP. `ArchiveDoctorRequest` hanya memakai `archiveBlockedReason()`. Mengubah tipe kembalian ke objek hasil akan memecah keempat tes itu dan tanda tangan di 11 §6.17. **Dipilih: tanda tangan tetap, ditambah `lastReport(): ?ScheduleChangeReport`.** Konsekuensi yang disadari: `DoctorService` kini menyimpan satu properti keadaan per instance; ia **bukan** singleton (container membuat instance baru per resolusi), controller memakai satu instance hasil method injection untuk memanggil `changeStatus()`/`archive()` lalu `lastReport()`, dan properti diatur ulang menjadi `null` di awal setiap pemanggilan (pemanggilan tanpa efek, seperti status yang sama, tidak mewarisi laporan lama). `ArchiveDoctorRequest` memakai instance terpisah dan tidak terpengaruh.
- **Cara `DoctorService` dibangun** (diverifikasi dengan `grep -rn "new DoctorService" app tests` yang kosong): hanya lewat container (`$this->app->make(DoctorService::class)` di `DoctorServiceTest`, `app(DoctorService::class)` di `ArchiveDoctorRequest` dan `AdminDoctorArchiveTest`, injeksi method di controller). Menambah parameter konstruktor ketiga aman; satu-satunya tes yang mengunci konstruktor adalah `test_service_is_final_and_resolvable_with_the_documented_constructor` yang memeriksa nama parameter, sehingga asersinya diubah menjadi `['audit', 'media', 'schedules']` (Edit di Siklus B).
- **Bentuk audit dokter tidak berubah tanpa dampak.** `impact` ditambahkan ke `new_values` hanya bila `cancelled + needs_review (+ schedules_deactivated) > 0`; tes `DoctorServiceTest` yang membandingkan `new_values` persis tetap hijau karena dokter ujinya tanpa sesi. Hanya dokter **aktif** yang dinonaktifkan memanggil `applyDoctorInactive()` (pemulihan arsip → `inactive` tidak, karena sesi sudah ditahan saat diarsipkan).
- **Arsip (BR-05/BR-06).** `archive()` tetap ditolak lewat `archiveBlockedReason()` bila ada appointment aktif pada sesi yang belum berakhir (isi `futureActiveAppointmentsCount()` dari Task 2), sehingga saat arsip lolos `applyDoctorInactive()` hanya menghasilkan `cancelled`. Seluruh templat aktif dokter dinonaktifkan dengan satu `UPDATE` (BR-06, ASUMSI 12); pemulihan tidak mengaktifkannya kembali, dan mengaktifkan dokter tidak membuka sesi `cancelled` (F3-R16).
- **Sesi manual (F3-R26).** `is_manually_modified = true` sejak dibuat (UNIQUE `doctor_schedule_id`+`session_date` mengizinkan banyak NULL, sehingga sesi manual berulang diizinkan dan generator tidak pernah menyentuhnya). Baris dokter dikunci selama pemeriksaan irisan (BR-29, I-28: dibanding sesi **non-batal**; jam bersebelahan tidak bentrok). Tanggal hari ini dengan `end_time` yang sudah lewat dianggap lampau. Setelah `save()` model di-`refresh()` karena `booked_count`/`last_queue_number` adalah default DB (mode ketat menolak atribut yang tidak dimuat).
- **`updateSession()`** (BR-30/BR-35): kuota 1–200 dan tidak di bawah `booked_count` (`booked_count` memuat appointment `completed`/`no_show`); jam: langsung bila tak ada appointment aktif, selain itu `needs_review` `manual_time` lewat `setPendingChange()` dan jam lama tetap berlaku. Bila sesi sudah menunggu sumber jenis-batal, jam baru diabaikan oleh prioritas F.4. Selalu `is_manually_modified = true`; audit hanya bila ada perubahan nilai.
- **`setSessionStatus()`**: `open ↔ closed` langsung; batal wajib beralasan (trim; Form Request menambah minimal 5 karakter): langsung `cancelled` (`schedule_exception_id` dikosongkan) atau `needs_review` `manual_cancel` bila ada appointment aktif. Membuka `cancelled` ditolak bila masih tercakup pengecualian (`pickFor`) atau dokter belum `active`. **Keputusan penulis (belum ditetapkan kerangka):** mengubah status sesi `needs_review` lewat jalur ini ditolak (diselesaikan di layar Sesi terdampak fase 7; tanpa penolakan invarian I-12 bisa rusak), menutup sesi `cancelled` ditolak, mengubah ke status yang sama tidak menulis apa pun, dan `needs_review` sebagai target adalah `InvalidArgumentException` (hanya sistem yang menetapkannya). Semua perubahan status menyetel `is_manually_modified = true` (00 F.1 menyebut "tutup").
- **`deleteManualSession()`** memeriksa `deletionBlockedReason()` dulu (pesan paling informatif untuk sesi templat), baru sesi lampau (F3-R27). **`applyDoctorInactive()`**: hanya sesi `open`/`closed`/`needs_review` yang belum berakhir; yang sudah `cancelled` (mis. "Cuti tahunan") tidak diubah alasannya; idempoten (pemanggilan kedua tidak menulis audit penggantian).
- Tes memakai `Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create())` untuk service dan `createStaff()` (hanya di `DoctorStatusScheduleTest`) untuk HTTP; aturan mutlak diuji di service sehingga berlaku untuk semua peran. Tes flash HTTP menegaskan flash `success` yang diperpanjang; kunci `warning` dari 12 V-20 tidak dipakai karena F3-R16 menetapkan penambahan ringkasan ke flash status.

**Siklus A — sesi manual, edit, status, hapus, dan `applyDoctorInactive`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\Availability;
use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * T8: sesi tambahan manual, edit satu sesi, status sesi, hapus sesi manual, dan dokter nonaktif. "Sekarang" =
 * Senin 2026-10-05 08:00. Aturan mutlak diuji di service, sehingga berlaku untuk semua peran (termasuk Super Admin).
 */
class ScheduleChangeSessionTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private ScheduleChangeService $service;

    private DoctorAvailabilityQuery $query;

    private Actor $actor;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->service = $this->app->make(ScheduleChangeService::class);
        $this->query = $this->app->make(DoctorAvailabilityQuery::class);
        $this->actor = Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create());
        $this->clinic = Clinic::factory()->create();
        $this->doctor = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function makeSession(string $date = '2026-10-12', array $overrides = [], ?Doctor $doctor = null): PracticeSession
    {
        $doctor ??= $this->doctor;

        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 10,
            'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
            'is_manually_modified' => false,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function withAppointments(PracticeSession $session, int $count, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed): PracticeSession
    {
        foreach (range(1, $count) as $ignored) {
            $this->bookAppointment($session->fresh(), $status);
        }

        return $session->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function manualInput(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'start_time' => '10:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00',
            'quota' => 10,
        ], $overrides);
    }

    private function assertRejected(callable $callback, string $key, string $message): void
    {
        try {
            $callback();
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame([$message], $e->errors()[$key] ?? null);

            return;
        }

        $this->fail('ValidationException tidak dilempar.');
    }

    private function auditRows(string $action): Collection
    {
        return AuditLog::query()->where('action', $action)->orderBy('id')->get();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ createManualSession (JDW-13)

    public function test_manual_session_is_created_open_and_manual_and_survives_regeneration_jdw13(): void
    {
        $first = $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(), $this->actor);
        $second = $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['start_time' => '13:00', 'end_time' => '15:00']), $this->actor);

        $this->assertNull($first->doctor_schedule_id);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $first->status);
        $this->assertTrue($first->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertSame(0, $first->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $first->last_queue_number);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-06', $first->session_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('10:00:00', $first->start_time);
        $this->assertSame('12:00:00', $first->end_time);
        $this->assertSame(10, $first->quota);
        $this->assertNotSame($first->id, $second->id);

        $this->createSchedule([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 2,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '09:00:00',
            'quota' => 5,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-05',
            'valid_until' => null,
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);
        $this->app->make(PracticeSessionGenerator::class)->ensureRange(CarbonImmutable::today(), CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays(30));

        $this->assertModelExists($first);
        $this->assertModelExists($second);
        $this->assertSame(2, PracticeSession::query()->whereNull('doctor_schedule_id')->count());
        $this->assertTrue($this->query->forSession($first->fresh())->isBookableOnline);
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Available, $this->query->forSession($first->fresh())->availability);

        $log = $this->auditRows('session.created')->first();
        $this->assertSame($first->id, (int) $log->auditable_id);
        $this->assertSame($this->actor->userId, (int) $log->user_id);
        $this->assertNull($log->old_values);
        $this->assertEquals([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'start_time' => '10:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00',
            'quota' => 10,
            'status' => 'open',
        ], $log->new_values);
    }

    public function test_manual_session_requires_an_active_doctor_an_open_clinic_valid_times_and_quota(): void
    {
        $inactive = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->inactive()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $archived = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->archived()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $dormant = Clinic::factory()->inactive()->create();
        $closed = Clinic::factory()->create(['is_bookable' => false]);
        $doctorMessage = 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.';
        $clinicMessage = 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.';

        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['doctor_id' => $inactive->id]), $this->actor), 'doctor_id', $doctorMessage);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['doctor_id' => $archived->id]), $this->actor), 'doctor_id', $doctorMessage);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['doctor_id' => 999999]), $this->actor), 'doctor_id', $doctorMessage);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['clinic_id' => $dormant->id]), $this->actor), 'clinic_id', $clinicMessage);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['clinic_id' => $closed->id]), $this->actor), 'clinic_id', $clinicMessage);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['start_time' => '25:00']), $this->actor), 'start_time', 'Format jam mulai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['end_time' => 'siang']), $this->actor), 'end_time', 'Format jam selesai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['start_time' => '12:00', 'end_time' => '12:00']), $this->actor), 'end_time', 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['quota' => 0]), $this->actor), 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['quota' => 201]), $this->actor), 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.');

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());

        $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['quota' => 200]), $this->actor);
        $this->assertSame(1, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_manual_session_dates_must_be_between_today_and_365_days_ahead_and_not_ended(): void
    {
        $past = 'Tanggal sesi tidak boleh di masa lalu.';

        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['session_date' => '2026-10-04']), $this->actor), 'session_date', $past);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '06:00', 'end_time' => '07:00']), $this->actor), 'session_date', $past);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['session_date' => '2027-10-06']), $this->actor), 'session_date', 'Tanggal sesi maksimal 365 hari ke depan.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['session_date' => null]), $this->actor), 'session_date', 'Tanggal sesi wajib diisi.');

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());

        $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '11:00']), $this->actor);
        $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['session_date' => '2027-10-05']), $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(2, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_manual_session_is_refused_inside_an_exception_or_when_it_overlaps_another_session(): void
    {
        $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ]);
        $overlap = 'Jam sesi bertabrakan dengan sesi lain milik dokter ini pada tanggal tersebut.';

        $this->assertRejected(
            fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['session_date' => '2026-10-07']), $this->actor),
            'session_date',
            'Tanggal ini berada dalam pengecualian jadwal (Cuti tahunan). Hapus atau ubah pengecualian terlebih dahulu.',
        );

        $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(), $this->actor);

        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['start_time' => '11:00', 'end_time' => '13:00']), $this->actor), 'start_time', $overlap);
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '10:30']), $this->actor), 'start_time', $overlap);

        // Bersebelahan (12:00 = akhir sesi lain) dan sesi batal tidak dihitung bentrok; dokter lain bebas.
        $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['start_time' => '12:00', 'end_time' => '14:00']), $this->actor);
        $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['start_time' => '08:00', 'end_time' => '10:00']), $this->actor);
        $this->makeSession('2026-10-06', ['start_time' => '15:00:00', 'end_time' => '17:00:00', 'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled]);
        $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['start_time' => '16:00', 'end_time' => '17:00']), $this->actor);
        $other = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $this->service->createManualSession($this->manualInput(['doctor_id' => $other->id]), $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->where('status', SessionStatus::Open->value)->count());
    }

    public function test_manual_session_creation_is_rolled_back_when_the_audit_row_cannot_be_written(): void

    }

    public function test_quota_cannot_go_below_booked_count_but_equal_is_accepted_jdw07(): void
    {
        $session = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession(), 5);

        $this->assertRejected(
            fn () => $this->service->updateSession($session, ['quota' => 4], $this->actor),
            'quota',
            'Kuota tidak boleh kurang dari jumlah pendaftaran yang sudah ada (5).',
        );
        $this->assertSame(10, $session->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertFalse($session->fresh()->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->auditRows('session.updated')->count());

        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->updateSession($session, ['quota' => 0], $this->actor), 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->updateSession($session, ['quota' => 201], $this->actor), 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.');

        $updated = $this->service->updateSession($session, ['quota' => 5], $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(5, $updated->quota);
        $this->assertSame(5, $session->fresh()->quota);
        $this->assertTrue($session->fresh()->is_manually_modified);

        $log = $this->auditRows('session.updated')->sole();
        $this->assertEquals(['quota' => 10], $log->old_values);
        $this->assertEquals(['quota' => 5], $log->new_values);
    }

    public function test_quota_increase_on_a_session_with_active_appointments_applies_immediately_jdw15(): void
    {
        $session = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession(), 3);

        $this->service->updateSession($session, ['quota' => 25], $this->actor);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(25, $fresh->quota);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $fresh->status);

    public function test_time_change_applies_directly_without_active_appointments_jdw15(): void
    {
        $session = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession(), 1, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

        $this->service->updateSession($session, ['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '13:00'], $this->actor);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame('09:00:00', $fresh->start_time);
        $this->assertSame('13:00:00', $fresh->end_time);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->pending_change);
        $this->assertTrue($fresh->is_manually_modified);

        $log = $this->auditRows('session.updated')->sole();
        $this->assertEquals(['start_time' => '08:00', 'end_time' => '12:00'], $log->old_values);
        $this->assertEquals(['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '13:00'], $log->new_values);

    public function test_time_change_with_active_appointments_waits_for_review_as_manual_time_jdw15(): void
    {
        $session = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession(), 2);

        $this->service->updateSession($session, ['quota' => 15, 'start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '13:00'], $this->actor);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame(['source' => 'manual_time', 'new_start_time' => '09:00', 'new_end_time' => '13:00'], $fresh->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame('08:00:00', $fresh->start_time);
        $this->assertSame('12:00:00', $fresh->end_time);
        $this->assertSame(15, $fresh->quota);
        $this->assertTrue($fresh->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertSame(2, $fresh->appointments()->active()->count());
        $this->assertSame(2, $fresh->booked_count);

        $log = $this->auditRows('session.updated')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('open', $log->old_values['status']);
        $this->assertSame('needs_review', $log->new_values['status']);
        $this->assertSame('manual_time', $log->new_values['pending_change']['source']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced')->count());
    }

    public function test_a_manual_time_replaces_a_template_time_but_never_an_exception_jdw17c(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 10,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-12',
            'valid_until' => '2026-10-19',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);
        $templateTime = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-12', [
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'pending_change' => ['source' => 'template_time', 'schedule_id' => $schedule->id, 'new_start_time' => '09:00', 'new_end_time' => '13:00'],
        ]), 2);
        $exception = $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-19',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-19',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ]);
        $underException = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-19', [
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id,
            'pending_change' => ['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => $exception->id],
        ]), 1);

        $this->service->updateSession($templateTime, ['start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '14:00'], $this->actor);
        $this->service->updateSession($underException, ['start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '14:00'], $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(
            ['source' => 'manual_time', 'new_start_time' => '10:00', 'new_end_time' => '14:00'],
            $templateTime->fresh()->pending_change,
        );
        $this->assertSame(['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => $exception->id], $underException->fresh()->pending_change);

        $log = $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced')->sole();
        $this->assertSame($templateTime->id, (int) $log->auditable_id);
        $this->assertSame('template_time', $log->old_values['pending_change']['source']);
        $this->assertSame('manual_time', $log->new_values['pending_change']['source']);
    }

    public function test_session_edit_validates_times_overlap_and_ended_sessions(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', ['start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:00']);
        $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', ['start_time' => '11:00:00', 'end_time' => '13:00:00']);
```
