```php
    public function test_open_and_closed_switch_directly_and_keep_existing_appointments(): void
    {
        $session = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession(), 2);

        $this->service->setSessionStatus($session, SessionStatus::Closed, $this->actor, 'Ruang dipakai kegiatan lain');

        $closed = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Closed, $closed->status);
        $this->assertSame('Ruang dipakai kegiatan lain', $closed->status_reason);
        $this->assertTrue($closed->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertSame(2, $closed->appointments()->active()->count());
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Closed, $this->query->forSession($closed)->availability);

        $this->service->setSessionStatus($session, SessionStatus::Open, $this->actor);

        $open = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $open->status);
        $this->assertNull($open->status_reason);

        $logs = $this->auditRows('session.status_changed');
        $this->assertSame(2, $logs->count());
        $this->assertEquals(['status' => 'open', 'status_reason' => null], $logs[0]->old_values);
        $this->assertEquals(['status' => 'closed', 'status_reason' => 'Ruang dipakai kegiatan lain'], $logs[0]->new_values);
        $this->assertEquals(['status' => 'open', 'status_reason' => null], $logs[1]->new_values);
    }

    public function test_a_cancelled_session_reopens_only_when_no_exception_covers_it_and_the_doctor_is_active(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'status_reason' => 'Dokter berhalangan']);
        $exception = $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ]);

        $this->assertRejected(
            fn () => $this->service->setSessionStatus($session, SessionStatus::Open, $this->actor),
            'status',
            'Tanggal ini berada dalam pengecualian jadwal (Cuti tahunan). Hapus atau ubah pengecualian terlebih dahulu.',
        );

        $exception->delete();
        $this->doctor->forceFill(['status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive])->save();

        $this->assertRejected(
            fn () => $this->service->setSessionStatus($session, SessionStatus::Open, $this->actor),
            'status',
            'Sesi tidak dapat dibuka karena dokter belum aktif kembali.',
        );
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $session->fresh()->status);

        $this->doctor->forceFill(['status' => DoctorStatus::Active])->save();
        $this->service->setSessionStatus($session, SessionStatus::Open, $this->actor);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->status_reason);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertTrue($fresh->is_manually_modified);
    }

    public function test_status_changes_are_refused_for_ended_review_and_nonsensical_transitions(): void
    {
        $ended = $this->makeSession('2026-10-05', ['start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '07:00:00']);
        $review = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', [
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'pending_change' => ['source' => 'doctor_inactive', 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id],
        ]);
        $cancelled = $this->makeSession('2026-10-13', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'status_reason' => 'Dokter berhalangan']);
        $open = $this->makeSession('2026-10-14');

        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->setSessionStatus($ended, SessionStatus::Closed, $this->actor), 'session', 'Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->setSessionStatus($ended, SessionStatus::Cancelled, $this->actor, 'Alasan'), 'session', 'Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->setSessionStatus($review, SessionStatus::Open, $this->actor), 'status', 'Sesi ini sedang menunggu penyelesaian di layar Sesi terdampak.');
        $this->assertRejected(fn () => $this->service->setSessionStatus($cancelled, SessionStatus::Closed, $this->actor), 'status', 'Sesi yang dibatalkan hanya dapat dibuka kembali.');

        $same = $this->service->setSessionStatus($open, SessionStatus::Open, $this->actor);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $same->status);
        $this->assertFalse($open->fresh()->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->auditRows('session.status_changed')->count());

        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->service->setSessionStatus($open, SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $this->actor);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ applyDoctorInactive (JDW-16, JDW-17 d)

    public function test_inactive_doctor_sessions_are_cancelled_or_held_for_review_jdw16(): void
    {
        $other = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 10,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-12',
            'valid_until' => '2026-10-12',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);
        $empty = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', ['doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id]);
        $booked = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-13'), 2);
        $closed = $this->makeSession('2026-10-14', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]);
        $history = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-15'), 1, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $alreadyCancelled = $this->makeSession('2026-10-16', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'status_reason' => 'Cuti tahunan']);
        $ended = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-05', ['start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '07:00:00']), 1);
        $review = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-17', [
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'pending_change' => ['source' => 'template_time', 'schedule_id' => $schedule->id, 'new_start_time' => '09:00', 'new_end_time' => '13:00'],
        ]), 1);
        $theirs = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', [], $other);
        $this->doctor->forceFill(['status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive])->save();

        $report = $this->service->applyDoctorInactive($this->doctor, $this->actor);

        foreach ([$empty, $closed, $history] as $session) {
            $fresh = $session->fresh();

            $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $fresh->status);
            $this->assertSame('Dokter tidak aktif', $fresh->status_reason);
            $this->assertNull($fresh->pending_change);
        }

        foreach ([$booked, $review] as $session) {
            $fresh = $session->fresh();

            $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $fresh->status);
            $this->assertSame(['source' => 'doctor_inactive', 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id], $fresh->pending_change);
            $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $fresh->appointments()->active()->count());
        }

        $this->assertSame('Cuti tahunan', $alreadyCancelled->fresh()->status_reason);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $ended->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $theirs->fresh()->status);

        $this->assertSame(3, $report->cancelled);
        $this->assertSame(2, $report->needsReview);
        $this->assertSame('3 sesi dibatalkan, 2 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran.', $report->message());

        $replaced = $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced')->sole();
        $this->assertSame($review->id, (int) $replaced->auditable_id);
        $this->assertSame('template_time', $replaced->old_values['pending_change']['source']);
        $this->assertSame('doctor_inactive', $replaced->new_values['pending_change']['source']);
    }

    public function test_doctor_inactive_replaces_manual_cancel_with_an_audit_row_jdw17d(): void
    {
        $session = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession(), 2);
        $this->service->setSessionStatus($session, SessionStatus::Cancelled, $this->actor, 'Dokter sakit');
        $this->assertSame('manual_cancel', $session->fresh()->pending_change['source']);

        $this->service->applyDoctorInactive($this->doctor, $this->actor);

        $fresh = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame(['source' => 'doctor_inactive', 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id], $fresh->pending_change);

        $log = $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('manual_cancel', $log->old_values['pending_change']['source']);
        $this->assertSame('doctor_inactive', $log->new_values['pending_change']['source']);
    }

    public function test_applying_doctor_inactive_twice_is_idempotent(): void
    {
        $booked = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-12'), 1);
        $empty = $this->makeSession('2026-10-13');

        $this->service->applyDoctorInactive($this->doctor, $this->actor);
        $second = $this->service->applyDoctorInactive($this->doctor, $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $booked->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $empty->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, $second->cancelled);
        $this->assertSame(1, $second->needsReview);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->auditRows('session.pending_replaced')->count());
    }
}
```

**Edit 3 dari 3**: method publik sesi manual, status, hapus, dan `applyDoctorInactive()` serta pembantu privat sesi.

`old_string` (tepat satu kecocokan):

```php
    // ---- pembantu privat ----
```

`new_string`:

```php
    /**
     * Sesi tambahan manual (`doctor_schedule_id` NULL; F3-R26, V-24, BR-29): dokter harus `active`, poliklinik aktif
     * dan dibuka untuk pendaftaran, tanggal hari ini … 365 hari ke depan dan belum berakhir, tidak dalam rentang
     * pengecualian, dan jamnya tidak beririsan dengan sesi non-batal dokter itu pada tanggal yang sama. Baris
     * dokter dikunci selama pemeriksaan irisan.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes  doctor_id, clinic_id, session_date, start_time, end_time, quota
     */
    public function createManualSession(array $attributes, Actor $actor): PracticeSession
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($attributes, $actor): PracticeSession {
            $errors = [];
            $today = CarbonImmutable::today();

            $doctorId = (int) ($attributes['doctor_id'] ?? 0);
            $doctor = Doctor::query()->whereKey($doctorId)->lockForUpdate()->first(['id', 'status']);

            if ($doctor === null || $doctor->status !== DoctorStatus::Active) {
                $errors['doctor_id'] = 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.';
            }

            $clinicId = (int) ($attributes['clinic_id'] ?? 0);
            $clinic = Clinic::query()->whereKey($clinicId)->first(['id', 'is_active', 'is_bookable']);

            if ($clinic === null || ! $clinic->is_active || ! $clinic->is_bookable) {
                $errors['clinic_id'] = 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.';
            }

            $start = $this->timeOrNull($attributes['start_time'] ?? null);
            $end = $this->timeOrNull($attributes['end_time'] ?? null);

            if ($start === null) {
                $errors['start_time'] = 'Format jam mulai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.';
            }

            if ($end === null) {
                $errors['end_time'] = 'Format jam selesai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.';
            } elseif ($start !== null && $end <= $start) {
                $errors['end_time'] = 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.';
            }

            $quota = (int) ($attributes['quota'] ?? 0);

            if ($quota < 1 || $quota > 200) {
                $errors['quota'] = 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.';
            }

            $date = $this->dateString($attributes['session_date'] ?? null);

            if ($date === null) {
                $errors['session_date'] = 'Tanggal sesi wajib diisi.';
            } elseif (
                $date < $today->format('Y-m-d')
                || ($date === $today->format('Y-m-d') && $end !== null && $end.':00' <= CarbonImmutable::now()->format('H:i:s'))
            ) {
                $errors['session_date'] = 'Tanggal sesi tidak boleh di masa lalu.';
            } elseif ($date > $today->addDays(365)->format('Y-m-d')) {
                $errors['session_date'] = 'Tanggal sesi maksimal 365 hari ke depan.';
            }

            if ($errors === []) {
                $day = CarbonImmutable::parse($date);
                $covering = ScheduleException::query()->covering($day)->forDoctor($doctorId)->get();
                $picked = ScheduleException::pickFor($covering, $doctorId, $day);

                if ($picked !== null) {
                    $errors['session_date'] = "Tanggal ini berada dalam pengecualian jadwal ({$picked->reason}). Hapus atau ubah pengecualian terlebih dahulu.";
                } elseif ($this->overlappingSessionExists($doctorId, $date, $start, $end, null)) {
                    $errors['start_time'] = 'Jam sesi bertabrakan dengan sesi lain milik dokter ini pada tanggal tersebut.';
                }
            }

            if ($errors !== []) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
            }

            $session = new PracticeSession;
            $session->fill([
                'doctor_id' => $doctorId,
                'clinic_id' => $clinicId,
                'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
                'session_date' => $date,
                'start_time' => $start.':00',
                'end_time' => $end.':00',
                'quota' => $quota,
                'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
                'is_manually_modified' => true,
            ]);
            $session->save();
            $session->refresh();

            $this->audit->log(
                'session.created',
                $session,
                null,
                $this->sessionValues($session),
                "Sesi tambahan {$this->describeSession($session)} dibuat.",
                $actor,
            );

            return $session;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Ubah satu sesi (BR-30/BR-35, F3-R27): kuota langsung (1–200 dan tidak di bawah `booked_count`); jam langsung
     * bila tidak ada appointment aktif, selain itu sesi menjadi `needs_review` sumber `manual_time` dan jam lama
     * tetap berlaku sampai resolusi. Selalu menyetel `is_manually_modified = true`. Sesi lampau ditolak.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes  quota, start_time, end_time (yang tidak dikirim tidak diubah)
     */
    public function updateSession(PracticeSession $session, array $attributes, Actor $actor): PracticeSession
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($session, $attributes, $actor): PracticeSession {
            $this->lockFresh($session);
            $this->assertNotEnded($session);

            $errors = [];
            $quota = (int) $session->quota;
            $start = $this->hhmm($session->start_time);
            $end = $this->hhmm($session->end_time);

            if (array_key_exists('quota', $attributes)) {
                $quota = (int) $attributes['quota'];

                if ($quota < 1 || $quota > 200) {
                    $errors['quota'] = 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.';
                } elseif ($quota < (int) $session->booked_count) {
                    $errors['quota'] = "Kuota tidak boleh kurang dari jumlah pendaftaran yang sudah ada ({$session->booked_count}).";
                }
            }

            if (array_key_exists('start_time', $attributes)) {
                $value = $this->timeOrNull($attributes['start_time']);

                if ($value === null) {
                    $errors['start_time'] = 'Format jam mulai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.';
                } else {
                    $start = $value;
                }
            }

            if (array_key_exists('end_time', $attributes)) {
                $value = $this->timeOrNull($attributes['end_time']);

                if ($value === null) {
                    $errors['end_time'] = 'Format jam selesai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.';
                } else {
                    $end = $value;
                }
            }

            if (! isset($errors['start_time']) && ! isset($errors['end_time']) && $end <= $start) {
                $errors['end_time'] = 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.';
            }

            $timesChanged = $start !== $this->hhmm($session->start_time) || $end !== $this->hhmm($session->end_time);

            if (
                $errors === []
                && $timesChanged
                && $session->status !== SessionStatus::Cancelled
                && $this->overlappingSessionExists((int) $session->doctor_id, $session->session_date->format('Y-m-d'), $start, $end, (int) $session->getKey())
            ) {
                $errors['start_time'] = 'Jam sesi bertabrakan dengan sesi lain milik dokter ini pada tanggal tersebut.';
            }

            if ($errors !== []) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
            }

            $old = [];
            $new = [];
            $values = ['is_manually_modified' => true];

            if ($quota !== (int) $session->quota) {
                $old['quota'] = (int) $session->quota;
                $new['quota'] = $quota;
                $values['quota'] = $quota;
            }

            $held = $timesChanged && $session->appointments()->active()->count() > 0;

            if ($timesChanged && ! $held) {
                $old['start_time'] = $this->hhmm($session->start_time);
                $old['end_time'] = $this->hhmm($session->end_time);
                $new['start_time'] = $start;
                $new['end_time'] = $end;
                $values['start_time'] = $start.':00';
                $values['end_time'] = $end.':00';
            }

            $oldStatus = $session->status;
            $session->forceFill($values)->save();

            if ($held) {
                $this->setPendingChange($session, [
                    'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_TIME,
                    'new_start_time' => $start,
                    'new_end_time' => $end,
                ], $actor);

                $old['status'] = $oldStatus->value;
                $new['status'] = $session->status->value;
                $new['pending_change'] = $session->pending_change;
            }

            if ($new !== []) {
                $this->audit->log('session.updated', $session, $old, $new, "Sesi {$this->describeSession($session)} diubah.", $actor);
            }

            return $session;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Buka/tutup/batalkan satu sesi (BR-35, BR-177, F3-R27). `open ↔ closed` langsung (appointment lama tetap berlaku).
     * Pembatalan wajib beralasan: langsung `cancelled` bila tidak ada appointment aktif, selain itu `needs_review`
     * sumber `manual_cancel`. Membuka kembali sesi `cancelled` ditolak bila masih tercakup pengecualian atau dokter
     * belum `active`. Sesi `needs_review` hanya diselesaikan lewat layar Sesi terdampak (fase 7). Selalu menyetel
     * `is_manually_modified = true`.
     */
    public function setSessionStatus(PracticeSession $session, SessionStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null): PracticeSession
    {
        if ($to === SessionStatus::NeedsReview) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Status needs_review hanya ditetapkan oleh sistem.');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($session, $to, $actor, $reason): PracticeSession {
            $this->lockFresh($session);
            $this->assertNotEnded($session);

            $from = $session->status;
            $reason = $this->nullableTrim($reason);

            if ($from === SessionStatus::NeedsReview) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['status' => 'Sesi ini sedang menunggu penyelesaian di layar Sesi terdampak.']);
            }

            if ($from === $to) {
                return $session;
            }

            if ($reason !== null && mb_strlen($reason) > 255) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.']);
            }

            $old = ['status' => $from->value, 'status_reason' => $session->status_reason];

            if ($to === SessionStatus::Cancelled) {
                if ($reason === null) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => 'Alasan pembatalan sesi wajib diisi.']);
                }

                if ($session->appointments()->active()->count() > 0) {
                    $session->forceFill(['is_manually_modified' => true])->save();
                    $this->setPendingChange($session, ['source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_CANCEL, 'reason' => $reason], $actor);
                } else {
                    $session->forceFill([
                        'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
                        'status_reason' => $reason,
                        'schedule_exception_id' => null,
                        'pending_change' => null,
                        'is_manually_modified' => true,
                    ])->save();
                }
            } elseif ($to === SessionStatus::Open) {
                if ($from === SessionStatus::Cancelled) {
                    $this->assertReopenAllowed($session);
                }

                $session->forceFill([
                    'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
                    'status_reason' => null,
                    'schedule_exception_id' => null,
                    'pending_change' => null,
                    'is_manually_modified' => true,
                ])->save();
            } else {
                if ($from === SessionStatus::Cancelled) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages(['status' => 'Sesi yang dibatalkan hanya dapat dibuka kembali.']);
                }

                $session->forceFill(['status' => SessionStatus::Closed, 'status_reason' => $reason, 'is_manually_modified' => true])->save();
            }

            $new = ['status' => $session->status->value, 'status_reason' => $session->status_reason];

            if ($session->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview) {
                $new['pending_change'] = $session->pending_change;
            }

            $this->audit->log(
                'session.status_changed',
                $session,
                $old,
                $new,
                "Status sesi {$this->describeSession($session)} diubah dari {$from->label()} menjadi {$session->status->label()}.",
                $actor,
            );

            return $session;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Hapus sesi tambahan manual (00 C, F3-R20, JDW-19): hanya `doctor_schedule_id` NULL tanpa appointment sama
     * sekali (`PracticeSession::deletionBlockedReason()`), dan belum berakhir. Berlaku untuk Super Admin juga.
     */
    public function deleteManualSession(PracticeSession $session, Actor $actor): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($session, $actor): void {
            $this->lockFresh($session);

            $reason = $session->deletionBlockedReason();

            if ($reason !== null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['session' => $reason]);
            }

            $this->assertNotEnded($session);

            $values = $this->sessionValues($session);
            $description = "Sesi tambahan {$this->describeSession($session)} dihapus.";

            $session->delete();

            $this->audit->log('session.deleted', $session, $values, null, $description, $actor);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Dokter dinonaktifkan atau diarsipkan (00 F.4, BR-05/BR-177). Sesi mendatang yang belum berakhir: tanpa
     * appointment aktif menjadi `cancelled` ("Dokter tidak aktif"), dengan appointment aktif menjadi `needs_review`
     * sumber `doctor_inactive` lewat setPendingChange(). Sesi yang sudah `cancelled` tidak disentuh. Audit
     * `doctor.status_changed`/`doctor.archived` ditulis DoctorService dengan ringkasan dampak dari laporan ini.
     */
    public function applyDoctorInactive(Doctor $doctor, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($doctor, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $counts = $this->counters();
            $open = [SessionStatus::Open, SessionStatus::Closed, SessionStatus::NeedsReview];

            $ids = PracticeSession::query()
                ->where('doctor_id', $doctor->getKey())
                ->whereIn('status', array_map(fn (SessionStatus $status): string => $status->value, $open))
                ->notEnded()
                ->orderBy('id')
                ->pluck('id');

            foreach ($ids as $id) {
                DB::transaction(function () use ($id, $doctor, $actor, $open, &$counts): void {
                    $session = $this->lockById((int) $id);

                    if ($session === null || $session->isEnded() || ! in_array($session->status, $open, true)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if ($session->appointments()->active()->count() === 0) {
                        $session->forceFill([
                            'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
                            'status_reason' => self::REASON_DOCTOR_INACTIVE,
                            'schedule_exception_id' => null,
                            'pending_change' => null,
                        ])->save();
                        $counts['cancelled']++;

                        return;
                    }

                    $this->setPendingChange($session, [
                        'source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_DOCTOR_INACTIVE,
                        'doctor_id' => (int) $doctor->getKey(),
                    ], $actor);
                    $counts['needsReview']++;
                });
            }

            return $this->toReport($counts);
        });
    }

    // ---- pembantu privat ----

    /**
     * Baca ulang baris sesi dengan kunci tulis dan perbarui instance pemanggil, agar instance basi tidak menimpa
     * perubahan lain. Dipanggil di dalam transaksi.
     */
    private function lockFresh(PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        $fresh = PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($session->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

        $session->setRawAttributes($fresh->getRawOriginal(), true);
    }

    /** Sesi yang sudah berakhir tidak boleh diubah, ditutup, dibatalkan, atau dihapus (F3-R27, BR-33). */
    private function assertNotEnded(PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        if ($session->isEnded()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['session' => self::MESSAGE_SESSION_PAST]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sesi `cancelled` hanya boleh dibuka bila dokter `active` dan tanggalnya tidak lagi tercakup pengecualian.
     */
    private function assertReopenAllowed(PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::query()->whereKey($session->doctor_id)->first(['id', 'status']);

        if ($doctor === null || $doctor->status !== DoctorStatus::Active) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['status' => 'Sesi tidak dapat dibuka karena dokter belum aktif kembali.']);
        }

        $covering = ScheduleException::query()->covering($session->session_date)->forDoctor((int) $session->doctor_id)->get();
        $picked = ScheduleException::pickFor($covering, (int) $session->doctor_id, $session->session_date);

        if ($picked !== null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'status' => "Tanggal ini berada dalam pengecualian jadwal ({$picked->reason}). Hapus atau ubah pengecualian terlebih dahulu.",
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Irisan jam dengan sesi non-batal dokter yang sama pada tanggal itu (BR-29, I-28): `start1 < end2 AND start2 < end1`.
     */
    private function overlappingSessionExists(int $doctorId, string $date, string $start, string $end, ?int $ignoreId): bool
    {
        return PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('doctor_id', $doctorId)
            ->where('session_date', $date)
            ->where('status', '!=', SessionStatus::Cancelled->value)
            ->where('start_time', '<', $end.':00')
            ->where('end_time', '>', $start.':00')
            ->when($ignoreId !== null, fn (Builder $query) => $query->whereKeyNot($ignoreId))
            ->exists();
    }

    /**
     * Nilai sesi yang dicatat di audit (tanpa data pasien).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function sessionValues(PracticeSession $session): array
    {
        return [
            'doctor_id' => (int) $session->doctor_id,
            'clinic_id' => (int) $session->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $session->session_date->format('Y-m-d'),
            'start_time' => $this->hhmm($session->start_time),
            'end_time' => $this->hhmm($session->end_time),
            'quota' => (int) $session->quota,
            'status' => $session->status->value,
        ];
    }

    /** "HH:MM" atau "HH:MM:SS" yang sah menjadi "HH:MM"; selain itu null. */
    private function timeOrNull(mixed $time): ?string
    {
        if (! is_string($time) || preg_match('/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d(:[0-5]\d)?$/', $time) !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        return substr($time, 0, 5);
    }

    private function nullableTrim(?string $value): ?string
    {
        $value = $value === null ? '' : trim($value);

        return $value === '' ? null : $value;
    }
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Doctors\DoctorService;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeReport;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * T8: dokter dinonaktifkan/diarsipkan memicu ScheduleChangeService::applyDoctorInactive() dalam transaksi yang sama
 * (F3-R16, JDW-16). "Sekarang" = Senin 2026-10-05 08:00.
 */
class DoctorStatusScheduleTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private DoctorService $service;

    private Actor $actor;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->service = $this->app->make(DoctorService::class);
        $this->actor = Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create());
        $this->clinic = Clinic::factory()->create();
        $this->doctor = Doctor::factory()->withSpecialties()->create(['clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function makeSession(string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 10,
            'status' => SessionStatus::Open,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function withAppointments(PracticeSession $session, int $count, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed): PracticeSession
    {
        foreach (range(1, $count) as $ignored) {
            $this->bookAppointment($session->fresh(), $status);
        }

        return $session->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * Satu sesi tanpa appointment aktif dan satu dengan dua appointment aktif.
     *
     * @return array{PracticeSession, PracticeSession}
     */
    private function emptyAndBookedSessions(): array
    {
        return [
            $this->makeSession('2026-10-12'),
            $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-13'), 2),
        ];
    }

    private function makeTemplate(): DoctorSchedule
    {
        return $this->createSchedule([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 10,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-12',
            'valid_until' => null,
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ nonaktif (JDW-16)

    public function test_deactivating_a_doctor_cancels_or_holds_future_sessions_and_audits_the_impact(): void
    {
        [$empty, $booked] = $this->emptyAndBookedSessions();

        $result = $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, 'Cuti panjang', $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Inactive, $result->status);

        $cancelled = $empty->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $cancelled->status);
        $this->assertSame('Dokter tidak aktif', $cancelled->status_reason);

        $held = $booked->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $held->status);
        $this->assertSame(['source' => 'doctor_inactive', 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id], $held->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame(2, $held->appointments()->active()->count());

        $report = $this->service->lastReport();
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ScheduleChangeReport::class, $report);
        $this->assertSame('1 sesi dibatalkan, 1 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran.', $report->message());

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'doctor.status_changed')->sole();
        $this->assertEquals(['status' => 'active'], $log->old_values);
        $this->assertEquals([
            'status' => 'inactive',
            'impact' => ['cancelled' => 1, 'needs_review' => 1],
            'reason' => 'Cuti panjang',
        ], $log->new_values);
    }

    public function test_deactivating_a_doctor_without_future_sessions_keeps_the_phase_two_audit_shape(): void
    {
        $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, null, $this->actor);

        $report = $this->service->lastReport();
        $this->assertInstanceOf(ScheduleChangeReport::class, $report);
        $this->assertSame('', $report->message());

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'doctor.status_changed')->sole();
        $this->assertEquals(['status' => 'inactive'], $log->new_values);
    }

    public function test_reactivating_a_doctor_never_reopens_cancelled_sessions(): void
    {
        [$empty, $booked] = $this->emptyAndBookedSessions();
        $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, null, $this->actor);

        $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Active, null, $this->actor);

        $this->assertNull($this->service->lastReport());
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $empty->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $booked->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, Doctor::query()->findOrFail($this->doctor->id)->status);
    }

    public function test_a_status_change_to_the_same_status_leaves_no_report(): void
    {
        $this->makeSession('2026-10-12');

        $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, null, $this->actor);
        $this->assertNotNull($this->service->lastReport());

        $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, null, $this->actor);

        $this->assertNull($this->service->lastReport());
    }

    public function test_deactivation_is_rolled_back_with_the_sessions_when_the_audit_row_cannot_be_written(): void
    {
        [$empty, $booked] = $this->emptyAndBookedSessions();

        AuditLog::creating(fn () => throw new RuntimeException('audit gagal'));

        $thrown = false;

        try {
            $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, null, $this->actor);
        } catch (RuntimeException) {
            $thrown = true;
        }

        $this->assertTrue($thrown);
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, Doctor::query()->findOrFail($this->doctor->id)->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $empty->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $booked->fresh()->status);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ arsip (JDW-16)

    public function test_archiving_is_refused_while_future_active_appointments_exist(): void
    {
        [$empty, $booked] = $this->emptyAndBookedSessions();

        try {
            $this->service->archive($this->doctor, null, $this->actor);
            $this->fail('ValidationException tidak dilempar.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(
                ['Dokter masih memiliki 2 pendaftaran aktif pada sesi mendatang. Selesaikan sesi terdampak terlebih dahulu, lalu arsipkan dokter.'],
                $e->errors()['status'],
            );
        }

        $fresh = Doctor::query()->findOrFail($this->doctor->id);
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->archived_at);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $empty->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $booked->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'doctor.archived')->count());
        $this->assertNull($this->service->lastReport());
    }

    public function test_archiving_cancels_future_sessions_deactivates_templates_and_audits_the_impact(): void
    {
        $template = $this->makeTemplate();
        $empty = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', ['doctor_schedule_id' => $template->id]);
        $history = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-13'), 1, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $endedWithActive = $this->withAppointments($this->makeSession('2026-10-05', ['start_time' => '06:00:00', 'end_time' => '07:00:00']), 1);

        $this->assertNull($this->service->archiveBlockedReason($this->doctor));

        $archived = $this->service->archive($this->doctor, 'Pensiun', $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Archived, $archived->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $empty->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame('Dokter tidak aktif', $empty->fresh()->status_reason);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $history->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $endedWithActive->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertFalse($template->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertSame('2 sesi dibatalkan.', $this->service->lastReport()->message());

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'doctor.archived')->sole();
        $this->assertSame('archived', $log->new_values['status']);
        $this->assertSame('Pensiun', $log->new_values['reason']);
        $this->assertEquals(['cancelled' => 2, 'needs_review' => 0, 'schedules_deactivated' => 1], $log->new_values['impact']);
    }

    public function test_archiving_without_any_schedule_data_keeps_the_phase_two_audit_shape(): void
    {
        $this->service->archive($this->doctor, null, $this->actor);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'doctor.archived')->sole();
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('impact', $log->new_values);
    }

    public function test_archiving_an_inactive_doctor_does_not_touch_sessions_again(): void
    {
        $empty = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12');
        $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, null, $this->actor);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $empty->fresh()->status);

        $this->service->archive($this->doctor, null, $this->actor);

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'doctor.archived')->sole();
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('impact', $log->new_values);
    }

    public function test_restoring_an_archived_doctor_does_not_reactivate_templates_or_reopen_sessions(): void
    {
        $template = $this->makeTemplate();
        $empty = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', ['doctor_schedule_id' => $template->id]);
        $this->service->archive($this->doctor, null, $this->actor);

        $restored = $this->service->changeStatus($this->doctor, DoctorStatus::Inactive, null, $this->actor);

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Inactive, $restored->status);
        $this->assertNull($this->service->lastReport());
        $this->assertFalse($template->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $empty->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_archive_is_rolled_back_with_templates_and_sessions_when_the_audit_row_cannot_be_written(): void
    {
        $template = $this->makeTemplate();
        $empty = $this->makeSession('2026-10-12', ['doctor_schedule_id' => $template->id]);

        AuditLog::creating(fn () => throw new RuntimeException('audit gagal'));

        $thrown = false;

        try {
            $this->service->archive($this->doctor, null, $this->actor);
        } catch (RuntimeException) {
            $thrown = true;
        }

        $this->assertTrue($thrown);
        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, Doctor::query()->findOrFail($this->doctor->id)->status);
        $this->assertTrue($template->fresh()->is_active);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $empty->fresh()->status);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ flash HTTP

    public function test_status_flash_appends_the_schedule_report(): void
    {
        $this->emptyAndBookedSessions();
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'));

        $this->from(route('admin.doctors.show', $this->doctor))
            ->patch(route('admin.doctors.status', $this->doctor), ['status' => 'inactive', 'reason' => 'Cuti panjang'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.doctors.show', $this->doctor))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Dokter dinonaktifkan. 1 sesi dibatalkan, 1 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran.');

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Inactive, $this->doctor->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_status_flash_stays_unchanged_without_schedule_impact(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'));

        $this->from(route('admin.doctors.show', $this->doctor))
            ->patch(route('admin.doctors.status', $this->doctor), ['status' => 'inactive'])
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Dokter dinonaktifkan.');

        $this->patch(route('admin.doctors.status', $this->doctor), ['status' => 'active'])
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Dokter diaktifkan.');
    }

    public function test_archive_flash_appends_the_schedule_report_and_refusal_keeps_its_message(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'));
        [$empty, $booked] = $this->emptyAndBookedSessions();
        $message = 'Dokter masih memiliki 2 pendaftaran aktif pada sesi mendatang. Selesaikan sesi terdampak terlebih dahulu, lalu arsipkan dokter.';

        $this->from(route('admin.doctors.show', $this->doctor))
            ->patch(route('admin.doctors.archive', $this->doctor), ['reason' => 'Pindah tugas'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.doctors.show', $this->doctor))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['status' => $message])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', $message);

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Active, $this->doctor->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $booked->fresh()->status);

        $this->completeActiveAppointments($booked);

        $this->from(route('admin.doctors.show', $this->doctor))
            ->patch(route('admin.doctors.archive', $this->doctor), ['reason' => 'Pindah tugas'])
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Dokter diarsipkan. 2 sesi dibatalkan.');

        $this->assertSame(DoctorStatus::Archived, $this->doctor->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $empty->fresh()->status);
    }

    /**
     * Menyelesaikan appointment aktif sebuah sesi (pasien sudah dilayani) agar dokter boleh diarsipkan.
     */
    private function completeActiveAppointments(PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        $session->appointments()->active()->get()->each(
            fn ($appointment) => $appointment->forceFill(['status' => AppointmentStatus::Completed])->save(),
        );
    }
}
```

```php
    private function withScheduleReport(string $message, DoctorService $service): string
```

| Status sesi | `reason` (wajib bila `cancelled`, min 5) | "Alasan pembatalan sesi wajib diisi." / "Alasan minimal 5 karakter." / "Alasan maksimal 255 karakter." |
| Pengecualian | `type` | "Jenis pengecualian wajib dipilih." / "Jenis pengecualian tidak valid." |
| Pengecualian | `doctor_id` | "Pilih dokter untuk cuti dokter." / "Libur rumah sakit atau libur nasional berlaku untuk semua dokter. Kosongkan pilihan dokter." / "Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia." |
| Pengecualian | `start_date` | "Tanggal mulai wajib diisi." / "Format tanggal tidak valid." / "Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu." |
| Pengecualian | `end_date` | "Tanggal selesai wajib diisi." / "Tanggal selesai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai." / "Rentang pengecualian maksimal 365 hari." |
| Pengecualian | `reason` | "Alasan wajib diisi." / "Alasan minimal 3 karakter." / "Alasan maksimal 255 karakter." |

**Test IDs:** VAL-05 (semua kasus form jadwal), JDW-06 (templat beririsan ditolak dan rentang lain diterima), JDW-07 (sisi Form Request), JDW-08(d) (sisi Form Request), JDW-18 (kombinasi jenis vs dokter, sisi Form Request), VAL-07 (parameter filter admin #35 yang tidak valid diabaikan), Review Focus 2 dan 5, AKS (Policy per peran).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. `Gate::before` meloloskan Super Admin dari semua Policy (`AppServiceProvider`), sehingga Policy hanya memetakan izin. Aturan yang juga mengikat Super Admin ada di Form Request (dokter arsip tidak diberi templat, bentrok, kuota di bawah `booked_count`, sesi lampau, pengecualian dan benturan jam sesi manual) dan di service (T6–T8).
2. `FormRequest::getValidatorInstance()` memanggil method `after()` lewat container (`vendor/laravel/framework/.../FormRequest.php` baris 98), jadi `after()` dapat dipakai langsung. Method `withValidator()` yang dipakai Form Request fase 2 tetap berlaku.
3. `after_or_equal:today` dan `after:start_time` diselesaikan `ValidatesAttributes::getDateTime()` lewat `Date::parse`, sehingga mengikuti `travelTo()` pada tes. `date_format:H:i` mewajibkan dua digit jam (`09:00`); input `type="time"` browser mengirim format itu.
4. Form Request yang dibuat langsung di tes (tanpa middleware `ConvertEmptyStringsToNull`) menerima `''` apa adanya. `attributesForModel()` menormalkan `valid_until` dan `notes` kosong menjadi `null`, dan `doctor_id` pengecualian kosong menjadi `null`, agar hasilnya sama dengan permintaan HTTP.
5. **Dokter pada templat yang sudah ada tidak dapat diganti** (aturan tambahan, keputusan penulis C): propagasi templat (00 F.4, 11 §6.6) hanya mengenal perubahan poliklinik, hari, jam, kuota, status, dan rentang, bukan perpindahan dokter. Mengganti dokter akan membiarkan sesi lama milik dokter lama. Pesannya "Dokter pada templat tidak dapat diganti. Buat templat baru, lalu nonaktifkan templat lama."; `attributesForModel()` tidak mengembalikan `doctor_id` saat ubah.
6. `NoOverlappingSchedule` memakai bentuk 12 V-23 untuk pesannya (hari, jam, rentang templat yang bentrok), bukan contoh "Bentrok dengan templat Senin …" di kerangka (kerangka menandainya "mis."). `NoOverlappingSession` (12 §3.1) tidak dibuat sebagai kelas karena kerangka tidak memuatnya di daftar nama baru; benturan jam sesi dan pengecualian pada tanggal sesi diperiksa di `PracticeSessionRequest::after()` dengan pesan 12 V-24.
7. `UpdateSessionStatusRequest` memakai kolom `reason` (kerangka T9 dan `x-confirm-modal` yang menamai textarea `reason`), bukan `status_reason` seperti di tabel 12 V-24; batas minimal 5 karakter mengikuti kerangka.
8. Mode ketat: semua `applyTo()` hanya membangun kueri; tidak ada relasi yang dibaca. Urutan nama dokter memakai subkueri `orderBy` (tanpa join) sehingga paginator tetap benar.
9. Tes Form Request memakai `InteractsWithFormRequests` (baru, T9): membuat Form Request dengan pengguna dan parameter route hasil binding (`Illuminate\Routing\Route` yang di-`bind` lalu `setParameter`) mengikuti pola `ListFilterRequestTest`, tanpa bergantung pada route T10–T12 yang belum ada.
10. Tes memakai `travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 …'))` (Senin) dan tidak bergantung pada tanggal nyata. Tes yang membuat sesi lewat `createSession` mengisi `booked_count` dan `last_queue_number` bersama-sama agar `chk_sessions_queue` terpenuhi.

`tests/Support/InteractsWithFormRequests.php`

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Support;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Routing\Route;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

/**
 * Pembantu tes untuk memvalidasi Form Request tanpa melewati route (pola ListFilterRequestTest).
 * Dipakai bersama InteractsWithStaff: pengguna bawaan adalah Admin Konten yang diizinkan `schedules.manage`.
 */
trait InteractsWithFormRequests
{
    private ?User $formRequestUser = null;

    /**
     * Membangun Form Request lengkap dengan pengguna dan parameter route (model hasil binding).
     *
     * @param  class-string<FormRequest>  $class
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $routeParameters
     */
    protected function makeFormRequest(string $class, array $data, ?User $user = null, array $routeParameters = [], string $method = 'POST'): FormRequest
    {
        $user ??= $this->formRequestUser ??= $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $request = $class::create('/_uji/form-request', $method, $data);
        $request->setContainer($this->app);
        $request->setRedirector($this->app->make('redirect'));
        $request->setUserResolver(fn () => $user);

        $uri = '/_uji/form-request';

        foreach (array_keys($routeParameters) as $name) {
            $uri .= '/{'.$name.'}';
        }

        $route = new Route($method, $uri, fn () => null);
        $route->bind($request);

        foreach ($routeParameters as $name => $value) {
            $route->setParameter($name, $value);
        }

        $request->setRouteResolver(fn () => $route);

        return $request;
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan validasi dan mengembalikan galat per field (kosong bila lolos). Penolakan otorisasi
     * dilempar sebagai AuthorizationException.
     *
     * @param  class-string<FormRequest>  $class
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $routeParameters
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    protected function validationErrors(string $class, array $data, ?User $user = null, array $routeParameters = [], string $method = 'POST'): array
    {
        try {
            $this->makeFormRequest($class, $data, $user, $routeParameters, $method)->validateResolved();
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            return $exception->errors();
        }

        return [];
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Access/SchedulePolicyTest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Access;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 04 §5 / 11 §8: Policy DoctorSchedule, ScheduleException, dan PracticeSession per peran.
 * Super Admin lolos lewat Gate::before; aturan mutlak (sesi lampau, kuota, hapus bersyarat) ada di service dan
 * Form Request, bukan di Policy (diuji di tes service dan tes Form Request).
 */
class SchedulePolicyTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string, bool, bool, bool}>
     */
    public static function roles(): array
    {
        // [peran, boleh lihat (schedules.view), boleh kelola (schedules.manage), boleh tindak lanjut (sessions.review)]
        return [
            'super admin' => ['super-admin', true, true, true],
            'admin konten' => ['content-admin', true, true, false],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer', true, false, true],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('roles')]
    public function test_doctor_schedule_policy_follows_view_and_manage_permissions(string $role, bool $view, bool $manage): void
    {
        $user = $this->createStaff($role);
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();

        $this->assertSame($view, $user->can('viewAny', $schedule::class));
        $this->assertSame($view, $user->can('view', $schedule));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('create', $schedule::class));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('update', $schedule));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('delete', $schedule));
    }

    #[DataProvider('roles')]
    public function test_schedule_exception_policy_follows_view_and_manage_permissions(string $role, bool $view, bool $manage): void
    {
        $user = $this->createStaff($role);
        $exception = $this->createException();

        $this->assertSame($view, $user->can('viewAny', $exception::class));
        $this->assertSame($view, $user->can('view', $exception));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('create', $exception::class));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('update', $exception));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('delete', $exception));
    }

    #[DataProvider('roles')]
    public function test_practice_session_policy_separates_manage_from_review(string $role, bool $view, bool $manage, bool $review): void
    {
        $user = $this->createStaff($role);
        $session = $this->createSession();

        $this->assertSame($view, $user->can('viewAny', $session::class));
        $this->assertSame($view, $user->can('view', $session));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('create', $session::class));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('update', $session));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('changeStatus', $session));
        $this->assertSame($manage, $user->can('delete', $session));
        $this->assertSame($review, $user->can('review', $session::class));
        $this->assertSame($review, $user->can('resolve', $session));
    }

    public function test_patient_account_has_no_schedule_ability(): void
    {
        $this->seedRoles();
        $patient = User::factory()->patient()->create();
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule();
        $exception = $this->createException();
        $session = $this->createSession();

        foreach (['viewAny' => $schedule::class, 'create' => $schedule::class] as $ability => $target) {
            $this->assertFalse($patient->can($ability, $target), "Pasien tidak boleh {$ability} templat.");
        }

        $this->assertFalse($patient->can('update', $schedule));
        $this->assertFalse($patient->can('delete', $exception));
        $this->assertFalse($patient->can('view', $session));
        $this->assertFalse($patient->can('review', $session::class));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use Tests\Support\InteractsWithFormRequests;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 12 V-23 dan BR-07..BR-11: VAL-05 (form jadwal), JDW-06 (templat beririsan), Review Focus 2 (bertetangga,
 * beririsan, rentang berbeda, nonaktif, ubah tidak bentrok dengan dirinya sendiri), JDW-08(d) sisi Form Request.
 */
class DoctorScheduleRequestTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithFormRequests;
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Senin, 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 08.00 WIB.
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan'], $this->clinic);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => (string) $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => (string) $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => '1',
            'start_time' => '08:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00',
            'quota' => '20',
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-05',
            'valid_until' => '',
            'is_active' => '1',
            'notes' => '',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function errorsFor(array $overrides = [], ?DoctorSchedule $schedule = null): array
    {
        return $this->validationErrors(
            DoctorScheduleRequest::class,
            $this->payload($overrides),
            null,
            $schedule === null ? [] : ['schedule' => $schedule],
        );
    }

    /**
     * Templat Senin 08.00-12.00 milik dokter uji, berlaku mulai 5 Okt 2026 tanpa batas akhir.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function existing(array $overrides = []): DoctorSchedule
    {
        return $this->createSchedule(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-05',
            'valid_until' => null,
            'is_active' => true,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    public function test_a_valid_payload_passes_and_yields_model_attributes(): void
    {
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(DoctorScheduleRequest::class, $this->payload(['notes' => 'Ruang 2']));
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertSame([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '08:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-05',
            'valid_until' => null,
            'is_active' => true,
            'notes' => 'Ruang 2',
        ], $request->attributesForModel());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'dokter kosong' => [['doctor_id' => ''], 'doctor_id', 'Dokter wajib dipilih.'],
            'dokter tidak ada' => [['doctor_id' => '999999'], 'doctor_id', 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.'],
            'dokter bukan angka' => [['doctor_id' => 'abc'], 'doctor_id', 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.'],
            'poliklinik kosong' => [['clinic_id' => ''], 'clinic_id', 'Poliklinik wajib dipilih.'],
            'poliklinik tidak ada' => [['clinic_id' => '999999'], 'clinic_id', 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.'],
            'hari kosong' => [['day_of_week' => ''], 'day_of_week', 'Hari wajib dipilih.'],
            'hari 8' => [['day_of_week' => '8'], 'day_of_week', 'Hari tidak valid.'],
            'hari 0' => [['day_of_week' => '0'], 'day_of_week', 'Hari tidak valid.'],
            'hari bukan angka' => [['day_of_week' => 'senin'], 'day_of_week', 'Hari tidak valid.'],
            'jam mulai kosong' => [['start_time' => ''], 'start_time', 'Jam mulai wajib diisi.'],
            'jam mulai format salah' => [['start_time' => '8.00'], 'start_time', 'Format jam mulai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.'],

            'jam selesai format salah' => [['end_time' => '25:00'], 'end_time', 'Format jam selesai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.'],
            'jam selesai sama dengan mulai' => [['start_time' => '08:00', 'end_time' => '08:00'], 'end_time', 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.'],
            'jam selesai sebelum mulai' => [['start_time' => '12:00', 'end_time' => '08:00'], 'end_time', 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.'],
            'kuota kosong' => [['quota' => ''], 'quota', 'Kuota wajib diisi.'],

            'kuota 201' => [['quota' => '201'], 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.'],
            'kuota bukan angka bulat' => [['quota' => '12.5'], 'quota', 'Kuota harus berupa angka bulat.'],
            'kuota huruf' => [['quota' => 'dua puluh'], 'quota', 'Kuota harus berupa angka bulat.'],
            'berlaku mulai kosong' => [['valid_from' => ''], 'valid_from', 'Tanggal mulai berlaku wajib diisi.'],
            'berlaku mulai format salah' => [['valid_from' => '05/10/2026'], 'valid_from', 'Format tanggal tidak valid.'],
            'berlaku mulai di masa lalu' => [['valid_from' => '2026-10-04'], 'valid_from', 'Tanggal mulai berlaku tidak boleh di masa lalu.'],
            'berlaku sampai format salah' => [['valid_until' => '31-12-2026'], 'valid_until', 'Format tanggal tidak valid.'],

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_val_05_invalid_input_gets_the_indonesian_message(array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $this->assertContains($message, $this->errorsFor($override)[$field] ?? []);
    }

    public function test_valid_until_may_equal_valid_from_and_may_be_empty(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['valid_from' => '2026-10-12', 'valid_until' => '2026-10-12']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['valid_until' => '']));
    }

    public function test_quota_boundaries_one_and_two_hundred_are_accepted(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['quota' => '1']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['quota' => '200']));
    }

    public function test_clinic_must_be_active_and_bookable(): void
    {
        $inactive = $this->createClinic(['is_active' => false]);
        $support = $this->createClinic(['is_bookable' => false]);
        $message = 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.';

        $this->assertContains($message, $this->errorsFor(['clinic_id' => (string) $inactive->id])['clinic_id'] ?? []);
        $this->assertContains($message, $this->errorsFor(['clinic_id' => (string) $support->id])['clinic_id'] ?? []);
    }

    public function test_archived_doctor_cannot_be_given_a_schedule_but_inactive_doctor_can(): void
    {
        $archived = $this->createDoctor(['status' => 'archived', 'archived_at' => now()->subDay()], $this->clinic);
        $inactive = $this->createDoctor(['status' => 'inactive'], $this->clinic);

        $this->assertContains(
            'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            $this->errorsFor(['doctor_id' => (string) $archived->id])['doctor_id'] ?? [],
        );
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['doctor_id' => (string) $inactive->id]));
    }

    // --- JDW-06 dan Review Focus 2: irisan templat ---------------------------------------------

    public function test_jdw_06_overlapping_template_is_rejected_and_names_the_conflicting_template(): void
    {
        $this->existing();

        $errors = $this->errorsFor(['start_time' => '11:00', 'end_time' => '13:00']);

        $this->assertCount(1, $errors['start_time'] ?? []);
        $this->assertSame(
            'Jadwal bertabrakan dengan jadwal aktif lain milik dokter ini pada hari yang sama (Senin 08.00–12.00, berlaku 5 Okt 2026 – tanpa batas).',
            $errors['start_time'][0],
        );
    }

    public function test_adjacent_templates_are_accepted(): void
    {
        $this->existing();

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['start_time' => '12:00', 'end_time' => '15:00']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['start_time' => '05:00', 'end_time' => '08:00']));
    }

    public function test_jdw_06_non_overlapping_validity_range_is_accepted(): void
    {
        $this->existing(['valid_until' => '2026-10-31']);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['valid_from' => '2026-11-02', 'start_time' => '11:00', 'end_time' => '13:00']));
        $this->assertNotSame([], $this->errorsFor(['valid_from' => '2026-10-26', 'start_time' => '11:00', 'end_time' => '13:00']));
    }

    public function test_a_template_that_contains_or_is_contained_by_another_overlaps(): void
    {
        $this->existing();

        $this->assertArrayHasKey('start_time', $this->errorsFor(['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '10:00']));
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('start_time', $this->errorsFor(['start_time' => '07:00', 'end_time' => '14:00']));
    }

    public function test_other_day_and_other_doctor_do_not_overlap(): void
    {
        $this->existing();
        $other = $this->createDoctor([], $this->clinic);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['day_of_week' => '2', 'start_time' => '08:00', 'end_time' => '12:00']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['doctor_id' => (string) $other->id, 'start_time' => '08:00', 'end_time' => '12:00']));
    }

    public function test_overlap_is_checked_per_doctor_not_per_clinic_br_11(): void
    {
        $this->existing();
        $otherClinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Bedah']);

        $this->assertArrayHasKey('start_time', $this->errorsFor([
            'clinic_id' => (string) $otherClinic->id,
            'start_time' => '10:00',
            'end_time' => '13:00',
        ]));
    }

    public function test_inactive_existing_template_is_not_a_conflict(): void
    {
        $this->existing(['is_active' => false]);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '11:00']));
    }

    public function test_a_new_inactive_template_is_not_checked_for_overlap(): void
    {
        $this->existing();

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['is_active' => '0', 'start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '11:00']));
    }

    public function test_updating_a_template_does_not_conflict_with_itself(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->existing();

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['quota' => '30'], $schedule));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '11:00'], $schedule));
    }

    public function test_updating_into_another_template_conflicts(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->existing();
        $this->existing(['day_of_week' => 1, 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);

        $this->assertArrayHasKey('start_time', $this->errorsFor(['start_time' => '12:00', 'end_time' => '14:00'], $schedule));
    }

    public function test_valid_from_in_the_past_is_only_rejected_when_creating(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->existing(['valid_from' => '2026-09-01']);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['valid_from' => '2026-09-01'], $schedule));
        $this->assertContains(
            'Tanggal mulai berlaku tidak boleh di masa lalu.',
            $this->errorsFor(['valid_from' => '2026-09-01'])['valid_from'] ?? [],
        );
    }

    // --- Ubah: dokter tetap, ganti poliklinik --------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_doctor_of_an_existing_template_cannot_be_changed(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->existing();
        $other = $this->createDoctor([], $this->clinic);

        $errors = $this->errorsFor(['doctor_id' => (string) $other->id], $schedule);

        $this->assertContains(
            'Dokter pada templat tidak dapat diganti. Buat templat baru, lalu nonaktifkan templat lama.',
            $errors['doctor_id'] ?? [],
        );
    }

    public function test_jdw_08d_clinic_change_is_rejected_when_a_future_session_has_an_active_appointment(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->existing();
        $session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ]);
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $otherClinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Bedah']);

        $errors = $this->errorsFor(['clinic_id' => (string) $otherClinic->id], $schedule);

        $this->assertContains(
            'Poliklinik tidak dapat diganti karena masih ada sesi mendatang dengan pendaftaran aktif. Buat jadwal baru, lalu nonaktifkan jadwal lama.',
            $errors['clinic_id'] ?? [],
        );
    }

    public function test_clinic_change_is_allowed_when_only_cancelled_appointments_exist(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->existing();
        $session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-12',
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
        ]);
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $otherClinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Bedah']);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['clinic_id' => (string) $otherClinic->id], $schedule));
    }

    // --- Otorisasi ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_registration_officer_is_not_authorized_for_create_or_update(): void
    {
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);

        $this->validationErrors(DoctorScheduleRequest::class, $this->payload(), $officer);
    }

    public function test_update_request_is_authorized_through_the_policy(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->existing();
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');

        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(DoctorScheduleRequest::class, $this->payload(), $officer, ['schedule' => $schedule], 'PUT')->authorize());
        $this->assertTrue($this->makeFormRequest(DoctorScheduleRequest::class, $this->payload(), null, ['schedule' => $schedule], 'PUT')->authorize());
    }

    public function test_update_attributes_never_include_the_doctor(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->existing();
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(DoctorScheduleRequest::class, $this->payload(['quota' => '25']), null, ['schedule' => $schedule], 'PUT');
        $request->validateResolved();

        $attributes = $request->attributesForModel();

        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('doctor_id', $attributes);
        $this->assertSame(25, $attributes['quota']);
    }
}
```
