`tests/Feature/Admin/ScheduleExceptionRequestTest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\ScheduleExceptionRequest;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithFormRequests;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 12 V-25 dan BR-23..BR-26: JDW-18 (kombinasi jenis vs dokter, sisi Form Request) dan F3-R21
 * (ubah: `start_date` yang tidak berubah boleh tetap di masa lalu).
 */
class ScheduleExceptionRequestTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithFormRequests;
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Senin, 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 08.00 WIB.
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));

        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan']);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'type' => 'doctor_leave',
            'doctor_id' => (string) $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-09',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function errorsFor(array $overrides = [], ?ScheduleException $exception = null): array
    {
        return $this->validationErrors(
            ScheduleExceptionRequest::class,
            $this->payload($overrides),
            null,
            $exception === null ? [] : ['exception' => $exception],
        );
    }

    public function test_a_valid_payload_passes_and_yields_model_attributes(): void
    {
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(ScheduleExceptionRequest::class, $this->payload());
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertSame([
            'type' => 'doctor_leave',
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-09',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ], $request->attributesForModel());
    }

    // --- JDW-18: kombinasi jenis vs dokter (BR-25) ----------------------------------------------

    public function test_jdw_18_doctor_leave_without_a_doctor_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $this->assertContains(
            'Pilih dokter untuk cuti dokter.',
            $this->errorsFor(['type' => 'doctor_leave', 'doctor_id' => ''])['doctor_id'] ?? [],
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string}>
     */
    public static function holidayTypes(): array
    {
        return ['libur rumah sakit' => ['hospital_holiday'], 'libur nasional' => ['national_holiday']];
    }

    #[DataProvider('holidayTypes')]
    public function test_jdw_18_holidays_with_a_doctor_are_rejected_and_without_a_doctor_accepted(string $type): void
    {
        $this->assertContains(
            'Libur rumah sakit atau libur nasional berlaku untuk semua dokter. Kosongkan pilihan dokter.',
            $this->errorsFor(['type' => $type])['doctor_id'] ?? [],
        );

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['type' => $type, 'doctor_id' => '']));
    }

    public function test_jdw_18_other_type_is_accepted_with_and_without_a_doctor(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['type' => 'other']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['type' => 'other', 'doctor_id' => '']));
    }

    public function test_jdw_18_doctor_leave_with_a_doctor_is_accepted(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['type' => 'doctor_leave']));
    }

    public function test_global_exception_attributes_carry_a_null_doctor(): void
    {
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(ScheduleExceptionRequest::class, $this->payload(['type' => 'hospital_holiday', 'doctor_id' => '']));
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertNull($request->attributesForModel()['doctor_id']);
    }

    // --- Field lain ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'jenis kosong' => [['type' => ''], 'type', 'Jenis pengecualian wajib dipilih.'],
            'jenis tidak valid' => [['type' => 'libur-bebas'], 'type', 'Jenis pengecualian tidak valid.'],
            'dokter tidak ada' => [['doctor_id' => '999999'], 'doctor_id', 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.'],
            'mulai kosong' => [['start_date' => ''], 'start_date', 'Tanggal mulai wajib diisi.'],
            'mulai format salah' => [['start_date' => '07/10/2026'], 'start_date', 'Format tanggal tidak valid.'],
            'mulai di masa lalu' => [['start_date' => '2026-10-04', 'end_date' => '2026-10-06'], 'start_date', 'Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu.'],
            'selesai kosong' => [['end_date' => ''], 'end_date', 'Tanggal selesai wajib diisi.'],
            'selesai format salah' => [['end_date' => 'besok'], 'end_date', 'Format tanggal tidak valid.'],
            'selesai sebelum mulai' => [['start_date' => '2026-10-09', 'end_date' => '2026-10-08'], 'end_date', 'Tanggal selesai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai.'],
            'rentang 366 hari' => [['start_date' => '2026-10-05', 'end_date' => '2027-10-06'], 'end_date', 'Rentang pengecualian maksimal 365 hari.'],
            'alasan kosong' => [['reason' => ''], 'reason', 'Alasan wajib diisi.'],
            'alasan terlalu pendek' => [['reason' => 'ab'], 'reason', 'Alasan minimal 3 karakter.'],
            'alasan terlalu panjang' => [['reason' => str_repeat('a', 256)], 'reason', 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidInputs')]
    public function test_invalid_input_gets_the_indonesian_message(array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $this->assertContains($message, $this->errorsFor($override)[$field] ?? []);
    }

    public function test_start_today_and_a_range_of_exactly_365_days_are_accepted(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['start_date' => '2026-10-05', 'end_date' => '2026-10-05']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['start_date' => '2026-10-05', 'end_date' => '2027-10-05']));
    }

    public function test_archived_doctor_is_not_selectable_for_leave(): void
    {
        $archived = $this->createDoctor(['status' => 'archived', 'archived_at' => now()->subDay()]);

        $this->assertContains(
            'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            $this->errorsFor(['doctor_id' => (string) $archived->id])['doctor_id'] ?? [],
        );
    }

    // --- F3-R21: ubah dengan start_date di masa lalu ---------------------------------------------

    public function test_f3_r21_update_may_keep_an_unchanged_start_date_in_the_past(): void
    {
        $exception = $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-01',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-10',
            'reason' => 'Cuti panjang',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->errorsFor(['start_date' => '2026-10-01', 'end_date' => '2026-10-08'], $exception));
    }

    public function test_f3_r21_update_that_changes_start_date_to_the_past_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $exception = $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-10',
        ]);

        $errors = $this->errorsFor(['start_date' => '2026-10-02', 'end_date' => '2026-10-10'], $exception);

        $this->assertContains('Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu.', $errors['start_date'] ?? []);
    }

    public function test_creating_with_a_past_start_date_that_equals_another_rows_start_is_still_rejected(): void
    {
        $this->createException(['start_date' => '2026-10-01', 'end_date' => '2026-10-10']);

        $this->assertContains(
            'Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu.',
            $this->errorsFor(['start_date' => '2026-10-01', 'end_date' => '2026-10-10'])['start_date'] ?? [],
        );
    }

    // --- Otorisasi -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_registration_officer_is_not_authorized(): void
    {
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);

        $this->validationErrors(ScheduleExceptionRequest::class, $this->payload(), $officer);
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Admin/PracticeSessionRequestTest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\PracticeSessionRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\UpdateSessionStatusRequest;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithFormRequests;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 12 V-24 dan BR-29..BR-35: sesi tambahan manual, ubah sesi (JDW-07 sisi Form Request), dan status sesi.
 * Aturan yang juga mengikat Super Admin: sesi lampau tidak diubah (F3-R27), kuota tidak di bawah booked_count.
 */
class PracticeSessionRequestTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithFormRequests;
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Senin, 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 10.00 WIB.
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 10:00:00'));

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan'], $this->clinic);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function createPayload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => (string) $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => (string) $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-08',
            'start_time' => '13:00',
            'end_time' => '15:00',
            'quota' => '10',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function createErrors(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return $this->validationErrors(PracticeSessionRequest::class, $this->createPayload($overrides));
    }

    /**
     * Sesi dr. Raka pada 8 Okt 2026 pukul 08.00-12.00 (mendatang), kuota 10, sudah terisi 5.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function upcomingSession(array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-08',
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 10,
            'booked_count' => 5,
            'last_queue_number' => 5,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function updateErrors(PracticeSession $session, array $data): array
    {
        return $this->validationErrors(
            PracticeSessionRequest::class,
            array_merge(['start_time' => '08:00', 'end_time' => '12:00', 'quota' => '10'], $data),
            null,
            ['session' => $session],
            'PUT',
        );
    }

    // --- Tambah sesi manual ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_valid_manual_session_passes_and_yields_six_attributes(): void
    {
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(PracticeSessionRequest::class, $this->createPayload());
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertSame([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-08',
            'start_time' => '13:00',
            'end_time' => '15:00',
            'quota' => 10,
        ], $request->sessionAttributes());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidCreateInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'dokter kosong' => [['doctor_id' => ''], 'doctor_id', 'Dokter wajib dipilih.'],
            'dokter tidak ada' => [['doctor_id' => '999999'], 'doctor_id', 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.'],
            'poliklinik kosong' => [['clinic_id' => ''], 'clinic_id', 'Poliklinik wajib dipilih.'],
            'poliklinik tidak ada' => [['clinic_id' => '999999'], 'clinic_id', 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.'],
            'tanggal kosong' => [['session_date' => ''], 'session_date', 'Tanggal sesi wajib diisi.'],
            'tanggal di masa lalu' => [['session_date' => '2026-10-04'], 'session_date', 'Tanggal sesi tidak boleh di masa lalu.'],
            'tanggal lebih dari 365 hari' => [['session_date' => '2027-10-06'], 'session_date', 'Tanggal sesi maksimal 365 hari ke depan.'],
            'jam mulai kosong' => [['start_time' => ''], 'start_time', 'Jam mulai wajib diisi.'],
            'jam mulai format salah' => [['start_time' => '1pm'], 'start_time', 'Format jam mulai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.'],
            'jam selesai kosong' => [['end_time' => ''], 'end_time', 'Jam selesai wajib diisi.'],
            'jam selesai tidak setelah mulai' => [['start_time' => '15:00', 'end_time' => '15:00'], 'end_time', 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.'],
            'kuota kosong' => [['quota' => ''], 'quota', 'Kuota wajib diisi.'],
            'kuota nol' => [['quota' => '0'], 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.'],
            'kuota 201' => [['quota' => '201'], 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidCreateInputs')]
    public function test_invalid_create_input_gets_the_indonesian_message(array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $this->assertContains($message, $this->createErrors($override)[$field] ?? []);
    }

    public function test_date_boundaries_today_and_exactly_365_days_ahead_are_accepted(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->createErrors(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '14:00', 'end_time' => '16:00']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->createErrors(['session_date' => '2027-10-05']));
    }

    public function test_manual_session_requires_an_active_doctor(): void
    {
        $inactive = $this->createDoctor(['status' => 'inactive'], $this->clinic);
        $archived = $this->createDoctor(['status' => 'archived', 'archived_at' => now()->subDay()], $this->clinic);

        foreach ([$inactive, $archived] as $doctor) {
            $this->assertContains(
                'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
                $this->createErrors(['doctor_id' => (string) $doctor->id])['doctor_id'] ?? [],
            );
        }
    }

    public function test_manual_session_clinic_must_be_active_and_bookable(): void
    {
        $inactive = $this->createClinic(['is_active' => false]);
        $support = $this->createClinic(['is_bookable' => false]);

        foreach ([$inactive, $support] as $clinic) {
            $this->assertContains(
                'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.',
                $this->createErrors(['clinic_id' => (string) $clinic->id])['clinic_id'] ?? [],
            );
        }
    }

    public function test_date_inside_a_doctor_leave_is_rejected_with_the_reason(): void
    {
        $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-09',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ]);

        $this->assertContains(
            'Tanggal ini berada dalam pengecualian jadwal (Cuti tahunan). Hapus atau ubah pengecualian terlebih dahulu.',
            $this->createErrors(['session_date' => '2026-10-08'])['session_date'] ?? [],
        );
        $this->assertSame([], $this->createErrors(['session_date' => '2026-10-10']));
    }

    public function test_date_inside_a_hospital_holiday_or_another_doctors_leave(): void
    {
        $other = $this->createDoctor([], $this->clinic);
        $this->createException(['type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'doctor_id' => $other->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-08', 'end_date' => '2026-10-08', 'reason' => 'Cuti dokter lain']);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->createErrors(['session_date' => '2026-10-08']), 'Cuti dokter lain tidak memblokir dokter ini.');

        $this->createException(['type' => ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday, 'doctor_id' => null, 'start_date' => '2026-10-08', 'end_date' => '2026-10-08', 'reason' => 'Hari ulang tahun RS']);

        $this->assertContains(
            'Tanggal ini berada dalam pengecualian jadwal (Hari ulang tahun RS). Hapus atau ubah pengecualian terlebih dahulu.',
            $this->createErrors(['session_date' => '2026-10-08'])['session_date'] ?? [],
        );
    }

    public function test_overlapping_session_of_the_same_doctor_is_rejected_but_adjacent_and_cancelled_are_not(): void
    {
        $this->upcomingSession(['booked_count' => 0, 'last_queue_number' => 0, 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);
        $this->upcomingSession([
            'booked_count' => 0,
            'last_queue_number' => 0,
            'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
            'start_time' => '17:00:00',
            'end_time' => '19:00:00',
        ]);

        $overlap = 'Jam sesi bertabrakan dengan sesi lain milik dokter ini pada tanggal tersebut.';

        $this->assertContains($overlap, $this->createErrors(['start_time' => '15:00', 'end_time' => '17:00'])['start_time'] ?? []);
        $this->assertSame([], $this->createErrors(['start_time' => '16:00', 'end_time' => '17:00']), 'Bersebelahan diterima.');
        $this->assertSame([], $this->createErrors(['start_time' => '17:30', 'end_time' => '18:30']), 'Sesi batal tidak memblokir.');
        $this->assertSame([], $this->createErrors(['session_date' => '2026-10-09', 'start_time' => '13:00', 'end_time' => '16:00']), 'Tanggal lain diterima.');
    }

    public function test_overlap_is_per_doctor(): void
    {
        $this->upcomingSession(['booked_count' => 0, 'last_queue_number' => 0, 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);
        $other = $this->createDoctor([], $this->clinic);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->createErrors(['doctor_id' => (string) $other->id, 'start_time' => '13:00', 'end_time' => '16:00']));
    }

    // --- Ubah sesi: JDW-07 dan sesi lampau --------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_jdw_07_quota_below_booked_count_is_rejected_and_equal_accepted(): void
    {
        $session = $this->upcomingSession();

        $this->assertContains(
            'Kuota tidak boleh kurang dari jumlah pendaftaran yang sudah ada (5).',
            $this->updateErrors($session, ['quota' => '4'])['quota'] ?? [],
        );
        $this->assertSame([], $this->updateErrors($session, ['quota' => '5']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->updateErrors($session, ['quota' => '30']));
    }

    public function test_updating_the_times_of_a_session_does_not_conflict_with_itself(): void
    {
        $session = $this->upcomingSession();

        $this->assertSame([], $this->updateErrors($session, ['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '11:00']));
    }

    public function test_updating_into_another_session_of_the_same_doctor_conflicts(): void
    {
        $session = $this->upcomingSession();
        $this->upcomingSession(['booked_count' => 0, 'last_queue_number' => 0, 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);

        $this->assertContains(
            'Jam sesi bertabrakan dengan sesi lain milik dokter ini pada tanggal tersebut.',
            $this->updateErrors($session, ['start_time' => '12:00', 'end_time' => '14:00'])['start_time'] ?? [],
        );
    }

    public function test_update_attributes_only_carry_times_and_quota_even_if_the_form_posts_more(): void
    {
        $session = $this->upcomingSession();
        $other = $this->createDoctor([], $this->clinic);
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(PracticeSessionRequest::class, [
            'doctor_id' => (string) $other->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-11-01',
            'start_time' => '09:00',
            'end_time' => '11:00',
            'quota' => '8',
        ], null, ['session' => $session], 'PUT');
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertSame(['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '11:00', 'quota' => 8], $request->sessionAttributes());
    }

    public function test_f3_r27_an_ended_session_cannot_be_updated_even_by_super_admin(): void
    {
        $ended = $this->upcomingSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '07:00:00', 'end_time' => '09:00:00']);
        $superAdmin = $this->createStaff('super-admin');

        $errors = $this->validationErrors(
            PracticeSessionRequest::class,
            ['start_time' => '07:00', 'end_time' => '09:00', 'quota' => '10'],
            $superAdmin,
            ['session' => $ended],
            'PUT',
        );

        $this->assertContains('Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.', $errors['start_time'] ?? []);
    }

    public function test_a_session_that_ends_later_today_can_still_be_updated(): void
    {
        $running = $this->upcomingSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);

        $this->assertSame([], $this->updateErrors($running, ['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '13:00']));
    }

    public function test_registration_officer_is_not_authorized_to_create_or_update_sessions(): void
    {
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $session = $this->upcomingSession();

        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(PracticeSessionRequest::class, $this->createPayload(), $officer)->authorize());
        $this->assertFalse($this->makeFormRequest(PracticeSessionRequest::class, [], $officer, ['session' => $session], 'PUT')->authorize());

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);

        $this->validationErrors(PracticeSessionRequest::class, $this->createPayload(), $officer);
    }

    // --- Status sesi ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function statusErrors(PracticeSession $session, array $data): array
    {
        return $this->validationErrors(UpdateSessionStatusRequest::class, $data, null, ['session' => $session], 'PATCH');
    }

    public function test_status_open_and_closed_need_no_reason(): void
    {
        $session = $this->upcomingSession();

        $this->assertSame([], $this->statusErrors($session, ['status' => 'closed']));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->statusErrors($session, ['status' => 'open', 'reason' => '']));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidStatusInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'status kosong' => [[], 'status', 'Status sesi wajib dipilih.'],
            'status tidak valid' => [['status' => 'hancur'], 'status', 'Status sesi tidak valid.'],
            'needs_review tidak dapat dipilih' => [['status' => 'needs_review'], 'status', 'Status sesi tidak valid.'],
            'batalkan tanpa alasan' => [['status' => 'cancelled'], 'reason', 'Alasan pembatalan sesi wajib diisi.'],
            'batalkan alasan kosong' => [['status' => 'cancelled', 'reason' => '   '], 'reason', 'Alasan pembatalan sesi wajib diisi.'],
            'alasan terlalu pendek' => [['status' => 'cancelled', 'reason' => 'abcd'], 'reason', 'Alasan minimal 5 karakter.'],
            'alasan terlalu panjang' => [['status' => 'cancelled', 'reason' => 'aaaaa'.str_repeat('a', 251)], 'reason', 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidStatusInputs')]
    public function test_invalid_status_input_gets_the_indonesian_message(array $data, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $this->assertContains($message, $this->statusErrors($this->upcomingSession(), $data)[$field] ?? []);
    }

    public function test_cancelling_with_a_five_character_reason_is_accepted_and_trimmed(): void
    {
        $session = $this->upcomingSession();
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest(UpdateSessionStatusRequest::class, ['status' => 'cancelled', 'reason' => '  Dokter sakit  '], null, ['session' => $session], 'PATCH');
        $request->validateResolved();

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $request->targetStatus());
        $this->assertSame('Dokter sakit', $request->reason());
    }

    public function test_f3_r27_status_of_an_ended_session_cannot_be_changed_even_by_super_admin(): void
    {
        $ended = $this->upcomingSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '07:00:00', 'end_time' => '09:00:00']);
        $superAdmin = $this->createStaff('super-admin');

        $errors = $this->validationErrors(UpdateSessionStatusRequest::class, ['status' => 'closed'], $superAdmin, ['session' => $ended], 'PATCH');

        $this->assertContains('Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.', $errors['status'] ?? []);
        $this->assertSame('Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.', session('error'));
    }

    public function test_registration_officer_cannot_change_session_status(): void
    {
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $session = $this->upcomingSession();

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);

        $this->validationErrors(UpdateSessionStatusRequest::class, ['status' => 'closed'], $officer, ['session' => $session], 'PATCH');
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Admin/ScheduleIndexRequestsTest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\Admin\DoctorScheduleIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\PracticeSessionIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F3-R22 / 12 V-45, V-46 / VAL-07 (parameter admin): parameter filter admin #35 yang tidak valid diabaikan,
 * tidak pernah galat 500. Filter dibaca langsung dari Form Request; kueri diuji lewat applyTo().
 */
class ScheduleIndexRequestsTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Senin, 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 08.00 WIB.
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));
    }

    /**
     * @template T of ListFilterRequest
     *
     * @param  class-string<T>  $class
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $query
     * @return T
     */
    private function resolve(string $class, array $query): ListFilterRequest
    {
        $request = $class::create('/_uji/filter', 'GET', $query);
        $request->setContainer($this->app);
        $request->setRedirector($this->app->make('redirect'));
        $request->validateResolved();

        return $request;
    }

    // --- Templat ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_schedule_filters_accept_valid_values(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan']);

        $request = $this->resolve(DoctorScheduleIndexRequest::class, [
            'dokter' => $doctor->slug,
            'hari' => '3',
            'status' => 'aktif',
            'urut' => '-hari',
        ]);

        $this->assertEquals(['dokter' => $doctor->slug, 'hari' => '3', 'status' => 'aktif', 'urut' => '-hari'], $request->filters());
    }

    public function test_schedule_filters_ignore_invalid_values_without_an_error(): void
    {
        $request = $this->resolve(DoctorScheduleIndexRequest::class, [
            'dokter' => 'tidak-ada',
            'hari' => '9',
            'status' => 'zzz',
            'urut' => 'kuota',
            'kembali' => 'https://situs-lain.test',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame([], $request->filters());
        $this->assertSame('Filter tidak valid dan diabaikan.', session('warning'));
    }

    public function test_schedule_filters_apply_doctor_day_and_status_to_the_query(): void
    {
        $raka = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan']);
        $sinta = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani']);
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $raka->id, 'clinic_id' => $raka->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 1]);
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $raka->id, 'clinic_id' => $raka->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 2, 'is_active' => false]);
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $sinta->id, 'clinic_id' => $sinta->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 1]);

        $apply = fn (array $query) => $this->resolve(DoctorScheduleIndexRequest::class, $query)
            ->applyTo(DoctorSchedule::query())
            ->get();

        $this->assertCount(3, $apply([]));
        $this->assertCount(2, $apply(['dokter' => $raka->slug]));
        $this->assertCount(2, $apply(['hari' => '1']));
        $this->assertCount(1, $apply(['dokter' => $raka->slug, 'hari' => '2', 'status' => 'nonaktif']));
        $this->assertCount(2, $apply(['status' => 'aktif']));
        $this->assertCount(3, $apply(['dokter' => 'tidak-ada']), 'Filter dokter yang tidak valid diabaikan.');
    }

    public function test_schedule_default_order_is_doctor_name_then_day_and_hari_sorts_by_day(): void
    {
        $sinta = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani']);
        $raka = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan']);
        $a = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $sinta->id, 'clinic_id' => $sinta->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 1]);
        $b = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $raka->id, 'clinic_id' => $raka->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 3]);
        $c = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $raka->id, 'clinic_id' => $raka->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 2]);

        $byDoctor = $this->resolve(DoctorScheduleIndexRequest::class, [])->applyTo(DoctorSchedule::query())->pluck('id')->all();
        $byDay = $this->resolve(DoctorScheduleIndexRequest::class, ['urut' => 'hari'])->applyTo(DoctorSchedule::query())->pluck('id')->all();
        $byDoctorDesc = $this->resolve(DoctorScheduleIndexRequest::class, ['urut' => '-dokter'])->applyTo(DoctorSchedule::query())->pluck('id')->all();

        $this->assertSame([$c->id, $b->id, $a->id], $byDoctor);
        $this->assertSame([$a->id, $c->id, $b->id], $byDay);
        $this->assertSame([$a->id, $c->id, $b->id], $byDoctorDesc);
    }

    // --- Pengecualian -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_exception_status_defaults_to_upcoming_and_invalid_values_are_ignored(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('mendatang', $this->resolve(ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest::class, [])->statusFilter());
        $this->assertSame('mendatang', $this->resolve(ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest::class, ['status' => 'zzz'])->statusFilter());
        $this->assertSame('lampau', $this->resolve(ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest::class, ['status' => 'lampau'])->statusFilter());
        $this->assertSame('semua', $this->resolve(ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest::class, ['status' => 'semua'])->statusFilter());
    }

    public function test_exception_type_filter_ignores_unknown_types(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(['jenis' => 'doctor_leave'], $this->resolve(ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest::class, ['jenis' => 'doctor_leave'])->filters());
        $this->assertSame([], $this->resolve(ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest::class, ['jenis' => 'libur-bebas'])->filters());
    }

    public function test_exception_query_splits_upcoming_and_past_by_end_date_and_filters_by_reason_and_type(): void
    {
        $past = $this->createException(['type' => 'other', 'start_date' => '2026-09-01', 'end_date' => '2026-09-03', 'reason' => 'Pelatihan lama']);
        $ongoing = $this->createException(['type' => 'other', 'start_date' => '2026-10-01', 'end_date' => '2026-10-05', 'reason' => 'Pelatihan berjalan']);
        $future = $this->createException(['type' => 'hospital_holiday', 'doctor_id' => null, 'start_date' => '2026-10-20', 'end_date' => '2026-10-20', 'reason' => 'Libur_100% khusus']);

        $ids = fn (array $query) => $this->resolve(ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest::class, $query)
            ->applyTo(ScheduleException::query())
            ->pluck('id')
            ->all();

        $this->assertSame([$ongoing->id, $future->id], $ids([]));
        $this->assertSame([$past->id], $ids(['status' => 'lampau']));
        $this->assertSame([$past->id, $ongoing->id, $future->id], $ids(['status' => 'semua']));
        $this->assertSame([$future->id], $ids(['jenis' => 'hospital_holiday']));
        $this->assertSame([$ongoing->id], $ids(['q' => 'berjalan']));
        $this->assertSame([$future->id], $ids(['q' => '100%']), 'Karakter % dan _ pada kata kunci diperlakukan literal.');
        $this->assertSame([], $ids(['q' => '100_']), 'Garis bawah pada kata kunci tidak menjadi wildcard.');
    }

    // --- Sesi ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_session_range_defaults_to_today_plus_thirteen_days(): void
    {
        [$from, $to] = $this->resolve(PracticeSessionIndexRequest::class, [])->range();

        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05', $from->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-18', $to->toDateString());
    }

    public function test_session_range_uses_given_dates_and_ignores_an_end_before_the_start(): void
    {
        [$from, $to] = $this->resolve(PracticeSessionIndexRequest::class, ['dari' => '2026-11-01', 'sampai' => '2026-11-07'])->range();
        $this->assertSame(['2026-11-01', '2026-11-07'], [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()]);

        [$from, $to] = $this->resolve(PracticeSessionIndexRequest::class, ['dari' => '2026-11-10'])->range();
        $this->assertSame(['2026-11-10', '2026-11-23'], [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()]);

        $request = $this->resolve(PracticeSessionIndexRequest::class, ['dari' => '2026-11-10', 'sampai' => '2026-11-01']);
        [$from, $to] = $request->range();
        $this->assertSame(['dari' => '2026-11-10'], $request->filters());
        $this->assertSame(['2026-11-10', '2026-11-23'], [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()]);
    }

    public function test_session_filters_ignore_invalid_values(): void
    {
        $request = $this->resolve(PracticeSessionIndexRequest::class, [
            'dari' => 'kemarin',
            'sampai' => '2026-02-31',
            'dokter' => 'tidak-ada',
            'poli' => ['x'],
            'status' => 'hancur',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame([], $request->filters());
        [$from, $to] = $request->range();
        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-05', '2026-10-18'], [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()]);
    }

    public function test_session_query_applies_range_doctor_clinic_and_status_in_date_and_time_order(): void
    {
        $sintaClinic = $this->createClinic();
        $raka = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan']);
        $sinta = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani'], $sintaClinic);

        $late = $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $raka->id, 'clinic_id' => $raka->clinic_id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-07', 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);
        $early = $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $raka->id, 'clinic_id' => $raka->clinic_id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-07', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:00']);
        $other = $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $sinta->id, 'clinic_id' => $sinta->clinic_id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00', 'status' => 'closed']);
        $outside = $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $raka->id, 'clinic_id' => $raka->clinic_id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-19', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '11:00:00']);

        $ids = fn (array $query) => $this->resolve(PracticeSessionIndexRequest::class, $query)
            ->applyTo(PracticeSession::query())
            ->pluck('id')
            ->all();

        $this->assertSame([$other->id, $early->id, $late->id], $ids([]));
        $this->assertSame([$early->id, $late->id], $ids(['dokter' => $raka->slug]));
        $this->assertSame([$other->id], $ids(['poli' => $sintaClinic->slug]));
        $this->assertSame([$other->id], $ids(['status' => 'closed']));
        $this->assertSame([$outside->id], $ids(['dari' => '2026-10-19', 'sampai' => '2026-10-19']));
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Admin/ScheduleMessagesTest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Kunci pesan baku fase 3 (F3 bagian D): `messages.entities.schedule|exception|session`.
 */
class ScheduleMessagesTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_entity_names_are_translated_and_not_returned_as_keys(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('Templat jadwal', __('messages.entities.schedule'));
        $this->assertSame('Pengecualian jadwal', __('messages.entities.exception'));
        $this->assertSame('Sesi praktik', __('messages.entities.session'));
    }

    public function test_standard_flash_messages_compose_with_the_new_entities(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('Templat jadwal berhasil ditambahkan.', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.schedule')]));
        $this->assertSame('Pengecualian jadwal berhasil diperbarui.', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.exception')]));
        $this->assertSame('Sesi praktik berhasil dihapus.', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.session')]));
    }

    public function test_existing_entity_names_are_unchanged(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('Spesialisasi', __('messages.entities.specialty'));
        $this->assertSame('Poliklinik', __('messages.entities.clinic'));
        $this->assertSame('Dokter', __('messages.entities.doctor'));
        $this->assertSame('Gambar', __('messages.entities.media'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\User;

/**
 * 04 §5 / 11 §8. Lihat: `schedules.view`; kelola: `schedules.manage`. Mengaktifkan atau menonaktifkan templat
 * adalah `update`. Penolakan hapus karena ada sesi ber-appointment (BR-12) dan penolakan ganti poliklinik
 * (BR-10) dilakukan service dan Form Request, bukan di sini, agar berlaku juga untuk Super Admin
 * (Gate::before melewati Policy; F3-R30 dan Global Constraints).
 */
```

`app/Rules/NoOverlappingSchedule.php`

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Rules;

use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\DataAwareRule;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;

/**
 * BR-08 / V-23: templat aktif seorang dokter pada hari yang sama tidak boleh beririsan jam
 * (`start1 < end2 AND start2 < end1`) dalam rentang berlaku yang beririsan (`valid_until` NULL = tanpa batas).
 * BR-11: pembandingan per dokter, bukan per poliklinik. Dipasang pada `start_time`.
 *
 * Aturan ini hanya bekerja bila isian lain valid; isian yang salah dilaporkan aturannya sendiri. Templat
 * nonaktif tidak dihitung bentrok, dan templat yang sedang diubah dikecualikan lewat `$ignoreId`.
 */
final class NoOverlappingSchedule implements DataAwareRule, ValidationRule
{
    /** @var array<string, mixed> */
    private array $data = [];

    public function __construct(
        private readonly ?int $doctorId,
        private readonly ?int $ignoreId = null,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function setData(array $data): static
    {
        $this->data = $data;

        return $this;
    }

    public function validate(string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail): void
    {
        if ($this->doctorId === null || ! $this->willBeActive()) {
            return;
        }

        $start = $this->time($value);
        $end = $this->time($this->data['end_time'] ?? null);
        $day = filter_var($this->data['day_of_week'] ?? null, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
        $from = $this->date($this->data['valid_from'] ?? null);

        if ($start === null || $end === null || $start >= $end || $day === false || $day < 1 || $day > 7 || $from === null) {
            return;
        }

        $untilInput = $this->data['valid_until'] ?? null;
        $until = null;

        if ($untilInput !== null && $untilInput !== '') {
            $until = $this->date($untilInput);

            if ($until === null || $until < $from) {
                return;
            }
        }

        $conflict = DoctorSchedule::query()
            ->active()
            ->overlapping($this->doctorId, $day, $start, $end, $from, $until, $this->ignoreId)
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->first();

        if ($conflict === null) {
            return;
        }

        $range = $conflict->valid_from->translatedFormat('j M Y').' – '
            .($conflict->valid_until === null ? 'tanpa batas' : $conflict->valid_until->translatedFormat('j M Y'));

        $fail(sprintf(
            'Jadwal bertabrakan dengan jadwal aktif lain milik dokter ini pada hari yang sama (%s %s, berlaku %s).',
            $conflict->day_name,
            $conflict->time_range,
            $range,
        ));
    }

    /** Templat yang dinonaktifkan tidak memakai slot, sehingga tidak diperiksa (BR-08). */
    private function willBeActive(): bool
    {
        $active = filter_var($this->data['is_active'] ?? true, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);

        return $active === true;
    }

    private function time(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        return is_string($value) && preg_match('/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/', $value) === 1 ? $value : null;
    }

    private function date(mixed $value): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        if (! is_string($value)) {
            return null;
        }

        $date = CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $value);

        return $date !== false && $date->format('Y-m-d') === $value ? $date : null;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Rules\NoOverlappingSchedule;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-23: satu kelas untuk tambah dan ubah templat (dibedakan dari parameter route `schedule`).
 *
 * Aturan yang tidak boleh dilewati siapa pun, termasuk Super Admin, ada di sini dan di service:
 * dokter arsip tidak diberi templat (BR-06), tidak bentrok (BR-08), ganti poliklinik ditolak bila ada sesi
 * mendatang berpendaftaran aktif (BR-10). Dokter pada templat yang sudah ada tidak dapat diganti, karena
 * propagasi templat (00 F.4) tidak memindahkan sesi antar dokter.
 */
class DoctorScheduleRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        $schedule = $this->schedule();

        return $schedule !== null
            ? $user->can('update', $schedule)
            : $user->can('create', DoctorSchedule::class);
    }

    /** Templat yang sedang diubah, atau null pada pembuatan. */
    public function schedule(): ?DoctorSchedule
    {
        $schedule = $this->route('schedule');

        return $schedule instanceof DoctorSchedule ? $schedule : null;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $schedule = $this->schedule();

        $validFrom = ['required', 'date_format:Y-m-d'];

        if ($schedule === null) {
            $validFrom[] = 'after_or_equal:today';
        }

        return [
            'doctor_id' => [
                'bail',
                'required',
                'integer',
                Rule::exists('doctors', 'id')->whereNot('status', DoctorStatus::Archived->value),
            ],
            'clinic_id' => [
                'bail',
                'required',
                'integer',
                Rule::exists('clinics', 'id')->where('is_active', true)->where('is_bookable', true),
            ],
            'day_of_week' => ['bail', 'required', 'integer', 'between:1,7'],
            'start_time' => [
                'bail',
                'required',
                'date_format:H:i',
                new NoOverlappingSchedule($this->doctorId(), $schedule?->id),
            ],
            'end_time' => ['bail', 'required', 'date_format:H:i', 'after:start_time'],
            'quota' => ['bail', 'required', 'integer', 'between:1,200'],
            'valid_from' => $validFrom,
            'valid_until' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'after_or_equal:valid_from'],
            'is_active' => ['required', 'boolean'],
            'notes' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'doctor_id.required' => 'Dokter wajib dipilih.',
            'doctor_id.integer' => 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            'doctor_id.exists' => 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            'clinic_id.required' => 'Poliklinik wajib dipilih.',
            'clinic_id.integer' => 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.',
            'clinic_id.exists' => 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.',
            'day_of_week.required' => 'Hari wajib dipilih.',
            'day_of_week.integer' => 'Hari tidak valid.',
            'day_of_week.between' => 'Hari tidak valid.',
            'start_time.required' => 'Jam mulai wajib diisi.',
            'start_time.date_format' => 'Format jam mulai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.',
            'end_time.required' => 'Jam selesai wajib diisi.',
            'end_time.date_format' => 'Format jam selesai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.',
            'end_time.after' => 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.',
            'quota.required' => 'Kuota wajib diisi.',
            'quota.integer' => 'Kuota harus berupa angka bulat.',
            'quota.between' => 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.',
            'valid_from.required' => 'Tanggal mulai berlaku wajib diisi.',
            'valid_from.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'valid_from.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal mulai berlaku tidak boleh di masa lalu.',
            'valid_until.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'valid_until.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal berlaku sampai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai berlaku.',
            'is_active.required' => 'Status aktif tidak valid.',
            'is_active.boolean' => 'Status aktif tidak valid.',
            'notes.string' => 'Catatan harus berupa teks.',
            'notes.max' => 'Catatan maksimal 255 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Pemeriksaan yang bergantung pada templat yang sudah ada (hanya saat ubah).
     *
     * @return array<int, callable>
     */
    public function after(): array
    {
        return [
            function (Validator $validator): void {
                $schedule = $this->schedule();

                if ($schedule === null) {
                    return;
                }

                if (
                    ! $validator->errors()->has('doctor_id')
                    && is_numeric($this->input('doctor_id'))
                    && (int) $this->input('doctor_id') !== (int) $schedule->doctor_id
                ) {
                    $validator->errors()->add('doctor_id', 'Dokter pada templat tidak dapat diganti. Buat templat baru, lalu nonaktifkan templat lama.');
                }

                $clinicId = $this->input('clinic_id');

                if (
                    $validator->errors()->has('clinic_id')
                    || ! is_numeric($clinicId)
                    || (int) $clinicId === (int) $schedule->clinic_id
                ) {
                    return;
                }

                try {
                    app(ScheduleChangeService::class)->assertClinicChangeAllowed($schedule, (int) $clinicId);
                } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
                    foreach ($exception->errors() as $field => $messages) {
                        foreach ($messages as $message) {
                            $validator->errors()->add($field, $message);
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi. `doctor_id` hanya dipakai saat tambah (tidak dapat diganti saat ubah).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function attributesForModel(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();

        $attributes = [
            'doctor_id' => (int) $data['doctor_id'],
            'clinic_id' => (int) $data['clinic_id'],
            'day_of_week' => (int) $data['day_of_week'],
            'start_time' => (string) $data['start_time'],
            'end_time' => (string) $data['end_time'],
            'quota' => (int) $data['quota'],
            'valid_from' => (string) $data['valid_from'],
            'valid_until' => $this->blankToNull($data['valid_until'] ?? null),
            'is_active' => (bool) $data['is_active'],
            'notes' => $this->blankToNull($data['notes'] ?? null),
        ];

        if ($this->schedule() !== null) {
            unset($attributes['doctor_id']);
        }

        return $attributes;
    }

    private function blankToNull(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        return is_string($value) && trim($value) !== '' ? trim($value) : null;
    }

    private function doctorId(): ?int
    {
        $value = $this->input('doctor_id');

        return is_numeric($value) && (int) $value > 0 ? (int) $value : null;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Filter daftar templat jadwal (F3-R22, 07 W-17): `dokter` (slug), `hari` (1-7), `status` aktif/nonaktif,
 * `urut` dokter/hari. Nilai tidak valid diabaikan oleh basis (12 V-45).
 */
class DoctorScheduleIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'dokter' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('doctors', 'slug')],
            'hari' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'between:1,7'],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'dokter.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.max' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.exists' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'hari.integer' => 'Hari tidak valid.',
            'hari.between' => 'Hari tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return ['aktif', 'nonaktif'];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function sortable(): array
    {
        return ['dokter', 'hari'];
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<DoctorSchedule>  $query
     * @return Builder<DoctorSchedule>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        $table = $query->getModel()->getTable();

        if (isset($filters['dokter'])) {
            $query->where($table.'.doctor_id', (int) Doctor::query()->where('slug', $filters['dokter'])->value('id'));
        }

        if (isset($filters['hari'])) {
            $query->where($table.'.day_of_week', (int) $filters['hari']);
        }

        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;

        if ($status === 'aktif' || $status === 'nonaktif') {
            $query->where($table.'.is_active', $status === 'aktif');
        }

        $sort = $filters['urut'] ?? 'dokter';
        $direction = str_starts_with($sort, '-') ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        $doctorName = Doctor::query()->select('doctors.name')->whereColumn('doctors.id', $table.'.doctor_id');

        if (ltrim($sort, '-') === 'hari') {
            return $query
                ->orderBy($table.'.day_of_week', $direction)
                ->orderBy($table.'.start_time')
                ->orderBy($doctorName)
                ->orderBy($table.'.id');
        }

        return $query
            ->orderBy($doctorName, $direction)
            ->orderBy($table.'.day_of_week')
            ->orderBy($table.'.start_time')
            ->orderBy($table.'.id');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * V-25: satu kelas untuk tambah dan ubah pengecualian (dibedakan dari parameter route `exception`).
 *
 * Kombinasi jenis dan dokter menurut 00 E.2 / BR-25 ditegakkan di sini, di service, dan oleh CHECK
 * `chk_schedule_exceptions_scope`. F3-R21: `start_date` yang tidak berubah boleh tetap di masa lalu saat ubah.
 */
class ScheduleExceptionRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        $exception = $this->exception();

        return $exception !== null
            ? $user->can('update', $exception)
            : $user->can('create', ScheduleException::class);
    }

    /** Pengecualian yang sedang diubah, atau null pada pembuatan. */
    public function exception(): ?ScheduleException
    {
        $exception = $this->route('exception');

        return $exception instanceof ScheduleException ? $exception : null;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $exception = $this->exception();

        $startDate = ['bail', 'required', 'date_format:Y-m-d'];

        if ($exception === null || $this->input('start_date') !== $exception->start_date->toDateString()) {
            $startDate[] = 'after_or_equal:today';
        }

        $endDate = ['bail', 'required', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'after_or_equal:start_date'];
        $limit = $this->maxEndDate();

        if ($limit !== null) {
            $endDate[] = 'before_or_equal:'.$limit;
        }

        return [
            'type' => ['bail', 'required', Rule::enum(ExceptionType::class)],
            'doctor_id' => [
                'bail',
                'nullable',
                'integer',
                Rule::exists('doctors', 'id')->whereNot('status', DoctorStatus::Archived->value),
                Rule::requiredIf(fn (): bool => $this->input('type') === ExceptionType::DoctorLeave->value),
                Rule::prohibitedIf(fn (): bool => in_array($this->input('type'), [
                    ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday->value,
                    ExceptionType::NationalHoliday->value,
                ], true)),
            ],
            'start_date' => $startDate,
            'end_date' => $endDate,
            'reason' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', 'min:3', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'type.required' => 'Jenis pengecualian wajib dipilih.',
            'type.enum' => 'Jenis pengecualian tidak valid.',
            'doctor_id.required' => 'Pilih dokter untuk cuti dokter.',
            'doctor_id.prohibited' => 'Libur rumah sakit atau libur nasional berlaku untuk semua dokter. Kosongkan pilihan dokter.',
            'doctor_id.integer' => 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            'doctor_id.exists' => 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            'start_date.required' => 'Tanggal mulai wajib diisi.',
            'start_date.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'start_date.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu.',
            'end_date.required' => 'Tanggal selesai wajib diisi.',
            'end_date.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'end_date.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal selesai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai.',
            'end_date.before_or_equal' => 'Rentang pengecualian maksimal 365 hari.',
            'reason.required' => 'Alasan wajib diisi.',
            'reason.string' => 'Alasan harus berupa teks.',
            'reason.min' => 'Alasan minimal 3 karakter.',
            'reason.max' => 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Atribut model hasil validasi. `doctor_id` NULL berarti seluruh dokter/RS.
     *
     * @return array{type: string, doctor_id: ?int, start_date: string, end_date: string, reason: string}
     */
    public function attributesForModel(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();

        return [
            'type' => (string) $data['type'],
            'doctor_id' => is_numeric($data['doctor_id'] ?? null) ? (int) $data['doctor_id'] : null,
            'start_date' => (string) $data['start_date'],
            'end_date' => (string) $data['end_date'],
            'reason' => trim((string) $data['reason']),
        ];
    }

    /** Batas `end_date` (BR-26: maksimal 365 hari dari `start_date`), atau null bila `start_date` belum valid. */
    private function maxEndDate(): ?string
    {
        $start = $this->input('start_date');

        if (! is_string($start)) {
            return null;
        }

        $date = CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $start);

        return $date !== false && $date->format('Y-m-d') === $start ? $date->addDays(365)->toDateString() : null;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Filter daftar pengecualian (F3-R22, 07 W-17): `q` (alasan), `jenis` (ExceptionType), `status`
 * mendatang (bawaan; `end_date` >= hari ini) / lampau / semua. Nilai tidak valid diabaikan oleh basis.
 */
class ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'jenis' => ['nullable', 'string', Rule::in(ExceptionType::values())],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'jenis.string' => 'Jenis tidak valid.',
            'jenis.in' => 'Jenis tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {

    /** Status yang berlaku: `mendatang` bila tidak ada atau tidak valid. */
    public function statusFilter(): string
    {
        return $this->filters()['status'] ?? 'mendatang';
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<ScheduleException>  $query
     * @return Builder<ScheduleException>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        $table = $query->getModel()->getTable();
        $status = $this->statusFilter();
        $today = today()->toDateString();

        if ($status === 'mendatang') {
            $query->where($table.'.end_date', '>=', $today);
        } elseif ($status === 'lampau') {
            $query->where($table.'.end_date', '<', $today);
        }

        if (isset($filters['q'])) {
            $like = '%'.str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $filters['q']).'%';
            $query->where($table.'.reason', 'like', $like);
        }

        if (isset($filters['jenis'])) {
            $query->where($table.'.type', $filters['jenis']);
        }

        return $status === 'lampau'
            ? $query->orderByDesc($table.'.start_date')->orderBy($table.'.id')
            : $query->orderBy($table.'.start_date')->orderBy($table.'.id');
    }
}
```

`app/Http/Requests/Admin/PracticeSessionRequest.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-24: satu kelas untuk tambah sesi manual dan ubah sesi (dibedakan dari parameter route `session`).
 *
 * Saat ubah hanya jam dan kuota yang dapat diubah; dokter, poliklinik, dan tanggal tetap (09 §3.7).
 * Aturan yang juga mengikat Super Admin ada di sini dan di ScheduleChangeService: sesi lampau tidak diubah
 * (F3-R27, BR-33), kuota tidak di bawah booked_count (BR-31), dokter harus aktif (F3-R26), tanggal tidak
 * di dalam pengecualian dan jam tidak berbenturan (BR-29).
 */
class PracticeSessionRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();

        if ($user === null) {
            return false;
        }

        $session = $this->practiceSession();

        return $session !== null
            ? $user->can('update', $session)
            : $user->can('create', PracticeSession::class);
    }

    /** Sesi yang sedang diubah, atau null pada pembuatan. */
    public function practiceSession(): ?PracticeSession
    {
        $session = $this->route('session');

        return $session instanceof PracticeSession ? $session : null;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $rules = [
            'start_time' => ['bail', 'required', 'date_format:H:i'],
            'end_time' => ['bail', 'required', 'date_format:H:i', 'after:start_time'],
            'quota' => ['bail', 'required', 'integer', 'between:1,200'],
        ];

        if ($this->practiceSession() !== null) {
            return $rules;
        }

        return [
            'doctor_id' => [
                'bail',
                'required',
                'integer',
                Rule::exists('doctors', 'id')->where('status', DoctorStatus::Active->value),
            ],
            'clinic_id' => [
                'bail',
                'required',
                'integer',
                Rule::exists('clinics', 'id')->where('is_active', true)->where('is_bookable', true),
            ],
            'session_date' => [
                'bail',
                'required',
                'date_format:Y-m-d',
                'after_or_equal:today',
                'before_or_equal:'.now()->addDays(365)->toDateString(),
            ],
        ] + $rules;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'doctor_id.required' => 'Dokter wajib dipilih.',
            'doctor_id.integer' => 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            'doctor_id.exists' => 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            'clinic_id.required' => 'Poliklinik wajib dipilih.',
            'clinic_id.integer' => 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.',
            'clinic_id.exists' => 'Poliklinik yang dipilih tidak tersedia atau tidak dibuka untuk pendaftaran.',
            'session_date.required' => 'Tanggal sesi wajib diisi.',
            'session_date.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'session_date.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal sesi tidak boleh di masa lalu.',
            'session_date.before_or_equal' => 'Tanggal sesi maksimal 365 hari ke depan.',
            'start_time.required' => 'Jam mulai wajib diisi.',
            'start_time.date_format' => 'Format jam mulai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.',
            'end_time.required' => 'Jam selesai wajib diisi.',
            'end_time.date_format' => 'Format jam selesai tidak valid. Gunakan format JJ:MM.',
            'end_time.after' => 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.',
            'quota.required' => 'Kuota wajib diisi.',
            'quota.integer' => 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.',
            'quota.between' => 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Pemeriksaan yang membutuhkan data lain: sesi lampau, kuota di bawah booked_count, pengecualian, benturan jam.
     *
     * @return array<int, callable>
     */
    public function after(): array
    {
        return [
            function (Validator $validator): void {
                $session = $this->practiceSession();

                if ($session !== null && $session->isEnded()) {
                    $validator->errors()->add('start_time', 'Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.');

                    return;
                }

                $errors = $validator->errors();

                if ($session !== null && ! $errors->has('quota') && (int) $this->input('quota') < (int) $session->booked_count) {
                    $errors->add('quota', 'Kuota tidak boleh kurang dari jumlah pendaftaran yang sudah ada ('.(int) $session->booked_count.').');
                }

                $doctorId = $session !== null ? (int) $session->doctor_id : $this->numericInput('doctor_id');
                $date = $session !== null ? CarbonImmutable::parse($session->session_date->toDateString()) : $this->dateInput('session_date');

                if ($session === null && $doctorId !== null && $date !== null && ! $errors->hasAny(['doctor_id', 'session_date'])) {
                    $exceptions = ScheduleException::query()->covering($date)->forDoctor($doctorId)->get();
                    $covering = ScheduleException::pickFor($exceptions, $doctorId, $date);

                    if ($covering !== null) {
                        $errors->add('session_date', 'Tanggal ini berada dalam pengecualian jadwal ('.$covering->reason.'). Hapus atau ubah pengecualian terlebih dahulu.');
                    }
                }

                if ($doctorId === null || $date === null || $errors->hasAny(['doctor_id', 'session_date', 'start_time', 'end_time'])) {
                    return;
                }

                $overlaps = PracticeSession::query()
                    ->where('doctor_id', $doctorId)
                    ->where('session_date', $date->toDateString())
                    ->where('status', '!=', SessionStatus::Cancelled->value)
                    ->when($session !== null, fn ($query) => $query->where('id', '!=', $session?->id))
                    ->where('start_time', '<', $this->input('end_time').':00')
                    ->where('end_time', '>', $this->input('start_time').':00')
                    ->exists();

                if ($overlaps) {
                    $errors->add('start_time', 'Jam sesi bertabrakan dengan sesi lain milik dokter ini pada tanggal tersebut.');
                }
            },
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Atribut untuk ScheduleChangeService: tambah memakai enam kunci, ubah hanya jam dan kuota.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function sessionAttributes(): array
    {
        $data = $this->validated();

        $attributes = [
            'start_time' => (string) $data['start_time'],
            'end_time' => (string) $data['end_time'],
            'quota' => (int) $data['quota'],
        ];

        if ($this->practiceSession() !== null) {
            return $attributes;
        }

        return [
            'doctor_id' => (int) $data['doctor_id'],
            'clinic_id' => (int) $data['clinic_id'],
            'session_date' => (string) $data['session_date'],
        ] + $attributes;
    }

    private function numericInput(string $key): ?int
    {
        $value = $this->input($key);

        return is_numeric($value) && (int) $value > 0 ? (int) $value : null;
    }

    private function dateInput(string $key): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        $value = $this->input($key);

        if (! is_string($value)) {
            return null;
        }

        $date = CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $value);

        return $date !== false && $date->format('Y-m-d') === $value ? $date : null;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator as ValidatorContract;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;

/**
 * V-24 (PATCH admin.sessions.status): `status` open/closed/cancelled; `reason` wajib dan minimal 5 karakter
 * bila `cancelled` (F3-R20/T9). Sesi lampau tidak dapat diubah statusnya (F3-R27), juga oleh Super Admin.
 * `needs_review` tidak dapat dipilih: status itu hanya ditetapkan ScheduleChangeService.
 */
class UpdateSessionStatusRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $session = $this->route('session');

        return $session instanceof PracticeSession && (bool) $this->user()?->can('changeStatus', $session);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'status' => ['bail', 'required', Rule::in([
                SessionStatus::Open->value,
                SessionStatus::Closed->value,
                SessionStatus::Cancelled->value,
            ])],
            'reason' => [
                'nullable',
                Rule::requiredIf(fn (): bool => $this->input('status') === SessionStatus::Cancelled->value),
                'string',
                'min:5',
                'max:255',
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'status.required' => 'Status sesi wajib dipilih.',
            'status.in' => 'Status sesi tidak valid.',
            'reason.required' => 'Alasan pembatalan sesi wajib diisi.',
            'reason.string' => 'Alasan harus berupa teks.',
            'reason.min' => 'Alasan minimal 5 karakter.',
            'reason.max' => 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, callable>
     */
    public function after(): array
    {
        return [
            function (Validator $validator): void {
                $session = $this->route('session');

                if ($session instanceof PracticeSession && $session->isEnded()) {
                    $validator->errors()->add('status', 'Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.');
                }
            },
        ];
    }

    public function targetStatus(): SessionStatus
    {
        return SessionStatus::from((string) $this->validated('status'));
    }

    public function reason(): ?string
    {
        $reason = $this->validated('reason');

        return is_string($reason) && trim($reason) !== '' ? trim($reason) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Modal ditutup setelah kirim, jadi galat juga dipasang sebagai flash `error` agar terlihat di halaman asal.
     */
    protected function failedValidation(ValidatorContract $validator): void
    {
        session()->flash('error', (string) $validator->errors()->first());

        parent::failedValidation($validator);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin;

use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Filter daftar sesi (F3-R22, 12 V-46): `dari`/`sampai` (bawaan hari ini sampai hari ini + 13), `dokter` (slug),
 * `poli` (slug), `status` (SessionStatus). `sampai` sebelum `dari` diabaikan. Nilai tidak valid diabaikan.
 */
class PracticeSessionIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /** Lebar rentang bawaan: hari ini sampai hari ini + 13 (dua minggu). */
    public const DEFAULT_SPAN_DAYS = 13;

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'dari' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d'],
            'sampai' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'after_or_equal:dari'],
            'dokter' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('doctors', 'slug')],
            'poli' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150', Rule::exists('clinics', 'slug')],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'dari.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'sampai.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'sampai.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal sampai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal dari.',
            'dokter.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.max' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'dokter.exists' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'poli.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'poli.max' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'poli.exists' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return SessionStatus::values();
    }

    /**
     * Rentang tanggal yang berlaku: `dari` (bawaan hari ini) sampai `sampai` (bawaan `dari` + 13 hari).
     *
     * @return array{0: CarbonImmutable, 1: CarbonImmutable}
     */
    public function range(): array
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();

        $from = isset($filters['dari'])
            ? CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $filters['dari'])
            : CarbonImmutable::today();

        $to = isset($filters['sampai'])
            ? CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $filters['sampai'])
            : $from->addDays(self::DEFAULT_SPAN_DAYS);

        return [$from, $to];
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<PracticeSession>  $query
     * @return Builder<PracticeSession>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->filters();
        $table = $query->getModel()->getTable();
        [$from, $to] = $this->range();

        $query->whereBetween($table.'.session_date', [$from->toDateString(), $to->toDateString()]);

        if (isset($filters['dokter'])) {
            $query->where($table.'.doctor_id', (int) Doctor::query()->where('slug', $filters['dokter'])->value('id'));
        }

        if (isset($filters['poli'])) {
            $query->where($table.'.clinic_id', (int) Clinic::query()->where('slug', $filters['poli'])->value('id'));
        }

        if (isset($filters['status'])) {
            $query->where($table.'.status', $filters['status']);
        }

        return $query
            ->orderBy($table.'.session_date')
            ->orderBy($table.'.start_time')
            ->orderBy($table.'.id');
    }
}
```

### Task 10: Admin #35 tab Templat Mingguan, tab modul, banner, dan route

**Files:**

- Modify: `config/navigation.php` (`modules.schedules`)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminScheduleTemplatesTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T9: `DoctorSchedulePolicy`, `DoctorScheduleRequest` (`attributesForModel()`), `DoctorScheduleIndexRequest` (`applyTo()`), `messages.entities.schedule`.
  - T6: `ScheduleChangeService::applyTemplateCreated(DoctorSchedule $schedule, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport`, `applyTemplateChange(DoctorSchedule $schedule, array $before, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport`, `deleteTemplate(DoctorSchedule $schedule, Actor $actor): void` (melempar `ValidationException` dengan pesan BR-12), `ScheduleChangeReport::message(): string` (F3-R23).
  - T2: `DoctorSchedule` (`$fillable`, relasi `doctor()` dan `clinic()`, accessor `day_name` dan `time_range`, casts `valid_from`/`valid_until`); `PracticeSession::needsReview()` dan `notEnded()`; `Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules`.
  - Fase 1 dan 2: `x-layouts.admin`, `x-breadcrumb`, `x-module-tabs`, `x-data-table`, `x-confirm-modal`, `x-form.input|select|checkbox|errors-summary`, `x-loading-button`, `NavigationMenu` (tab disaring `Route::has` dan izin), `Actor::staff()`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\DoctorScheduleController`: `index`, `create`, `store`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy` (tanpa `show`).
  - Route (grup G-ADMIN): `admin.schedules.index` (`permission:schedules.view`), `create|store|edit|update|destroy` (`permission:schedules.manage`) → `/admin/jadwal`, `/admin/jadwal/buat`, `/admin/jadwal/{schedule}/ubah`, `/admin/jadwal/{schedule}`. Grup kelola didaftarkan lebih dulu. **Urutan di berkas (mengikat T11 dan T12):** blok `jadwal/sesi*` (T12), lalu `jadwal/pengecualian*` (T11), lalu resource `jadwal`. T10 menulis dua komentar penanda untuk keduanya: `// [FASE-3 T12] Rute sesi per tanggal didaftarkan di sini.` dan `// [FASE-3 T11] Rute pengecualian didaftarkan di sini.`
