  - Flash `success`: `trim("Templat jadwal berhasil ditambahkan." + " " + report->message())` (juga `diperbarui`); hapus: "Templat jadwal berhasil dihapus."; penolakan hapus: flash `error` = pesan BR-12 "Jadwal ini sudah memiliki sesi dengan pendaftaran dan hanya dapat dinonaktifkan." (berlaku juga untuk Super Admin).
  - Breadcrumb (05 §8.3): "Dasbor › Jadwal Praktik › Templat Mingguan" dan "… › Templat Mingguan › Tambah Templat|Ubah Templat".

**Test IDs:** AKS #35 dan #35b (baris templat; matriks penuh di T16), JDW-06 (HTTP), JDW-08(b)(c)(d) (HTTP), JDW-14 (sisi templat), JDW-19(a)(b)(f), Review Focus 5, F3-R19 (banner), F3-R23 (flash), VAL-07 (parameter filter admin).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Urutan route.** Resource memakai `Route::resource('jadwal', …)->names('schedules')->parameters(['jadwal' => 'schedule'])`; `Route::resourceVerbs` (`AppServiceProvider`) menghasilkan segmen `/buat` dan `/{id}/ubah`. Parameter `{schedule}` sudah dibatasi `[0-9]+` di `bootstrap/app.php`, sehingga `/admin/jadwal/abc/ubah` memberi 404. Seluruh route (gabungan T10 sampai T12: 19 route jadwal) diperiksa dengan `Router` mandiri: nama, URI, dan izin sesuai tabel route 11 §2.0.
2. **Nilai lama templat.** `update()` memanggil `$schedule->fill(...)`, lalu `$before = $schedule->getOriginal()`, lalu `save()`. Setelah `save()` `getOriginal()` sudah berisi nilai baru, sehingga pengambilan nilai lama harus sebelum `save()`. Seluruhnya di dalam `DB::transaction` bersama pemanggilan service (transaksi per sesi di service menjadi savepoint).
3. **Flash laporan.** `ScheduleChangeReport::message()` mengembalikan `""` bila semua nol, sehingga flash hanya pesan baku (`trim`). Penghapusan tidak membawa laporan.
4. **Penolakan hapus** memakai `ValidationException` dari service (BR-12), ditangkap controller dan ditampilkan sebagai flash `error` lewat `messages.delete_blocked` (`:reason`). Pagar ini tidak ada di Policy karena `Gate::before` melewati Policy untuk Super Admin.
5. **Banner** menghitung sendiri di partial (`needsReview()->notEnded()->count()`), supaya tiga tab selalu sama dan tidak ada angka yang dilewatkan controller. Hanya angka agregat; tidak ada data pasien (04 §6 V1).
6. **Mode ketat.** Daftar memuat `doctor` dan `clinic` lewat `with()`. View hanya memakai accessor `day_name`/`time_range` dan relasi yang dimuat. Tes daftar membuat beberapa dokter, poliklinik, dan baris sekaligus.
7. **Form.** `type="time"` membutuhkan `HH:MM`, sehingga kolom `TIME` (`HH:MM:SS`) dipotong `substr(…, 0, 5)`. Saat ubah, dokter hanya tampil sebagai teks dengan `<input type="hidden" name="doctor_id">` (aturan T9 butir 5). Poliklinik pada form memuat poliklinik aktif yang dapat didaftar ditambah poliklinik yang kini dipakai templat, agar templat lama dapat disunting. Dokter nonaktif muncul dengan akhiran "(nonaktif)" (F3-R26); dokter arsip tidak muncul.
8. `x-data-table` dipakai dengan `:searchable="false"` (F3-R22 untuk templat tidak memuat `q`); filter (dokter, hari, status) berada di slot `filters`, urutan (`urut`) berupa tautan di slot `actions`, dan `preserve` membawa `urut` agar penerapan filter tidak menghapusnya.
9. Tes memakai `SettingsSeeder` (jendela 30 hari) dan `travelTo` Senin 5 Okt 2026 pukul 07.00. Tes tab hanya menegaskan tab "Templat Mingguan"; tab Sesi dan Pengecualian muncul setelah T11 dan T12 dan diuji di sana. Tes tautan banner dilewati bila route `admin.sessions.review` sudah ada (fase 7).
10. Tidak ada perubahan `resources/js` atau `resources/scss`: modal hapus memakai perilaku `[data-confirm-modal]` di `admin.js` yang sudah ada (tanpa atribut event inline dan tanpa `{!! !!}`), sehingga `npm run build` tidak diperlukan.

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => (string) $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => (string) $this->clinic->id,

    private function template(array $overrides = []): DoctorSchedule
    {
        return $this->createSchedule(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-05',
            'valid_until' => null,
            'is_active' => true,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * Sesi mendatang milik templat (12 Okt 2026), kuota 20.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function sessionOf(DoctorSchedule $schedule, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'doctor_id' => $schedule->doctor_id,
            'clinic_id' => $schedule->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-12',

            'is_manually_modified' => false,

    /**
     * Nama dokter pada baris tabel, berurutan. Filter dokter di atas tabel memuat semua dokter, sehingga
     * nama dokter di seluruh HTML tidak dapat dipakai sebagai bukti baris.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function rowDoctors(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/data-label="Dokter"><span class="fw-semibold">(.*?)<\/span>/s', $html, $matches);

        return array_map(fn (string $name): string => html_entity_decode($name), $matches[1]);
    }

    /**
     * Nama hari pada baris tabel, berurutan.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function rowDays(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/data-label="Hari">(.*?)<\/td>/s', $html, $matches);

        return $matches[1];
    }

    private function fakeRoute(string $name, string $uri): void
    {
        if (! Route::has($name)) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get($uri, fn () => 'x')->name($name);
            Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
        }
    }

    public function test_index_filters_by_doctor_day_and_status_and_ignores_invalid_values(): void

        $this->template(['doctor_id' => $sinta->id, 'clinic_id' => $sinta->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 4]);
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $rows = fn (array $query): array => $this->rowDays(
            $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('admin.schedules.index', $query))->assertOk()->getContent(),
        );

        $this->assertSame(['Kamis'], $rows(['dokter' => $sinta->slug]));
        $this->assertSame(['Selasa'], $rows(['hari' => 2]));
        $this->assertSame(['Selasa'], $rows(['status' => 'nonaktif']));
        $this->assertSame(['Senin', 'Kamis'], $rows(['status' => 'aktif']));
        $this->assertCount(3, $rows(['dokter' => 'tidak-ada', 'hari' => 9, 'status' => 'zzz', 'urut' => 'kuota']));

        $this->get(route('admin.schedules.index', ['hari' => 9]))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Filter tidak valid dan diabaikan.');

        $this->template(['day_of_week' => 2]);
        $this->template(['day_of_week' => 4]);
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $byDoctor = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('admin.schedules.index'))->assertOk()->getContent();
        $byDay = $this->get(route('admin.schedules.index', ['urut' => 'hari']))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(['Jumat', 'Selasa', 'Kamis'], $this->rowDays($byDoctor), 'Bawaan: nama dokter, lalu hari.');
        $this->assertSame(['Selasa', 'Kamis', 'Jumat'], $this->rowDays($byDay), 'urut=hari: hari lebih dulu.');
    }

    private function needsReviewSession(string $date, string $start, string $end): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => $start,
            'end_time' => $end,
            'status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview,
            'pending_change' => ['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => 1],
        ]);
    }

        $this->needsReviewSession('2026-10-04', '08:00:00', '10:00:00');
        $this->needsReviewSession('2026-10-05', '04:00:00', '06:00:00');
        $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id, 'session_date' => '2026-10-07', 'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled]);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))

    public function test_store_creates_the_template_generates_sessions_and_flashes_the_impact(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->post(route('admin.schedules.store'), $this->payload())
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.schedules.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success');

        $schedule = DoctorSchedule::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame($this->doctor->id, $schedule->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($this->clinic->id, $schedule->clinic_id);
        $this->assertSame(1, $schedule->day_of_week);
        $this->assertSame(20, $schedule->quota);
        $this->assertNull($schedule->valid_until);
        $this->assertTrue($schedule->is_active);

        // Senin 5, 12, 19, 26 Okt dan 2 Nov 2026 ada dalam jendela 30 hari.
        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_schedule_id', $schedule->id)->count());

        $flash = (string) session('success');
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('Templat jadwal berhasil ditambahkan.', $flash);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('5 sesi dibangkitkan', $flash);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'schedule.created']);
    }

        $this->post(route('admin.schedules.store'), $this->payload(['start_time' => '11:00', 'end_time' => '13:00', 'valid_from' => '2026-11-02']))

    public function test_update_saves_the_changes_and_flashes(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.schedules.update', $schedule), $this->payload(['quota' => '30', 'notes' => 'Lantai 2']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.schedules.index'));

        $this->assertStringStartsWith('Templat jadwal berhasil diperbarui.', (string) session('success'));
        $schedule->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(30, $schedule->quota);
        $this->assertSame('Lantai 2', $schedule->notes);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'schedule.updated']);
    }

    public function test_jdw_08b_changing_the_time_turns_a_session_with_an_active_appointment_into_needs_review(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->sessionOf($schedule);
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.schedules.update', $schedule), $this->payload(['start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '13:00']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.schedules.index'));

        $this->assertStringContainsString('1 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran', (string) session('success'));

        $session->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $session->status);
        $this->assertSame('template_time', $session->pending_change['source']);
        $this->assertSame('09:00:00', (string) $session->start_time, 'Jam lama tetap berlaku sampai ditindaklanjuti.');
    }

    public function test_jdw_08c_deactivating_a_template_marks_sessions_with_active_appointments_for_review(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->sessionOf($schedule);
        $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.schedules.update', $schedule), $this->payload(['is_active' => '0']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.schedules.index'));

        $this->assertStringContainsString('1 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran', (string) session('success'));
        $session->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $session->status);
        $this->assertSame('template_removed', $session->pending_change['source']);
        $this->assertFalse($schedule->fresh()->is_active);
    }

    public function test_jdw_08d_changing_the_clinic_is_rejected_when_a_session_has_an_active_appointment(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $this->bookAppointment($this->sessionOf($schedule), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $other = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Bedah']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.schedules.edit', $schedule))
            ->put(route('admin.schedules.update', $schedule), $this->payload(['clinic_id' => (string) $other->id]))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.schedules.edit', $schedule))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['clinic_id' => 'Poliklinik tidak dapat diganti karena masih ada sesi mendatang dengan pendaftaran aktif. Buat jadwal baru, lalu nonaktifkan jadwal lama.']);

        $this->assertSame($this->clinic->id, $schedule->fresh()->clinic_id);
    }

    public function test_the_doctor_of_a_template_cannot_be_changed_through_the_form(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $other = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Dokter Lain'], $this->clinic);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.schedules.edit', $schedule))
            ->put(route('admin.schedules.update', $schedule), $this->payload(['doctor_id' => (string) $other->id]))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('doctor_id');

        $this->assertSame($this->doctor->id, $schedule->fresh()->doctor_id);
    }

    public function test_registration_officer_cannot_update(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('registration-officer'))
            ->put(route('admin.schedules.update', $schedule), $this->payload(['quota' => '99']))
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertSame(20, $schedule->fresh()->quota);
    }

    // --- JDW-14: Admin Konten tidak melihat data pasien ----------------------------------------------------

    public function test_jdw_14_content_admin_sees_the_summary_after_a_change_but_no_patient_data(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $session = $this->sessionOf($schedule);
        $patient = PatientProfile::factory()->create([
            'full_name' => 'Zulkarnain Rahasiawan',
            'phone' => '081377770042',
        ]);
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $patient->id]);

        $html = $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->followingRedirects()
            ->put(route('admin.schedules.update', $schedule), $this->payload(['start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '13:00']))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('1 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran')
            ->getContent();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Zulkarnain', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('081377770042', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($appointment->booking_code, $html);
    }

    // --- Hapus (JDW-19 a, b, f) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_jdw_19a_template_without_appointments_is_deleted_together_with_its_sessions(): void
    {
        $schedule = $this->template();
        $this->sessionOf($schedule);
        $this->sessionOf($schedule, ['session_date' => '2026-10-19']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->delete(route('admin.schedules.destroy', $schedule))

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'schedule.deleted']);
    }

    public function test_jdw_19b_history_of_cancelled_appointments_also_blocks_deletion(): void

`app/Http/Controllers/Admin/DoctorScheduleController.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\DoctorScheduleIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\DoctorScheduleRequest;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeReport;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #35, tab Templat Mingguan (F3-R19/R20/R22). Semua tulis lewat ScheduleChangeService:
 * simpan templat memicu pembangkitan sesi, propagasi (00 F.4), dan audit; flash memuat ringkasan dampak (F3-R23).
 */
class DoctorScheduleController extends Controller
{
    /** Hari ISO-8601 => nama (1 = Senin ... 7 = Minggu). */
    private const DAYS = [
        1 => 'Senin',
        2 => 'Selasa',
        3 => 'Rabu',
        4 => 'Kamis',
        5 => 'Jumat',
        6 => 'Sabtu',
        7 => 'Minggu',
    ];

    public function index(DoctorScheduleIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', DoctorSchedule::class);

        $schedules = $request
            ->applyTo(DoctorSchedule::query()->with(['doctor', 'clinic']))
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.schedules.index', [
            'schedules' => $schedules,
            'doctorOptions' => Doctor::query()->ordered()->get()
                ->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $doctor): array => [$doctor->slug => $doctor->display_name])
                ->all(),
            'dayOptions' => self::DAYS,
        ]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', DoctorSchedule::class);

        return view('admin.schedules.create', $this->formOptions(null));
    }

    public function store(DoctorScheduleRequest $request, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', DoctorSchedule::class);

        $actor = Actor::staff($request->user());

        $report = DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $service, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $schedule = DoctorSchedule::query()->create($request->attributesForModel());

            return $service->applyTemplateCreated($schedule, $actor);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.schedules.index')
            ->with('success', $this->flash('messages.created', $report));
    }

    public function edit(DoctorSchedule $schedule): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $schedule);

        return view('admin.schedules.edit', ['schedule' => $schedule->load('doctor')] + $this->formOptions($schedule));
    }

    public function update(DoctorScheduleRequest $request, DoctorSchedule $schedule, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $schedule);

        $actor = Actor::staff($request->user());

        $report = DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $schedule, $service, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $schedule->fill($request->attributesForModel());

            // Nilai lama harus diambil sebelum save(): sesudahnya getOriginal() sudah berisi nilai baru.
            $before = $schedule->getOriginal();
            $schedule->save();

            return $service->applyTemplateChange($schedule, $before, $actor);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.schedules.index')
            ->with('success', $this->flash('messages.updated', $report));
    }

    /**
     * Penolakan (BR-12) datang dari service sebagai ValidationException, bukan Policy, sehingga berlaku juga
     * untuk Super Admin (F3-R20, Review Focus 5). Pesannya ditampilkan sebagai flash `error`.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, DoctorSchedule $schedule, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $schedule);

        try {
            $service->deleteTemplate($schedule, Actor::staff($request->user()));
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            return redirect()->route('admin.schedules.index')
                ->with('error', __('messages.delete_blocked', ['reason' => (string) collect($exception->errors())->flatten()->first()]));
        }

        return redirect()->route('admin.schedules.index')
            ->with('success', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.schedule')]));
    }

    /** Pesan baku ditambah ringkasan dampak (F3-R23) bila tidak kosong. */
    private function flash(string $key, ScheduleChangeReport $report): string
    {
        return trim(__($key, ['entity' => __('messages.entities.schedule')]).' '.$report->message());
    }

    /**
     * Pilihan form: dokter yang tidak diarsipkan (dokter nonaktif boleh, F3-R26) dan poliklinik aktif yang
     * dapat didaftar, ditambah poliklinik yang kini dipakai templat ini.
     *
     * @return array{doctorOptions: array<int, string>, clinicOptions: array<int, string>, dayOptions: array<int, string>}
     */
    private function formOptions(?DoctorSchedule $schedule): array
    {
        return [
            'doctorOptions' => Doctor::query()
                ->where('status', '!=', DoctorStatus::Archived->value)
                ->ordered()
                ->get()
                ->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $doctor): array => [
                    $doctor->id => $doctor->display_name.($doctor->status === DoctorStatus::Active ? '' : ' (nonaktif)'),
                ])
                ->all(),
            'clinicOptions' => Clinic::query()
                ->where(function ($query) use ($schedule): void {
                    $query->where(fn ($open) => $open->where('is_active', true)->where('is_bookable', true));

                    if ($schedule !== null) {
                        $query->orWhere('id', $schedule->clinic_id);
                    }
                })
                ->ordered()
                ->pluck('name', 'id')
                ->all(),
            'dayOptions' => self::DAYS,
        ];
    }
}

### Task 11: Admin #35 tab Pengecualian

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ScheduleExceptionController.php`
- Create: `resources/views/admin/exceptions/index.blade.php`, `create.blade.php`, `edit.blade.php`, `_form.blade.php`
- Modify: `routes/admin.php` (impor dan blok route pengecualian pada penanda T11)
- Test: `tests/Feature/Admin/AdminScheduleExceptionsTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T9: `ScheduleExceptionPolicy`, `ScheduleExceptionRequest` (`attributesForModel()`), `ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest` (`applyTo()`, `statusFilter()`), `messages.entities.exception`.
  - T7: `ScheduleChangeService::applyException(ScheduleException $exception, ?array $previous, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport` dan `removeException(ScheduleException $exception, Actor $actor): ScheduleChangeReport` (dipanggil sebelum baris dihapus); `ScheduleChangeReport::message()`.
  - T10: partial `admin/schedules/_review-banner`, `config('navigation.modules.schedules')`, penanda `// [FASE-3 T11] Rute pengecualian didaftarkan di sini.` di `routes/admin.php`.
  - T2: `ScheduleException` (`$fillable`: `doctor_id`, `type`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `reason`; relasi `doctor()`; casts), `ExceptionType::options()`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\ScheduleExceptionController`: `index`, `create`, `store`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy` (tanpa `show`).
  - Route: `admin.exceptions.index` (`permission:schedules.view`), `create|store|edit|update|destroy` (`permission:schedules.manage`) → `/admin/jadwal/pengecualian`, `/admin/jadwal/pengecualian/buat`, `/admin/jadwal/pengecualian/{exception}/ubah`, `/admin/jadwal/pengecualian/{exception}`.
  - `applyException` menerima `$previous = ['start_date' => Carbon, 'end_date' => Carbon, 'doctor_id' => ?int]` pada ubah, dan `null` pada tambah.
  - Flash `success`: "Pengecualian jadwal berhasil ditambahkan." / "… diperbarui." / "… dihapus.", masing-masing ditambah ` ` + `report->message()` bila tidak kosong (mis. "1 sesi dibatalkan, 1 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran." atau "2 sesi dibuka kembali.").
  - Kolom daftar: Jenis (`x-status-badge` `ExceptionType`), Dokter (atau "Semua dokter"), Tanggal, Alasan, Aksi; breadcrumb "Dasbor › Jadwal Praktik › Pengecualian".

**Test IDs:** JDW-04 dan JDW-09 (HTTP), JDW-10 (HTTP: persempit dan hapus), JDW-18 (Form Request lewat HTTP), F3-R21, F3-R23, AKS #35 dan #35b (baris pengecualian), VAL-07 (filter).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Satu transaksi.** `destroy()` memanggil `removeException` lalu `$exception->delete()` di dalam satu `DB::transaction` (11 §6.6: dipanggil sebelum baris dihapus; FK `schedule_exception_id` `SET NULL` hanya jaring pengaman). `update()` mengambil `$previous` sebelum `update()` supaya sesi yang terlepas dari rentang lama dibuka kembali oleh service.
2. **Route bersarang.** `Route::resource('jadwal/pengecualian', …)` didaftarkan Laravel sebagai resource berawalan `jadwal`; `->parameters(['pengecualian' => 'exception'])` memberi parameter `{exception}` (sudah dibatasi `[0-9]+`). Diperiksa dengan `Router` mandiri: URI dan nama sesuai tabel route 11 §2.0.
3. **F3-R21.** Aturan `start_date` ≥ hari ini hanya dipasang pada tambah atau bila `start_date` berubah (`ScheduleExceptionRequest`). Service juga menolak sesuai F3-R21 (T7). Tes ubah menutupi kedua arah.
4. **Daftar.** Filter `status` (bawaan `mendatang`), `jenis`, dan `q` (alasan, `LIKE` ter-escape) dari `ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest`; relasi `doctor` dimuat lewat `with('doctor')`, sehingga pengecualian global (tanpa dokter) tampil "Semua dokter" tanpa memuat relasi lain (mode ketat). `:preserve="[]"` karena layar ini tidak memakai `urut`.
5. **Form tanpa JavaScript.** Pilihan dokter memakai baris pertama "Semua dokter" bernilai kosong; bantuan teks menjelaskan kombinasi 00 E.2; validasi tetap di server (Form Request dan service, ditambah CHECK `chk_schedule_exceptions_scope`).
6. Tes membuat sesi tanpa templat (`createSession`) sehingga `ensureRange` tidak membangkitkan apa pun, dan flash dapat dibandingkan persis. `status` ditutup lewat service (T7), bukan diisi manual, kecuali tes yang memang menyiapkan keadaan awal sesi `cancelled`.
7. Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS; tidak ada `npm run build`.

        parent::setUp();

        // Senin, 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 07.00 WIB.
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 07:00:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan'], $this->clinic);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'type' => 'doctor_leave',
            'doctor_id' => (string) $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-07',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-09',
            'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    /**
     * Sesi dokter uji pada tanggal tertentu (tanpa templat), pukul 09.00-12.00.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function sessionOn(string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function rowReasons(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/data-label="Alasan">(.*?)<\/td>/s', $html, $matches);

        return array_map(fn (string $reason): string => html_entity_decode($reason), $matches[1]);
    }

        $empty = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-07');
        $booked = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-08');
        $outside = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-12');
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($booked, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->post(route('admin.exceptions.store'), $this->payload())
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.exceptions.index'));

        $exception = ScheduleException::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame(ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, $exception->type);
        $this->assertSame($this->doctor->id, $exception->doctor_id);

        $empty->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $empty->status);
        $this->assertSame($exception->id, $empty->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertSame('Cuti tahunan', $empty->status_reason);

        $booked->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $booked->status);
        $this->assertEquals(['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => $exception->id], $booked->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $appointment->fresh()->status, 'Appointment lama tetap aktif.');

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $outside->fresh()->status);

        $flash = (string) session('success');
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('Pengecualian jadwal berhasil ditambahkan.', $flash);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('1 sesi dibatalkan', $flash);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('1 sesi perlu ditindaklanjuti petugas pendaftaran', $flash);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'exception.created']);
    }

    public function test_jdw_04_hospital_holiday_cancels_every_doctors_sessions_that_day(): void
    {
        $other = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani']);
        $first = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-08');
        $second = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-08', ['doctor_id' => $other->id, 'clinic_id' => $other->clinic_id]);
        $nextDay = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-09');

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->post(route('admin.exceptions.store'), $this->payload([
                'type' => 'hospital_holiday',
                'doctor_id' => '',
                'start_date' => '2026-10-08',
                'end_date' => '2026-10-08',
                'reason' => 'Hari ulang tahun RS',
            ]))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.exceptions.index'));

        $exception = ScheduleException::query()->sole();
        $this->assertNull($exception->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $first->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $second->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame('Hari ulang tahun RS', $second->fresh()->status_reason);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $nextDay->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('2 sesi dibatalkan', (string) session('success'));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidCombinations(): array
    {
        return [
            'cuti dokter tanpa dokter' => [['type' => 'doctor_leave', 'doctor_id' => ''], 'doctor_id', 'Pilih dokter untuk cuti dokter.'],
            'libur rumah sakit dengan dokter' => [['type' => 'hospital_holiday'], 'doctor_id', 'Libur rumah sakit atau libur nasional berlaku untuk semua dokter. Kosongkan pilihan dokter.'],
            'libur nasional dengan dokter' => [['type' => 'national_holiday'], 'doctor_id', 'Libur rumah sakit atau libur nasional berlaku untuk semua dokter. Kosongkan pilihan dokter.'],
            'mulai di masa lalu' => [['start_date' => '2026-10-04', 'end_date' => '2026-10-06'], 'start_date', 'Tanggal mulai tidak boleh di masa lalu.'],
            'selesai sebelum mulai' => [['start_date' => '2026-10-09', 'end_date' => '2026-10-08'], 'end_date', 'Tanggal selesai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai.'],
            'alasan kosong' => [['reason' => ''], 'reason', 'Alasan wajib diisi.'],

    #[DataProvider('invalidCombinations')]
    public function test_jdw_18_invalid_input_is_rejected_over_http_and_nothing_is_saved(array $override, string $field, string $message): void

    public function test_jdw_10_narrowing_the_range_reopens_the_sessions_that_fall_outside_it(): void
    {
        $day7 = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-07');
        $day8 = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-08');
        $day9 = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-09');
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)->post(route('admin.exceptions.store'), $this->payload())->assertRedirect(route('admin.exceptions.index'));
        $exception = ScheduleException::query()->sole();

        foreach ([$day7, $day8, $day9] as $session) {
            $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $session->fresh()->status);
        }

        $this->put(route('admin.exceptions.update', $exception), $this->payload(['end_date' => '2026-10-07']))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.exceptions.index'));

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $day7->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $day8->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertNull($day8->fresh()->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $day9->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('2 sesi dibuka kembali', (string) session('success'));
    }

    public function test_jdw_10_deleting_an_exception_reopens_its_sessions_and_removes_the_row(): void
    {
        $day7 = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-07');
        $day8 = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-08');
        $booked = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-09');
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($booked, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)->post(route('admin.exceptions.store'), $this->payload())->assertRedirect(route('admin.exceptions.index'));
        $exception = ScheduleException::query()->sole();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $booked->fresh()->status);

        $this->delete(route('admin.exceptions.destroy', $exception))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.exceptions.index'));

        $this->assertModelMissing($exception);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $day7->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $day8->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertNull($day7->fresh()->schedule_exception_id);

        $booked->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $booked->status);
        $this->assertNull($booked->pending_change);
        $this->assertNull($booked->schedule_exception_id);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $appointment->fresh()->status);

        $flash = (string) session('success');
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('Pengecualian jadwal berhasil dihapus.', $flash);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('3 sesi dibuka kembali', $flash);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'exception.deleted']);
    }

    public function test_deleting_an_exception_does_not_reopen_sessions_that_have_already_ended(): void
    {
        $exception = $this->createException([
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'start_date' => '2026-10-05',
            'end_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'reason' => 'Cuti singkat',
        ]);
        $ended = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-05', [
            'start_time' => '04:00:00',
            'end_time' => '06:00:00',
            'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
            'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id,
            'status_reason' => 'Cuti singkat',
        ]);
        $future = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-06', [
            'status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled,
            'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id,
            'status_reason' => 'Cuti singkat',
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->delete(route('admin.exceptions.destroy', $exception))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.exceptions.index'));

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $ended->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $future->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_registration_officer_cannot_delete(): void
    {
        $exception = $this->createException();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('registration-officer'))
            ->delete(route('admin.exceptions.destroy', $exception))
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertModelExists($exception);
    }
}

- [ ] **Step 5: Tulis controller dan view (tool Write)**

`app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ScheduleExceptionController.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\ScheduleExceptionRequest;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeReport;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #35, tab Pengecualian (cuti dan libur; F3-R19/R21/R22). Simpan, ubah, dan hapus (= cabut) lewat
 * ScheduleChangeService: sesi dalam rentang dibatalkan atau ditandai perlu tindak lanjut, dan dibuka kembali
 * saat pengecualian dipersempit atau dicabut. Flash memuat ringkasan dampak (F3-R23).
 */
class ScheduleExceptionController extends Controller
{
    public function index(ScheduleExceptionIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', ScheduleException::class);

        $exceptions = $request
            ->applyTo(ScheduleException::query()->with('doctor'))
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.exceptions.index', [
            'exceptions' => $exceptions,
            'statusFilter' => $request->statusFilter(),
            'typeOptions' => ExceptionType::options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', ScheduleException::class);

        return view('admin.exceptions.create', $this->formOptions());
    }

    public function store(ScheduleExceptionRequest $request, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', ScheduleException::class);

        $actor = Actor::staff($request->user());

        $report = DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $service, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $exception = ScheduleException::query()->create($request->attributesForModel());

            return $service->applyException($exception, null, $actor);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.exceptions.index')
            ->with('success', $this->flash('messages.created', $report));
    }

    public function edit(ScheduleException $exception): View
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $exception);

        return view('admin.exceptions.edit', ['exception' => $exception] + $this->formOptions());
    }

    public function update(ScheduleExceptionRequest $request, ScheduleException $exception, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $exception);

        $actor = Actor::staff($request->user());

        $report = DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $exception, $service, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            // Nilai lama (rentang dan cakupan dokter) dikirim ke service agar sesi yang terlepas dibuka kembali.
            $previous = [
                'start_date' => $exception->start_date,
                'end_date' => $exception->end_date,
                'doctor_id' => $exception->doctor_id === null ? null : (int) $exception->doctor_id,
            ];

            $exception->update($request->attributesForModel());

            return $service->applyException($exception, $previous, $actor);
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.exceptions.index')
            ->with('success', $this->flash('messages.updated', $report));
    }

    /**
     * "Hapus" berarti mencabut pengecualian: removeException dipanggil SEBELUM baris dihapus, keduanya dalam
     * satu transaksi (00 C, 11 §6.6).
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, ScheduleException $exception, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $exception);

        $actor = Actor::staff($request->user());

        $report = DB::transaction(function () use ($exception, $service, $actor): ScheduleChangeReport {
            $report = $service->removeException($exception, $actor);
            $exception->delete();

            return $report;
        });

        return redirect()->route('admin.exceptions.index')
            ->with('success', $this->flash('messages.deleted', $report));
    }

    /** Pesan baku ditambah ringkasan dampak (F3-R23) bila tidak kosong. */
    private function flash(string $key, ScheduleChangeReport $report): string
    {
        return trim(__($key, ['entity' => __('messages.entities.exception')]).' '.$report->message());
    }

    /**
     * Pilihan form: jenis pengecualian dan dokter yang tidak diarsipkan. Baris pertama "Semua dokter" bernilai
     * kosong (libur rumah sakit atau libur nasional berlaku untuk semua dokter, 00 E.2).
     *
     * @return array{typeOptions: array<string, string>, doctorOptions: array<int|string, string>}
     */
    private function formOptions(): array
    {
        $doctors = Doctor::query()
            ->where('status', '!=', DoctorStatus::Archived->value)
            ->ordered()
            ->get()
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $doctor): array => [
                $doctor->id => $doctor->display_name.($doctor->status === DoctorStatus::Active ? '' : ' (nonaktif)'),
            ])
            ->all();

        return [
            'typeOptions' => ExceptionType::options(),
            'doctorOptions' => ['' => 'Semua dokter'] + $doctors,
        ];
    }
}

Tombol Hapus hanya untuk sesi tambahan manual tanpa appointment sama sekali dan belum lewat; tanpa itu, sesi dari templat ditutup atau dibatalkan lewat `admin.sessions.status`.

**Test IDs:** JDW-07 dan JDW-15 (HTTP), JDW-13 (sesi manual bisa berulang), **JDW-14** (HTML Admin Konten tanpa nama, telepon, atau kode booking pasien), JDW-19(c)(d)(e)(f), AKS #35, #35b, dan #35d (DELETE sesi manual), F3-R20, F3-R27, F3-R30, V-24 (pesan), Review Focus 5, mode ketat.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **JDW-14 dan F3-R30.** Daftar sesi memakai `with(['doctor', 'clinic'])->withCount('appointments')`; `booked_count` dan `quota` dibaca dari kolom sesi. Tidak ada relasi `appointments`, `patientProfile`, atau kolom `booking_code`/`complaint` yang dimuat. Tes membuat appointment dari factory dengan pasien berinama khas dan nomor telepon khas, lalu menegaskan HTML tidak memuat keduanya dan kode booking, dan, lewat `DB::listen`, tidak ada kueri yang menyentuh `patient_profiles`, `booking_code`, atau `complaint`. Form ubah hanya menampilkan "{booked_count} dari {quota}".
2. **Tiga lapis pagar sesi lampau (F3-R27).** Tombol disembunyikan di daftar (kolom Aksi "Sudah lewat"), `PracticeSessionRequest` dan `UpdateSessionStatusRequest` menolak pada `after()`, dan controller menolak `edit` dan `destroy` sebelum memanggil service. Service (T8) tetap menjadi pagar terakhir bagi pemanggil non-HTTP. Semuanya berlaku juga untuk Super Admin.
3. **Hapus (F3-R20).** `destroy()` memanggil `deleteManualSession`; `ValidationException` dari service ditangkap dan ditampilkan sebagai flash `error` (`messages.delete_blocked`). Pesan sesi templat: "Sesi dari templat tidak dapat dihapus. Tutup atau batalkan sesi ini."; sesi manual ber-appointment: "Sesi ini sudah memiliki pendaftaran. Tutup atau batalkan sesi ini." (T2 `deletionBlockedReason()`). Satu catatan di atas tabel memberi saran "Tutup atau batalkan sesi" untuk baris tanpa tombol Hapus.
4. **Status.** `status()` memanggil `setSessionStatus` dengan `targetStatus()` dan `reason()`. Hanya `open`, `closed`, `cancelled` yang dapat dipilih; `needs_review` hanya ditetapkan service. Tombol Buka kembali untuk sesi `cancelled` hanya ditampilkan bila `schedule_exception_id` kosong; service tetap menolak membuka sesi yang masih tercakup pengecualian atau milik dokter nonaktif (BR-177). Satu modal per jenis dipakai ulang oleh semua baris lewat `data-confirm-action` (perilaku `admin.js` yang sudah ada). Modal ditutup setelah kirim, sehingga galat `UpdateSessionStatusRequest` juga dipasang sebagai flash `error` (pola `UpdateDoctorStatusRequest`).
5. **Peringatan BR-35.** Setelah `updateSession` atau `setSessionStatus`, controller membaca status hasil. Bila `needs_review` (sumber `manual_time` pada ubah, atau pembatalan), jumlah appointment aktif dihitung `appointments()->active()->count()` dan dipasang sebagai flash `warning`. Pada ubah, flash `success` tetap ada karena kuota langsung berlaku.
6. **Redirect.** Tambah dan ubah kembali ke daftar dengan `dari` dan `sampai` sama dengan tanggal sesi agar hasilnya langsung terlihat (rentang bawaan hanya 14 hari). Status dan hapus memakai `back(fallback: route('admin.sessions.index'))` agar filter tetap.
7. **Rute `status`.** `PATCH jadwal/sesi/{session}/status` didaftarkan sebelum resource sesi dalam grup kelola. Diperiksa dengan `Router` mandiri: tidak ada tabrakan dengan route templat (`{schedule}` numerik) maupun pengecualian.
8. **Eager loading dan filter.** `PracticeSessionIndexRequest` menyaring `dari`/`sampai` (bawaan hari ini sampai hari ini + 13), `dokter`, `poli`, `status`; tanggal tidak valid dan `sampai` sebelum `dari` diabaikan. Opsi dokter dan poliklinik slug di view diambil di controller, bukan di view.
9. Tes menetapkan waktu sendiri (`travelTo` Senin 5 Okt 2026 pukul 07.00); sesi lampau dibuat 04.00–06.00 pada hari yang sama. `bookAppointment` dari `InteractsWithSchedules` menaikkan `booked_count`; sesi uji untuk JDW-07 diisi `booked_count`/`last_queue_number` langsung karena yang diuji adalah validasi kuota.
10. Tidak ada perubahan JS atau SCSS; tidak ada `npm run build`.

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Admin;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman #35, tab Sesi per Tanggal (T12): daftar tanpa data pasien (JDW-14, F3-R30), sesi tambahan manual
 * (JDW-13), kuota dan jam (JDW-07/15), status sesi, hapus (JDW-19 c-f, F3-R20), sesi lampau (F3-R27),
 * akses per peran (AKS 35, 35b, 35d), mode ketat.
 */
class AdminPracticeSessionsTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const PAST = 'Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.';

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Senin, 5 Oktober 2026 pukul 07.00 WIB.
        $this->travelTo(Carbon::parse('2026-10-05 07:00:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Raka Wirawan'], $this->clinic);
    }

    /**
     * Sesi tambahan manual (tanpa templat) dokter uji, pukul 09.00-12.00, kuota 20.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function manualSession(string $date = '2026-10-08', array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'is_manually_modified' => false,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * Sesi hasil templat (doctor_schedule_id terisi).
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function templateSession(string $date = '2026-10-12', array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'day_of_week' => 1,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
            'valid_from' => '2026-10-05',
            'valid_until' => null,
        ]);

        return $this->manualSession($date, array_merge(['doctor_schedule_id' => $schedule->id], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * Sesi yang sudah berakhir pada 5 Okt 2026 pukul 06.00 (sekarang 07.00).
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function endedSession(array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->manualSession('2026-10-05', array_merge(['start_time' => '04:00:00', 'end_time' => '06:00:00'], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function createPayload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => (string) $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => (string) $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-08',
            'start_time' => '13:00',
            'end_time' => '15:00',
            'quota' => '10',
        ], $overrides);
    }

    {

            'super admin' => ['super-admin', 200, 200],

        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('staffRoles')]
    public function test_access_per_staff_role(string $role, int $indexStatus, int $manageStatus): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession();
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role));

        $this->get(route('admin.sessions.index'))->assertStatus($indexStatus);
        $this->get(route('admin.sessions.create'))->assertStatus($manageStatus);
        $this->get(route('admin.sessions.edit', $session))->assertStatus($manageStatus);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{string, int}>
     */
    public static function destroyRoles(): array
    {
        return [

            'admin konten' => ['content-admin', 302],
            'petugas pendaftaran' => ['registration-officer', 403],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('destroyRoles')]
    public function test_aks_35d_delete_of_a_manual_session_per_staff_role(string $role, int $status): void
    {

            ->delete(route('admin.sessions.destroy', $session))

    // --- JDW-14 dan F3-R30: tanpa data pasien -------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_jdw_14_content_admin_html_never_contains_patient_name_phone_or_booking_code(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession('2026-10-08', ['quota' => 20]);
        $second = $this->manualSession('2026-10-09');
        $patient = PatientProfile::factory()->create([
            'full_name' => 'Zulkarnain Rahasiawan',
            'phone' => '081377770042',
        ]);
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $patient->id]);
        $this->bookAppointment($second, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $queries = [];
        DB::listen(function ($query) use (&$queries): void {
            $queries[] = $query->sql;
        });

        $html = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('admin.sessions.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-label="Terisi">1/20</td>', false)
            ->getContent();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Zulkarnain', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Rahasiawan', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('081377770042', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($appointment->booking_code, $html);

        foreach ($queries as $sql) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('patient_profiles', $sql, 'Daftar sesi tidak boleh memuat profil pasien.');
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('booking_code', $sql);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('complaint', $sql);
        }
    }

    public function test_status_buttons_follow_the_session_status_and_ended_sessions_have_no_actions(): void
    {
        $open = $this->manualSession('2026-10-07');
        $closed = $this->manualSession('2026-10-08', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]);
        $reopenable = $this->manualSession('2026-10-09', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'status_reason' => 'Dokter sakit']);
        $exception = $this->createException(['type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-10', 'end_date' => '2026-10-10']);
        $byException = $this->manualSession('2026-10-10', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id]);
        $review = $this->manualSession('2026-10-11', ['status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview, 'pending_change' => ['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => $exception->id]]);
        $ended = $this->endedSession();

        $html = $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->get(route('admin.sessions.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Menunggu petugas pendaftaran')
            ->assertSee('Sudah lewat')
            ->assertSee('data-bs-target="#modal-sesi-tutup"', false)
            ->assertSee('data-bs-target="#modal-sesi-buka"', false)
            ->assertSee('data-bs-target="#modal-sesi-batalkan"', false)
            ->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'data-bs-target="#modal-sesi-tutup" data-confirm-action="'.route('admin.sessions.status', $open).'"'));
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'data-bs-target="#modal-sesi-buka" data-confirm-action="'.route('admin.sessions.status', $closed).'"'));
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'data-bs-target="#modal-sesi-buka" data-confirm-action="'.route('admin.sessions.status', $reopenable).'"'));
        $this->assertSame(0, substr_count($html, 'data-confirm-action="'.route('admin.sessions.status', $byException).'"'), 'Sesi yang dibatalkan pengecualian tidak dibuka dari sini.');
        $this->assertSame(0, substr_count($html, 'data-confirm-action="'.route('admin.sessions.status', $review).'"'));
        $this->assertSame(0, substr_count($html, 'data-confirm-action="'.route('admin.sessions.status', $ended).'"'));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(route('admin.sessions.edit', $ended), $html);
    }

    public function test_jdw_13_a_manual_session_is_created_without_a_template_and_can_be_repeated(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->post(route('admin.sessions.store'), $this->createPayload())
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.sessions.index', ['dari' => '2026-10-08', 'sampai' => '2026-10-08']))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Sesi praktik berhasil ditambahkan.');

        $this->post(route('admin.sessions.store'), $this->createPayload(['start_time' => '16:00', 'end_time' => '18:00']))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertSame(2, PracticeSession::query()->whereNull('doctor_schedule_id')->count());

        $session = PracticeSession::query()->orderBy('id')->first();
        $this->assertSame($this->doctor->id, $session->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($this->clinic->id, $session->clinic_id);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-08', $session->session_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(10, $session->quota);
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->status);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'session.created']);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string}>

    public static function invalidCreateInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'tanggal di masa lalu' => [['session_date' => '2026-10-04'], 'session_date', 'Tanggal sesi tidak boleh di masa lalu.'],
            'tanggal lebih dari 365 hari' => [['session_date' => '2027-10-06'], 'session_date', 'Tanggal sesi maksimal 365 hari ke depan.'],
            'dokter kosong' => [['doctor_id' => ''], 'doctor_id', 'Dokter wajib dipilih.'],
            'jam selesai tidak setelah mulai' => [['start_time' => '15:00', 'end_time' => '14:00'], 'end_time', 'Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.'],
            'kuota nol' => [['quota' => '0'], 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.'],
            'kuota 201' => [['quota' => '201'], 'quota', 'Kuota minimal 1 dan maksimal 200.'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $override
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidCreateInputs')]
    public function test_store_rejects_invalid_input_with_indonesian_messages(array $override, string $field, string $message): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->from(route('admin.sessions.create'))

            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.sessions.create'))

    public function test_store_rejects_an_inactive_doctor_an_overlap_and_a_date_inside_an_exception(): void
    {
        $inactive = $this->createDoctor(['status' => 'inactive'], $this->clinic);
        $admin = $this->createStaff('super-admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->from(route('admin.sessions.create'));

        $this->post(route('admin.sessions.store'), $this->createPayload(['doctor_id' => (string) $inactive->id]))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['doctor_id' => 'Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia.']);

        $this->manualSession('2026-10-08', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);
        $this->post(route('admin.sessions.store'), $this->createPayload(['start_time' => '15:00', 'end_time' => '17:00']))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['start_time' => 'Jam sesi bertabrakan dengan sesi lain milik dokter ini pada tanggal tersebut.']);

        $this->createException(['type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-20', 'end_date' => '2026-10-21', 'reason' => 'Cuti tahunan']);
        $this->post(route('admin.sessions.store'), $this->createPayload(['session_date' => '2026-10-20']))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['session_date' => 'Tanggal ini berada dalam pengecualian jadwal (Cuti tahunan). Hapus atau ubah pengecualian terlebih dahulu.']);

        $this->assertSame(1, PracticeSession::query()->count(), 'Hanya sesi awal yang ada.');
    }

    public function test_jdw_07_quota_below_booked_count_is_rejected_and_equal_is_accepted(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession('2026-10-08', ['quota' => 10, 'booked_count' => 5, 'last_queue_number' => 5]);
        $payload = ['start_time' => '09:00', 'end_time' => '12:00'];
        $admin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->from(route('admin.sessions.edit', $session))
            ->put(route('admin.sessions.update', $session), $payload + ['quota' => '4'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.sessions.edit', $session))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['quota' => 'Kuota tidak boleh kurang dari jumlah pendaftaran yang sudah ada (5).']);
        $this->assertSame(10, $session->fresh()->quota);

        $this->put(route('admin.sessions.update', $session), $payload + ['quota' => '5'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.sessions.index', ['dari' => '2026-10-08', 'sampai' => '2026-10-08']))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Sesi praktik berhasil diperbarui.');

        $session->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(5, $session->quota);
        $this->assertTrue($session->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'session.updated']);
    }

    public function test_jdw_15_time_change_with_an_active_appointment_goes_to_review_as_manual_time(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession('2026-10-08');
        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->put(route('admin.sessions.update', $session), ['start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '13:00', 'quota' => '25'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertSessionHas('warning', 'Sesi memiliki 1 pendaftaran aktif. Perubahan dikirim ke layar Sesi terdampak untuk diselesaikan petugas pendaftaran.');

        $session->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $session->status);
        $this->assertEquals(['source' => 'manual_time', 'new_start_time' => '10:00', 'new_end_time' => '13:00'], $session->pending_change);
        $this->assertSame('09:00:00', (string) $session->start_time, 'Jam lama tetap berlaku sampai ditindaklanjuti.');
        $this->assertSame(25, $session->quota, 'Kuota langsung berlaku.');
        $this->assertTrue($session->is_manually_modified);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $appointment->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_a_cancelled_session_covered_by_an_exception_cannot_be_reopened(): void
    {
        $exception = $this->createException(['type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id, 'start_date' => '2026-10-08', 'end_date' => '2026-10-08']);
        $session = $this->manualSession('2026-10-08', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id, 'status_reason' => 'Cuti']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->patch(route('admin.sessions.status', $session), ['status' => 'open'])
            ->assertSessionHasErrors();

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $session->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_a_manually_cancelled_session_can_be_reopened(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession('2026-10-08', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'status_reason' => 'Dokter sakit']);

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->patch(route('admin.sessions.status', $session), ['status' => 'open'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Sesi dibuka kembali.');

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_f3_r27_status_of_an_ended_session_cannot_be_changed_even_by_super_admin(): void
    {
        $ended = $this->endedSession();

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('super-admin'))
            ->patch(route('admin.sessions.status', $ended), ['status' => 'closed'])
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['status' => self::PAST])
            ->assertSessionHas('error', self::PAST);

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $ended->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_registration_officer_cannot_change_status(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession('2026-10-08');

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('registration-officer'))
            ->patch(route('admin.sessions.status', $session), ['status' => 'closed'])
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Open, $session->fresh()->status);
    }

    // --- Hapus (JDW-19 c, d, e, f) --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_jdw_19c_a_manual_session_without_appointments_is_deleted_and_audited(): void
    {
        $session = $this->manualSession('2026-10-08');

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->delete(route('admin.sessions.destroy', $session))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.sessions.index'))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Sesi praktik berhasil dihapus.');

        $this->assertModelMissing($session);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('audit_logs', ['action' => 'session.deleted']);
    }

    /**

     */
    public static function managers(): array
    {
        return ['super admin' => ['super-admin'], 'admin konten' => ['content-admin']];
    }

    {

    public function test_jdw_19f_registration_officer_cannot_delete_a_session(): void

- [ ] **Step 5: Tulis controller dan view (tool Write)**

`app/Http/Controllers/Admin/PracticeSessionController.php`

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\PracticeSessionIndexRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\PracticeSessionRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\UpdateSessionStatusRequest;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #35, tab Sesi per Tanggal (F3-R19/R20/R22/R27/R30). Semua tulis lewat ScheduleChangeService.
 *
 * Admin Konten tidak pernah menerima data pasien (F3-R30, 04 §6 V1): daftar hanya membaca `booked_count`/`quota`
 * dan jumlah appointment (`withCount`); tidak ada relasi pasien yang dimuat.
 */
class PracticeSessionController extends Controller
{
    private const PAST_MESSAGE = 'Sesi yang sudah lewat tidak dapat diubah.';

    public function index(PracticeSessionIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', PracticeSession::class);

        $sessions = $request
            ->applyTo(PracticeSession::query()->with(['doctor', 'clinic'])->withCount('appointments'))
            ->paginate($request->perPage());

        return view('admin.sessions.index', [
            'sessions' => $sessions,
            'range' => $request->range(),
            'doctorOptions' => Doctor::query()->ordered()->get()
                ->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $doctor): array => [$doctor->slug => $doctor->display_name])
                ->all(),
            'clinicOptions' => Clinic::query()->ordered()->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'statusOptions' => SessionStatus::options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        $this->authorize('create', PracticeSession::class);

        return view('admin.sessions.create', $this->formOptions());
    }

    public function store(PracticeSessionRequest $request, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', PracticeSession::class);

        $session = $service->createManualSession($request->sessionAttributes(), Actor::staff($request->user()));
        $date = $session->session_date->toDateString();

        // Daftar dibuka pada tanggal sesi baru supaya hasilnya langsung terlihat.
        return redirect()->route('admin.sessions.index', ['dari' => $date, 'sampai' => $date])
            ->with('success', __('messages.created', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.session')]));
    }

    public function edit(PracticeSession $session): View|RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $session);

        if ($session->isEnded()) {
            return redirect()->route('admin.sessions.index')->with('error', self::PAST_MESSAGE);
        }

        return view('admin.sessions.edit', ['session' => $session->load(['doctor', 'clinic'])] + $this->formOptions());
    }

    public function update(PracticeSessionRequest $request, PracticeSession $session, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $session);

        $updated = $service->updateSession($session, $request->sessionAttributes(), Actor::staff($request->user()));

        $redirect = redirect()->route('admin.sessions.index', [
            'dari' => $updated->session_date->toDateString(),
            'sampai' => $updated->session_date->toDateString(),
        ])->with('success', __('messages.updated', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.session')]));

        if ($updated->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview && $updated->pendingSource() === PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_TIME) {
            $redirect->with('warning', $this->pendingMessage($updated));
        }

        return $redirect;
    }

    public function status(UpdateSessionStatusRequest $request, PracticeSession $session, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('changeStatus', $session);

        $target = $request->targetStatus();

        try {
            $updated = $service->setSessionStatus($session, $target, Actor::staff($request->user()), $request->reason());
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            // Modal ditutup setelah kirim: galat service (kunci `status`/`reason`/`session`) juga dipasang sebagai
            // flash `error` agar terlihat di halaman asal; galatnya tetap dilempar ulang (kembali dengan $errors).
            session()->flash('error', (string) collect($exception->errors())->flatten()->first());

            throw $exception;
        }

        $redirect = back(fallback: route('admin.sessions.index'));

        if ($target === SessionStatus::Cancelled && $updated->status === SessionStatus::NeedsReview) {
            return $redirect->with('warning', $this->pendingMessage($updated));
        }

        return $redirect->with('success', match ($target) {
            SessionStatus::Closed => 'Sesi ditutup untuk pendaftaran baru.',
            SessionStatus::Open => 'Sesi dibuka kembali.',
            default => 'Sesi dibatalkan.',
        });
    }

    /**
     * Penolakan datang dari service (F3-R20, F3-R27) sebagai ValidationException, bukan Policy, sehingga berlaku
     * juga untuk Super Admin. Pesannya ditampilkan sebagai flash `error`.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, PracticeSession $session, ScheduleChangeService $service): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $session);

        $redirect = back(fallback: route('admin.sessions.index'));

        if ($session->isEnded()) {
            return $redirect->with('error', self::PAST_MESSAGE);
        }

        try {
            $service->deleteManualSession($session, Actor::staff($request->user()));
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            return $redirect->with('error', __('messages.delete_blocked', ['reason' => (string) collect($exception->errors())->flatten()->first()]));
        }

        return $redirect->with('success', __('messages.deleted', ['entity' => __('messages.entities.session')]));
    }

    /** BR-35: perubahan jam atau pembatalan sesi ber-appointment aktif dikirim ke layar Sesi terdampak. */
    private function pendingMessage(PracticeSession $session): string
    {
        $count = $session->appointments()->active()->count();

        return "Sesi memiliki {$count} pendaftaran aktif. Perubahan dikirim ke layar Sesi terdampak untuk diselesaikan petugas pendaftaran.";
    }

    /**
     * Pilihan form tambah sesi: dokter aktif dan poliklinik aktif yang dapat didaftar (V-24, F3-R26).
     *
     * @return array{doctorOptions: array<int, string>, clinicOptions: array<int, string>}
     */
    private function formOptions(): array
    {
        return [
            'doctorOptions' => Doctor::query()
                ->where('status', DoctorStatus::Active->value)
                ->ordered()
                ->get()
                ->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $doctor): array => [$doctor->id => $doctor->display_name])
                ->all(),
            'clinicOptions' => Clinic::query()->bookable()->ordered()->pluck('name', 'id')->all(),
        ];
    }
}

- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/View/AvailabilityBadgeComponentTest.php`, `tests/Feature/View/ScheduleTableComponentTest.php`, `tests/Feature/View/DoctorCardNextSessionTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Public/PublicDoctorIndexTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 2: `PracticeSession` (accessor `time_range`, `remaining`; relasi `doctor`, `clinic`, `exception`), `Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules` (`createSchedule`, `createSession`, `createException`, `bookAppointment`), factory sesi/templat/pengecualian.
  - Task 4: `PracticeSessionGenerator::ensureDailyHorizon()`, `::LOCK_KEY`, `::markerKey()`.
  - Task 5: `AvailabilityFilter`, `SessionAvailability`, `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::sessions()`/`::doctors()` (relasi `availabilities` pada tiap dokter halaman), `SettingsService::bookingRules()`.
  - Fase 1–2: enum `Availability` (label, warna, ikon), `Doctor::publiclyVisible()`/`search()`/`inSpecialty()`/`inClinic()`/`ordered()` dan accessor `display_name`/`primary_specialty`, `Specialty::active()`/`ordered()`, `Clinic::active()`/`ordered()`, `x-layouts.public` (prop `title`, `metaDescription`, `noindex`; slot `breadcrumb`; `@stack('head')`), `x-breadcrumb`, `x-page-header`, `x-empty-state`, `x-form.input`/`x-form.select`, `x-loading-button`, `x-image`, `Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData`/`InteractsWithStaff`.
- Produces:
  - `App\View\Components\AvailabilityBadge` (komponen kelas, 10 §3.4): props `availability` (`Availability`), `remaining` (`?int`), `compact` (`bool`). Teks "Tersedia · sisa {n}" bila `available` dan `remaining` diisi; mode `compact` menampilkan "Sisa {n}" dengan awalan "Tersedia, " khusus pembaca layar. Warna dan ikon dari enum apa adanya (F3-R13); atribut `data-availability="{nilai}"` sebagai kait tes.
  - `x-schedule-table` (anonim, 10 §3.3): props `sessions` (`Collection<SessionAvailability>`), `showDoctor` (bawaan `true`), `showAction` (bawaan `true`), `caption`, serta `emptyTitle` dan `emptyMessage` (tambahan, untuk teks kosong). Kolom: tanggal, jam, dokter, poliklinik, sisa kuota, status, aksi; di bawah 768 px baris menjadi kartu (`table-cards`, `data-label`). Tombol **Daftar** hanya bila `Route::has('patient.appointments.create')` dan `isBookableOnline`; selain itu teks label.
  - `x-doctor-card` mendapat prop `nextSession` (`?SessionAvailability`, bawaan `null`): lencana, "Jadwal terdekat: {Hari, j F Y} · {HH.MM–HH.MM}", dan tombol Daftar (aturan yang sama). Tanpa tombol "Lihat Jadwal" terpisah (F3-R25).
  - `App\Http\Requests\Public\DoctorIndexRequest` (`filters()`, `dateError()`), `App\Http\Controllers\Public\DoctorController@index`, view `public.doctors.index`, route `GET /dokter` → `doctors.index`.

**Test IDs:** CRD-01 (spesialisasi baru muncul di filter `doctors.index`, nonaktif hilang), CRD-03 bagian #6 (dokter baru tampil; nonaktif, arsip, dan poliklinik nonaktif tidak), VAL-07 (`/dokter?tanggal=abc&spesialisasi=tidak-ada&poli[]=x` dan variasinya), EMP-02 (pencarian tanpa hasil), AKS publik #6 (matriks lima aktor penuh di Task 16), Review Focus 4 (parameter publik tidak valid, mode ketat dengan 13 dokter × 3 sesi), F3-R9 (pemicu pembangkitan harian), F3-R17, F3-R18, F3-R25.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Komponen.** `AvailabilityBadge` adalah komponen **kelas** (10 §3.4) dengan view `components.availability-badge`; `x-schedule-table` anonim. `x-doctor-card` ditulis ulang utuh (Read lalu Write): hanya prop `nextSession`, variabel `$registerUrl`, dan blok sesi terdekat yang baru; selebihnya sama dengan fase 2, sehingga `DoctorCardComponentTest` lama tetap hijau.
- **Tanpa tautan bersarang.** Nama dokter tetap satu-satunya `stretched-link`; tombol Daftar berupa tautan terpisah (`position-relative z-2`, utilitas `z-*` ada sejak Bootstrap 5.3) sehingga tetap dapat diklik di atas lapisan `stretched-link`. Tes memindai pola `<a …><a` dengan regex.
- **Galat inline pada halaman GET.** Controller membagikan `MessageBag` lewat `view()->share('errors', (new ViewErrorBag)->put('default', $messageBag))` sebelum `view(...)`; komponen `x-form.*` membaca `$errors->first($key)`, jadi pesan tampil di bawah field tanpa pengalihan. `view(...)->withErrors()` **tidak** dipakai: data itu hanya melekat pada view induk dan tidak diteruskan ke komponen anonim (terbukti dengan skrip render; yang sampai ke komponen hanya data bersama), sehingga pesan inline tidak akan tampil. `share()` di controller menimpa bagasi kosong dari `ShareErrorsFromSession` karena dijalankan sesudah middleware.
- **`DoctorIndexRequest` berdiri sendiri**, bukan turunan `ListFilterRequest` (11 §9.1 menyebut turunan): aturan `status`/`urut`/`kembali` tidak relevan di halaman publik dan flash `warning` "Filter tidak valid dan diabaikan." akan menggandakan pesan inline. `failedValidation()` sengaja kosong; `Validator::valid()` mengembalikan seluruh input dikurangi yang gagal, sehingga `filters()` mengiris ke empat kunci yang beraturan. Aturan `tanggal` memakai `bail`, `date_format:Y-m-d` (ketat: menolak `2026-10-7`), `after_or_equal:today`, dan `before_or_equal:today + booking.window_days` (kedua ujung termasuk). Direkonsiliasi di Task 16.
- **Slug tak dikenal.** `spesialisasi` dan `poli` valid sebagai string tetapi dicocokkan ke daftar aktif; bila tidak ada, filter diabaikan dengan pesan "… tidak dikenal. Filter ini diabaikan." Daftar pilihan hanya memuat spesialisasi aktif dan poliklinik aktif berjenis `poliklinik`.
- **`DoctorAvailabilityQuery::doctors()`** memuat sesi satu kali per halaman dan memasang relasi `availabilities` (mode ketat aman). Controller menyaring `specialties` ke yang aktif lewat `setRelation` (D-56); pivot `is_primary` ikut terbawa. Foto kartu memakai rasio `1x1` karena `x-image` tidak menyediakan 4:5 (07 W-03).
- **Sesi pada kartu.** Dengan filter `tanggal`: sesi pertama pada tanggal itu, termasuk Cuti/Libur agar pengunjung tahu alasannya; tanpa filter: sesi terdekat yang bukan pembatalan (`leave`/`holiday`/`cancelled` dilewati; `past` sudah dibuang query).
- **Pemicu harian.** `ensureDailyHorizon()` dipanggil di setiap permintaan; penanda cache menjaganya sekali per hari. Tes mengisi penanda di `setUp()` agar templat buatan pabrik tidak menambah sesi, dan dua tes menghapusnya untuk menguji pemicu (termasuk kunci yang dipegang proses lain ⇒ halaman tetap 200).
- **Efek ke tes lama.** Setelah `doctors.index` ada, menu publik dan halaman 404 menampilkan "Daftar Dokter"/"Cari Dokter" secara nyata; `ErrorPagesTest` dan `LayoutsTest` tidak lagi mendaftarkan route palsu itu. Tes yang memalsukan `patient.appointments.create` (route fase 6) tetap memakai pola `Route::has()` + route palsu; versi "tanpa route" di-*skip* bila fase 6 sudah menambahkannya.
- Jumlah tes baru: **69** (lencana 15, tabel 12, kartu 6, halaman #6 36). Semua blok PHP lolos `php -l` 8.2 dan `pint --test`; semua view Blade dikompilasi dan tiga komponen diuji render dengan objek tiruan; jangkar Edit dicocokkan dengan berkas nyata (tepat satu kali).
