`tests/Feature/View/AvailabilityBadgeComponentTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\View;

use App\Enums\Availability;
use App\View\Components\AvailabilityBadge;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * `x-availability-badge` (10 §3.4, F3-R13): komponen kelas yang memakai enum Availability apa adanya.
 */
class AvailabilityBadgeComponentTest extends TestCase
{
    /** @return array<string, array{Availability}> */
    public static function cases(): array
    {
        $cases = [];

        foreach (Availability::cases() as $case) {
            $cases[$case->value] = [$case];
        }

        return $cases;
    }

    private function render(Availability $availability, string $attributes = ''): string
    {
        return Blade::render('<x-availability-badge :availability="$availability" '.$attributes.' />', ['availability' => $availability]);
    }

    #[DataProvider('cases')]
    public function test_every_case_renders_icon_text_and_colour_from_the_enum(Availability $availability): void
    {
        $html = $this->render($availability);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('text-bg-'.$availability->color(), $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<i class="bi '.$availability->icon().'" aria-hidden="true"></i>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString($availability->label(), $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-availability="'.$availability->value.'"', $html);
    }

    public function test_available_with_remaining_reads_tersedia_sisa_n(): void
    {
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Tersedia · sisa 5', $this->render(Availability::Available, ':remaining="5"'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Tersedia · sisa 0', $this->render(Availability::Available, ':remaining="0"'));
    }

    public function test_available_without_remaining_reads_only_the_label(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(Availability::Available);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Tersedia', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('sisa', $html);
    }

    public function test_compact_mode_shows_sisa_n_and_keeps_tersedia_for_screen_readers(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(Availability::Available, ':remaining="12" :compact="true"');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sisa 12', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<span class="visually-hidden">Tersedia, </span>', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Tersedia · sisa', $html);
    }

    public function test_remaining_is_ignored_for_every_other_availability(): void
    {
        foreach (Availability::cases() as $availability) {
            if ($availability === Availability::Available) {
                continue;
            }

            $html = $this->render($availability, ':remaining="7" :compact="true"');

            $this->assertStringContainsString($availability->label(), $html);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Sisa 7', $html, $availability->value);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('visually-hidden', $html, $availability->value);
        }
    }

    public function test_extra_classes_are_merged_and_no_inline_handlers_are_rendered(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(Availability::Full, 'class="ms-2"');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('class="badge text-bg-danger availability-badge ms-2"', $html);
        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i', $html));
    }

    public function test_it_is_a_class_component(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(class_exists(AvailabilityBadge::class));
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist(resource_path('views/components/availability-badge.php'));
        $this->assertFileExists(resource_path('views/components/availability-badge.blade.php'));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\View;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Scheduling\AvailabilityFilter;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use App\Services\Scheduling\SessionAvailability;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * `x-schedule-table` (10 §3.3, F3-R24/F3-R25): tabel jadwal dari koleksi SessionAvailability; di bawah 768 px
 * baris menjadi kartu (`.table-cards` + `data-label`). Tombol Daftar hanya bila route pendaftaran ada dan sesi
 * dapat dipesan online.
 */
class ScheduleTableComponentTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin
    }

    private function doctor(string $name = 'Laras Wulandari'): Doctor
    {
        return $this->createDoctor(['name' => $name, 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A']);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOf(Doctor $doctor, string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /** @return Collection<int, SessionAvailability> */
    private function items(): Collection
    {
        return app(DoctorAvailabilityQuery::class)->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(
            from: CarbonImmutable::today(),
            to: CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays(10),
            includePast: true,
        ));
    }

    private function render(Collection $items, string $attributes = ''): string
    {
        return Blade::render('<x-schedule-table :sessions="$items" '.$attributes.' />', ['items' => $items]);
    }

    private function fakeRegistrationRoute(): void
    {
        if (! Route::has('patient.appointments.create')) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/pasien/pendaftaran/baru', fn () => 'x')->name('patient.appointments.create');
            Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
        }
    }

    public function test_it_renders_a_table_with_caption_scoped_headers_and_mobile_labels(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->doctor();
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->render($this->items(), 'caption="Jadwal uji komponen"');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<caption class="visually-hidden">Jadwal uji komponen</caption>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('table-cards', $html);

        foreach (['Tanggal', 'Jam', 'Dokter', 'Poliklinik', 'Sisa kuota', 'Status', 'Aksi'] as $heading) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('<th scope="col">'.$heading.'</th>', $html);
        }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<th scope="row" class="fw-semibold"><time datetime="2026-10-06">Sel, 6 Okt 2026</time></th>', $html);

        foreach (['Jam', 'Dokter', 'Poliklinik', 'Sisa kuota', 'Status', 'Aksi'] as $label) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('data-label="'.$label.'"', $html);
        }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('09.00–12.00', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('dr. Laras Wulandari, Sp.A', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('20 dari 20', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Tersedia · sisa 20', $html);
    }

    public function test_show_doctor_false_drops_the_doctor_column(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->doctor();
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->render($this->items(), ':show-doctor="false" :show-action="false"');

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<th scope="col">Dokter</th>', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('data-label="Dokter"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('dr. Laras Wulandari', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<th scope="col">Poliklinik</th>', $html);
    }

    public function test_show_action_false_drops_the_action_column(): void
    {
        $this->sessionOf($this->doctor(), '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->render($this->items(), ':show-action="false"');

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<th scope="col">Aksi</th>', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('data-label="Aksi"', $html);
    }

    public function test_register_button_is_shown_only_for_online_bookable_sessions_when_the_route_exists(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRegistrationRoute();
        $doctor = $this->doctor();
        $open = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06');
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07', ['quota' => 1, 'booked_count' => 1]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]);

        $html = $this->render($this->items());

        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, '>Daftar</a>'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $open->id]).'"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('aria-label="Daftar ke dr. Laras Wulandari, Sp.A, Selasa, 6 Oktober 2026, 09.00 sampai 12.00"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Penuh', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Ditutup', $html);
    }

    public function test_register_button_is_hidden_while_the_registration_route_does_not_exist(): void
    {
        if (Route::has('patient.appointments.create')) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('Route patient.appointments.create sudah ada (fase 6): tombol diuji di tes fase 6.');
        }

        $this->sessionOf($this->doctor(), '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->render($this->items());

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('>Daftar</a>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<span class="small text-body-secondary">Tersedia</span>', $html);
    }

    public function test_leave_holiday_and_cancelled_sessions_show_a_dash_instead_of_the_quota(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->doctor();
        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => '2026-10-06', 'end_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id, 'status_reason' => 'Cuti tahunan']);

        $html = $this->render($this->items());

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Cuti', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<span aria-hidden="true">–</span><span class="visually-hidden">tidak berlaku</span>', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('20 dari 20', $html);
    }

    public function test_an_empty_collection_renders_the_empty_state_with_custom_texts(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(new Collection, 'empty-title="Belum ada jadwal praktik dua minggu ke depan" empty-message="Silakan hubungi kami."');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Belum ada jadwal praktik dua minggu ke depan', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Silakan hubungi kami.', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<table', $html);
    }

    public function test_an_empty_collection_uses_the_default_empty_title(): void
    {
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Belum ada jadwal praktik', $this->render(new Collection));
    }

    public function test_past_sessions_are_labelled_without_an_action(): void
    {
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 13:00:00');
        $this->sessionOf($this->doctor(), '2026-10-05');

        $html = $this->render($this->items());

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sudah lewat', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('>Daftar</a>', $html);
    }

    public function test_only_active_specialties_are_shown_under_the_doctor_name(): void
    {
        $hidden = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Nonaktif Utama', 'is_active' => false]);
        $shown = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Aktif Tambahan']);
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], null, [$hidden, $shown]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->render($this->items());

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<span class="d-block small text-body-secondary">Spesialis Aktif Tambahan</span>', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Spesialis Nonaktif Utama', $html);
    }

    public function test_many_rows_render_in_strict_mode_without_lazy_loading(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(Model::preventsLazyLoading());

        foreach (range(1, 6) as $number) {
            $doctor = $this->doctor("Dokter Uji {$number}");

            foreach (['2026-10-06', '2026-10-08'] as $date) {
                $session = $this->sessionOf($doctor, $date);
                $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
            }
        }

        $html = $this->render($this->items());

        $this->assertSame(12, substr_count($html, '<th scope="row"'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('dr. Dokter Uji 6, Sp.A', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('19 dari 20', $html);
    }

    public function test_no_inline_handlers_or_nested_links_are_rendered(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRegistrationRoute();
        $this->sessionOf($this->doctor(), '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->render($this->items());

        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i', $html));
        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/<a\b[^>]*>(?:(?!<\/a>).)*<a\b/s', $html));
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/View/DoctorCardNextSessionTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\View;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Services\Scheduling\AvailabilityFilter;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use App\Services\Scheduling\SessionAvailability;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Prop `nextSession` pada `x-doctor-card` (F3-R25, 10 §3.3): lencana ketersediaan, teks "Jadwal terdekat", dan
 * tombol Daftar yang hanya muncul bila route pendaftaran ada dan sesi dapat dipesan online. Tidak ada tombol
 * "Lihat Jadwal" terpisah dan tidak ada tautan bersarang.
 */
class DoctorCardNextSessionTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function nextSessionFor(Doctor $doctor, array $overrides = []): SessionAvailability
    {
        $session = $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));

        return app(DoctorAvailabilityQuery::class)->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(
            doctorId: $doctor->id,
            from: CarbonImmutable::today(),
            to: CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays(10),
            includePast: true,
        ))->first(fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => $item->session->id === $session->id);
    }

    private function render(Doctor $doctor, ?SessionAvailability $next): string
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::query()->with(['specialties', 'media', 'clinic'])->findOrFail($doctor->id);

        return Blade::render('<x-doctor-card :doctor="$doctor" :next-session="$next" />', ['doctor' => $doctor, 'next' => $next]);
    }

    private function fakeRegistrationRoute(): void
    {
        if (! Route::has('patient.appointments.create')) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/pasien/pendaftaran/baru', fn () => 'x')->name('patient.appointments.create');
            Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
        }
    }

    public function test_without_a_next_session_the_card_shows_no_schedule_information(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();

        $html = $this->render($doctor, null);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Jadwal terdekat', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('availability-badge', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Lihat Jadwal', $html);
    }

    public function test_it_shows_the_availability_badge_and_the_nearest_schedule_text(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $next = $this->nextSessionFor($doctor);

        $html = $this->render($doctor, $next);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Tersedia · sisa 20', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Jadwal terdekat: <time datetime="2026-10-06">Selasa, 6 Oktober 2026</time> · 09.00–12.00', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Lihat Jadwal', $html);
    }

    public function test_a_leave_session_shows_its_status_without_a_register_button(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRegistrationRoute();
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => '2026-10-06', 'end_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $next = $this->nextSessionFor($doctor, ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id]);

        $html = $this->render($doctor, $next);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Cuti', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('>Daftar</a>', $html);
    }

    public function test_register_button_appears_only_for_an_online_bookable_session_when_the_route_exists(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRegistrationRoute();
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $open = $this->nextSessionFor($doctor);
        $fullDoctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $full = $this->nextSessionFor($fullDoctor, ['quota' => 1, 'booked_count' => 1]);

        $html = $this->render($doctor, $open);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('>Daftar</a>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $open->session->id]).'"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('position-relative z-2', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('>Daftar</a>', $this->render($fullDoctor, $full));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Penuh', $this->render($fullDoctor, $full));
    }

    public function test_register_button_is_hidden_while_the_registration_route_does_not_exist(): void
    {
        if (Route::has('patient.appointments.create')) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('Route patient.appointments.create sudah ada (fase 6): tombol diuji di tes fase 6.');
        }

        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('>Daftar</a>', $this->render($doctor, $this->nextSessionFor($doctor)));
    }

    public function test_the_card_never_nests_links_even_with_the_register_button(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRegistrationRoute();
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();

        $html = $this->render($doctor, $this->nextSessionFor($doctor));

        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/<a\b[^>]*>(?:(?!<\/a>).)*<a\b/s', $html));
        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i', $html));
    }
}
```

`tests/Feature/Public/PublicDoctorIndexTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Public;

use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Http\Controllers\Public\DoctorController;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman #6 `doctors.index` (05 hal. 6, 07 W-03, F3-R9/R17/R18/R25): direktori dokter yang tampil di publik,
 * filter `q`/`spesialisasi`/`poli`/`tanggal`, label ketersediaan dari DoctorAvailabilityQuery, dan pemicu
 * pembangkitan sesi harian. Mencakup CRD-01/CRD-03 (bagian #6), VAL-07, dan EMP-02.
 */
class PublicDoctorIndexTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin
        $this->markHorizonGenerated();
    }

    /** Menandai pembangkitan harian sudah berjalan agar sesi buatan tes tidak bertambah oleh templat pabrik. */
    private function markHorizonGenerated(): void
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey($today), true, $today->endOfDay());
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOf(Doctor $doctor, string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function fakeRegistrationRoute(): void
    {
        if (! Route::has('patient.appointments.create')) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/pasien/pendaftaran/baru', fn () => 'x')->name('patient.appointments.create');
            Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
        }
    }

    // --- judul, SEO, breadcrumb (F3-R18) -------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_index_renders_the_static_title_subtitle_meta_description_and_breadcrumb(): void
    {
        $this->createDoctor();

        $response = $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('<title>Cari Dokter — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('Cari berdasarkan nama, spesialisasi, poliklinik, atau tanggal praktik')
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Cari dokter UNPAM HOSPITAL berdasarkan nama, spesialisasi, poliklinik, dan tanggal.">', false)
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['aria-label="Breadcrumb"', 'Beranda', 'Dokter'], false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">Dokter</li>', false)
            ->assertSee('<link rel="canonical" href="'.route('doctors.index').'">', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">', false);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
    }

    public function test_the_page_is_marked_noindex_only_when_there_is_no_result(): void
    {
        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">', false);

        $this->createDoctor();

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertDontSee('<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">', false);
    }

    // --- dokter yang tampil (F3-R17, CRD-03 bagian #6) ------------------------------------------

    public function test_only_publicly_visible_doctors_are_listed(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic();
        $inactiveClinic = $this->createClinic(['is_active' => false]);
        $anak = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Anak']);

        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $clinic, [$anak]);
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Nonaktif Satu', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null, 'status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive], $clinic);
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Arsip Dua', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null, 'status' => DoctorStatus::Archived, 'archived_at' => now()->subDays(3)], $clinic);
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Poli Mati Tiga', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null], $inactiveClinic);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('dr. Laras Wulandari, Sp.A')
            ->assertSee('Menampilkan 1 dari 1 dokter')
            ->assertDontSee('Nonaktif Satu')
            ->assertDontSee('Arsip Dua')
            ->assertDontSee('Poli Mati Tiga');
    }

    public function test_a_new_doctor_appears_and_disappears_when_deactivated(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani');

        $doctor->forceFill(['status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive])->save();

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Rani Oktaviani');
    }

    public function test_the_page_is_identical_for_guests_patients_and_staff(): void
    {
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani');
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->patient()->create())->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani');

        foreach (['content-admin', 'registration-officer', 'super-admin'] as $role) {
            $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani');
        }
    }

    public function test_inactive_specialties_are_not_shown_on_the_cards(): void
    {
        $hidden = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Nonaktif Utama', 'is_active' => false]);
        $shown = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Aktif Tambahan']);
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Dokter Dua Spesialis'], null, [$hidden, $shown]);

        $html = $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Dokter Dua Spesialis')->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<span class="badge text-bg-light border">Spesialis Aktif Tambahan</span>', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Spesialis Nonaktif Utama', $html);
    }

    // --- filter nama, spesialisasi, poliklinik (CRD-01) ----------------------------------------

    public function test_filters_by_name_specialty_and_clinic(): void
    {
        $anak = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Anak']);
        $mata = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Mata']);
        $poliAnak = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak']);
        $poliMata = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Mata']);
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], $poliAnak, [$anak]);
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Intan Permatasari'], $poliMata, [$mata]);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['spesialisasi' => $anak->slug]))->assertOk()->assertSee('Laras Wulandari')->assertDontSee('Intan Permatasari');
        $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['poli' => $poliMata->slug]))->assertOk()->assertSee('Intan Permatasari')->assertDontSee('Laras Wulandari');
        $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['q' => 'Intan']))->assertOk()->assertSee('Intan Permatasari')->assertDontSee('Laras Wulandari');
        $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['q' => 'Mata']))->assertOk()->assertSee('Intan Permatasari')->assertDontSee('Laras Wulandari');
        $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['spesialisasi' => $anak->slug, 'poli' => $poliMata->slug]))->assertOk()->assertSee('Tidak ada dokter yang cocok');
    }

    public function test_filter_values_are_kept_in_the_form(): void
    {
        $anak = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Anak']);
        $poli = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak']);
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], $poli, [$anak]);

        $html = $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['q' => 'Laras', 'spesialisasi' => $anak->slug, 'poli' => $poli->slug, 'tanggal' => '2026-10-07']))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('value="Laras"', $html);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/<option value="'.preg_quote($anak->slug, '/').'"\s+selected>/', $html);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/<option value="'.preg_quote($poli->slug, '/').'"\s+selected>/', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('value="2026-10-07"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Filter (4 aktif)', $html);
    }

    public function test_a_new_specialty_appears_in_the_filter_and_a_deactivated_one_disappears(): void
    {
        $new = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Contoh Baru']);
        $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Nonaktif', 'is_active' => false]);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<option value="'.$new->slug.'"', false)
            ->assertSee('Contoh Baru')
            ->assertDontSee('Spesialis Nonaktif');

        $new->update(['is_active' => false]);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Contoh Baru');
    }

    public function test_only_active_polyclinics_are_offered_in_the_clinic_filter(): void
    {
        $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Aktif']);
        $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Tutup', 'is_active' => false]);
        $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Laboratorium Uji'])->forceFill(['type' => 'penunjang', 'is_bookable' => false])->save();

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Poliklinik Aktif')
            ->assertDontSee('Poliklinik Tutup')
            ->assertDontSee('Laboratorium Uji');
    }

    // --- filter tanggal dan label ketersediaan --------------------------------------------------

    public function test_date_filter_keeps_doctors_with_a_session_that_day_including_leave_and_shows_their_status(): void
    {
        $available = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $onLeave = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Teguh Wicaksono', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $other = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Ayu Larasati', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->sessionOf($available, '2026-10-07');
        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $onLeave->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => '2026-10-07', 'end_date' => '2026-10-07']);
        $this->sessionOf($onLeave, '2026-10-07', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id, 'status_reason' => 'Cuti tahunan']);
        $this->sessionOf($other, '2026-10-08');

        $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['tanggal' => '2026-10-07']))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani')
            ->assertSee('Tersedia · sisa 20')
            ->assertSee('Jadwal terdekat: <time datetime="2026-10-07">Rabu, 7 Oktober 2026</time> · 09.00–12.00', false)
            ->assertSee('dr. Teguh Wicaksono')
            ->assertSee('data-availability="leave"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Ayu Larasati');
    }

    public function test_without_a_date_cards_show_the_nearest_session_that_is_not_a_cancellation(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => '2026-10-06', 'end_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Jadwal terdekat: <time datetime="2026-10-08">Kamis, 8 Oktober 2026</time> · 13.00–15.00', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Selasa, 6 Oktober 2026');
    }

    public function test_a_doctor_without_upcoming_sessions_has_a_plain_card(): void
    {
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani')->assertDontSee('Jadwal terdekat');
    }

    public function test_register_button_on_the_card_needs_the_route_and_an_online_bookable_session(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRegistrationRoute();
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $session = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07');

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $session->id]).'"', false);

        $session->forceFill(['status' => SessionStatus::Closed])->save();

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertDontSee('?sesi=', false);
    }

    // --- parameter tidak valid (VAL-07) dan tanggal di luar jendela -----------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>}> */
    public static function invalidFilters(): array
    {
        return [
            'tanggal tidak valid, spesialisasi tak dikenal, poli array' => [['tanggal' => 'abc', 'spesialisasi' => 'tidak-ada', 'poli' => ['x']]],
            'q array' => [['q' => ['x']]],

    {
        $this->assertTrue(Model::preventsLazyLoading());

        $anak = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Anak']);
        $umum = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Dokter Umum']);

        foreach (range(1, 13) as $number) {
            $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => sprintf('Dokter Uji %02d', $number), 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null, 'sort_order' => $number], null, [$anak, $umum]);

            foreach (['2026-10-06', '2026-10-08', '2026-10-13'] as $date) {
                $this->sessionOf($doctor, $date);
            }
        }

        $first = $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk();
        $second = $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['page' => 2]))->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame(12, substr_count($first->getContent(), 'doctor-card"'));
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($second->getContent(), 'doctor-card"'));
        $first->assertSee('Menampilkan 12 dari 13 dokter')->assertSee('dr. Dokter Uji 12')->assertDontSee('dr. Dokter Uji 13');
        $second->assertSee('Menampilkan 1 dari 13 dokter')->assertSee('dr. Dokter Uji 13');
    }

    public function test_visiting_the_page_triggers_the_daily_generation_once(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 3, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-05']);
        Cache::forget(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()));

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->count()); // Rabu 7, 14, 21, 28 Okt dan 4 Nov
        $this->assertTrue(Cache::has(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today())));

        PracticeSession::query()->delete();
        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count(), 'Penanda harian mencegah pembangkitan kedua.');
    }

    public function test_a_lock_held_by_another_process_does_not_block_the_page(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 3, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-05']);
        Cache::forget(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()));

        $lock = Cache::lock(PracticeSessionGenerator::LOCK_KEY, 30);
        $this->assertTrue($lock->get());

        try {
            $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani');
        } finally {
            $lock->release();
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    {
        $source = (string) file_get_contents((new \ReflectionClass(DoctorController::class))->getFileName());

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ensureDailyHorizon()', $source);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('PracticeSession::', $source);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('DB::', $source);
    }

    public function test_the_page_has_no_inline_handlers_and_no_external_resources(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i', $html));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onerror', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('javascript:', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('blob:', $html);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\View\Components;

use App\Enums\Availability;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\View\Component;

/**
 * Lencana ketersediaan sesi (10 §3.4). Selalu menampilkan ikon, teks, dan warna (00 D); warna dan ikon diambil
 * dari enum `Availability` apa adanya (F3-R13). Bila `available` dan `remaining` diisi, teksnya "Tersedia · sisa {n}";
 * pada mode `compact` (sel grid mingguan) teks yang tampak "Sisa {n}" dan kata "Tersedia" tetap dibaca pembaca layar.
 */
class AvailabilityBadge extends Component
{
    public string $label;

    public string $color;

    public string $icon;

    /** Awalan khusus pembaca layar pada mode kompak ("Tersedia, "); kosong pada kasus lain. */
    public string $srPrefix = '';

    public function __construct(
        public Availability $availability,
        public ?int $remaining = null,
        public bool $compact = false,
    ) {
        $this->color = $availability->color();
        $this->icon = $availability->icon();
        $this->label = $availability->label();

        if ($availability === Availability::Available && $remaining !== null) {
            $left = max(0, $remaining);

            if ($compact) {
                $this->label = "Sisa {$left}";
                $this->srPrefix = 'Tersedia, ';
            } else {
                $this->label = "Tersedia · sisa {$left}";
            }
        }
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('components.availability-badge');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Requests\Public;

use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

/**
 * Filter halaman #6 Daftar Dokter (05 hal. 6, 00 I.5): `q`, `spesialisasi` (slug), `poli` (slug), `tanggal`.
 * GET-filter longgar (12 V-45, VAL-07): nilai yang tidak lolos aturan diabaikan, tidak pernah menjadi galat 500
 * atau pengalihan; hanya `tanggal` yang gagal diberi pesan inline (`dateError()`).
 */
final class DoctorIndexRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, string>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $last = $today->addDays($this->windowDays());

        return [
            'q' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'spesialisasi' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:170'],
            'poli' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:170'],
            'tanggal' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'after_or_equal:'.$today->toDateString(), 'before_or_equal:'.$last->toDateString()],
            'page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'q.string' => 'Kata kunci tidak valid.',
            'q.max' => 'Kata kunci maksimal 100 karakter.',
            'tanggal.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid. Gunakan format TTTT-BB-HH.',
            'tanggal.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal praktik tidak boleh sebelum hari ini.',
            'tanggal.before_or_equal' => "Tanggal praktik maksimal {$this->windowDays()} hari ke depan.",
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Tidak melempar: filter yang tidak valid diabaikan dan halaman tetap tampil (VAL-07).
     */
    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator): void
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Hanya parameter yang lolos aturan (tanpa `page`, yang dibaca paginator sendiri). Validator::valid()
     * mengembalikan seluruh input dikurangi yang gagal, sehingga hasilnya diiris ke kunci yang beraturan.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function filters(): array
    {
        $valid = $this->getValidatorInstance()->valid();
        $filters = [];

        foreach (['q', 'spesialisasi', 'poli', 'tanggal'] as $key) {
            $value = $valid[$key] ?? null;

            if (is_string($value) && trim($value) !== '') {
                $filters[$key] = trim($value);
            }
        }

        return $filters;
    }

    /** Pesan galat `tanggal` untuk ditampilkan di bawah field, atau null bila tanggal kosong atau valid. */
    public function dateError(): ?string
    {
        $message = $this->getValidatorInstance()->errors()->first('tanggal');

        return $message === '' ? null : $message;
    }

    /** Jendela pendaftaran dalam hari (`booking.window_days`, minimal 1). */
    private function windowDays(): int
    {
        return max(1, app(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules()->windowDays);
    }
}
```

```php
/**
 * Halaman publik dokter (#6 `doctors.index`, #7 `doctors.show`). Jadwal dibaca hanya lewat
 * DoctorAvailabilityQuery (sumber yang sama dengan #8 dan wizard, JDW-12); pembangkitan sesi harian dipicu di sini
 * (F3-R9). Tanpa Policy: dokter yang tidak tampil di publik menjawab 404 untuk semua orang (F3-R17).
 */
class DoctorController extends Controller
{
    /** Jumlah kartu per halaman (07 W-03). */
    public const PER_PAGE = 12;

    public function index(
        DoctorIndexRequest $request,
        PracticeSessionGenerator $generator,
        DoctorAvailabilityQuery $query,
        SettingsService $settings,
    ): View {
        // Pemicu (b) pembangkitan sesi harian; kunci tidak menunggu, jadi halaman tetap tampil (F3-R8).
        $generator->ensureDailyHorizon();

        $filters = $request->filters();
        $errors = new MessageBag;

        if (($dateError = $request->dateError()) !== null) {
            $errors->add('tanggal', $dateError);
        }

        $specialties = Specialty::query()->active()->ordered()->get(['id', 'name', 'slug']);
        $clinics = Clinic::query()->active()->where('type', ClinicType::Poliklinik->value)->ordered()->get(['id', 'name', 'slug']);

        $specialty = null;

        if (isset($filters['spesialisasi'])) {
            $specialty = $specialties->firstWhere('slug', $filters['spesialisasi']);

            if ($specialty === null) {
                $errors->add('spesialisasi', 'Spesialisasi tidak dikenal. Filter ini diabaikan.');
                unset($filters['spesialisasi']);
            }
        }

        $clinic = null;

        if (isset($filters['poli'])) {
            $clinic = $clinics->firstWhere('slug', $filters['poli']);

            if ($clinic === null) {
                $errors->add('poli', 'Poliklinik tidak dikenal. Filter ini diabaikan.');
                unset($filters['poli']);
            }
        }

        $date = isset($filters['tanggal']) ? CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $filters['tanggal']) : null;

        $doctors = $query->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter(
            clinicId: $clinic?->id,
            specialtyId: $specialty?->id,
            q: $filters['q'] ?? null,
            date: $date ?: null,
        ), self::PER_PAGE);

        $nextSessions = [];

        foreach ($doctors as $doctor) {
            // Data publik hanya memuat spesialisasi aktif (D-56); pivot `is_primary` tetap terbawa.
            $doctor->setRelation('specialties', $doctor->specialties->filter(fn (Specialty $item): bool => $item->is_active)->values());
            $nextSessions[$doctor->id] = $this->nextSession($doctor->availabilities, $date !== null);
        }

        // Galat inline dibagikan ke semua view (termasuk komponen `x-form.*`), bukan lewat `->withErrors()` yang hanya
        // terlihat oleh view induk dan tidak sampai ke komponen anonim (diverifikasi saat pemeriksaan konsistensi 2).
        view()->share('errors', (new ViewErrorBag)->put('default', $errors));

        return view('public.doctors.index', [
            'doctors' => $doctors,
            'nextSessions' => $nextSessions,
            'filters' => $filters,
            'specialtyOptions' => ['' => 'Semua spesialisasi'] + $specialties->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'clinicOptions' => ['' => 'Semua poliklinik'] + $clinics->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'windowDays' => max(1, $settings->bookingRules()->windowDays),
            'today' => CarbonImmutable::today(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Sesi yang diwakili pada kartu: dengan filter tanggal, sesi pertama pada tanggal itu (termasuk Cuti/Libur agar
     * pengunjung tahu alasannya); tanpa filter, sesi terdekat yang bukan pembatalan (F3-R25).
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, SessionAvailability>  $availabilities
     */
    private function nextSession(Collection $availabilities, bool $forDate): ?SessionAvailability
    {
        if ($forDate) {
            return $availabilities->first();
        }

        $cancellations = [Availability::Leave, Availability::Holiday, Availability::Cancelled];

        return $availabilities->first(
            fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => ! in_array($item->availability, $cancellations, true),
        );
    }
}
```

### Task 14: Halaman #7 Detail Dokter dan #8 Jadwal Dokter

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Public/ScheduleIndexRequest.php`, `app/Http/Controllers/Public/ScheduleController.php`
- Modify: `app/Http/Controllers/Public/DoctorController.php` (method `show`; dua impor), `routes/web.php` (route `doctors.show` dan `schedules.index`), `resources/scss/_public.scss`
- Create: `resources/views/public/doctors/show.blade.php`, `resources/views/public/schedules/index.blade.php`, `resources/views/public/schedules/_week-grid.blade.php`, `resources/views/public/partials/_availability-legend.blade.php`
- Modify (tes fase 1/2 yang tadinya *skip* atau memalsukan route; kini positif): `tests/Feature/View/DoctorCardComponentTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Public/PublicClinicDetailTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Errors/ErrorPagesTest.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Public/PublicDoctorPagesTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Public/PublicScheduleTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 13: `DoctorController@index` (file yang sama diperluas), `x-schedule-table`, `x-availability-badge`, `x-doctor-card`, pola `public.*`.
  - Task 4/5/6/7: `PracticeSessionGenerator::ensureDailyHorizon()`, `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::sessions()` (`AvailabilityFilter` dengan `doctorId`, `clinicId`, `from`, `to`, `includePast`), `SettingsService::bookingRules()`, `ScheduleChangeService::applyTemplateCreated()`/`applyTemplateChange()`/`applyException()` (hanya di tes CRD-05), `Actor::system()`.
  - Fase 2: `Doctor::publiclyVisible()`, `Doctor::firstMedia('photo')`, `Clinic::active()->ordered()`, `route('clinics.show')`, `x-image`.
- Produces:
  - Route `GET /dokter/{doctor:slug}` → `doctors.show` dan `GET /jadwal-dokter` → `schedules.index` (grup `web`, tanpa middleware izin).
  - `DoctorController@show(Doctor, PracticeSessionGenerator, DoctorAvailabilityQuery)`: 404 tanpa Policy bila bukan `publiclyVisible` (juga untuk staf, F3-R17/A-42); memanggil `ensureDailyHorizon()`; jadwal 14 hari (hari ini … hari ini + 13) lewat `sessions()` ke `x-schedule-table :show-doctor="false"`; bio sebagai teks biasa (`white-space: pre-line`); SEO: `meta_title` (cadangan "{nama tampilan} — {spesialisasi utama}") dan `meta_description` (cadangan `short_bio`, dipotong 160).
  - `App\Http\Requests\Public\ScheduleIndexRequest` (`filters()`, `weekError()`), `ScheduleController@index(ScheduleIndexRequest, PracticeSessionGenerator, DoctorAvailabilityQuery, SettingsService)`; view `public.schedules.index` (variabel `items`, `days`, `byDate`, `rows`, `weekStart`, `weekEnd`, `weekLabel`, `previousWeek`, `nextWeek`, `notice`, `filters`, `clinicOptions`, `doctorOptions`).
  - Partial `public.schedules._week-grid` (grid mingguan, baris = dokter, kolom = Senin–Minggu, ≥ md) dan `public.partials._availability-legend` (legenda sembilan status, selalu tampil).
  - Kelas SCSS `.doctor-bio`, `.availability-badge`, `.week-grid`, `.week-cell-item`, `.week-cell-link`, `.availability-legend`.

**Test IDs:** CRD-03 (URL langsung dokter nonaktif/arsip/poliklinik nonaktif **404**, juga untuk staf), CRD-05 (templat baru terlihat di `/jadwal-dokter` dan `doctors.show`; nonaktif atau cuti hilang atau berlabel), JDW-12 (kontrak: #7 dan #8 memakai kelas yang sama dan menampilkan `availability`/`remaining` yang sama), JDW-05 sisi tampilan (label sesi berakhir/batas online/jendela), VAL-07 (`/jadwal-dokter?minggu=xx`), Review Focus 1 (`minggu` di luar jendela, hari ke-30 versus ke-31) dan 4 (404, mode ketat), AKS publik #7 dan #8 (matriks lima aktor penuh di Task 16), F3-R17, F3-R18, F3-R24.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **404 tanpa Policy.** `show` memeriksa `Doctor::publiclyVisible()->whereKey(...)->exists()` setelah route-model binding, sebelum `ensureDailyHorizon()`; staf yang login mendapat 404 yang sama (A-42). Route memakai `{doctor:slug}`; `route('doctors.show', $doctor)` menghasilkan slug karena `RouteUrlGenerator` memakai `bindingFieldFor` (pola `clinics.show`, F2-R4).
- **Satu sumber.** Kedua controller tidak menyentuh `PracticeSession` sendiri; `show` memakai `sessions()` (`doctorId`, 14 hari) dan `index` memakai `sessions()` untuk satu minggu (`includePast = true`). Mockery tidak dapat menirukan `DoctorAvailabilityQuery` (`final`), jadi JDW-12 dibuktikan dua cara: tes perilaku (nilai di baris #7 dan #8 sama dengan hasil kueri) dan tes kontrak berbasis sumber (kedua controller memuat `DoctorAvailabilityQuery` dan `ensureDailyHorizon()`, dan tidak memuat `PracticeSession::` atau `DB::`).
- **Minggu.** `minggu` dinormalisasi dengan `startOfWeek(CarbonInterface::MONDAY)` eksplisit (tidak bergantung pada awal pekan locale). Minggu pertama = minggu `today`; minggu terakhir = minggu yang memuat `today + booking.window_days` (pada 5 Oktober 2026: 2–8 November, karena hari terakhir jendela Rabu 4 November). `minggu` sebelum minggu pertama ⇒ minggu ini + "Menampilkan minggu ini."; sesudah minggu terakhir ⇒ minggu terakhir + "Jadwal hanya tersedia sampai {j F Y}."; format salah ⇒ minggu ini + "Format minggu tidak valid. Menampilkan minggu ini." Tombol minggu sebelumnya/berikutnya di luar batas menjadi `span` `disabled` + `aria-disabled`.
- **Dua tata letak, satu koleksi.** HTML memuat grid (`data-week-grid`, `d-none d-md-block`) dan daftar bertumpuk (`data-week-stack`, `d-md-none`) sekaligus; tes membatasi asersi per bagian (`gridOf()`) atau per baris (`rowFor()`, mengabaikan baris judul) agar tidak terkecoh duplikasi. Legenda memuat sembilan label sehingga tes tidak memakai `assertDontSee('Cuti')` dan sejenisnya; yang dipakai adalah atribut `data-availability` per baris atau per sel.
- **Sesi lampau.** Generator tidak membuat sesi lampau (F3-R7), jadi "Sudah lewat" hanya muncul untuk sesi hari ini yang sudah berakhir pada minggu berjalan; tes memajukan jam ke 13.00.
- **Spesialisasi aktif saja (D-56).** `sessions()` memuat `doctor.specialties` tanpa batasan; tabel dan grid menyaring ke spesialisasi aktif (utama lebih dulu) di view, sedangkan `show` memuat relasi yang sudah dibatasi.
- **Legenda dan SCSS.** Kelas baru ditambahkan sebelum blok `.rich-text` di `_public.scss`; `.week-cell-item + .week-cell-item` memberi jarak antarsesi pada satu sel. SCSS diuji kompilasi dengan `sass` terhadap `app.scss`; `npm run build` wajib di akhir task.
- **Tautan Hubungi Kami.** Keadaan kosong #7 menautkan `contact` hanya bila route itu ada (fase 4a); tes memakai route palsu dan versi "tanpa route" di-*skip* bila fase 4a sudah menambahkannya.
- **Tes lama yang dijadikan positif** (maksudnya dipertahankan): `DoctorCardComponentTest` (tautan nama ke `doctors.show`; impor `Route` yang tak terpakai dihapus agar Pint bersih), `PublicClinicDetailTest` (tombol Jadwal Dokter kini selalu ada; tautan Daftar Kunjungan tetap tersembunyi tanpa route fase 6; kartu dokter selalu bertaut), dan `ErrorPagesTest` (tautan "Cari Dokter" dan "Jadwal Dokter" di halaman 404).
- Jumlah tes baru: **55** (#7 20, #8 35) ditambah lima tes lama yang dijadikan positif (jumlah tidak berubah). Semua blok PHP lolos `php -l` 8.2 dan `pint --test`; semua view Blade dikompilasi; SCSS dikompilasi; jangkar Edit dicocokkan dengan berkas nyata dalam urutan Task 13 → 14.

```php
/**
 * Halaman #7 `doctors.show` (05 hal. 7, 07 W-04, F3-R9/R17): 404 untuk dokter yang tidak tampil (juga bagi staf,
 * A-42), identitas dan biodata teks biasa, SEO, serta jadwal 14 hari dari DoctorAvailabilityQuery. Mencakup
 * CRD-03 (URL langsung) dan Review Focus 4.
 */
class PublicDoctorPagesTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin
        $this->markHorizonGenerated();
    }

    private function markHorizonGenerated(): void
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey($today), true, $today->endOfDay());
    }

    private function url(Doctor $doctor): string
    {
        return route('doctors.show', $doctor->slug);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOf(Doctor $doctor, string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /** Baris tabel jadwal (bukan baris judul) yang memuat tanggal tersebut. */
    private function rowFor(string $html, string $date): string
    {
        preg_match_all('#<tr>.*?</tr>#s', $html, $matches);

        foreach ($matches[0] as $row) {
            if (! str_contains($row, 'scope="col"') && str_contains($row, 'datetime="'.$date.'"')) {
                return $row;
            }
        }

        $this->fail("Baris jadwal untuk {$date} tidak ditemukan.");
    }

    private function fakeRoute(string $name, string $uri): void
    {
        if (! Route::has($name)) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get($uri, fn () => 'x')->name($name);
            Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
        }
    }

    // --- 404 (F3-R17, A-42, CRD-03) ------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_doctors_that_are_not_publicly_visible_are_404_for_guests_patients_and_every_staff_role(): void
    {
        $inactiveClinic = $this->createClinic(['is_active' => false]);
        $hidden = [
            $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Nonaktif Satu', 'status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive]),
            $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Arsip Dua', 'status' => DoctorStatus::Archived, 'archived_at' => now()->subDays(3)]),
            $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Poli Mati Tiga'], $inactiveClinic),
        ];

        foreach ($hidden as $doctor) {
            $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertNotFound()->assertDontSee($doctor->name);

            foreach (['content-admin', 'registration-officer', 'super-admin'] as $role) {
                $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))->get($this->url($doctor))->assertNotFound();
            }

            $this->actingAs(User::factory()->patient()->create())->get($this->url($doctor))->assertNotFound();
        }
    }

    public function test_unknown_slug_is_404(): void
    {
        $this->get('/dokter/slug-yang-tidak-ada')->assertNotFound();
    }

    public function test_a_doctor_becomes_404_as_soon_as_the_status_changes(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani');

        $doctor->forceFill(['status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive])->save();
        $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertNotFound();

        $doctor->forceFill(['status' => DoctorStatus::Archived, 'archived_at' => now()])->save();
        $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertNotFound();
    }

    public function test_the_page_is_open_to_every_actor_for_a_visible_doctor(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->patient()->create())->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk();

        foreach (['content-admin', 'registration-officer', 'super-admin'] as $role) {
            $this->actingAs($this->createStaff($role))->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk();
        }
    }

    // --- identitas, biodata, SEO ---------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_show_renders_identity_specialties_clinic_and_profile(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Jantung', 'location' => 'Gedung B Lt. 1']);
        $jantung = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Jantung']);
        $dalam = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Penyakit Dalam']);
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor([
            'name' => 'Maya Kartika Sari', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.JP',
            'short_bio' => 'Melayani konsultasi jantung.', 'bio' => "Paragraf satu.\n\nParagraf dua.",
        ], $clinic, [$jantung, $dalam]);

        $response = $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('dr. Maya Kartika Sari, Sp.JP')
            ->assertSee('Jantung (utama)')
            ->assertSee('Penyakit Dalam')
            ->assertSee('Poliklinik Jantung')
            ->assertSee('Gedung B Lt. 1')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('clinics.show', $clinic).'"', false)
            ->assertSee('Profil singkat')
            ->assertSee('Melayani konsultasi jantung.')
            ->assertSee('Biodata')
            ->assertSee("Paragraf satu.\n\nParagraf dua.")
            ->assertSee('Jadwal praktik 14 hari ke depan')
            ->assertSee('Lihat jadwal mingguan semua dokter')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('schedules.index').'"', false);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));
    }

    public function test_the_biography_is_plain_text_shown_with_pre_line(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['bio' => "Baris satu.\n\n<script>alert(1)</script> <b>tebal</b>"]);

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<div class="doctor-bio">', false)
            ->assertSee('&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt; &lt;b&gt;tebal&lt;/b&gt;', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(1)</script>', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<b>tebal</b>', false);
    }

    public function test_inactive_specialties_are_hidden_and_the_card_survives_without_any_badge(): void
    {
        $hidden = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Nonaktif Utama', 'is_active' => false]);
        $shown = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Aktif Tambahan']);
        $both = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Dokter Dua Spesialis'], null, [$hidden, $shown]);
        $only = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Dokter Tanpa Lencana'], null, [$hidden]);

        $this->get($this->url($both))->assertOk()->assertSee('Spesialis Aktif Tambahan')->assertDontSee('Spesialis Nonaktif Utama');
        $this->get($this->url($only))->assertOk()->assertSee('Dokter Tanpa Lencana')->assertDontSee('Spesialis Nonaktif Utama');
    }

    public function test_title_and_description_fall_back_to_name_specialty_and_short_bio(): void
    {
        $anak = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Anak']);
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor([
            'name' => 'Laras Wulandari', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A',
            'short_bio' => str_repeat('Melayani konsultasi anak. ', 12), 'meta_title' => null, 'meta_description' => null,
        ], null, [$anak]);

        $html = $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<title>dr. Laras Wulandari, Sp.A — Anak — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:title" content="dr. Laras Wulandari, Sp.A — Anak">', false)
            ->assertSee('<link rel="canonical" href="'.$this->url($doctor).'">', false)
            ->assertDontSee('og:image', false)
            ->getContent();

        preg_match('/<meta name="description" content="([^"]*)">/', $html, $match);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($match);
        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(160, mb_strlen(html_entity_decode($match[1])));
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('Melayani konsultasi anak.', html_entity_decode($match[1]));
    }

    public function test_meta_fields_override_the_defaults_and_a_photo_adds_og_image(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari', 'meta_title' => 'Dokter Anak Terdekat', 'meta_description' => 'Deskripsi SEO khusus.']);
        $this->app->make(MediaService::class)->store(ImageFixtures::jpeg(600, 600, 'foto.jpg'), 'photo', $doctor, ['alt_text' => 'Foto contoh dokter']);

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('<title>Dokter Anak Terdekat — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta name="description" content="Deskripsi SEO khusus.">', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta property="og:image" content="', false);
    }

    public function test_missing_photo_uses_the_local_placeholder_with_an_alt_text(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('images/placeholders/doctor.svg', false)
            ->assertSee('alt="Foto dr. Laras Wulandari"', false);
    }

    public function test_breadcrumb_ends_with_the_doctor_name_without_a_link(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['aria-label="Breadcrumb"', 'Beranda', 'Dokter', 'dr. Laras Wulandari'], false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="'.route('doctors.index').'">Dokter</a></li>', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">dr. Laras Wulandari</li>', false);
    }

    // --- jadwal 14 hari (F3-R12 label, JDW-05) -------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_schedule_covers_today_through_day_thirteen_and_skips_ended_sessions(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-05', ['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-18');
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-19');

        $html = $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('datetime="2026-10-05"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('datetime="2026-10-18"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('datetime="2026-10-19"', $html);

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 13:00:00');

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('datetime="2026-10-05"', $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()->getContent());
    }

    public function test_each_session_shows_its_label_remaining_quota_and_time(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $leave = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => '2026-10-09', 'end_date' => '2026-10-09']);
        $holiday = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => null, 'type' => ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-05', ['start_time' => '07:30:00', 'end_time' => '09:00:00']);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['quota' => 5, 'booked_count' => 5]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08', ['status' => SessionStatus::NeedsReview, 'pending_change' => ['source' => 'template_time', 'schedule_id' => 1, 'new_start_time' => '10:00', 'new_end_time' => '13:00']]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-09', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $leave->id]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-12', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $holiday->id]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-13', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:30:00', 'quota' => 15, 'booked_count' => 4]);

        $html = $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $expected = [
            '2026-10-05' => ['booking_closed', '07.30–09.00', '20 dari 20'],
            '2026-10-06' => ['full', '09.00–12.00', '0 dari 5'],
            '2026-10-07' => ['closed', '09.00–12.00', '20 dari 20'],
            '2026-10-08' => ['under_review', '09.00–12.00', '20 dari 20'],
            '2026-10-09' => ['leave', '09.00–12.00', 'tidak berlaku'],
            '2026-10-12' => ['holiday', '09.00–12.00', 'tidak berlaku'],
            '2026-10-13' => ['available', '13.00–15.30', '11 dari 15'],
        ];

        foreach ($expected as $date => [$availability, $time, $quota]) {
            $row = $this->rowFor($html, $date);

            $this->assertStringContainsString('data-availability="'.$availability.'"', $row, $date);
            $this->assertStringContainsString($time, $row, $date);
            $this->assertStringContainsString($quota, $row, $date);
        }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Tersedia · sisa 11', $this->rowFor($html, '2026-10-13'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Keterangan status', $html);
    }

    public function test_the_register_button_exists_only_for_online_bookable_sessions_when_the_route_exists(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRoute('patient.appointments.create', '/_uji/pasien/pendaftaran/baru');
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $open = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07');
        $full = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08', ['quota' => 1, 'booked_count' => 1]);
        $closed = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-09', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]);

        $html = $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $open->id]).'"', $this->rowFor($html, '2026-10-07'));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('?sesi='.$full->id.'"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('?sesi='.$closed->id.'"', $html);
    }

    public function test_an_empty_schedule_shows_the_empty_state_without_a_contact_link_when_the_route_is_missing(): void
    {
        if (Route::has('contact')) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('Route contact sudah ada (fase 4a): tautan diuji di tes fase tersebut.');
        }

        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Belum ada jadwal praktik dua minggu ke depan')
            ->assertDontSee('Hubungi Kami')
            ->assertDontSee('<table', false);
    }

    public function test_an_empty_schedule_links_to_contact_when_the_route_exists(): void
    {
        $this->fakeRoute('contact', '/_uji/kontak');
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Belum ada jadwal praktik dua minggu ke depan')
            ->assertSee('href="'.route('contact').'"', false);
    }

    // --- tautan ke halaman dokter di kartu dan tabel (route kini ada) ---------------------------

    public function test_doctor_cards_and_schedule_tables_link_to_the_doctor_page(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07');

        $this->get(route('doctors.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('href="'.$this->url($doctor).'"', false);
        $this->get(route('schedules.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('href="'.$this->url($doctor).'"', false);
    }

    // --- pembangkitan sesi harian (F3-R9) dan mode ketat ---------------------------------------

    public function test_visiting_the_page_triggers_the_daily_generation(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 3, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-05']);
        Cache::forget(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()));

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());

        $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()->assertSee('datetime="2026-10-07"', false);

        $this->assertSame(5, PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_many_sessions_and_specialties_render_in_strict_mode(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(Model::preventsLazyLoading());

        $a = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Anak']);
        $b = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Dokter Umum']);
        $other = Clinic::factory()->create(['name' => 'Poliklinik Lain']);
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani'], null, [$a, $b]);

        foreach (range(0, 13) as $offset) {
            $date = CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays($offset)->toDateString();
            $this->sessionOf($doctor, $date);
            $this->sessionOf($doctor, $date, ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00', 'clinic_id' => $other->id]);
        }

        $html = $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(28, substr_count($html, '<th scope="row"'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Poliklinik Lain', $html);
    }

    public function test_the_page_has_no_inline_handlers(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07');

        $html = $this->get($this->url($doctor))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertSame(0, preg_match('/\son[a-z]+\s*=/i', $html));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onerror', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('javascript:', $html);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Halaman #8 `schedules.index` (05 hal. 8, 07 W-05, F3-R9/R17/R18/R24): grid mingguan dan daftar bertumpuk dari
 * koleksi DoctorAvailabilityQuery yang sama. Mencakup CRD-05, JDW-12 (kontrak: #7 dan #8 memakai kelas yang sama dan
 * menampilkan nilai yang sama), VAL-07, dan Review Focus 1/4.
 */
class PublicScheduleTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin; jendela pendaftaran 30 hari berakhir Rabu 4 November
        $this->markHorizonGenerated();
    }

    private function markHorizonGenerated(): void
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey($today), true, $today->endOfDay());
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOf(Doctor $doctor, string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function rowFor(string $html, string $date): string
    {
        preg_match_all('#<tr>.*?</tr>#s', $html, $matches);

        foreach ($matches[0] as $row) {
            if (! str_contains($row, 'scope="col"') && str_contains($row, 'datetime="'.$date.'"')) {
                return $row;
            }
        }

        $this->fail("Baris jadwal untuk {$date} tidak ditemukan.");
    }

    /** Bagian grid mingguan saja (tanpa daftar bertumpuk dan legenda). */
    private function gridOf(string $html): string
    {
        $start = strpos($html, 'data-week-grid');
        $end = strpos($html, 'data-week-stack');
        $this->assertNotFalse($start);

        return substr($html, $start, ($end === false ? strlen($html) : $end) - $start);
    }

    private function fakeRegistrationRoute(): void
    {
        if (! Route::has('patient.appointments.create')) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/pasien/pendaftaran/baru', fn () => 'x')->name('patient.appointments.create');

    // --- judul, SEO, breadcrumb, legenda (F3-R18) -----------------------------------------------

    public function test_index_renders_the_static_title_subtitle_meta_description_and_breadcrumb(): void

    {

        foreach (Availability::cases() as $case) {

    public function test_grid_has_a_row_per_doctor_a_column_per_day_and_one_cell_per_session(): void
    {

    public function test_visiting_the_page_triggers_the_daily_generation(): void
```
