```php
    public function test_crd_05_a_new_template_shows_up_and_deactivating_or_a_leave_removes_or_relabels_it(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $service = app(ScheduleChangeService::class);
        $schedule = $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id, 'day_of_week' => 1, 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00', 'quota' => 15, 'valid_from' => '2026-10-05']);
        $service->applyTemplateCreated($schedule, Actor::system());

        $detail = $this->get(route('doctors.show', $doctor->slug))->assertOk()->getContent();
        $week = $this->get(route('schedules.index'))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('15 dari 15', $this->rowFor($detail, '2026-10-05'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('09.00–12.00', $this->rowFor($week, '2026-10-05'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('dr. Rani Oktaviani', $this->gridOf($week));

        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => '2026-10-12', 'end_date' => '2026-10-12']);
        $service->applyException($exception, null, Actor::system());

        $afterLeave = $this->get(route('doctors.show', $doctor->slug))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-availability="leave"', $this->rowFor($afterLeave, '2026-10-12'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-availability="available"', $this->rowFor($afterLeave, '2026-10-05'));

        $schedule->is_active = false;
        $before = $schedule->getOriginal();
        $schedule->save();
        $service->applyTemplateChange($schedule, $before, Actor::system());

        $this->get(route('doctors.show', $doctor->slug))->assertOk()->assertSee('Belum ada jadwal praktik dua minggu ke depan');
        $this->get(route('schedules.index'))->assertOk()->assertSee('Tidak ada jadwal praktik pada pekan ini');
    }

    // --- JDW-12: satu sumber jadwal ------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_jdw_12_detail_and_week_pages_show_exactly_what_the_shared_query_returns(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $leave = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => '2026-10-09', 'end_date' => '2026-10-09']);
        $full = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['quota' => 2]);
        $this->bookAppointment($full, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->bookAppointment($full, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07', ['quota' => 15, 'booked_count' => 4]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-09', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $leave->id]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-10', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:30:00']);

        $expected = app(DoctorAvailabilityQuery::class)->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(
            doctorId: $doctor->id,
            from: CarbonImmutable::today(),
            to: CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays(13),
        ));
        $this->assertCount(5, $expected);

        $detail = $this->get(route('doctors.show', $doctor->slug))->assertOk()->getContent();
        $week = $this->get(route('schedules.index'))->assertOk()->getContent();
        $grid = $this->gridOf($week);

        foreach ($expected as $item) {
            $date = $item->session->session_date->toDateString();
            $detailRow = $this->rowFor($detail, $date);
            $weekRow = $this->rowFor(substr($week, (int) strpos($week, 'data-week-stack')), $date);

            foreach ([$detailRow, $weekRow] as $row) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString('data-availability="'.$item->availability->value.'"', $row, $date);
                $this->assertStringContainsString($item->session->time_range, $row, $date);

                if (! in_array($item->availability, [Availability::Leave, Availability::Holiday, Availability::Cancelled], true)) {
                    $this->assertStringContainsString($item->remaining.' dari '.$item->session->quota, $row, $date);
                }
            }

            $this->assertStringContainsString('data-availability="'.$item->availability->value.'"', $grid);

            if ($item->availability === Availability::Available) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString('Sisa '.$item->remaining, $grid);
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame(['full', 'available', 'closed', 'leave', 'available'], $expected->map(fn ($item): string => $item->availability->value)->all());
    }

    public function test_jdw_12_both_public_controllers_use_the_shared_query_and_the_daily_generator(): void
    {
        foreach ([DoctorController::class, ScheduleController::class] as $controller) {
            $source = (string) file_get_contents((new ReflectionClass($controller))->getFileName());

            $this->assertStringContainsString('DoctorAvailabilityQuery', $source, $controller);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('ensureDailyHorizon()', $source, $controller);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('PracticeSession::', $source, $controller);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('DB::', $source, $controller);
        }
    }
```

```php
    public function show(
        Doctor $doctor,
        PracticeSessionGenerator $generator,
        DoctorAvailabilityQuery $query,
    ): View {
        // Tanpa Policy: dokter nonaktif, arsip, atau di poliklinik nonaktif = 404 untuk semua orang, termasuk staf (A-42).
        abort_unless(Doctor::query()->publiclyVisible()->whereKey($doctor->getKey())->exists(), 404);

        $generator->ensureDailyHorizon();

        $doctor->load([
            'clinic',
            'specialties' => fn ($specialties) => $specialties->where('specialties.is_active', true),
            'media' => fn ($media) => $media->where('collection', 'photo'),
        ]);

        // Jadwal 14 hari (hari ini sampai hari ini + 13) dari sumber yang sama dengan #8 dan wizard (JDW-12).
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $sessions = $query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(
            doctorId: $doctor->id,
            from: $today,
            to: $today->addDays(13),
        ));

        $specialty = $doctor->primary_specialty;
        $title = filled($doctor->meta_title)
            ? (string) $doctor->meta_title
            : $doctor->display_name.($specialty !== null ? ' — '.$specialty->name : '');

        return view('public.doctors.show', [
            'doctor' => $doctor,
            'sessions' => $sessions,
            'title' => $title,
            'metaDescription' => Str::limit((string) ($doctor->meta_description ?: $doctor->short_bio), 160, ''),
        ]);
    }
```

`app/Http/Requests/Public/ScheduleIndexRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Requests\Public;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

/**
 * Filter halaman #8 Jadwal Dokter (05 hal. 8, 00 I.5): `minggu` (tanggal mana pun dalam minggu, `YYYY-MM-DD`),
 * `poli` dan `dokter` (slug). GET-filter longgar (12 V-45, VAL-07): nilai yang tidak lolos aturan diabaikan.
 * Penormalan `minggu` ke hari Senin dan pembatasan pada jendela pendaftaran dilakukan controller (F3-R24).
 */
final class ScheduleIndexRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, string>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'minggu' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d'],
            'poli' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:170'],
            'dokter' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:170'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'minggu.date_format' => 'Format minggu tidak valid. Menampilkan minggu ini.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Tidak melempar: filter yang tidak valid diabaikan dan halaman tetap tampil (VAL-07).
     */
    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator): void
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Hanya parameter yang lolos aturan (Validator::valid() mengembalikan seluruh input dikurangi yang gagal,
     * sehingga hasilnya diiris ke kunci yang beraturan).
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function filters(): array
    {
        $valid = $this->getValidatorInstance()->valid();
        $filters = [];

        foreach (['minggu', 'poli', 'dokter'] as $key) {
            $value = $valid[$key] ?? null;

            if (is_string($value) && trim($value) !== '') {
                $filters[$key] = trim($value);
            }
        }

        return $filters;
    }

    /** Pesan galat `minggu` untuk ditampilkan di atas jadwal, atau null bila kosong atau valid. */
    public function weekError(): ?string
    {
        $message = $this->getValidatorInstance()->errors()->first('minggu');

        return $message === '' ? null : $message;
    }
}
```


`app/Http/Controllers/Public/ScheduleController.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Public;

use App\Enums\ClinicType;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Public\ScheduleIndexRequest;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Services\Scheduling\AvailabilityFilter;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use App\Services\Scheduling\SessionAvailability;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\MessageBag;
use Illuminate\Support\ViewErrorBag;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Halaman #8 `schedules.index` (05 hal. 8, 07 W-05, F3-R24): jadwal satu minggu dari DoctorAvailabilityQuery, sumber
 * yang sama dengan #7 dan wizard (JDW-12). Dua tata letak dari koleksi yang sama: grid mingguan (layar >= md) dan
 * daftar bertumpuk per hari (layar kecil). Pembangkitan sesi harian dipicu di sini (F3-R9).
 */
class ScheduleController extends Controller
{
    public function index(
        ScheduleIndexRequest $request,
        PracticeSessionGenerator $generator,
        DoctorAvailabilityQuery $query,
        SettingsService $settings,
    ): View {
        $generator->ensureDailyHorizon();

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $lastDay = $today->addDays(max(1, $settings->bookingRules()->windowDays));
        $firstWeek = $today->startOfWeek(CarbonInterface::MONDAY);
        $lastWeek = $lastDay->startOfWeek(CarbonInterface::MONDAY);

        $filters = $request->filters();
        $notice = $request->weekError();
        $weekStart = $firstWeek;

        // `minggu` dinormalisasi ke Senin; di luar [minggu ini, minggu yang memuat hari terakhir jendela]
        // diganti minggu terdekat yang valid disertai pesan (F3-R24).
        if (isset($filters['minggu'])) {
            $requested = CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $filters['minggu'])->startOfWeek(CarbonInterface::MONDAY);

            if ($requested->lessThan($firstWeek)) {
                $notice = 'Menampilkan minggu ini.';
            } elseif ($requested->greaterThan($lastWeek)) {
                $weekStart = $lastWeek;
                $notice = 'Jadwal hanya tersedia sampai '.$lastDay->translatedFormat('j F Y').'.';
            } else {
                $weekStart = $requested;
            }
        }

        $weekEnd = $weekStart->addDays(6);

        $clinics = Clinic::query()->active()->where('type', ClinicType::Poliklinik->value)->ordered()->get(['id', 'name', 'slug']);
        $doctors = Doctor::query()->publiclyVisible()->ordered()->get(['id', 'name', 'slug', 'title_prefix', 'title_suffix']);
        $errors = new MessageBag;

        $clinic = null;

        if (isset($filters['poli'])) {
            $clinic = $clinics->firstWhere('slug', $filters['poli']);

            if ($clinic === null) {
                $errors->add('poli', 'Poliklinik tidak dikenal. Filter ini diabaikan.');
                unset($filters['poli']);
            }
        }

        $doctor = null;

        if (isset($filters['dokter'])) {
            $doctor = $doctors->firstWhere('slug', $filters['dokter']);

            if ($doctor === null) {
                $errors->add('dokter', 'Dokter tidak dikenal. Filter ini diabaikan.');
                unset($filters['dokter']);
            }
        }

        $items = $query->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(
            clinicId: $clinic?->id,
            doctorId: $doctor?->id,
            from: $weekStart,
            to: $weekEnd,
            includePast: true,
        ));

        $days = collect(range(0, 6))->map(fn (int $offset): CarbonImmutable => $weekStart->addDays($offset));
        $byDate = $items->groupBy(fn (SessionAvailability $item): string => $item->session->session_date->toDateString());

        // Baris grid: satu baris per dokter, urut sort_order lalu nama; sel = sesi dokter itu pada tanggal tersebut.
        $rows = $items
            ->groupBy(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => (int) $item->session->doctor_id)
            ->map(fn (Collection $group): array => [
                'doctor' => $group->first()->session->doctor,
                'cells' => $group->groupBy(fn (SessionAvailability $item): string => $item->session->session_date->toDateString()),
            ])
            ->sortBy(fn (array $row): string => sprintf('%05d|%s', $row['doctor']->sort_order, $row['doctor']->name))
            ->values();

        // Galat inline dibagikan ke semua view agar `x-form.select` melihatnya (lihat DoctorController@index).
        view()->share('errors', (new ViewErrorBag)->put('default', $errors));

        return view('public.schedules.index', [
            'items' => $items,
            'days' => $days,
            'byDate' => $byDate,
            'rows' => $rows,
            'weekStart' => $weekStart,
            'weekEnd' => $weekEnd,
            'weekLabel' => $weekStart->translatedFormat('j F').' – '.$weekEnd->translatedFormat('j F Y'),
            'previousWeek' => $weekStart->greaterThan($firstWeek) ? $weekStart->subWeek() : null,
            'nextWeek' => $weekStart->lessThan($lastWeek) ? $weekStart->addWeek() : null,
            'notice' => $notice,
            'filters' => $filters,
            'clinicOptions' => ['' => 'Semua poliklinik'] + $clinics->pluck('name', 'slug')->all(),
            'doctorOptions' => ['' => 'Semua dokter'] + $doctors->mapWithKeys(fn (Doctor $row): array => [$row->slug => $row->display_name])->all(),
        ]);
    }
}
```

### Task 15: Seeder demo jadwal (`DoctorScheduleSeeder`, `ScheduleExceptionSeeder`)

**Files:**
- Create: `database/seeders/DoctorScheduleSeeder.php`, `database/seeders/ScheduleExceptionSeeder.php`
- Modify: `database/seeders/DemoSeeder.php` (dua seeder dipanggil setelah `DoctorSeeder`)
- Modify (tes fase 2): `tests/Feature/Seeding/DemoSeederWiringTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Seeding/DemoSeederInvariantsTest.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Seeding/ScheduleSeederTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 4: `PracticeSessionGenerator::ensureRange()`.
  - Task 5: `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::forSession()`, `SettingsService::bookingRules()`.
  - Task 6–8: `ScheduleChangeService::applyException()`, `::setSessionStatus()`, `::createManualSession()`, `Actor::system()`.
  - Task 2: model `DoctorSchedule`, `ScheduleException`, `PracticeSession` (scope `onDate()`, `open()`, `notEnded()`; `created_by` lewat `forceFill`).
  - Fase 2: `DoctorSeeder::ROWS`, `DemoUserSeeder::ACCOUNTS`, pola penjaga lingkungan (`app()->environment(['local', 'testing'])` ⇒ `RuntimeException` "… DILARANG di APP_ENV=…").
- Produces:
  - `Database\Seeders\DoctorScheduleSeeder` (`ROWS`: 51 templat aktif, `INACTIVE_ROWS`: satu templat nonaktif dr. Eko, `CREATOR_EMAIL`): 13 §7.1 disalin persis (hari ISO, jam, kuota; `valid_from` = today − 45, `valid_until` NULL, `created_by` = Admin Konten Demo), lalu `ensureRange(today, today + booking.window_days)` **sekali** untuk seluruh templat.
  - `Database\Seeders\ScheduleExceptionSeeder` (`TODAY_BACKUP`, konstanta alasan): 13 §7.2–7.3 lewat model dan service: cuti dr. Dimas (today + 8 … today + 14, `applyException`), libur rumah sakit satu hari (tanggal pertama yang bukan Minggu pada atau setelah today + 16), sesi "Ditutup sementara (contoh)" dr. Citra (`setSessionStatus(Closed)`), sesi tambahan dr. Teguh 08:00–10:00 kuota 2 (`createManualSession`), dan sesi cadangan hari ini.
  - `DemoSeeder` memanggilnya setelah `DoctorSeeder` (13 §2.1).

**Test IDs:** SEED-01 (bagian jadwal), SEED-02 (penjaga lingkungan seeder baru), JDW-01 sisi data demo, JDW-13 sisi data demo, F3-R7 (tanpa sesi lampau), F3-R28 (tanggal sesi tambahan dr. Teguh, sesi tutup contoh).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Data persis 13 §7.** `ScheduleSeederTest` memegang oracle yang diketik ulang dari tabel 13 §7.1 (bukan dari konstanta seeder) dan membandingkannya per dokter: 52 templat, 51 aktif, dr. Eko satu-satunya nonaktif. Jumlah sesi pada 5 Oktober 2026 (Senin) adalah 230 sesi hasil templat (tanggal 5 Oktober s.d. 4 November, kedua ujung) + 1 sesi tambahan = 231; angka itu bergantung pada hari seeding, jadi tes mengunci tanggal dengan `travelTo`.
- **Sesi lampau tidak dibuat (F3-R7).** 13 §7.1 meminta `ensureRange(today − 14, today − 1)`, tetapi generator diklem ke hari ini (BR-22). Sesi lampau demo menyusul bersama appointment `completed`/`no_show` di fase 6/7.
- **Satu panggilan `ensureRange`.** Seeder tidak memanggil `ScheduleChangeService::applyTemplateCreated()` per templat (52 kali kueri dan audit); templat disimpan lewat model lalu generator dipanggil sekali. Tanpa audit per templat, sejalan dengan 12 §8 (seeder bukan aksi pengguna).
- **`created_by`.** Event `saving` model hanya mengisi dari `Auth::id()` (NULL di seeder), sehingga seeder mengisi `created_by`/`updated_by` lewat `forceFill` dengan akun `konten@unpamhospital.test` (bila ada).
- **Tanggal sesi tambahan dr. Teguh (F3-R28, K-5).** Mulai dari today + 2, maju satu hari selama hari ISO-nya termasuk hari templat aktif dr. Teguh (Senin, Kamis, Jumat, Sabtu). Pada Senin 5 Oktober hasilnya Rabu 7 Oktober; pada Selasa 6 Oktober, Kamis–Sabtu dilewati dan hasilnya Minggu 11 Oktober. `createManualSession` mengisi `is_manually_modified = true`; seeder menambahkan `status_reason` "Sesi tambahan (contoh)".
- **Sesi tutup contoh.** Sesi `open` pertama dr. Citra pada atau setelah today + 3, lewat `setSessionStatus(Closed, Actor::system(), "Ditutup sementara (contoh)")` (menyetel `is_manually_modified`).
- **Cadangan hari ini (13 §7.3).** Bila sesi `open` yang belum berakhir hari ini kurang dari 3 (mis. Minggu), seeder membuat sesi manual dr. Rani 08–11, dr. Sekar 13–16, dan dr. Laras 16–19 (kuota 20). Sesi yang sudah berakhir pada jam seeding atau yang bentrok ditolak service dengan `ValidationException` dan dilewati (tes: Minggu 07.00 ⇒ tiga sesi; Minggu 17.30 ⇒ hanya dr. Laras).
- **Idempoten.** Setiap templat, pengecualian (menurut `reason`), sesi tutup, dan sesi tambahan dilewati bila sudah ada; `ensureRange` idempoten. `DemoSeeder` tetap berhenti lebih awal bila akun demo sudah ada, sehingga seeder baru hanya berjalan sekali pada `migrate:fresh --seed`.
- **Tes cepat.** Gambar adalah bagian termahal seeding fase 2, jadi `ScheduleSeederTest` menyiapkan 18 dokter lewat factory dari `DoctorSeeder::ROWS` (tanpa media) dan hanya satu tes memakai `DatabaseSeeder` penuh (sekaligus menguji halaman publik dengan 16 dokter dan 231 sesi dalam mode ketat). Seeding setiap tes berjalan pada transaksi `RefreshDatabase` sendiri; seeding sekali per kelas tidak mungkin dengan transaksi itu, jadi tes digabung per tema (17 tes).
- **Efek ke tes fase 2.** `DemoSeederInvariantsTest` kini menjalankan seeder jadwal pada setiap tes (sekitar 230 sesi per seeding, tanpa gambar tambahan); jumlah media tetap 32.
- Jumlah tes baru: **17**. Semua blok PHP lolos `php -l` 8.2 dan `pint --test`; seluruh baris `ROWS` dicocokkan terhadap tabel 13 §7.1 dengan skrip; jangkar Edit dicocokkan dengan berkas nyata (tepat satu kali).

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Seeding;

use App\Enums\Availability;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use Closure;
use Database\Seeders\DatabaseSeeder;
use Database\Seeders\DemoUserSeeder;
use Database\Seeders\DoctorScheduleSeeder;
use Database\Seeders\DoctorSeeder;
use Database\Seeders\ScheduleExceptionSeeder;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Seeder demo jadwal (13 §7, F3-R7, F3-R28): 52 templat, sesi untuk hari ini s.d. hari ini + 30 (tanpa sesi lampau),
 * dua pengecualian lewat ScheduleChangeService, satu sesi ditutup, satu sesi tambahan manual dr. Teguh, dan sesi
 * cadangan hari ini. Prasyarat dibuat tanpa gambar (dokter dari DoctorSeeder::ROWS lewat factory) agar tes cepat;
 * satu tes memakai DatabaseSeeder penuh.
 */
class ScheduleSeederTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /**
     * Oracle yang diketik ulang dari 13 §7.1 (bukan dari konstanta seeder): "{hari ISO} {mulai}-{selesai} {kuota}".
     *
     * @var array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private const ORACLE = [
        'raka-pradipta-wibowo' => ['1 09:00-12:00 15', '3 09:00-12:00 15', '5 13:00-15:00 10'],
        'sekar-ayuningtyas' => ['1 08:00-11:00 20', '3 08:00-11:00 20', '5 08:00-11:00 20', '6 08:00-10:00 15'],
        'bagas-setiawan-nugroho' => ['2 13:00-16:00 20', '4 13:00-16:00 20', '6 10:00-12:00 15'],
        'laras-wulandari' => ['1 09:00-12:00 20', '2 09:00-12:00 20', '4 09:00-12:00 20', '6 09:00-11:00 15'],
        'dimas-aryaputra' => ['2 16:00-19:00 15', '3 13:00-16:00 20', '5 13:00-16:00 20'],
        'nadira-kusumawardani' => ['1 13:00-16:00 15', '3 13:00-16:00 15', '5 09:00-12:00 15'],
        'hendra-mahardika' => ['2 09:00-12:00 12', '4 09:00-12:00 12'],
        'maya-kartika-sari' => ['1 16:00-19:00 12', '4 16:00-19:00 12', '6 09:00-12:00 10'],
        'fajar-ramadhan-lubis' => ['2 13:00-16:00 15', '5 13:00-16:00 15'],
        'intan-permatasari' => ['2 08:00-11:00 20', '4 08:00-11:00 20', '6 08:00-11:00 15'],
        'yoga-prasetya' => ['1 13:00-16:00 15', '3 09:00-12:00 15', '5 16:00-19:00 15'],
        'citra-anindya-putri' => ['1 16:00-19:00 20', '3 16:00-19:00 20', '6 09:00-12:00 20'],
        'arif-budiman-santoso' => ['2 16:00-19:00 12', '4 13:00-16:00 12', '6 09:00-11:00 10'],
        'rani-oktaviani' => ['1 08:00-11:00 30', '2 08:00-11:00 30', '3 08:00-11:00 30', '4 08:00-11:00 30'],
        'teguh-wicaksono' => ['1 13:00-16:00 25', '4 16:00-19:00 25', '5 13:00-16:00 25', '6 08:00-11:00 30'],
        'ayu-larasati-hakim' => ['1 09:00-12:00 15', '3 13:00-16:00 15', '5 09:00-12:00 15', '6 09:00-12:00 15'],
        'eko-susanto' => ['2 13:00-16:00 12'],
    ];

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin
    }

    /**
     * Prasyarat seeder jadwal tanpa gambar: pengaturan, akun demo, dan 18 dokter dari DoctorSeeder::ROWS
     * (masing-masing dengan poliklinik sendiri), lewat factory.
     */
    private function seedPrerequisites(): void
    {
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->seed(DemoUserSeeder::class);

        foreach (DoctorSeeder::ROWS as $index => $row) {
            $clinic = Clinic::factory()->create(['name' => 'Poliklinik '.$row['name']]);

            Doctor::factory()->create([
                'clinic_id' => $clinic->id,
                'name' => $row['name'],
                'slug' => $row['slug'],
                'title_prefix' => $row['prefix'],
                'title_suffix' => $row['suffix'],
                'status' => $row['status'],
                'archived_at' => $row['status'] === 'archived' ? now()->subDays(30) : null,
                'sort_order' => $index + 1,
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function seedSchedules(): void
    {
        $this->seed(DoctorScheduleSeeder::class);
        $this->seed(ScheduleExceptionSeeder::class);
    }

    private function doctorId(string $slug): int
    {
        return (int) Doctor::query()->where('slug', $slug)->value('id');
    }

    // --- templat (13 §7.1) ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_templates_match_13_section_7_1_exactly(): void
    {
        $this->seedPrerequisites();
        $this->seedSchedules();

        $this->assertSame(52, DoctorSchedule::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(51, DoctorSchedule::query()->where('is_active', true)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, DoctorSchedule::query()->where('is_active', false)->count());

        $actual = DoctorSchedule::query()->with('doctor')->get()
            ->groupBy(fn (DoctorSchedule $schedule): string => $schedule->doctor->slug)
            ->map(fn ($group) => $group->map(fn (DoctorSchedule $schedule): string => sprintf(
                '%d %s-%s %d',
                $schedule->day_of_week,
                substr((string) $schedule->start_time, 0, 5),
                substr((string) $schedule->end_time, 0, 5),
                $schedule->quota,
            ))->sort()->values()->all())
            ->all();

        $expected = array_map(function (array $rows): array {
            sort($rows);

            return $rows;
        }, self::ORACLE);
        ksort($actual);
        ksort($expected);

        $this->assertSame($expected, $actual);
    }

    public function test_every_template_follows_the_demo_rules(): void
    {
        $this->seedPrerequisites();
        $this->seedSchedules();

        $creatorId = (int) User::query()->where('email', 'konten@unpamhospital.test')->value('id');
        $schedules = DoctorSchedule::query()->with('doctor')->get();

        foreach ($schedules as $schedule) {
            $this->assertSame($creatorId, (int) $schedule->created_by);
            $this->assertSame($schedule->doctor->clinic_id, $schedule->clinic_id);
            $this->assertSame('2026-08-21', $schedule->valid_from->toDateString(), 'valid_from = today - 45 hari');
            $this->assertNull($schedule->valid_until);
            $this->assertNotSame(7, $schedule->day_of_week, 'Tidak ada jadwal hari Minggu.');
            $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(10, $schedule->quota);
            $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(30, $schedule->quota);
            $this->assertSame($schedule->doctor->slug !== 'eko-susanto', $schedule->is_active);
        }

        // Tidak ada irisan jam pada hari yang sama untuk satu dokter.
        foreach ($schedules->where('is_active', true) as $schedule) {
            $this->assertFalse(
                DoctorSchedule::query()->overlapping(
                    $schedule->doctor_id,
                    $schedule->day_of_week,
                    substr((string) $schedule->start_time, 0, 5),
                    substr((string) $schedule->end_time, 0, 5),
                    $schedule->valid_from,
                    $schedule->valid_until,
                    $schedule->id,
                )->exists(),

    public function test_the_two_exceptions_are_created_and_cancel_their_sessions(): void
    {
        $this->seedPrerequisites();
        $this->seedSchedules();

        $creatorId = (int) User::query()->where('email', 'konten@unpamhospital.test')->value('id');
        $leave = ScheduleException::query()->where('type', ExceptionType::DoctorLeave->value)->sole();
        $holiday = ScheduleException::query()->where('type', ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday->value)->sole();

        $this->assertSame(2, ScheduleException::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame($this->doctorId('dimas-aryaputra'), $leave->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-13', $leave->start_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-19', $leave->end_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(7, (int) $leave->start_date->diffInDays($leave->end_date) + 1);
        $this->assertSame('Cuti tahunan (contoh)', $leave->reason);
        $this->assertSame($creatorId, (int) $leave->created_by);

        $this->assertNull($holiday->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-21', $holiday->start_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-21', $holiday->end_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('Contoh libur rumah sakit (bukan tanggal libur nasional)', $holiday->reason);
        $this->assertSame($creatorId, (int) $holiday->created_by);

        $leaveSessions = PracticeSession::query()->where('schedule_exception_id', $leave->id)->get();
        $holidaySessions = PracticeSession::query()->where('schedule_exception_id', $holiday->id)->get();

        $this->assertCount(3, $leaveSessions, 'Dimas: Selasa 13, Rabu 14, dan Jumat 16 Oktober.');
        $this->assertSame([$this->doctorId('dimas-aryaputra')], $leaveSessions->pluck('doctor_id')->unique()->values()->all());
        $this->assertCount(8, $holidaySessions, 'Delapan dokter praktik Rabu 21 Oktober.');
        $this->assertSame(8, PracticeSession::query()->where('session_date', '2026-10-21')->whereNotNull('doctor_schedule_id')->count());

        foreach ($leaveSessions->concat($holidaySessions) as $session) {
            $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $session->status);
            $this->assertNotNull($session->status_reason);
        }

        $this->assertSame(11, PracticeSession::query()->where('status', SessionStatus::Cancelled->value)->count());
        $this->assertSame(2, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'exception.created')->count());
    }

    public function test_both_seeders_refuse_to_run_outside_local_and_testing(): void
    {
        foreach ([DoctorScheduleSeeder::class, ScheduleExceptionSeeder::class] as $seeder) {
            foreach (['production', 'staging'] as $environment) {
                $thrown = null;

                $this->inEnvironment($environment, function () use (&$thrown, $seeder): void {
                    try {
                        $this->app->make($seeder)->run();
                    } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
                        $thrown = $e;
                    }
                });

                $this->assertInstanceOf(RuntimeException::class, $thrown, "{$seeder} di {$environment}");
                $this->assertStringContainsString('DILARANG di APP_ENV='.$environment, $thrown->getMessage());
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, DoctorSchedule::query()->count() + ScheduleException::query()->count() + PracticeSession::query()->count());
    }

    {

        $this->assertSame(231, PracticeSession::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(16, Doctor::query()->publiclyVisible()->count());

        $this->get(route('schedules.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Minggu 5 Oktober – 11 Oktober 2026')
            ->assertSee('dr. Sekar Ayuningtyas, Sp.PD')
            ->assertSee('dr. Rani Oktaviani');

        // Cuti dr. Dimas: 3 sesi pada grid, 3 pada daftar bertumpuk, dan 1 pada legenda.
        $leaveWeek = $this->get(route('schedules.index', ['minggu' => '2026-10-12']))->assertOk()->getContent();
        $this->assertSame(7, substr_count($leaveWeek, 'data-availability="leave"'));

        // Libur rumah sakit 21 Oktober: 8 sesi pada grid, 8 pada daftar bertumpuk, dan 1 pada legenda.
        $holidayWeek = $this->get(route('schedules.index', ['minggu' => '2026-10-19']))->assertOk()->getContent();
        $this->assertSame(17, substr_count($holidayWeek, 'data-availability="holiday"'));

        $this->get(route('doctors.show', 'teguh-wicaksono'))->assertOk()->assertSee('datetime="2026-10-07"', false)->assertSee('08.00–10.00');
        $this->get(route('doctors.show', 'eko-susanto'))->assertNotFound();
        $this->get(route('doctors.show', 'lilis-marlina'))->assertNotFound();
        $this->get(route('doctors.index', ['tanggal' => '2026-10-07']))->assertOk()->assertSee('Jadwal terdekat');
    }

    private function inEnvironment(string $environment, Closure $callback): void
    {
        $original = $this->app['env'];
        $this->app['env'] = $environment;

        try {
            $callback();
        } finally {
            $this->app['env'] = $original;
        }
    }
}
```

```php
    public function run(): void
    {
        if (! app()->environment(['local', 'testing'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('DoctorScheduleSeeder DILARANG di APP_ENV='.app()->environment().'. Seeder jadwal hanya untuk data demo.');
        }

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $creatorId = User::query()->where('email', self::CREATOR_EMAIL)->value('id');
        $doctors = Doctor::query()->get()->keyBy('slug');

        $rows = array_merge(
            array_map(fn (array $row): array => [...$row, true], self::ROWS),
            array_map(fn (array $row): array => [...$row, false], self::INACTIVE_ROWS),
        );

            $exists = DoctorSchedule::query()
                ->where('doctor_id', $doctor->id)
                ->where('day_of_week', $day)
                ->where('start_time', $start.':00')
                ->exists();

            if ($exists) {
                $this->command?->warn("Templat {$slug} hari {$day} {$start} sudah ada, dilewati.");

                continue;
            }

            // Seeder melewati Form Request: valid_from (45 hari lalu) sengaja di masa lalu agar sesi hari ini terbentuk.
            $schedule = new DoctorSchedule([
                'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
                'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
                'day_of_week' => $day,
                'start_time' => $start.':00',
                'end_time' => $end.':00',
                'quota' => $quota,
                'valid_from' => $today->subDays(45)->toDateString(),
                'valid_until' => null,
                'is_active' => $active,
                'notes' => null,
            ]);
            $schedule->forceFill(['created_by' => $creatorId, 'updated_by' => $creatorId]);
            $schedule->save();
        }

        // Sesi hanya untuk hari ini s.d. hari ini + booking.window_days (F3-R7: tanpa sesi lampau; sesi lampau demo
        // dibuat seeder appointment di fase 6/7, bukan generator).
        app(SettingsService::class)->forget();
        $windowDays = max(1, app(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules()->windowDays);
        $created = app(PracticeSessionGenerator::class)->ensureRange($today, $today->addDays($windowDays));

        $this->command?->info("{$created} sesi praktik dibangkitkan untuk {$today->format('d/m/Y')} s.d. {$today->addDays($windowDays)->format('d/m/Y')}.");
    }
}
```

`database/seeders/ScheduleExceptionSeeder.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\DoctorSchedule;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use RuntimeException;

class ScheduleExceptionSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public const LEAVE_DOCTOR = 'dimas-aryaputra';

    public const LEAVE_REASON = 'Cuti tahunan (contoh)';

    public const HOLIDAY_REASON = 'Contoh libur rumah sakit (bukan tanggal libur nasional)';

    public const CLOSED_DOCTOR = 'citra-anindya-putri';

    public const CLOSED_REASON = 'Ditutup sementara (contoh)';

    public const EXTRA_DOCTOR = 'teguh-wicaksono';

    public const EXTRA_REASON = 'Sesi tambahan (contoh)';

    /**
     * Cadangan hari ini (13 §7.3): bila hari seeding punya kurang dari 3 sesi `open` yang belum berakhir (mis. Minggu),
     * dibuat sesi manual agar skenario "hari ini" selalu punya sesi. [slug dokter, jam mulai, jam selesai].
     *
     * @var list<array{string, string, string}>
     */
    public const TODAY_BACKUP = [
        ['rani-oktaviani', '08:00', '11:00'],
        ['sekar-ayuningtyas', '13:00', '16:00'],
        ['laras-wulandari', '16:00', '19:00'],
    ];

    public function run(): void
    {
        if (! app()->environment(['local', 'testing'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('ScheduleExceptionSeeder DILARANG di APP_ENV='.app()->environment().'. Seeder jadwal hanya untuk data demo.');
        }

        $service = app(ScheduleChangeService::class);
        $actor = Actor::system();
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $creatorId = User::query()->where('email', DoctorScheduleSeeder::CREATOR_EMAIL)->value('id');
        $doctors = Doctor::query()->get()->keyBy('slug');

        $this->seedLeave($service, $actor, $doctors->get(self::LEAVE_DOCTOR), $today, $creatorId);
        $this->seedHoliday($service, $actor, $today, $creatorId);
        $this->seedClosedSession($service, $actor, $doctors->get(self::CLOSED_DOCTOR), $today);
        $this->seedExtraSession($service, $actor, $doctors->get(self::EXTRA_DOCTOR), $today);
        $this->seedTodayBackup($service, $actor, $doctors, $today);
    }

    /** Pengecualian #1: cuti dr. Dimas, today + 8 s.d. today + 14 (tepat 7 hari, selalu memuat Sel/Rab/Jum). */
    private function seedLeave(ScheduleChangeService $service, Actor $actor, ?Doctor $doctor, CarbonImmutable $today, ?int $creatorId): void
    {
        if ($doctor === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Dokter '.self::LEAVE_DOCTOR.' belum ada. Jalankan DoctorSeeder lebih dulu.');
        }

        $this->createException($service, $actor, [
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
            'start_date' => $today->addDays(8)->toDateString(),
            'end_date' => $today->addDays(14)->toDateString(),
            'reason' => self::LEAVE_REASON,
        ], $creatorId);
    }

    /** Pengecualian #2: libur rumah sakit satu hari, tanggal pertama yang bukan Minggu pada atau setelah today + 16. */
    private function seedHoliday(ScheduleChangeService $service, Actor $actor, CarbonImmutable $today, ?int $creatorId): void
    {
        $date = $today->addDays(16);

        if ($date->isSunday()) {
            $date = $date->addDay();
        }

        $this->createException($service, $actor, [
            'doctor_id' => null,
            'type' => ExceptionType::HospitalHoliday,
            'start_date' => $date->toDateString(),
            'end_date' => $date->toDateString(),
            'reason' => self::HOLIDAY_REASON,
        ], $creatorId);
    }

    /**
     * Baris pengecualian lalu `applyException`, sehingga sesi terkait otomatis `cancelled` dengan
     * `schedule_exception_id` terisi. Dilewati bila alasan yang sama sudah ada (idempoten).
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    private function createException(ScheduleChangeService $service, Actor $actor, array $attributes, ?int $creatorId): void
    {
        if (ScheduleException::query()->where('reason', $attributes['reason'])->exists()) {
            $this->command?->warn("Pengecualian \"{$attributes['reason']}\" sudah ada, dilewati.");

            return;
        }

        $exception = new ScheduleException($attributes);
        $exception->forceFill(['created_by' => $creatorId]);
        $exception->save();

        $service->applyException($exception, null, $actor);
    }

    /** Sesi "Ditutup sementara (contoh)": sesi terbuka pertama dr. Citra pada atau setelah today + 3. */
    private function seedClosedSession(ScheduleChangeService $service, Actor $actor, ?Doctor $doctor, CarbonImmutable $today): void
    {
        if ($doctor === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Dokter '.self::CLOSED_DOCTOR.' belum ada. Jalankan DoctorSeeder lebih dulu.');
        }

        if (PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_id', $doctor->id)->where('status_reason', self::CLOSED_REASON)->exists()) {
            $this->command?->warn('Sesi "'.self::CLOSED_REASON.'" sudah ada, dilewati.');

            return;
        }

        $session = PracticeSession::query()
            ->where('doctor_id', $doctor->id)
            ->where('status', SessionStatus::Open->value)
            ->where('session_date', '>=', $today->addDays(3)->toDateString())
            ->orderBy('session_date')
            ->orderBy('start_time')
            ->first();

        if ($session === null) {
            $this->command?->warn('Tidak ada sesi dr. Citra pada atau setelah today + 3; sesi tutup contoh dilewati.');

            return;
        }

        $service->setSessionStatus($session, SessionStatus::Closed, $actor, self::CLOSED_REASON);
    }

    /**
     * Sesi tambahan manual dr. Teguh 08:00-10:00, kuota 2: tanggal pertama pada atau setelah today + 2 yang hari ISO-nya
     * bukan hari templat dr. Teguh (K-5, F3-R28), sehingga tidak pernah bentrok dengan sesi hasil templat.
     */
    private function seedExtraSession(ScheduleChangeService $service, Actor $actor, ?Doctor $doctor, CarbonImmutable $today): void
    {
        if ($doctor === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Dokter '.self::EXTRA_DOCTOR.' belum ada. Jalankan DoctorSeeder lebih dulu.');
        }

        if (PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_id', $doctor->id)->where('status_reason', self::EXTRA_REASON)->exists()) {
            $this->command?->warn('Sesi "'.self::EXTRA_REASON.'" sudah ada, dilewati.');

            return;
        }

        $templateDays = DoctorSchedule::query()->where('doctor_id', $doctor->id)->where('is_active', true)->pluck('day_of_week')->all();
        $date = $today->addDays(2);

        while (in_array($date->isoWeekday(), $templateDays, true)) {
            $date = $date->addDay();
        }

        $session = $service->createManualSession([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date->toDateString(),
            'start_time' => '08:00',
            'end_time' => '10:00',
            'quota' => 2,
        ], $actor);

        $session->forceFill(['status_reason' => self::EXTRA_REASON])->save();
    }

    /**
     * Cadangan hari ini (13 §7.3). Sesi yang sudah berakhir pada jam seeding, atau yang bentrok dengan sesi dokter itu
     * hari ini, dilewati (ditolak service dengan ValidationException).
     *
     * @param  Collection<string, Doctor>  $doctors
     */
    private function seedTodayBackup(ScheduleChangeService $service, Actor $actor, Collection $doctors, CarbonImmutable $today): void
    {
        $openToday = PracticeSession::query()
            ->onDate($today)
            ->open()
            ->notEnded()
            ->count();

        if ($openToday >= 3) {
            return;
        }

        foreach (self::TODAY_BACKUP as [$slug, $start, $end]) {
            $doctor = $doctors->get($slug);

            if ($doctor === null) {
                continue;
            }

            try {
                $service->createManualSession([
                    'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
                    'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
                    'session_date' => $today->toDateString(),
                    'start_time' => $start,
                    'end_time' => $end,
                    'quota' => 20,
                ], $actor);
            } catch (ValidationException) {
                $this->command?->warn("Sesi cadangan hari ini {$slug} {$start}-{$end} dilewati.");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Access;

use App\Models\Media;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMedia;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * 15 §3.1 baris 4 sampai 8 dan §3.3 baris 31, 31b, 32, 33, 33b, 34, 35, 35b, 35d × lima aktor (AKS-01 sampai AKS-05),
 * ditambah matriks mutasi non-GET (15 §3 catatan) untuk modul master data, media, dan jadwal.
 * Hasil: 200 = tampil, 403 = ditolak, L = redirect ke admin.login, D = redirect dasbor sesuai tipe akun,
 * OK = lolos otorisasi (200/201/204/302/422, bukan 403/login), G = tamu (redirect login atau 401 JSON).
 * Baris 35c (`admin.sessions.review`, Sesi Terdampak) menyusul di fase 7 bersama route-nya.
 */
class AdminPageMatrixTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithMedia;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const ACTORS = ['guest', 'patient', 'content-admin', 'registration-officer', 'super-admin'];

    /** Hasil mutasi untuk route berizin kelola: Tamu G, Pasien 403, Admin Konten OK, Petugas 403, Super Admin OK. */
    private const MANAGE = ['G', '403', 'OK', '403', 'OK'];

    /** @return array<string, array{string, ?string, string, string}> */
    public static function matrix(): array
    {
        // Urutan hasil mengikuti ACTORS: Tamu, Pasien, Admin Konten, Petugas, Super Admin.
        $rows = [
            '31 Login admin' => ['admin.login', null, ['200', 'D', 'D', 'D', 'D']],

    /** @return array<string, array{string, ?string, string}> */
    public static function publicMatrix(): array
    {
        $cases = [];

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string, ?string, string, string}> */
    public static function mutations(): array
    {
        // Hasil ditentukan per baris: [metode, route, jenis parameter, hasil menurut urutan ACTORS].
        $rows = [
            'POST dokter baru' => ['post', 'admin.doctors.store', null, self::MANAGE],
            'PUT ubah dokter' => ['put', 'admin.doctors.update', 'doctor', self::MANAGE],

            'PUT ubah spesialisasi' => ['put', 'admin.specialties.update', 'specialty', self::MANAGE],
            'DELETE spesialisasi' => ['delete', 'admin.specialties.destroy', 'specialty', self::MANAGE],
            'POST poliklinik baru' => ['post', 'admin.clinics.store', null, self::MANAGE],
            'PUT ubah poliklinik' => ['put', 'admin.clinics.update', 'clinic', self::MANAGE],
            'DELETE poliklinik' => ['delete', 'admin.clinics.destroy', 'clinic', self::MANAGE],

            'POST urutkan media' => ['post', 'admin.media.reorder', null, self::MANAGE],
            'PATCH ubah media dokter' => ['patch', 'admin.media.update', 'doctor-media', self::MANAGE],
            'DELETE media dokter' => ['delete', 'admin.media.destroy', 'doctor-media', self::MANAGE],
            'POST templat jadwal baru' => ['post', 'admin.schedules.store', null, self::MANAGE],
            'PUT ubah templat jadwal' => ['put', 'admin.schedules.update', 'schedule', self::MANAGE],
            'DELETE templat jadwal' => ['delete', 'admin.schedules.destroy', 'schedule', self::MANAGE],
            'POST pengecualian baru' => ['post', 'admin.exceptions.store', null, self::MANAGE],
            'PUT ubah pengecualian' => ['put', 'admin.exceptions.update', 'exception', self::MANAGE],
            'DELETE pengecualian' => ['delete', 'admin.exceptions.destroy', 'exception', self::MANAGE],
            'POST sesi tambahan manual' => ['post', 'admin.sessions.store', null, self::MANAGE],
            'PUT ubah sesi' => ['put', 'admin.sessions.update', 'session', self::MANAGE],
            'PATCH status sesi' => ['patch', 'admin.sessions.status', 'session', self::MANAGE],
            'DELETE sesi (35d)' => ['delete', 'admin.sessions.destroy', 'session', self::MANAGE],
        ];

        $cases = [];

        foreach ($rows as $label => [$method, $routeName, $kind, $expected]) {
            foreach (self::ACTORS as $index => $actor) {
                $cases["{$label} / {$actor}"] = [$method, $routeName, $kind, $actor, $expected[$index]];
            }
        }

        return $cases;
    }

    #[DataProvider('matrix')]
    public function test_admin_page_matrix(string $routeName, ?string $kind, string $actor, string $expected): void
    {
        $user = $this->userFor($actor);

        if ($user !== null) {
            $this->actingAs($user);
        }

        $response = $this->get(route($routeName, $this->parameters($kind)));

        match ($expected) {
            '200' => $response->assertOk(),
            '403' => $response->assertForbidden(),
            'L' => $response->assertRedirect(route('admin.login')),
            'D' => $response->assertRedirect($this->dashboardFor($actor)),
        };
    }

    #[DataProvider('publicMatrix')]
    public function test_public_page_matrix_is_open_to_every_actor(string $routeName, ?string $kind, string $actor): void
    {
        $user = $this->userFor($actor);

        if ($user !== null) {
            $this->actingAs($user);
        }

        $this->get(route($routeName, $this->parameters($kind)))->assertOk();
    }

    #[DataProvider('mutations')]
    public function test_mutation_matrix_denies_actors_without_permission(string $method, string $routeName, ?string $kind, string $actor, string $expected): void
    {
        $user = $this->userFor($actor);

        if ($user !== null) {
            $this->actingAs($user);
        }

        $response = $this->{$method}(route($routeName, $this->parameters($kind)));

        match ($expected) {
            '403' => $response->assertForbidden(),
            'G' => $this->assertGuestRejected($response->getStatusCode(), (string) $response->headers->get('Location')),
            'OK' => $this->assertAuthorized($response->getStatusCode(), (string) $response->headers->get('Location')),
        };
    }

    public function test_patient_is_forbidden_from_admin_doctor_urls_aks_06(): void
    {
        $patient = User::factory()->patient()->create();

        $this->actingAs($patient)->get('/admin/dokter')->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($patient)->post('/admin/dokter')->assertForbidden();
    }

    public function test_patient_is_forbidden_from_admin_schedule_urls(): void
    {
        $patient = User::factory()->patient()->create();

        $this->actingAs($patient)->get('/admin/jadwal')->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($patient)->get('/admin/jadwal/sesi')->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($patient)->get('/admin/jadwal/pengecualian')->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($patient)->post('/admin/jadwal')->assertForbidden();
    }

    private function assertGuestRejected(int $status, string $location): void
    {
        $this->assertContains($status, [302, 401], "Tamu harus dialihkan ke login atau menerima 401, bukan {$status}.");

        if ($status === 302) {
            $this->assertSame(route('admin.login'), $location);
        }
    }

    private function assertAuthorized(int $status, string $location): void
    {
        $this->assertContains($status, [200, 201, 204, 302, 422], "Aktor berhak tidak boleh menerima {$status}.");
        $this->assertNotSame(route('admin.login'), $location);
    }

    /** @return array<string, int|string> */
    private function parameters(?string $kind): array
    {
        return match ($kind) {
            null => [],
            'doctor' => ['doctor' => $this->createDoctor()->id],
            'clinic' => ['clinic' => $this->createClinic()->id],
            'specialty' => ['specialty' => $this->createSpecialty()->id],
            'public-clinic' => ['clinic' => $this->createClinic()->slug],
            'public-doctor' => ['doctor' => $this->createDoctor()->slug],
            'doctor-media' => ['media' => $this->doctorPhotoRow()->id],
            'schedule' => ['schedule' => $this->createSchedule()->id],
            'session' => ['session' => $this->createSession()->id],
            'exception' => ['exception' => $this->createException()->id],
        };
    }

    private function doctorPhotoRow(): Media
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();

        return $this->createMediaRow([
            'model_type' => $doctor->getMorphClass(),
            'model_id' => $doctor->id,
            'collection' => 'photo',
            'directory' => 'photo/2026/10',
        ]);
    }

    private function userFor(string $actor): ?User
    {
        return match ($actor) {
            'guest' => null,
            'patient' => User::factory()->patient()->create(),
            default => $this->createStaff($actor),
        };
    }

    private function dashboardFor(string $actor): string
    {
        if ($actor === 'patient') {
            return Route::has('patient.dashboard') ? route('patient.dashboard') : route('home');
        }

        return route('admin.dashboard');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Access;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * KNS-01 (bagian fase 3), KNS-02 (route admin berizin), dan bagian route dari CRD-13: nama route, izin, URI,
 * urutan segmen statis sebelum berparameter, dan route yang sengaja tidak ada.
 */
class Phase3RoutePermissionTest extends TestCase
{
    private const VIEW = 'permission:schedules.view';

    private const MANAGE = 'permission:schedules.manage';

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string}> */
    public static function permissions(): array
    {
        $rows = [];

        foreach (['schedules', 'exceptions'] as $resource) {
            $rows["admin.{$resource}.index"] = self::VIEW;

            foreach (['create', 'store', 'edit', 'update', 'destroy'] as $action) {
                $rows["admin.{$resource}.{$action}"] = self::MANAGE;
            }
        }

        $rows['admin.sessions.index'] = self::VIEW;

        foreach (['create', 'store', 'edit', 'update', 'status', 'destroy'] as $action) {
            $rows["admin.sessions.{$action}"] = self::MANAGE;
        }

        $cases = [];

        foreach ($rows as $name => $permission) {
            $cases[$name] = [$name, $permission];
        }

        return $cases;
    }

    #[DataProvider('permissions')]
    public function test_route_exists_with_the_documented_permission_middleware(string $name, string $permission): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);

        $this->assertNotNull($route, "Route {$name} belum terdaftar.");

        $middleware = array_filter($route->gatherMiddleware(), 'is_string');
        $this->assertContains($permission, $middleware, "Route {$name} harus memakai {$permission}.");
        $this->assertContains('auth', $middleware, "Route {$name} harus berada di grup admin yang memakai auth.");
        $this->assertCount(1, array_filter($middleware, fn (string $item): bool => str_starts_with($item, 'permission:')), "Route {$name} hanya boleh memakai satu middleware izin.");
    }

    public function test_the_phase_3_admin_route_names_are_exactly_the_nineteen_documented_ones(): void
    {
        $names = [];

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $route) {
            $name = (string) $route->getName();

            if (preg_match('/^admin\.(schedules|exceptions|sessions)\./', $name) === 1) {
                $names[] = $name;
            }
        }

        sort($names);

        $this->assertSame(19, count($names));
        $this->assertSame(array_values(array_unique($names)), $names, 'Nama route tidak boleh ganda.');
        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing(
            array_keys(self::permissions()),
            $names,
            'Hanya route fase 3 yang terdaftar; Sesi Terdampak (`admin.sessions.review`, `.resolve`) menyusul di fase 7 dan mengubah daftar ini.',
        );
    }

    public function test_public_schedule_routes_are_open_get_routes_without_auth_or_permission_middleware(): void
    {
        foreach (['doctors.index' => '/dokter', 'doctors.show' => '/dokter/{doctor}', 'schedules.index' => '/jadwal-dokter'] as $name => $uri) {
            $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);

            $this->assertNotNull($route, "Route {$name} belum terdaftar.");
            $this->assertSame(['GET', 'HEAD'], $route->methods());
            $this->assertSame(ltrim($uri, '/'), $route->uri());

            foreach (array_filter($route->gatherMiddleware(), 'is_string') as $middleware) {
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString('permission:', $middleware, "{$name}: {$middleware}");
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString('auth', $middleware, "{$name}: {$middleware}");
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString('account:', $middleware, "{$name}: {$middleware}");
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_the_doctor_detail_route_binds_by_slug(): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('doctors.show');

        $this->assertSame('slug', $route->bindingFieldFor('doctor'));
    }

    public function test_routes_that_must_not_exist_are_absent(): void
    {
        foreach (['admin.schedules.show', 'admin.sessions.show', 'admin.exceptions.show'] as $name) {
            $this->assertNull(Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name), "{$name} tidak boleh ada (00 I.6).");
        }
    }

    public function test_crd_13_destroy_routes_do_not_exist_for_entities_that_are_never_deleted(): void
    {
        $forbidden = ['doctors', 'patients', 'appointments', 'pages', 'messages', 'staff', 'roles', 'audit-logs'];

        foreach (Route::getRoutes()->getRoutes() as $route) {
            $name = (string) $route->getName();

            foreach ($forbidden as $entity) {
                $this->assertNotSame("admin.{$entity}.destroy", $name, "{$name} tidak boleh ada (00 C, BR-03).");
            }

            if (str_starts_with($route->uri(), 'admin/dokter')) {
                $this->assertNotContains('DELETE', $route->methods(), "Dokter tidak boleh punya route DELETE ({$route->uri()}).");
            }
        }

        $this->assertNotNull(Route::getRoutes()->getByName('admin.sessions.destroy'), 'admin.sessions.destroy ada (00 I.4, F3-R20).');
    }

    public function test_uris_use_indonesian_segments(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal', route('admin.schedules.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/buat', route('admin.schedules.create', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/7/ubah', route('admin.schedules.edit', 7, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/sesi', route('admin.sessions.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/sesi/buat', route('admin.sessions.create', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/sesi/7/ubah', route('admin.sessions.edit', 7, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/sesi/7/status', route('admin.sessions.status', 7, false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/pengecualian', route('admin.exceptions.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/pengecualian/buat', route('admin.exceptions.create', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/admin/jadwal/pengecualian/7/ubah', route('admin.exceptions.edit', 7, false));
        $this->assertSame('/dokter', route('doctors.index', [], false));
        $this->assertSame('/dokter/raka-pradipta-wibowo', route('doctors.show', 'raka-pradipta-wibowo', false));
        $this->assertSame('/jadwal-dokter', route('schedules.index', [], false));
    }

    public function test_static_segments_are_matched_before_parameterised_routes(): void
    {
        $routes = Route::getRoutes();

        $this->assertSame('admin.schedules.create', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/buat', 'GET'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.sessions.index', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/sesi', 'GET'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.sessions.create', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/sesi/buat', 'GET'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.sessions.status', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/sesi/7/status', 'PATCH'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.sessions.destroy', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/sesi/7', 'DELETE'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.exceptions.index', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/pengecualian', 'GET'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.exceptions.create', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/pengecualian/buat', 'GET'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.exceptions.destroy', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/pengecualian/7', 'DELETE'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('admin.schedules.destroy', $routes->match(Request::create('/admin/jadwal/7', 'DELETE'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('doctors.index', $routes->match(Request::create('/dokter', 'GET'))->getName());
        $this->assertSame('doctors.show', $routes->match(Request::create('/dokter/dr-contoh', 'GET'))->getName());
    }

    public function test_the_schedule_module_tabs_follow_the_documented_configuration(): void
    {
        $tabs = config('navigation.modules.schedules');

        $this->assertSame(
            ['admin.schedules.index', 'admin.sessions.index', 'admin.exceptions.index', 'admin.sessions.review'],
            array_column($tabs, 'route'),
        );
        $this->assertSame(
            ['schedules.view', 'schedules.view', 'schedules.view', 'sessions.review'],
            array_column($tabs, 'permission'),
        );
    }
}
```

````markdown
```

## Fase 3 — Penjadwalan (templat, pengecualian, sesi, dan jadwal publik)

Yang tersedia:
- **Jadwal Praktik** di <http://unpam-hospital.test/admin/jadwal> dengan tiga tab: **Templat Mingguan** (`/admin/jadwal`), **Sesi per Tanggal** (`/admin/jadwal/sesi`), dan **Pengecualian** (cuti dan libur, `/admin/jadwal/pengecualian`). Tab **Sesi Terdampak** muncul otomatis setelah fasenya (fase 7).
- Halaman publik **Cari Dokter** (`/dokter`), **Detail Dokter** (`/dokter/{slug}`), dan **Jadwal Dokter** (`/jadwal-dokter`), semuanya memakai satu sumber jadwal (`DoctorAvailabilityQuery`).
- Perintah `sessions:generate` dan jadwal harian pukul 00.05, serta skema booking (`patient_profiles`, `appointments`, `appointment_status_histories`) yang baru berupa tabel, model, dan factory. Pendaftaran kunjungan sungguhan (wizard dan `BookingService`) menyusul di fase 6.

### Hak akses

| Peran | Lihat jadwal | Kelola jadwal (tambah, ubah, hapus) | Sesi Terdampak |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Super Admin | ya | ya | ya (fase 7) |
| Admin Konten | ya | ya | tidak |
| Petugas Pendaftaran | ya | tidak | ya (fase 7) |

Admin Konten hanya melihat jumlah terisi dan kuota per sesi ("Terisi"), tidak pernah nama atau data pasien. Halaman publik #6, #7, dan #8 terbuka untuk semua orang; dokter nonaktif, arsip, atau di poliklinik nonaktif menjawab 404 di URL detailnya, juga untuk staf yang login.

### Pembangkitan sesi

Sesi dibangkitkan dari templat mingguan untuk hari ini sampai hari ini + `booking.window_days` (30 hari) lewat tiga pemicu: setiap simpan templat atau pengecualian, sekali per hari saat halaman #6, #7, atau #8 dibuka, dan perintah manual:

```powershell
& $PHP artisan sessions:generate            # jendela bawaan (booking.window_days)
& $PHP artisan sessions:generate --days=45  # 1-120 hari
& $PHP artisan schedule:list                # sessions:generate dijadwalkan harian pukul 00.05
```

Windows Task Scheduler (blueprint 16 §11.1) bersifat opsional; tanpa itu, halaman publik tetap membangkitkan sesi sekali per hari.

### Aturan yang berlaku untuk semua peran, termasuk Super Admin

Sesi yang sudah berakhir tidak dapat diubah, ditutup, dibatalkan, atau dihapus. Kuota sesi tidak boleh di bawah jumlah terisi. Templat atau sesi yang sudah punya pendaftaran tidak dapat dihapus (nonaktifkan, tutup, atau batalkan). Dokter arsip tidak dapat diberi jadwal, dan dokter dengan pendaftaran aktif pada sesi mendatang tidak dapat diarsipkan.

### Data demo

```powershell
& $PHP artisan migrate:fresh --seed   # LOKAL SAJA: menghapus semua tabel dan isi database unpam_hospital
```

Selain data fase 1–2: 52 templat jadwal (51 aktif, 1 nonaktif milik dokter nonaktif), sesi untuk hari ini sampai hari ini + 30 (tanpa sesi lampau; sekitar 230 sesi), cuti 7 hari dr. Dimas, satu hari libur rumah sakit, satu sesi "Ditutup sementara (contoh)" dr. Citra, dan satu sesi tambahan dr. Teguh berkuota 2. Seluruh tanggal relatif terhadap hari seeding. Appointment demo menyusul di fase 6.

### Pemeriksaan cepat (fase 3)

& $PHP artisan route:list --path=admin   # 50 route admin (31 fase 1-2 + 19 fase 3)
& $PHP artisan route:list --except-path=admin --name=doctors     # doctors.index dan doctors.show (publik)
& $PHP artisan route:list --except-path=admin --name=schedules   # schedules.index (publik)
& $PHP artisan test                      # seluruh suite
npm run build                            # gaya grid jadwal ikut dibundel
```
````

## Catatan Eksekusi (2026-10-05)

Dieksekusi dengan `superpowers:subagent-driven-development`. Semua peran memakai subagent **Sonnet 5.5** (preferensi pemilik): implementer, reviewer per tugas, re-reviewer, final reviewer, dan implementer gelombang perbaikan final. Eksekusi berlangsung 2026-10-05 dalam dua sesi. Sesi pertama dijeda atas permintaan pemilik (ganti jaringan) tepat saat gelombang perbaikan final dimulai. Pekerjaan F1 yang setengah jadi disimpan di `git stash`, lalu dilanjutkan di sesi berikutnya tanpa kehilangan pekerjaan.

Cabang `fase-3-jadwal-dokter` dibuat dari `master` (`af4fd02`). Isinya dua commit penyusunan rencana (`df790d7`, `5f9af09`) dan 29 commit kerja (`083ff72`..`606cfbe`), ditambah commit CHECKPOINT `f838eb7` dan commit catatan ini.

**Hasil akhir:**

| Pemeriksaan | Hasil |
|---|---|
| `artisan test` | **2933 tes lulus (14113 asersi)** setelah gelombang perbaikan final; sebelumnya 2925 di `4f79823` |
| `pint --test` | PASS |
| `npm run build` | Sukses |
| `route:list --path=admin` | 50 route (31 fase 1–2 + 19 baru di `admin/jadwal`) |
| `migrate:fresh --seed` (DB pengembangan, Step 13) | OK setelah izin pemilik ("Ya, jalankan"). Hitungan: 52 templat (51 aktif), 2 pengecualian, 231 sesi untuk hari ini s.d. +30, 0 sesi lampau, 11 batal, 1 ditutup, 1 sesi tambahan, 18 dokter. `sessions:generate` → 0 sesi baru; `--days=45` → 110 sesi baru. `media:prune` membersihkan 68 berkas yatim dari isi DB lama, sehingga `--dry-run` kini 0/0. |
| Smoke publik | `/dokter` 200, `/jadwal-dokter` 200, `/dokter/eko-susanto` (nonaktif) 404. |
| MANUAL (Step 14) | Dijalankan koordinator lewat Playwright; laporan bergambar ada di `Documents\UNPAM-Uji-Manual-2026-10-05-fase-3\index.html`. Kelompok 1–6 sesuai: publik desktop dan 360 px, Admin Konten, Petugas, Super Admin, 404 untuk staf, serta 0 galat JS, 0 pelanggaran CSP, dan 0 atribut event inline. Lighthouse aksesibilitas awalnya 97/96/97 dengan dua temuan kontras: M1 tautan navbar publik dan M2 tombol Reset `btn-outline-secondary` di #6/#8. Setelah perbaikan (`606cfbe`), skornya **100/100/100**. Audit yang masih gagal hanya HTTPS, yang wajar untuk server lokal. |

### Bawaan (carry) untuk rencana fase berikutnya

**Fase 6 (Booking):**
- F1 sudah masuk (`49f966a`). Penulis booking wajib mengunci sesi lebih dulu dengan urutan kunci yang sama dengan `ScheduleChangeService`.
- `assertClinicChangeAllowed` dan cek arsip dokter (`futureActiveAppointmentsCount`) berupa *check-then-act*; uji ulang di bawah kunci booking.
- `createManualSession` membaca poliklinik tanpa kunci.
- Siklus referensi `Doctor → availabilities → session → doctor` dari `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::doctors()`: jangan diserialisasi apa adanya.
- Tes konkurensi tanpa transaksi wajib ikut membersihkan `audit_logs` (pola baseline id di `ConcurrencySpikeTest`).

**Fase 7 (Sesi Terdampak):**
- Saat *resolve*, cek ulang status dokter, karena sumber `doctor_inactive` bisa tergantikan `exception`.
- Perbarui `Phase3RoutePermissionTest` (19 → 20 route) dan angka `route admin: 50`.
- Ganti tes tautan banner yang ter-skip dengan tes positif.

**Minor final review yang ditunda (tidak memblokir):**
- Reaktivasi dokter tanpa petunjuk tentang sesi yang sudah dibatalkan, dan tanpa `ensureRange`.
- `status_reason` basi saat jenis atau alasan pengecualian diubah.
- Penanda pembangkitan harian mengabaikan `window_days` baru.
- Sesi `closed` yang diblokir pengecualian kembali `open` saat pengecualian dicabut.
- #6 dengan `tanggal` = hari ini menampilkan "Sudah lewat" untuk sesi yang jamnya lewat.

**Minor per tugas yang ditunda** (sebagian besar celah tes kecil atau kosmetik). Yang paling layak dikerjakan saat menyentuh area terkait:
- Modal hapus templat dan pengecualian dijaga `@can('create')`, sedangkan tombolnya `@can('delete')`.
- `og:description` kosong bila `meta_description` dan `short_bio` kosong.
- Legenda #7 tidak tampil saat jadwal kosong.
- Sesi tambahan dr. Teguh di seeder tidak atomik.
- Format "HH.MM" terduplikasi (`DoctorSchedule::displayTime` vs `PracticeSession::timeRange`).
- Sisa teks 07 W-03 (`[ Lihat Jadwal ]`, "Dokter tidak ditemukan") dan 00 J.6 `NoOverlapping*`.
- README "sekitar 230 sesi" vs 09 "±230–260".
- Tes F1 hanya mengasersi teks SQL `for update`, tanpa simulasi penulis konkuren.

**Catatan uji manual:**
- DB pengembangan memuat sedikit data dari uji manual: templat dr. Bagas Senin 10.00–13.00 kuota 15. Untuk data demo murni, jalankan `migrate:fresh --seed`.
